generated_sql: SELECT it.type_name AS image_type_name, `if`.format_name AS image_format_name, AVG(ia.metric_value) AS avg_metric_value FROM images AS i JOIN image_types AS it ON i.image_type = it.type_id JOIN image_formats AS `if` ON i.image_format = `if`.format_id JOIN image_processing AS ip ON i.image_id = ip.image_id JOIN image_analytics AS ia ON i.image_id = ia.image_id WHERE ip.task_name IN ('edge detection', 'feature extraction') AND ia.metric_name = 'accuracy' AND ip.status = 'completed' GROUP BY it.type_name, `if`.format_name HAVING AVG(ia.metric_value) > 0.8

SELECT p.product_name FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN order_frequency AS `of` ON o.user_id = `of`.user_id WHERE `of`.order_count > 10 GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY COUNT(oi.order_item_id) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH DeviceEnergyConsumption AS (SELECT ec.device_id, SUM(ec.energy_consumed) AS total_energy_consumed FROM energy_consumption AS ec GROUP BY ec.device_id), DeviceStateSummary AS (SELECT ds.device_id, COUNT(ds.state_id) AS state_change_count, MAX(ds.timestamp) AS last_state_change_timestamp, (SELECT state FROM device_states WHERE device_id = ds.device_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_state FROM device_states AS ds GROUP BY ds.device_id), DeviceUserAccess AS (SELECT ud.device_id, u.username, ud.last_access_time FROM user_devices AS ud INNER JOIN users AS u ON ud.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ud.access_mode = 'RW' ORDER BY ud.last_access_time DESC LIMIT 1), DeviceTypeDetails AS (SELECT d.device_id, dt.device_type_name FROM devices AS d INNER JOIN device_types AS dt ON d.device_type_id = dt.device_type_id) SELECT d.device_id, dtd.device_type_name, `dec`.total_energy_consumed, dua.username, dua.last_access_time, dss.state_change_count, dss.current_state, dss.last_state_change_timestamp FROM devices AS d LEFT JOIN DeviceEnergyConsumption AS `dec` ON d.device_id = `dec`.device_id LEFT JOIN DeviceTypeDetails AS dtd ON d.device_id = dtd.device_id LEFT JOIN DeviceUserAccess AS dua ON d.device_id = dua.device_id LEFT JOIN DeviceStateSummary AS dss ON d.device_id = dss.device_id ORDER BY `dec`.total_energy_consumed DESC, dtd.device_type_name

WITH MaintenanceSummary AS (SELECT asset_id, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, SUM(estimated_cost) AS total_estimated_cost, SUM(actual_cost) AS total_actual_cost FROM maintenance_activities GROUP BY asset_id), InspectionSummary AS (SELECT asset_id, COUNT(*) AS total_inspections, GROUP_CONCAT(inspection_result SEPARATOR ', ') AS inspection_results FROM inspections GROUP BY asset_id), PhotoSummary AS (SELECT asset_id, COUNT(*) AS total_photos, GROUP_CONCAT(photo_description SEPARATOR ', ') AS photo_descriptions FROM photos GROUP BY asset_id), GisDataSummary AS (SELECT asset_id, COUNT(*) AS total_gis_data, GROUP_CONCAT(gis_data_file SEPARATOR ', ') AS gis_data_files FROM gis_data GROUP BY asset_id) SELECT ma.asset_id, ma.activity_date, ma.activity_type, ma.description, ma.status, ma.estimated_cost, ma.actual_cost, ma.performed_by, ma.completion_date, ma.notes, isum.total_inspections, isum.inspection_results, psum.total_photos, psum.photo_descriptions, gdsum.total_gis_data, gdsum.gis_data_files, msum.total_activities, msum.total_estimated_cost, msum.total_actual_cost FROM maintenance_activities AS ma LEFT JOIN MaintenanceSummary AS msum ON ma.asset_id = msum.asset_id LEFT JOIN InspectionSummary AS isum ON ma.asset_id = isum.asset_id LEFT JOIN PhotoSummary AS psum ON ma.asset_id = psum.asset_id LEFT JOIN GisDataSummary AS gdsum ON ma.asset_id = gdsum.asset_id WHERE ma.asset_id = 1

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CAST(c.category_name AS CHAR) AS full_path, 1 AS level FROM categories AS c WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CAST(CONCAT(ch.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS CHAR) AS full_path, ch.level + 1 FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), OfferDetails AS (SELECT so.offer_id, so.proposal_id, so.product_id, so.quantity, so.unit_cost, so.discount, so.total_cost, so.created_at, so.updated_at, so.start_date, so.end_date, so.status, p.product_name, p.category_id, ch.full_path AS category_path, pr.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM sales_offers AS so JOIN products AS p ON so.product_id = p.product_id JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON p.category_id = ch.category_id JOIN proposals AS pr ON so.proposal_id = pr.proposal_id JOIN customers AS c ON pr.customer_id = c.customer_id), UserOfferPerformance AS (SELECT ol.user_id, od.offer_id, od.proposal_id, od.product_id, od.quantity, od.unit_cost, od.discount, od.total_cost, od.created_at, od.updated_at, od.start_date, od.end_date, od.status, od.product_name, od.category_path, od.customer_id, od.customer_name, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(od.total_cost, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.user_id ORDER BY od.created_at) AS cumulative_total_cost FROM offer_logs AS ol JOIN OfferDetails AS od ON ol.offer_id = od.offer_id) SELECT u.user_name, u.role, u.email, uo.offer_id, uo.proposal_id, uo.product_id, uo.product_name, uo.quantity, uo.unit_cost, uo.discount, uo.total_cost, uo.created_at, uo.updated_at, uo.start_date, uo.end_date, uo.status, uo.category_path, uo.customer_id, uo.customer_name, uo.cumulative_total_cost FROM UserOfferPerformance AS uo JOIN users AS u ON uo.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY u.user_name, uo.created_at

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(la.number_of_sessions) AS avg_sessions, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(la.student_hours, 1, LOCATE(':', la.student_hours) - 1) AS SIGNED)) AS total_student_hours FROM learning_activities AS la JOIN categories AS c ON la.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name HAVING AVG(la.number_of_sessions) > 10 ORDER BY total_student_hours DESC

WITH RankedPapers AS (SELECT p.paper_id, p.title, p.publication_year, p.times_cited_all_databases, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.times_cited_all_databases DESC) AS citation_rank FROM papers AS p) SELECT rp.title, rp.publication_year, rp.times_cited_all_databases, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ',') AS author_names, pub.publication_name FROM RankedPapers AS rp JOIN paper_authors AS pa ON rp.paper_id = pa.paper_id JOIN authors AS a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id JOIN paper_publications AS pp ON rp.paper_id = pp.paper_id JOIN publications AS pub ON pp.publication_id = pub.publication_id WHERE rp.citation_rank <= 5 GROUP BY rp.paper_id, rp.title, rp.publication_year, rp.times_cited_all_databases, pub.publication_name ORDER BY rp.times_cited_all_databases DESC

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, c.category_name AS category_path_name FROM categories AS c WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CONCAT(ch.category_path_name, ' > ', c.category_name) AS category_path_name FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), SalesData AS (SELECT oi.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_amount, AVG(oi.unit_price) AS average_price FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(oi.created_at AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2023-05' GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.name) SELECT ch.category_id, ch.category_name, ch.category_path_name, sd.product_name, sd.total_quantity, sd.total_amount, sd.average_price FROM SalesData AS sd INNER JOIN products AS p ON sd.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON p.category_id = ch.category_id ORDER BY ch.category_id, sd.product_name

WITH HyperparametersSummary AS (SELECT h.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(h.name, ': ', h.value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS hyperparameters FROM hyperparameters AS h GROUP BY h.model_id), PerformanceDetails AS (SELECT p.model_id, p.cv_score, p.holdout_score, p.holdout_roc_auc_score, p.training_time, p.evaluation_time, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.holdout_roc_auc_score DESC) AS model_rank FROM model_performance AS p), DatasetInfo AS (SELECT md.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(d.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS datasets FROM model_dataset AS md JOIN datasets AS d ON md.dataset_id = d.dataset_id GROUP BY md.model_id) SELECT m.model_id, m.name AS model_name, m.algorithm, m.description, hps.hyperparameters, pd.cv_score, pd.holdout_score, pd.holdout_roc_auc_score, pd.training_time, pd.evaluation_time, pd.model_rank, di.datasets FROM models AS m JOIN HyperparametersSummary AS hps ON m.model_id = hps.model_id JOIN PerformanceDetails AS pd ON m.model_id = pd.model_id JOIN DatasetInfo AS di ON m.model_id = di.model_id WHERE m.algorithm = 'XGBoost' AND pd.holdout_roc_auc_score > 0.7 ORDER BY pd.model_rank

SELECT c.cache_name, AVG(cu.hit_ratio) AS average_hit_ratio FROM caches AS c JOIN cache_usage AS cu ON c.cache_id = cu.cache_id JOIN applications AS a ON cu.app_id = a.app_id JOIN cache_configurations AS cc ON c.cache_id = cc.cache_id WHERE c.distributed = 1 AND a.active = 1 AND cc.parameter = 'time_to_live_seconds' AND CAST(cc.value AS SIGNED) > 300 GROUP BY c.cache_name

WITH ModelPerformanceSummary AS (SELECT m.model_id, m.name AS model_name, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time FROM models AS m JOIN model_performance AS mp ON m.model_id = mp.model_id), HyperparameterSummary AS (SELECT h.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(h.name, ': ', h.value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS hyperparameters FROM hyperparameters AS h GROUP BY h.model_id), CommentSummary AS (SELECT mc.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(u.name, ': ', mc.comment) SEPARATOR ', ') AS comments FROM model_comments AS mc JOIN users AS u ON mc.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY mc.model_id), CombinedSummary AS (SELECT mps.model_id, mps.model_name, mps.cv_score, mps.holdout_score, mps.holdout_roc_auc_score, mps.training_time, mps.evaluation_time, COALESCE(hs.hyperparameters, 'No hyperparameters') AS hyperparameters, COALESCE(cs.comments, 'No comments') AS comments FROM ModelPerformanceSummary AS mps LEFT JOIN HyperparameterSummary AS hs ON mps.model_id = hs.model_id LEFT JOIN CommentSummary AS cs ON mps.model_id = cs.model_id) SELECT cs.model_name, CONCAT('Performance: CV Score=', cs.cv_score, ', Holdout Score=', cs.holdout_score, ', ROC AUC Score=', cs.holdout_roc_auc_score, ', Training Time=', cs.training_time, 's, Evaluation Time=', cs.evaluation_time, 's, Hyperparameters=', cs.hyperparameters, ', Comments=', cs.comments) AS model_details FROM CombinedSummary AS cs ORDER BY cs.model_name

generated_sql: SELECT dc.component_name FROM design_components AS dc JOIN design_configurations AS dcg ON dc.component_id = dcg.component_id GROUP BY dc.component_name HAVING AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(dcg.version, LOCATE('.', dcg.version) + 1) AS FLOAT)) > 1.0

SELECT c.cache_name FROM caches AS c LEFT JOIN cache_usage AS cu ON c.cache_id = cu.cache_id INNER JOIN cache_configurations AS cc ON c.cache_id = cc.cache_id WHERE cu.cache_id IS NULL AND cc.parameter = 'time_to_idle_seconds' AND CAST(cc.value AS SIGNED) > 300
SELECT AVG(reaction_time) AS average_reaction_time FROM responses WHERE `condition` = (SELECT condition_id FROM conditions WHERE condition_name = 'Control')

SELECT a.account_type_id, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(t.amount, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS total_amount FROM transactions AS t INNER JOIN accounts AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2023-01' GROUP BY a.account_type_id

WITH BaselineMetrics AS (SELECT i.region_id, SUM(dr.critical_cases) AS prev_critical_cases, SUM(dr.deaths) AS prev_deaths FROM interventions AS i LEFT JOIN daily_reports AS dr ON i.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.date < i.start_date GROUP BY i.region_id), InterventionMetrics AS (SELECT i.intervention_id, i.intervention_name, i.region_id, SUM(dr.critical_cases) AS total_critical_cases, SUM(dr.deaths) AS total_deaths FROM interventions AS i LEFT JOIN daily_reports AS dr ON i.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.date >= i.start_date AND dr.date <= i.end_date GROUP BY i.intervention_id, i.intervention_name, i.region_id), ImpactAnalysis AS (SELECT im.intervention_id, im.intervention_name, im.region_id, im.total_critical_cases, im.total_deaths, bm.prev_critical_cases, bm.prev_deaths, (im.total_critical_cases - bm.prev_critical_cases) * 100.0 / bm.prev_critical_cases AS critical_cases_reduction, (im.total_deaths - bm.prev_deaths) * 100.0 / bm.prev_deaths AS deaths_reduction FROM InterventionMetrics AS im JOIN BaselineMetrics AS bm ON im.region_id = bm.region_id) SELECT ia.intervention_name, CONCAT('Critical Cases Reduction: ', CAST(ia.critical_cases_reduction AS CHAR), '%, Deaths Reduction: ', CAST(ia.deaths_reduction AS CHAR), '%') AS impact_summary FROM ImpactAnalysis AS ia ORDER BY ia.intervention_name

WITH FilteredIncomeData AS (SELECT d.age, d.income, c.region FROM demographic_data AS d JOIN countries AS c ON d.country = c.country_name WHERE d.occupation = 'Data Analyst' AND d.race = 'White' AND d.marital_status = 'Married' AND d.age BETWEEN 25 AND 60 AND c.region = 'North America') SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN income = '>50K' THEN 50001 ELSE CAST(SUBSTRING(income, 2, LENGTH(income) - 1) AS SIGNED) END) AS average_income FROM FilteredIncomeData

WITH DelayedFlights AS (SELECT f.airport_id, c.carrier_id, COUNT(fd.flight_delay_id) AS num_delays FROM flight_delays AS fd INNER JOIN flights AS f ON fd.flight_id = f.flight_id INNER JOIN carriers AS c ON f.carrier_id = c.carrier_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.departure_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.departure_date AS DATETIME), '%m') = '01' GROUP BY f.airport_id, c.carrier_id), RankedCarriers AS (SELECT df.airport_id, df.carrier_id, c.name AS carrier_name, df.num_delays, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY df.airport_id ORDER BY df.num_delays DESC) AS carrier_rank FROM DelayedFlights AS df INNER JOIN carriers AS c ON df.carrier_id = c.carrier_id) SELECT a.name AS airport_name, rc.carrier_name, rc.num_delays FROM RankedCarriers AS rc INNER JOIN airports AS a ON rc.airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE rc.carrier_rank <= 3

WITH NormalizedEconomicFactors AS (SELECT es.suburb_code, (es.median_weekly_income - (SELECT MIN(median_weekly_income) FROM economic_statistics)) / (SELECT MAX(median_weekly_income) FROM economic_statistics) AS normalized_income, (es.median_rent - (SELECT MIN(median_rent) FROM economic_statistics)) / (SELECT MAX(median_rent) FROM economic_statistics) AS normalized_rent, (es.average_household_income - (SELECT MIN(average_household_income) FROM economic_statistics)) / (SELECT MAX(average_household_income) FROM economic_statistics) AS normalized_household_income FROM economic_statistics AS es), NormalizedSocialFactors AS (SELECT ss.suburb_code, ss.life_satisfaction_score / 100.0 AS normalized_life_satisfaction, ss.sentiment_score / 2.0 AS normalized_sentiment, ss.crime_rate / (SELECT MAX(crime_rate) FROM social_statistics) AS normalized_crime, ss.healthcare_quality_score / 100.0 AS normalized_healthcare FROM social_statistics AS ss), NormalizedDemographicFactors AS (SELECT ds.suburb_code, (ds.median_age - (SELECT MIN(median_age) FROM demographic_statistics)) / (SELECT MAX(median_age) FROM demographic_statistics) AS normalized_age, (ds.population - (SELECT MIN(population) FROM demographic_statistics)) / (SELECT MAX(population) FROM demographic_statistics) AS normalized_population, ds.unemployment_rate / (SELECT MAX(unemployment_rate) FROM demographic_statistics) AS normalized_unemployment, ds.homeless_rate / (SELECT MAX(homeless_rate) FROM demographic_statistics) AS normalized_homelessness, ds.nonreligious_percentage / (SELECT MAX(nonreligious_percentage) FROM demographic_statistics) AS normalized_nonreligion, ds.citizenship_percentage / (SELECT MAX(citizenship_percentage) FROM demographic_statistics) AS normalized_citizenship FROM demographic_statistics AS ds), CombinedScores AS (SELECT es.suburb_code, (es.normalized_income + es.normalized_rent + es.normalized_household_income) / 3 AS economic_score, (ss.normalized_life_satisfaction + ss.normalized_sentiment + (1 - ss.normalized_crime) + ss.normalized_healthcare) / 4 AS social_score, (ds.normalized_age + ds.normalized_population + (1 - ds.normalized_unemployment) + (1 - ds.normalized_homelessness) + (1 - ds.normalized_nonreligion) + ds.normalized_citizenship) / 7 AS demographic_score, (es.normalized_income + es.normalized_rent + es.normalized_household_income + ss.normalized_life_satisfaction + ss.normalized_sentiment + (1 - ss.normalized_crime) + ss.normalized_healthcare + ds.normalized_age + ds.normalized_population + (1 - ds.normalized_unemployment) + (1 - ds.normalized_homelessness) + (1 - ds.normalized_nonreligion) + ds.normalized_citizenship) / 14 AS combined_score FROM NormalizedEconomicFactors AS es JOIN NormalizedSocialFactors AS ss ON es.suburb_code = ss.suburb_code JOIN NormalizedDemographicFactors AS ds ON es.suburb_code = ds.suburb_code) SELECT s.suburb_name, cs.combined_score FROM CombinedScores AS cs JOIN suburbs AS s ON cs.suburb_code = s.suburb_code ORDER BY cs.combined_score DESC LIMIT 1

WITH MutationDetailsCTE AS (SELECT m.mutation_id, g.gene_id, g.gene_name, m.mutation_type, m.mutation_details, m.mutation_effect, m.mutation_frequency, m.mutation_impact, a.antibiotic_name, ar.resistance_level, m.mutation_discovery_date, m.mutation_discovered_by FROM mutations AS m JOIN genes AS g ON m.gene_id = g.gene_id JOIN mutation_antibiotic AS ma ON m.mutation_id = ma.mutation_id JOIN antibiotics AS a ON ma.antibiotic_id = a.antibiotic_id JOIN antibiotic_resistance AS ar ON a.antibiotic_id = ar.antibiotic_id AND m.mutation_id = ar.mutation_id WHERE g.gene_function LIKE '%DNA replication%'), FilteredMutationsCTE AS (SELECT mutation_id, gene_name, mutation_type, mutation_details, mutation_effect, mutation_frequency, mutation_impact, antibiotic_name, resistance_level, mutation_discovery_date, mutation_discovered_by FROM MutationDetailsCTE WHERE mutation_frequency > 0.05 AND resistance_level IN ('high', 'medium')), GroupedMutationsCTE AS (SELECT gene_name, mutation_type, mutation_details, mutation_effect, mutation_frequency, mutation_impact, antibiotic_name, resistance_level, MAX(mutation_discovery_date) AS latest_discovery_date, GROUP_CONCAT(mutation_discovered_by SEPARATOR ',') AS discovered_by, COUNT(DISTINCT mutation_discovered_by) AS discovery_count FROM FilteredMutationsCTE GROUP BY gene_name, mutation_type, mutation_details, mutation_effect, mutation_frequency, mutation_impact, antibiotic_name, resistance_level) SELECT gene_name, mutation_type, mutation_details, mutation_effect, mutation_frequency, mutation_impact, antibiotic_name, resistance_level, latest_discovery_date, discovered_by FROM GroupedMutationsCTE WHERE discovery_count > 1 ORDER BY latest_discovery_date DESC, mutation_frequency DESC

WITH EnergyChanges AS (SELECT n.node_id, n.node_name, e.reading_date, e.energy_consumption, LAG(e.energy_consumption, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY e.reading_date) AS prev_energy_consumption, (e.energy_consumption - LAG(e.energy_consumption, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY e.reading_date)) / LAG(e.energy_consumption, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY e.reading_date) * 100 AS energy_change_percent FROM nodes AS n JOIN energy_data AS e ON n.node_id = e.node_id), ForecastChanges AS (SELECT n.node_id, n.node_name, f.forecast_date, f.energy_forecast, LAG(f.energy_forecast, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY f.forecast_date) AS prev_energy_forecast, (f.energy_forecast - LAG(f.energy_forecast, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY f.forecast_date)) / LAG(f.energy_forecast, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY n.node_id ORDER BY f.forecast_date) * 100 AS forecast_change_percent FROM nodes AS n JOIN energy_forecasts AS f ON n.node_id = f.node_id) SELECT node_name FROM (SELECT node_id, node_name FROM EnergyChanges WHERE energy_change_percent > 10 GROUP BY node_id, node_name HAVING COUNT(node_id) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT node_id, node_name FROM ForecastChanges WHERE forecast_change_percent > 10 GROUP BY node_id, node_name HAVING COUNT(node_id) > 1) AS CombinedChanges GROUP BY node_name
SELECT s.song_id, s.name FROM songs AS s WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(s.release_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') > '2010' AND (s.danceability + s.energy + s.valence) / 3 > 0.70

SELECT r.repo_name, AVG(a.views) AS average_views, SUM(a.downloads) AS total_downloads FROM repositories AS r INNER JOIN analytics AS a ON r.repo_id = a.repo_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.created_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2013' AND r.stars > 10000 GROUP BY r.repo_name HAVING AVG(a.views) > 5000

WITH TotalLeaveCTE AS (SELECT employee_id, SUM(number_of_days) AS total_leave_days_2022 FROM employee_leave WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(start_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY employee_id), EmployeeDetailsCTE AS (SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.age, e.department_id, d.department_name, jt.job_title FROM employees AS e INNER JOIN departments AS d ON e.department_id = d.department_id INNER JOIN job_titles AS jt ON e.job_title_id = jt.job_title_id WHERE e.age > 30 AND d.department_name = 'Engineering') SELECT ed.employee_id, CONCAT(ed.first_name, ' ', ed.last_name) AS full_name, tl.total_leave_days_2022 FROM EmployeeDetailsCTE AS ed LEFT JOIN TotalLeaveCTE AS tl ON ed.employee_id = tl.employee_id

SELECT a.athlete_name, s.sport_name, c.category_name, MIN(ast.starts) AS min_starts, AVG(ast.first_place) AS avg_first_places, AVG(ast.second_place) AS avg_second_places, AVG(ast.third_place) AS avg_third_places, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM ast.earnings), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS total_earnings, AVG(ast.total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(ast.`rank`) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.injuries) AS distinct_injuries_count FROM athletes AS a JOIN annual_stats AS ast ON a.athlete_id = ast.athlete_id JOIN sports AS s ON a.sport_id = s.sport_id JOIN categories AS c ON a.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY a.athlete_name, s.sport_name, c.category_name

WITH ProductReviewsCTE AS (SELECT pr.product_id, AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating FROM product_reviews AS pr GROUP BY pr.product_id), ProductDetailsCTE AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.description, i.image_url, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pov.option_value SEPARATOR ',') AS sizes FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN images AS i ON p.product_id = i.product_id AND i.image_type = 'main' LEFT JOIN product_options AS pov ON p.product_id = pov.product_id AND pov.option_name = 'size' WHERE p.brand_id = 1 AND p.type_id = 1 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.description, i.image_url) SELECT pd.product_id, pd.description, pd.image_url, pd.sizes, pr.avg_rating FROM ProductDetailsCTE AS pd JOIN ProductReviewsCTE AS pr ON pd.product_id = pr.product_id ORDER BY pr.avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.`date` AS `Event Date`, l.`location_name` AS `Location Name`, l.`country` AS `Country`, COUNT(c.`event_id`) AS `Number of Events` FROM `conflict_events` AS c JOIN `locations` AS l ON c.`location_id` = l.`location_id` WHERE c.`scale` > 1 AND c.`fatalities` > 0 AND l.`country` IN ('Country A', 'Country B') GROUP BY c.`date`, l.`location_name`, l.`country` HAVING COUNT(c.`event_id`) > 10 ORDER BY COUNT(c.`event_id`) DESC

SELECT l.location_name, ag.description AS age_group_description, vd.total_population, vd.people_vaccinated, GROUP_CONCAT(v.vaccine_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS vaccines_used FROM vaccination_data AS vd JOIN locations AS l ON vd.location_id = l.location_id JOIN age_groups AS ag ON vd.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id JOIN vaccination_records AS vr ON vd.vaccination_id = vr.vaccination_id JOIN vaccines AS v ON vr.vaccine_id = v.vaccine_id WHERE l.location_name = 'Austria' GROUP BY l.location_name, ag.description, vd.total_population, vd.people_vaccinated

SELECT t.username AS tweet_username, SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) AS total_engagement, AVG(u.followers_count) AS avg_followers FROM tweets AS t INNER JOIN user_engagement AS ue ON t.tweet_id = ue.tweet_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON ue.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN hashtags AS h ON LOCATE(h.hashtag, t.hashtags) > 0 WHERE h.hashtag = '#Census2020' AND t.sentiment = 'positive' GROUP BY t.username ORDER BY total_engagement DESC

SELECT d.department_name, AVG(pr.rating) AS average_performance_rating FROM departments AS d INNER JOIN employees AS e ON d.department_id = e.department_id INNER JOIN performance_reviews AS pr ON e.employee_id = pr.employee_id INNER JOIN (SELECT et.employee_id FROM employee_training AS et WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(et.completion_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') GROUP BY et.employee_id) AS completed_training ON e.employee_id = completed_training.employee_id WHERE pr.review_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING COUNT(pr.review_id) > 0

SELECT r.sensor_id, AVG(r.value) AS average_reading_value, GROUP_CONCAT(a.annotation_text SEPARATOR ',') AS annotations, GROUP_CONCAT(al.access_type SEPARATOR ',') AS access_types FROM readings AS r JOIN sensors AS s ON r.sensor_id = s.sensor_id JOIN datasets AS d ON r.dataset_id = d.dataset_id LEFT JOIN annotations AS a ON r.reading_id = a.reading_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON r.reading_id = al.reading_id WHERE d.dataset_name = 'Temperature Dataset' AND r.data_quality_flag = 'good' AND s.sensor_type = 'temperature' GROUP BY r.sensor_id

SELECT c.category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors FROM documents AS d INNER JOIN categories AS c ON d.category = c.category_id INNER JOIN document_authors AS da ON d.doc_id = da.doc_id INNER JOIN authors AS a ON da.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY c.category_name

SELECT a.athlete_name, a.gender, a.date_of_birth, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM ast.earnings), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS total_earnings, AVG(ast.`rank`) AS average_rank FROM athletes AS a INNER JOIN annual_stats AS ast ON a.athlete_id = ast.athlete_id INNER JOIN sports AS s ON ast.sport_id = s.sport_id INNER JOIN categories AS c ON ast.category_id = c.category_id INNER JOIN user_roles AS ur ON a.coach_id = ur.role_id WHERE s.sport_name = 'Running' AND c.category_name = 'Senior Men' AND ast.`rank` <= 5 AND ur.role_name = 'Coach' GROUP BY a.athlete_name, a.gender, a.date_of_birth

WITH MachineStatus AS (SELECT m.machine_id, m.machine_no, m.model, m.location, m.status, COALESCE(ml.duration_per_event, 0) AS downtime_duration, COALESCE(ml.last_downtime, 0) AS days_since_last_downtime, COALESCE(ml.maintenance_type, 'None') AS last_maintenance_type, ml.last_maintenance_date, ml.alerts_sent FROM machines AS m LEFT JOIN maintenance_logs AS ml ON m.machine_id = ml.machine_id AND ml.job_complete = (SELECT MAX(job_complete) FROM maintenance_logs WHERE machine_id = m.machine_id)), MaintenanceEfficiency AS (SELECT ms.machine_id, ms.machine_no, ms.model, ms.location, ms.status, ms.downtime_duration, ms.days_since_last_downtime, ms.last_maintenance_type, ms.alerts_sent, r.name AS last_repair_personnel, r.position AS repair_personnel_position, ms.last_maintenance_date, ml.start_down, ml.job_complete, ml.notes, ml.start_repair FROM MachineStatus AS ms LEFT JOIN maintenance_logs AS ml ON ms.machine_id = ml.machine_id AND ml.job_complete = ms.last_maintenance_date LEFT JOIN repair_personnel AS r ON r.personnel_id = ml.repair_personnel_id), ScheduledMaintenance AS (SELECT machine_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN completed = 1 THEN CONCAT(maintenance_type, ' on ', completed_date) ELSE CONCAT(maintenance_type, ' scheduled for ', scheduled_date) END SEPARATOR ', ') AS maintenance_schedule FROM maintenance_schedule GROUP BY machine_id) SELECT me.machine_no, me.model, me.location, me.status, me.downtime_duration, me.days_since_last_downtime, me.last_maintenance_type, me.alerts_sent, me.last_repair_personnel, me.repair_personnel_position, me.last_maintenance_date, me.start_down, me.job_complete, me.notes, me.start_repair, sm.maintenance_schedule, SUM(me.downtime_duration) OVER (PARTITION BY me.location ORDER BY me.location, me.machine_no) AS cumulative_downtime_per_location FROM MaintenanceEfficiency AS me LEFT JOIN ScheduledMaintenance AS sm ON me.machine_id = sm.machine_id ORDER BY me.location, me.machine_no DESC

SELECT mc.condition_name AS `Condition`, hp.specialty AS Specialty, AVG(ho.outcome_value) AS Average_Weight FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN medical_conditions AS mc ON p.patient_id = mc.patient_id INNER JOIN health_outcomes AS ho ON p.patient_id = ho.patient_id INNER JOIN patient_provider AS pp ON p.patient_id = pp.patient_id INNER JOIN healthcare_providers AS hp ON pp.provider_id = hp.provider_id WHERE ho.outcome_type = 'Weight' AND mc.status = 'active' GROUP BY mc.condition_name, hp.specialty HAVING AVG(ho.outcome_value) > (SELECT AVG(outcome_value) FROM health_outcomes WHERE outcome_type = 'Weight') ORDER BY Average_Weight DESC

SELECT o.outlet_name, SUM(s.sale_amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.sale_amount) AS average_sales, SUM(s.item_quantity) AS total_items_sold, GROUP_CONCAT(i.item_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_selling_items FROM sales AS s INNER JOIN outlets AS o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id INNER JOIN items AS i ON s.item_id = i.item_id WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND o.outlet_status = 'active' GROUP BY o.outlet_name HAVING SUM(s.sale_amount) > 10000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC

WITH StudyMetrics AS (SELECT pm.study_id, pm.test_id, pm.tp, pm.fp, pm.fn, pm.tn, CAST(pm.tp AS FLOAT) / (pm.tp + pm.fn) AS recall, CAST(pm.tp AS FLOAT) / (pm.tp + pm.fp) AS `precision`, pm.positive_predictive_value, pm.negative_predictive_value, pm.auc_roc, pm.confidence_interval FROM performance_metrics AS pm JOIN studies AS s ON pm.study_id = s.study_id WHERE s.study_status = 'completed'), UserAccess AS (SELECT a.user_id, a.study_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count, MIN(a.access_date) AS first_access, MAX(a.access_date) AS last_access FROM access_logs AS a GROUP BY a.user_id, a.study_id), UserDepartments AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.department FROM users AS u) SELECT sm.study_id, sm.test_id, CASE WHEN sm.`precision` > 0.8 AND sm.recall > 0.8 THEN 'High Accurate' WHEN sm.`precision` > 0.7 AND sm.recall > 0.7 THEN 'Moderate Accurate' ELSE 'Low Accurate' END AS accuracy_rating, sm.recall, sm.`precision`, sm.positive_predictive_value, sm.negative_predictive_value, sm.auc_roc, sm.confidence_interval, ua.access_count, ua.first_access, ua.last_access, ud.department FROM StudyMetrics AS sm LEFT JOIN UserAccess AS ua ON sm.study_id = ua.study_id LEFT JOIN UserDepartments AS ud ON ud.user_id = ua.user_id ORDER BY sm.study_id, sm.test_id
SELECT latch_name FROM latches ORDER BY CAST(get_requests AS SIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH May_Accessed_Proteins AS (SELECT DISTINCT protein_id FROM access_logs WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(access_date AS DATETIME), '%m') = '05'), Protein_Interactions_In_May AS (SELECT DISTINCT pi.protein_id_1, pi.protein_id_2, ps.similarity_score FROM protein_interactions AS pi INNER JOIN May_Accessed_Proteins AS map ON pi.protein_id_1 = map.protein_id OR pi.protein_id_2 = map.protein_id INNER JOIN protein_similarities AS ps ON pi.protein_id_1 = ps.protein_id_1 AND pi.protein_id_2 = ps.protein_id_2) SELECT DISTINCT u.user_name, p1.protein_name AS protein_name_1, p2.protein_name AS protein_name_2, pii.similarity_score FROM Protein_Interactions_In_May AS pii INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON (al.protein_id = pii.protein_id_1 OR al.protein_id = pii.protein_id_2) AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(al.access_date AS DATETIME), '%m') = '05' INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.user_id = al.user_id INNER JOIN proteins AS p1 ON p1.protein_id = pii.protein_id_1 INNER JOIN proteins AS p2 ON p2.protein_id = pii.protein_id_2

SELECT r.region_name, e.type_name, AVG(ce.emission_value) AS average_carbon_emission FROM carbon_emissions AS ce JOIN regions AS r ON ce.region_id = r.region_id JOIN energy_types AS e ON ce.type_id = e.type_id WHERE r.region_name IN ('North America', 'South America') AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ce.emission_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY r.region_name, e.type_name

SELECT u.user_name, AVG(o.total_cost) AS average_total_cost FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN order_frequency AS `of` ON o.user_id = `of`.user_id WHERE `of`.order_count > 5 AND `of`.reordered = 1 GROUP BY u.user_name HAVING AVG(o.total_cost) > 50

WITH ExamRoomEquipment AS (SELECT er.exam_room_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ere.equipment_name, ' (', ere.quantity, ')') SEPARATOR ',') AS equipment_list FROM exam_rooms AS er LEFT JOIN exam_rooms_equipment AS ere ON er.exam_room_id = ere.exam_room_id GROUP BY er.exam_room_id), ExamAttendance AS (SELECT ea.exam_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN ea.status = 'Present' THEN 1 END) AS present_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ea.status = 'Absent' THEN 1 END) AS absent_count, COUNT(*) AS total_students, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN ea.status = 'Present' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS attendance_rate FROM exam_attendance AS ea GROUP BY ea.exam_id) SELECT e.exam_id, e.exam_date, e.exam_day, e.session, e.subject_title, e.exam_format, e.duration, e.exam_category, e.special_needs_accommodations, et.exam_type_name, i.instructor_name, er.room_name, er.capacity, er.location, er.room_type, ere.equipment_list, ea.present_count, ea.absent_count, ea.total_students, ea.attendance_rate FROM exams AS e JOIN exam_types AS et ON e.exam_type_id = et.exam_type_id JOIN instructors AS i ON e.instructor_id = i.instructor_id JOIN exam_rooms AS er ON e.exam_room_id = er.exam_room_id JOIN ExamRoomEquipment AS ere ON er.exam_room_id = ere.exam_room_id LEFT JOIN ExamAttendance AS ea ON e.exam_id = ea.exam_id ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.exam_id

generated_sql: WITH MotionVotes AS (SELECT m.motion_id, m.motion_text, m.proposer_id, m.proposed_date, p.mep_name AS proposer_name, COUNT(v.vote_id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_result = 'for' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_for, SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_result = 'against' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_against, SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_result = 'abstain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_abstain FROM motions AS m JOIN proposers AS p ON m.proposer_id = p.proposer_id LEFT JOIN votes AS v ON m.motion_id = v.vote_session_id WHERE m.proposer_group = 'ALDE' GROUP BY m.motion_id, m.motion_text, m.proposer_id, m.proposed_date, p.mep_name) SELECT mv.motion_id, mv.motion_text, mv.proposer_name, mv.proposed_date, mv.total_votes, mv.votes_for, mv.votes_against, mv.votes_abstain, ROUND((mv.votes_for * 100.0 / mv.total_votes), 2) AS for_percentage, ROUND((mv.votes_against * 100.0 / mv.total_votes), 2) AS against_percentage, ROUND((mv.votes_abstain * 100.0 / mv.total_votes), 2) AS abstain_percentage FROM MotionVotes AS mv ORDER BY mv.proposed_date, mv.motion_id

generated_sql: WITH LatestConfigurations AS (SELECT d.device_id, d.device_name, c.config_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.device_id ORDER BY c.created_date DESC) AS config_rank FROM devices AS d JOIN configurations AS c ON d.device_id = c.device_id), FilteredSettings AS (SELECT s.device_id, s.setting_name, s.value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.device_id, s.setting_name ORDER BY s.setting_id ASC) AS setting_rank FROM settings AS s) SELECT lc.device_name, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(fs.setting_name, ': ', fs.value) SEPARATOR ',') AS settings_info FROM LatestConfigurations AS lc JOIN FilteredSettings AS fs ON lc.device_id = fs.device_id AND fs.setting_rank = 1 WHERE lc.config_rank = 1 GROUP BY lc.device_name

WITH DemographicStats AS (SELECT d.demographic_name, g.txt_yr, g.pct_enrolled FROM graduation_statistics AS g JOIN demographics AS d ON g.demographic_id = d.demographic_id), CumulativeEnrollment AS (SELECT demographic_name, txt_yr, pct_enrolled, SUM(pct_enrolled) OVER (PARTITION BY demographic_name ORDER BY txt_yr) AS cumulative_pct_enrolled FROM DemographicStats) SELECT CONCAT(demographic_name, ', ', txt_yr, ': ', CAST(cumulative_pct_enrolled AS CHAR), '%') AS `Demographic, Academic Year: Cumulative Percentage%` FROM CumulativeEnrollment ORDER BY demographic_name, txt_yr

SELECT l.latch_name FROM latches AS l JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id WHERE lh.timestamp BETWEEN '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2023-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY l.latch_name HAVING SUM(CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED)) > 1000

WITH SalesSummary AS (SELECT s.product_id, s.region_id, SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold, COUNT(s.sale_id) AS total_sales_count FROM sales AS s WHERE s.year = 2023 GROUP BY s.product_id, s.region_id), InventorySummary AS (SELECT i.product_id, i.region_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity_in_stock FROM inventory_logs AS i WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(i.transaction_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY i.product_id, i.region_id) SELECT COALESCE(s.product_id, i.product_id) AS product_id, COALESCE(r.region_name, '') AS region_name, COALESCE(s.total_quantity_sold, 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(i.total_quantity_in_stock, 0) AS total_quantity_in_stock, COALESCE(s.total_sales_count, 0) AS total_sales_count FROM SalesSummary AS s LEFT OUTER JOIN InventorySummary AS i ON s.product_id = i.product_id AND s.region_id = i.region_id LEFT JOIN regions AS r ON COALESCE(s.region_id, i.region_id) = r.region_id UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(s.product_id, i.product_id) AS product_id, COALESCE(r.region_name, '') AS region_name, COALESCE(s.total_quantity_sold, 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(i.total_quantity_in_stock, 0) AS total_quantity_in_stock, COALESCE(s.total_sales_count, 0) AS total_sales_count FROM SalesSummary AS s RIGHT OUTER JOIN InventorySummary AS i ON s.product_id = i.product_id AND s.region_id = i.region_id LEFT JOIN regions AS r ON COALESCE(s.region_id, i.region_id) = r.region_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SalesSummary AS s WHERE s.product_id = i.product_id AND s.region_id = i.region_id) LIMIT 3

WITH ProjectDetails AS (SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, CONCAT(pm.first_name, ' ', pm.last_name) AS project_manager, p.status AS project_status FROM projects AS p JOIN project_managers AS pm ON p.manager_id = pm.manager_id), ComponentDetails AS (SELECT c.component_id, c.component_name, c.component_type, c.status AS component_status, col.project_id FROM design_components AS c JOIN collaborations AS col ON c.created_by = col.user_id), ValidationDetails AS (SELECT v.component_id, v.validation_result, v.validation_duration, tt.test_tool_name FROM validation_processes AS v JOIN testing_tools AS tt ON v.validation_tool_id = tt.test_tool_id), ProjectComponentValidation AS (SELECT pd.project_id, pd.project_name, pd.project_manager, pd.project_status, cd.component_id, cd.component_name, cd.component_type, cd.component_status, vd.validation_result, vd.validation_duration, vd.test_tool_name FROM ProjectDetails AS pd JOIN ComponentDetails AS cd ON pd.project_id = cd.project_id LEFT JOIN ValidationDetails AS vd ON cd.component_id = vd.component_id), AverageValidationDuration AS (SELECT project_id, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(validation_duration, 1, LOCATE('m', validation_duration) - 1) AS SIGNED)) AS avg_validation_duration FROM ProjectComponentValidation GROUP BY project_id), CumulativeValidationDuration AS (SELECT project_id, component_id, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(validation_duration, 1, LOCATE('m', validation_duration) - 1) AS SIGNED)) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY component_id) AS cumulative_duration FROM ProjectComponentValidation) SELECT pcv.project_id, pcv.project_name, pcv.project_manager, pcv.project_status, pcv.component_id, pcv.component_name, pcv.component_type, pcv.component_status, pcv.validation_result, pcv.validation_duration, pcv.test_tool_name, avd.avg_validation_duration, cvd.cumulative_duration FROM ProjectComponentValidation AS pcv JOIN AverageValidationDuration AS avd ON pcv.project_id = avd.project_id JOIN CumulativeValidationDuration AS cvd ON pcv.project_id = cvd.project_id AND pcv.component_id = cvd.component_id ORDER BY pcv.project_id, pcv.component_id

WITH BankFinancialPerformance AS (SELECT b.bank_id, b.bank_name, i.industry_name, bid.year, bid.value AS roe_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.industry_name, bid.year ORDER BY bid.value DESC) AS roe_rank FROM bank_industry_data AS bid INNER JOIN banks AS b ON bid.bank_id = b.bank_id INNER JOIN industries AS i ON bid.industry_id = i.industry_id INNER JOIN financial_metrics AS fm ON bid.metric_id = fm.metric_id WHERE fm.metric_name = 'Return on Equity' AND bid.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM bank_industry_data)), TopPerformingBanks AS (SELECT bank_name, industry_name, roe_value FROM BankFinancialPerformance WHERE roe_rank <= 3) SELECT industry_name, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(bank_name, ': ', roe_value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_performing_banks_roe FROM TopPerformingBanks GROUP BY industry_name

WITH RankedConditions AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS year, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, condition_type, condition_severity_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y'), DATE_FORMAT(CAST(start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY condition_severity_level DESC) AS severity_rank FROM weather_conditions WHERE condition_impact = 'High') SELECT year, `year_month`, condition_type, condition_severity_level FROM RankedConditions WHERE severity_rank = 1

WITH InstructorSessions AS (SELECT i.instructor_name, fs.response_rate, fs.responses FROM instructors AS i INNER JOIN feedback_sessions AS fs ON i.instructor_id = fs.created_by WHERE fs.status = 'Closed' AND fs.responses > 10), AverageResponseRate AS (SELECT instructor_name, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(response_rate, 1, LOCATE('%', response_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT) / 100) AS avg_response_rate FROM InstructorSessions GROUP BY instructor_name) SELECT instructor_name, avg_response_rate FROM AverageResponseRate ORDER BY avg_response_rate DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(v.publish_time AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS publish_month, SUM(v.likes) AS total_likes FROM videos AS v INNER JOIN channels AS c ON v.channel_id = c.channel_id INNER JOIN video_reports AS vr ON v.video_id = vr.video_id WHERE c.channel_title = 'Sam Chui' AND vr.is_resolved = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(v.publish_time AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') HAVING SUM(v.likes) > 0 ORDER BY publish_month
SELECT title, CAST(REPLACE(box_office, ',', '') AS SIGNED) AS box_office_revenue FROM movies ORDER BY box_office_revenue DESC, release_year, title LIMIT 10

WITH ExperimentFilter AS (SELECT e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name FROM experiments AS e INNER JOIN images AS i ON e.experiment_id = i.experiment_id WHERE e.principal_investigator_id = (SELECT researcher_id FROM researchers WHERE researcher_name = 'Bob Smith') AND i.image_type = 'fluorescence' GROUP BY e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name), ImageAggregation AS (SELECT ef.experiment_id, ef.experiment_name, COUNT(i.image_id) AS total_images, GROUP_CONCAT(i.image_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS microscopy_types, GROUP_CONCAT(w.well_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS well_locations FROM ExperimentFilter AS ef INNER JOIN images AS i ON ef.experiment_id = i.experiment_id INNER JOIN wells AS w ON i.well_id = w.well_id GROUP BY ef.experiment_id, ef.experiment_name), FeatureAggregation AS (SELECT i.image_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(cf.feature_name, ': ', cf.feature_value, ' ', cf.feature_unit) SEPARATOR ', ') AS features FROM images AS i LEFT JOIN cell_features AS cf ON i.image_id = cf.image_id GROUP BY i.image_id), AnnotationAggregation AS (SELECT ia.image_id, GROUP_CONCAT(ia.annotation_text SEPARATOR ', ') AS annotations FROM image_annotations AS ia GROUP BY ia.image_id) SELECT ia.experiment_name, ia.total_images, ia.microscopy_types, ia.well_locations, GROUP_CONCAT(f.features SEPARATOR ', ') AS all_features, GROUP_CONCAT(a.annotations SEPARATOR ', ') AS all_annotations FROM ImageAggregation AS ia LEFT JOIN FeatureAggregation AS f ON ia.experiment_id = f.image_id LEFT JOIN AnnotationAggregation AS a ON ia.experiment_id = a.image_id GROUP BY ia.experiment_name, ia.total_images, ia.microscopy_types, ia.well_locations

WITH ModelsWithPerformance AS (SELECT m.model_id, m.name AS model_name, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time, COALESCE(SUM(cm.tp + cm.tn + cm.fp + cm.fn), 0) AS total_confusion_matrix_entries FROM models AS m JOIN model_performance AS mp ON m.model_id = mp.model_id LEFT JOIN confusion_matrix AS cm ON m.model_id = cm.model_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time) SELECT msp.model_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(comment SEPARATOR ', ') FROM model_comments WHERE model_id = msp.model_id) AS user_comments, msp.cv_score, msp.holdout_score, msp.holdout_roc_auc_score, msp.training_time, msp.evaluation_time FROM ModelsWithPerformance AS msp ORDER BY msp.total_confusion_matrix_entries DESC, msp.holdout_roc_auc_score DESC

SELECT a.athlete_id, a.athlete_name, ast.year, ur.role_name AS coach_role, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM ast.earnings), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS total_earnings, SUM(ast.total_points) AS total_points FROM athletes AS a JOIN annual_stats AS ast ON a.athlete_id = ast.athlete_id JOIN user_roles AS ur ON a.coach_id = ur.role_id WHERE ast.starts > 0 GROUP BY a.athlete_id, a.athlete_name, ast.year, ur.role_name

WITH AccessCounts AS (SELECT dataset_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count FROM access_logs GROUP BY dataset_id), MostAccessedDataset AS (SELECT dataset_id FROM AccessCounts WHERE access_count = (SELECT MAX(access_count) FROM AccessCounts)), DatasetDetails AS (SELECT d.dataset_id, d.name AS dataset_name, d.description AS dataset_description, i.name AS instrument_name, p.project_id, p.name AS project_name FROM datasets AS d JOIN instruments AS i ON d.instrument_id = i.instrument_id JOIN project_datasets AS pd ON d.dataset_id = pd.dataset_id JOIN projects AS p ON pd.project_id = p.project_id WHERE d.dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM MostAccessedDataset)) SELECT dd.dataset_id, dd.dataset_name, dd.dataset_description, dd.instrument_name, GROUP_CONCAT(dd.project_name SEPARATOR ',') AS project_names FROM DatasetDetails AS dd GROUP BY dd.dataset_id, dd.dataset_name, dd.dataset_description, dd.instrument_name

WITH IndustryRevenue AS (SELECT i.industry_id, i.industry_name, SUM(rd.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM industries AS i JOIN company_industries AS ci ON i.industry_id = ci.industry_id JOIN companies AS c ON ci.company_id = c.company_id JOIN revenue_distribution AS rd ON c.company_id = rd.company_id WHERE rd.year >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) - 1 GROUP BY i.industry_id, i.industry_name), AverageMarketCap AS (SELECT i.industry_id, AVG(c.mkt_cap) AS avg_mkt_cap FROM industries AS i JOIN company_industries AS ci ON i.industry_id = ci.industry_id JOIN companies AS c ON ci.company_id = c.company_id GROUP BY i.industry_id) SELECT ir.industry_name, ir.total_revenue, amc.avg_mkt_cap FROM IndustryRevenue AS ir JOIN AverageMarketCap AS amc ON ir.industry_id = amc.industry_id ORDER BY ir.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT a.name AS author_name, COUNT(ap.paper_id) AS number_of_papers, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ap.contribution, 1, LOCATE('%', ap.contribution) - 1) AS FLOAT)) AS average_contribution_score, MAX(p.publication_year) AS most_recent_publication_year FROM authors AS a JOIN author_paper AS ap ON a.author_id = ap.author_id JOIN papers AS p ON ap.paper_id = p.paper_id WHERE p.status = 'published' GROUP BY a.name HAVING COUNT(ap.paper_id) > 1 ORDER BY most_recent_publication_year DESC, average_contribution_score DESC

WITH ServiceRatings AS (SELECT r.service_id, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews AS r GROUP BY r.service_id), ServiceAnalytics AS (SELECT a.service_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.metric = 'views' THEN a.value ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, SUM(CASE WHEN a.metric = 'clicks' THEN a.value ELSE 0 END) AS total_clicks FROM analytics AS a GROUP BY a.service_id), ServiceReviews AS (SELECT r.service_id, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count FROM reviews AS r GROUP BY r.service_id), ServiceHours AS (SELECT sh.service_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sh.day, ' ', sh.open_time, ' - ', sh.close_time) SEPARATOR ', ') AS operational_hours FROM service_hours AS sh GROUP BY sh.service_id) SELECT s.service_id, s.name, st.type_name, COALESCE(sr.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(sa.total_views, 0) AS total_views, COALESCE(sa.total_clicks, 0) AS total_clicks, COALESCE(srv.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(sh.operational_hours, 'N/A') AS operational_hours, s.address, s.phone_number, s.email, s.website, s.rating AS overall_rating, s.operational_hours AS operational_hours, s.description FROM services AS s LEFT JOIN service_types AS st ON s.type_id = st.type_id LEFT JOIN ServiceRatings AS sr ON s.service_id = sr.service_id LEFT JOIN ServiceAnalytics AS sa ON s.service_id = sa.service_id LEFT JOIN ServiceReviews AS srv ON s.service_id = srv.service_id LEFT JOIN ServiceHours AS sh ON s.service_id = sh.service_id ORDER BY s.rating DESC, s.name

WITH EngagementsCTE AS (SELECT u.username, u.user_id, te.tweet_id, te.timestamp, te.text, te.hashtags, ue.retweets, ue.favorites, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY ue.retweets + ue.favorites DESC) AS engagement_rank FROM tweets AS te INNER JOIN user_engagement AS ue ON te.tweet_id = ue.tweet_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON ue.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN hashtags AS ht ON LOCATE(ht.hashtag, te.hashtags) > 0 WHERE ht.hashtag = '#SocialMedia' AND te.date = '2020-03-01') SELECT username, user_id, tweet_id, timestamp, text, hashtags, retweets, favorites FROM EngagementsCTE WHERE engagement_rank <= 3

WITH StudyFeatures AS (SELECT sf.study_id, sf.feature_id, sf.value AS study_feature_value, sf.source AS study_feature_source, sf.version AS study_feature_version, sf.created_at AS study_feature_created_at, sf.updated_at AS study_feature_updated_at FROM study_features AS sf), TreeFeatures AS (SELECT fv.tree_id, fv.feature_id, fv.value AS tree_feature_value, fv.source AS feature_value_source, fv.version AS feature_value_version, fv.created_at AS feature_value_created_at, fv.updated_at AS feature_value_updated_at FROM feature_values AS fv), FeatureStats AS (SELECT fv.feature_id, fv.tree_id, st.p_val1, st.p_val0, st.test_type, st.confidence_interval, st.created_at AS stat_created_at, st.updated_at AS stat_updated_at FROM feature_values AS fv INNER JOIN statistical_values AS st ON fv.value_id = st.value_id), RelevantFeatures AS (SELECT sf.feature_id, sf.study_id, tf.tree_id, sf.study_feature_value, tf.tree_feature_value, fs.p_val1, fs.p_val0, fs.test_type, fs.confidence_interval FROM StudyFeatures AS sf INNER JOIN TreeFeatures AS tf ON sf.feature_id = tf.feature_id INNER JOIN FeatureStats AS fs ON tf.feature_id = fs.feature_id AND tf.tree_id = fs.tree_id), FeatureDetails AS (SELECT rf.feature_id, rf.study_id, rf.tree_id, rf.study_feature_value, rf.tree_feature_value, rf.p_val1, rf.p_val0, rf.test_type, rf.confidence_interval, gf.feature_name, gf.description, gf.chromosome, gf.start_position, gf.end_position, gf.strand, gf.source AS genomic_feature_source, gf.version AS genomic_feature_version, dt.tree_name, dt.description AS tree_description, dt.algorithm, dt.parameters, dt.accuracy, s.study_name, s.description AS study_description, r.name AS researcher_name, r.email AS researcher_email FROM RelevantFeatures AS rf INNER JOIN genomic_features AS gf ON rf.feature_id = gf.feature_id INNER JOIN decision_trees AS dt ON rf.tree_id = dt.tree_id INNER JOIN studies AS s ON rf.study_id = s.study_id INNER JOIN researchers AS r ON s.researcher_id = r.researcher_id) SELECT fd.feature_name, fd.study_name, fd.tree_name, fd.study_feature_value, fd.tree_feature_value, fd.p_val1, fd.p_val0, fd.test_type, fd.chromosome, fd.start_position, fd.end_position, fd.accuracy, fd.researcher_name, TRIM(TRAILING ', ' FROM GROUP_CONCAT(fd.description SEPARATOR ', ')) AS combined_description FROM FeatureDetails AS fd GROUP BY fd.feature_name, fd.study_name, fd.tree_name, fd.study_feature_value, fd.tree_feature_value, fd.p_val1, fd.p_val0, fd.test_type, fd.chromosome, fd.start_position, fd.end_position, fd.accuracy, fd.researcher_name ORDER BY fd.accuracy DESC

SELECT a.athlete_name, s.sport_name, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM ast.earnings), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS average_earnings FROM athletes AS a JOIN annual_stats AS ast ON a.athlete_id = ast.athlete_id JOIN sports AS s ON ast.sport_id = s.sport_id GROUP BY a.athlete_name, s.sport_name

SELECT s.study_name, ss.site_name FROM studies AS s JOIN study_sites AS ss ON s.study_id = ss.study_id JOIN patients AS p ON s.study_id = p.study_id AND ss.site_id = p.site_id JOIN data_values AS dv ON p.patient_id = dv.patient_id JOIN validation_rules AS vr ON s.study_id = vr.study_id AND dv.data_point_id = vr.data_point_id WHERE vr.rule_type = 'range check' AND vr.rule_condition = 'value > 18 and value < 65' AND CAST(dv.value AS SIGNED) BETWEEN 18 AND 65 GROUP BY s.study_name, ss.site_name HAVING COUNT(p.patient_id) > 1

WITH OrderSummary AS (SELECT u.user_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend, MAX(`of`.days_since_prior_order) AS max_days_since_last_order, MIN(`of`.days_since_prior_order) AS min_days_since_last_order, AVG(`of`.days_since_prior_order) AS avg_days_between_orders FROM users AS u INNER JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN order_frequency AS `of` ON u.user_id = `of`.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id), ReorderSummary AS (SELECT u.user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN `of`.reordered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_reordered, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS unique_products_reordered FROM users AS u INNER JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN order_frequency AS `of` ON u.user_id = `of`.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id) SELECT os.user_id, os.total_orders, os.total_spend, os.max_days_since_last_order, os.min_days_since_last_order, os.avg_days_between_orders, rs.total_reordered, rs.unique_products_reordered FROM OrderSummary AS os INNER JOIN ReorderSummary AS rs ON os.user_id = rs.user_id WHERE os.total_orders > 5 ORDER BY os.total_spend DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT p.patient_name FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN data_values AS dv ON p.patient_id = dv.patient_id WHERE dv.data_point_id = 4001 AND NOT CAST(dv.value AS SIGNED) BETWEEN 18 AND 65

WITH TopCitedPapers AS (SELECT paper_id, title, publication_year, cited_reference_count AS citation_count, times_cited_all_databases FROM papers ORDER BY times_cited_all_databases DESC LIMIT 10), AuthorDetails AS (SELECT pa.paper_id, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors, GROUP_CONCAT(a.affiliation SEPARATOR ', ') AS affiliations FROM paper_authors AS pa JOIN authors AS a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY pa.paper_id), PublicationDetails AS (SELECT pp.paper_id, pub.publication_name, pub.publisher FROM paper_publications AS pp JOIN publications AS pub ON pp.publication_id = pub.publication_id), DatabaseDetails AS (SELECT pd.paper_id, GROUP_CONCAT(db.database_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS `databases` FROM paper_databases AS pd JOIN `databases` AS db ON pd.database_id = db.database_id GROUP BY pd.paper_id) SELECT tcp.paper_id, tcp.title, tcp.publication_year, tcp.citation_count, tcp.times_cited_all_databases, COALESCE(ad.authors, '') AS authors, COALESCE(ad.affiliations, '') AS affiliations, COALESCE(pd.publication_name, '') AS publication_name, COALESCE(pd.publisher, '') AS publisher, COALESCE(dd.`databases`, '') AS `databases` FROM TopCitedPapers AS tcp LEFT JOIN AuthorDetails AS ad ON tcp.paper_id = ad.paper_id LEFT JOIN PublicationDetails AS pd ON tcp.paper_id = pd.paper_id LEFT JOIN DatabaseDetails AS dd ON tcp.paper_id = dd.paper_id

WITH ProjectOutcomeCTE AS (SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome_measurements LIKE '%area restored%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(outcome_measurements, LOCATE(' ', outcome_measurements) + 1, LOCATE('hectares', outcome_measurements) - LOCATE(' ', outcome_measurements) - 1) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END) AS total_area_restored FROM project_outcomes WHERE impact = 'Positive' GROUP BY project_id), CriticalGrasslandSpeciesCTE AS (SELECT sh.species_id FROM species_habitats AS sh INNER JOIN habitats AS h ON sh.habitat_id = h.habitat_id WHERE h.habitat_name = 'Grassland' AND sh.habitat_importance = 'critical'), ProjectSpeciesCTE AS (SELECT ps.project_id, COUNT(ps.species_id) AS species_count FROM project_species AS ps INNER JOIN CriticalGrasslandSpeciesCTE AS cgs ON ps.species_id = cgs.species_id GROUP BY ps.project_id), FinalProjectsCTE AS (SELECT po.project_id, po.total_area_restored, ps.species_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY po.total_area_restored DESC, ps.species_count DESC) AS project_rank FROM ProjectOutcomeCTE AS po INNER JOIN ProjectSpeciesCTE AS ps ON po.project_id = ps.project_id) SELECT project_id FROM FinalProjectsCTE WHERE project_rank <= 3

SELECT u.username, MAX(sp.high_price) AS max_high_price FROM users AS u JOIN favorite_companies AS fc ON u.user_id = fc.user_id JOIN stock_prices AS sp ON fc.company_id = sp.company_id WHERE u.account_type = 'premium' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(sp.date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY u.username

WITH MonthlyEnergy AS (SELECT e.year_id, r.region_name, p.process_name, e.source_type, e.subprocess, e.energy_source, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(e.datetime AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(e.`load`) AS total_monthly_load, AVG(e.`load`) AS average_monthly_load, MAX(e.`load`) AS max_monthly_load, MIN(e.`load`) AS min_monthly_load FROM energy_consumption AS e JOIN regions AS r ON e.nuts2_code = r.nuts2_code JOIN processes AS p ON e.process_id = p.process_id JOIN years AS y ON e.year_id = y.year_id WHERE r.region_name = 'Slovakia - Bratislava' AND p.process_name = 'heating_residential' AND e.source_type = 'residential' AND e.subprocess = 'heating_living_room' AND e.energy_source = 'electricity' AND y.year = 2010 GROUP BY e.year_id, r.region_name, p.process_name, e.source_type, e.subprocess, e.energy_source, month), LoadCategory AS (SELECT month, total_monthly_load, average_monthly_load, max_monthly_load, min_monthly_load, CASE WHEN total_monthly_load <= 100 THEN 'Low' WHEN total_monthly_load > 300 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END AS load_category FROM MonthlyEnergy) SELECT load_category, month, total_monthly_load, average_monthly_load, max_monthly_load, min_monthly_load FROM LoadCategory ORDER BY load_category

WITH TopRatedPosts AS (SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, COUNT(v.vote_id) AS total_votes FROM posts AS p JOIN votes AS v ON p.post_id = v.post_id WHERE p.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE category_name = 'Environmental') GROUP BY p.post_id, p.user_id HAVING COUNT(v.vote_id) > 20), CommentCount AS (SELECT c.post_id, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS total_comments FROM comments AS c GROUP BY c.post_id), ActionCount AS (SELECT pa.post_id, COUNT(pa.action_id) AS total_actions, GROUP_CONCAT(pa.action_type SEPARATOR ',') AS action_types FROM post_actions AS pa GROUP BY pa.post_id) SELECT trp.post_id, u.username, trp.total_votes, COALESCE(cc.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ac.total_actions, 0) AS total_post_actions, COALESCE(ac.action_types, '') AS actions_on_post FROM TopRatedPosts AS trp JOIN users AS u ON trp.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN CommentCount AS cc ON trp.post_id = cc.post_id LEFT JOIN ActionCount AS ac ON trp.post_id = ac.post_id
SELECT `rank` FROM ranks WHERE indicator_id = 1 AND country_id = 1 AND year_id = 1

WITH RankedData AS (SELECT u.university_id, u.name, u.enrollment, h.early_career_pay, r.`rank`, r.stem_percent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.university_id ORDER BY r.year DESC) AS rank_row_num FROM universities AS u JOIN historical_data AS h ON u.university_id = h.university_id JOIN rankings AS r ON u.university_id = r.university_id), WeightedScores AS (SELECT university_id, name, enrollment, early_career_pay, `rank`, stem_percent, (enrollment * early_career_pay * (100 - `rank`) * stem_percent) / 100000 AS weighted_score FROM RankedData WHERE rank_row_num = 1) SELECT name, SUM(weighted_score) AS total_weighted_score FROM WeightedScores GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total_weighted_score DESC

WITH PlayerStats AS (SELECT ps.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.team_id, t.team_name, ps.runs, ps.hits, ps.home_runs, ps.rbis, ps.avg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.runs DESC) AS runs_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.hits DESC) AS hits_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.home_runs DESC) AS home_runs_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.rbis DESC) AS rbis_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.avg DESC) AS avg_rank FROM player_statistics AS ps INNER JOIN players AS p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id INNER JOIN teams AS t ON p.team_id = t.team_id WHERE ps.year = 2023), TopPlayers AS (SELECT ps.first_name, ps.last_name, ps.team_name, MAX(ps.runs_rank) AS top_runs_rank, MAX(ps.hits_rank) AS top_hits_rank, MAX(ps.home_runs_rank) AS top_home_runs_rank, MAX(ps.rbis_rank) AS top_rbis_rank, MAX(ps.avg_rank) AS top_avg_rank FROM PlayerStats AS ps WHERE ps.runs_rank <= 3 OR ps.hits_rank <= 3 OR ps.home_runs_rank <= 3 OR ps.rbis_rank <= 3 OR ps.avg_rank <= 3 GROUP BY ps.player_id, ps.first_name, ps.last_name, ps.team_name) SELECT CONCAT(tp.first_name, ' ', tp.last_name) AS player_name, tp.team_name, tp.top_runs_rank, tp.top_hits_rank, tp.top_home_runs_rank, tp.top_rbis_rank, tp.top_avg_rank FROM TopPlayers AS tp ORDER BY LEAST(tp.top_runs_rank, tp.top_hits_rank, tp.top_home_runs_rank, tp.top_rbis_rank, tp.top_avg_rank) ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT job_title, COUNT(*) AS number_of_posts FROM job_postings WHERE (experience_required LIKE '%6 -%' OR experience_required LIKE '% - 6%' OR experience_required LIKE '%6 years%' OR experience_required LIKE '%6 yr%') AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(posting_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2019-07' GROUP BY job_title

SELECT m.medal_type, GROUP_CONCAT(a.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS athletes FROM athletes AS a JOIN medals AS m ON a.athlete_id = m.athlete_id JOIN sports AS s ON m.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE LENGTH(s.equipment_required) - LENGTH(REPLACE(s.equipment_required, ',', '')) > 3 GROUP BY m.medal_type

SELECT ma.activity_type, i.inspection_result, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email FROM maintenance_activities AS ma LEFT JOIN inspections AS i ON ma.asset_id = i.asset_id AND ma.activity_date = i.inspection_date JOIN users AS u ON ma.performed_by = u.username WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ma.activity_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' ORDER BY ma.activity_date DESC
SELECT l.latch_name FROM latches AS l JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id GROUP BY l.latch_name HAVING AVG(CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED)) > 1000

WITH DocumentDetails AS (SELECT d.doc_id, d.title, dt.type_name AS document_type, c.category_name AS document_category, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count FROM documents AS d JOIN document_types AS dt ON d.type = dt.type_id JOIN categories AS c ON d.category = c.category_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id WHERE c.is_active = 1 AND dt.is_active = 1 GROUP BY d.doc_id, d.title, dt.type_name, c.category_name), AuthorsDetails AS (SELECT da.doc_id, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors FROM document_authors AS da JOIN authors AS a ON da.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY da.doc_id) SELECT dd.title, dd.document_type, dd.document_category, ad.authors, dd.access_count FROM DocumentDetails AS dd JOIN AuthorsDetails AS ad ON dd.doc_id = ad.doc_id ORDER BY dd.access_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT sector_name, sector_performance FROM sectors WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(sector_performance, 1, LENGTH(sector_performance) - 1) AS SIGNED) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(sector_performance, 1, LENGTH(sector_performance) - 1) AS SIGNED)) FROM sectors)

WITH AppointmentsByDoctor AS (SELECT a.doctor_id, CONCAT(d.first_name, ' ', d.last_name) AS doctor_name, COUNT(a.appointment_id) AS total_appointments FROM appointments AS a JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.scheduled_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2022-05' AND a.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name), TotalAppointments AS (SELECT COUNT(a.appointment_id) AS total_appointments FROM appointments AS a WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.scheduled_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2022-05' AND a.status = 'completed'), RankedAppointmentsByDoctor AS (SELECT doctor_name, total_appointments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_appointments DESC) AS doctor_rank FROM AppointmentsByDoctor) SELECT doctor_name, total_appointments, (total_appointments * 100.0 / (SELECT total_appointments FROM TotalAppointments)) AS percentage_of_total_appointments FROM RankedAppointmentsByDoctor ORDER BY doctor_rank

WITH RECURSIVE GenreHierarchy AS (SELECT genre_id, genre_name, parent_genre_id, CAST(genre_name AS CHAR) AS full_path FROM genres WHERE parent_genre_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT g.genre_id, g.genre_name, g.parent_genre_id, CONCAT(gh.full_path, ' > ', g.genre_name) FROM genres AS g JOIN GenreHierarchy AS gh ON g.parent_genre_id = gh.genre_id), MovieGenreHierarchy AS (SELECT m.movie_id, g.full_path AS genre_path FROM movies AS m JOIN movie_genres AS mg ON m.movie_id = mg.movie_id JOIN GenreHierarchy AS g ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id), AggregateData AS (SELECT mg.genre_path, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews, COUNT(a.award_id) AS total_awards FROM MovieGenreHierarchy AS mg LEFT JOIN reviews AS r ON mg.movie_id = r.movie_id LEFT JOIN awards AS a ON mg.movie_id = a.movie_id GROUP BY mg.genre_path) SELECT genre_path, avg_rating AS overall_avg_rating, total_reviews, total_awards FROM AggregateData ORDER BY overall_avg_rating DESC

WITH StudentScores AS (SELECT s.student_id, AVG(sc.average_score) AS average_score FROM students AS s INNER JOIN scores AS sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id), StudentAttendance AS (SELECT a.student_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS attendance_percentage FROM attendance AS a GROUP BY a.student_id), StudentCourses AS (SELECT e.student_id, GROUP_CONCAT(c.course_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS enrolled_courses FROM enrollments AS e INNER JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY e.student_id) SELECT ss.student_id, ss.average_score, pr.range_name AS performance_range, sa.attendance_percentage, sc.enrolled_courses FROM StudentScores AS ss INNER JOIN StudentAttendance AS sa ON ss.student_id = sa.student_id INNER JOIN StudentCourses AS sc ON ss.student_id = sc.student_id INNER JOIN performance_ranges AS pr ON ss.average_score BETWEEN pr.lower_bound AND pr.upper_bound

SELECT o.operator_name, SUM(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(op.duration AS DATETIME), '%s') AS FLOAT)) AS total_duration_seconds FROM operations AS op JOIN operators AS o ON op.operator_id = o.operator_id WHERE op.weather_conditions = 'Good' AND op.status = 'completed' AND o.status = 'active' GROUP BY o.operator_name

SELECT dc.component_name, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(tp.test_duration, 1, LOCATE(' ', tp.test_duration) - 1) AS SIGNED)) AS average_test_duration FROM design_components AS dc INNER JOIN testing_processes AS tp ON dc.component_id = tp.component_id WHERE dc.status = 'active' AND tp.test_result = 'passed' GROUP BY dc.component_name HAVING COUNT(tp.test_id) > 1

WITH JobDetails AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.title, c.company_name, l.city, l.country, t.type_name, e.level_name, j.years_exp, j.skills, j.salary_range, j.benefits, j.description, j.posted_date, j.deadline, r.name AS recruiter_name FROM jobs AS j INNER JOIN companies AS c ON j.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN locations AS l ON j.location = l.location_id INNER JOIN employment_types AS t ON j.type = t.type_id INNER JOIN experience_levels AS e ON j.level = e.level_id INNER JOIN recruiters AS r ON j.recruiter_id = r.recruiter_id), ApplicantDetails AS (SELECT a.applicant_id, a.job_id, a.name AS applicant_name, a.email AS applicant_email, a.application_date, a.phone AS applicant_phone, a.linkedin_profile, a.portfolio_url, s.status_name AS application_status FROM applicants AS a INNER JOIN application_status AS s ON a.status_id = s.status_id), ApplicationStats AS (SELECT ja.job_id, COUNT(a.applicant_id) AS application_count, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(j.years_exp, 1, LOCATE('-', j.years_exp) - 1) AS SIGNED)) AS avg_years_exp FROM job_applications AS ja INNER JOIN applicants AS a ON ja.applicant_id = a.applicant_id INNER JOIN jobs AS j ON ja.job_id = j.job_id GROUP BY ja.job_id) SELECT jd.job_id, jd.title, jd.company_name, jd.city, jd.country, jd.type_name, jd.level_name, jd.years_exp, jd.skills, jd.salary_range, jd.benefits, jd.description, jd.posted_date, jd.deadline, jd.recruiter_name, ad.applicant_id, ad.applicant_name, ad.applicant_email, ad.application_date, ad.applicant_phone, ad.linkedin_profile, ad.portfolio_url, ad.application_status, ast.application_count, ast.avg_years_exp FROM JobDetails AS jd LEFT JOIN ApplicantDetails AS ad ON jd.job_id = ad.job_id LEFT JOIN ApplicationStats AS ast ON jd.job_id = ast.job_id ORDER BY jd.job_id, ad.applicant_id
