WITH LatchStats AS (SELECT l.latch_id, l.latch_name, SUM(CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED) + CAST(lh.sleeps AS SIGNED)) AS total_misses_sleeps FROM latches AS l INNER JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id GROUP BY l.latch_id, l.latch_name HAVING SUM(CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED) + CAST(lh.sleeps AS SIGNED)) > 1000), LatestConfigurations AS (SELECT lc.latch_id, lc.config_key, lc.config_value, lc.last_updated, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lc.latch_id ORDER BY lc.last_updated DESC) AS rn FROM latch_configurations AS lc) SELECT ls.latch_name, ls.total_misses_sleeps, lc.config_key, lc.config_value, lc.last_updated FROM LatchStats AS ls INNER JOIN LatestConfigurations AS lc ON ls.latch_id = lc.latch_id WHERE lc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ls.total_misses_sleeps DESC

WITH AboveAverageCalls AS (SELECT call_id, timestamp, call_type, execution_time, server_id, user_id, status, resource_usage, call_parameters FROM system_calls WHERE execution_time > (SELECT AVG(execution_time) FROM system_calls)), StatusChanges AS (SELECT call_id, timestamp, call_type, execution_time, server_id, user_id, status, resource_usage, call_parameters, LAG(status) OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_status FROM AboveAverageCalls), FilteredCalls AS (SELECT sc.call_id, sc.timestamp, sc.call_type, sc.execution_time, sc.server_id, sc.user_id, sc.status, sc.resource_usage, sc.call_parameters FROM StatusChanges AS sc WHERE NOT sc.prev_status <=> sc.status) SELECT fc.call_id, fc.timestamp, fc.call_type, fc.execution_time, fc.server_id, fc.user_id, fc.status, fc.resource_usage, fc.call_parameters, ct.type_name AS call_type_name, ct.description AS call_type_description, ct.category AS call_type_category, ct.criticality AS call_type_criticality, u.user_name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, u.role AS user_role, u.department AS user_department, s.server_name AS server_name, s.location AS server_location, s.os_version AS server_os_version, s.hardware_config AS server_hardware_config FROM FilteredCalls AS fc JOIN call_types AS ct ON fc.call_type = ct.type_name JOIN users AS u ON fc.user_id = u.user_id JOIN servers AS s ON fc.server_id = s.server_id ORDER BY fc.timestamp DESC

SELECT u.username, u.email, ur.role_name, SUM(gd.quality_score) AS total_quality_score, AVG(gd.quality_score) AS average_quality_score, COUNT(gd.dataset_id) AS total_datasets_generated, COUNT(CASE WHEN gd.is_archived = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_archived_datasets, SUM(CAST(gd.size_in_bytes AS SIGNED)) AS total_size_in_bytes FROM generated_datasets AS gd INNER JOIN users AS u ON gd.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN user_roles AS ur ON u.role_id = ur.role_id GROUP BY u.username, u.email, ur.role_name ORDER BY total_quality_score DESC

WITH RECURSIVE EmployeeHierarchy AS (SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.manager_id, e.department_id, 1 AS level, CAST(e.employee_id AS CHAR) AS hierarchy_path FROM employees AS e WHERE e.manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.manager_id, e.department_id, eh.level + 1, CONCAT(eh.hierarchy_path, '->', e.employee_id) FROM employees AS e JOIN EmployeeHierarchy AS eh ON e.manager_id = eh.employee_id), PerformanceSummary AS (SELECT p.employee_id, AVG(p.rating) AS avg_rating, MAX(p.review_date) AS last_review_date, MAX(p.comments) AS last_review_comments FROM performance_reviews AS p GROUP BY p.employee_id), TrainingSummary AS (SELECT t.employee_id, MAX(t.completion_date) AS last_training_date, AVG(t.rating) AS avg_training_rating FROM employee_training AS t GROUP BY t.employee_id) SELECT eh.first_name, eh.last_name, eh.department_id, d.department_name, COALESCE(ps.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_performance_rating, ps.last_review_date, ps.last_review_comments, COALESCE(ts.avg_training_rating, 0) AS avg_training_rating, ts.last_training_date, eh.level, eh.hierarchy_path FROM EmployeeHierarchy AS eh LEFT JOIN departments AS d ON eh.department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN PerformanceSummary AS ps ON eh.employee_id = ps.employee_id LEFT JOIN TrainingSummary AS ts ON eh.employee_id = ts.employee_id ORDER BY eh.department_id, eh.level, eh.hierarchy_path

SELECT c.city, s.sale_year, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM s.sale_amount), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(ci.total_interactions) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS avg_interactions_per_customer FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN sales AS s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS total_interactions FROM customer_interactions GROUP BY customer_id) AS ci ON c.customer_id = ci.customer_id GROUP BY c.city, s.sale_year

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(m.date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS year, COUNT(*) AS num_matches FROM matches AS m JOIN teams AS t1 ON m.team1_id = t1.team_id JOIN teams AS t2 ON m.team2_id = t2.team_id WHERE t1.team_name = 'TeamName' OR t2.team_name = 'TeamName' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

WITH FishDetails AS (SELECT fish_id, species_name, rearing_type_name, initial_mark_site_code, initial_mark_date_time, initial_length_mm, initial_weight_g, sex, genetic_stock, fin_clip_code FROM fish), EventDetails AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.fish_id, e.event_type_name, s.site_name AS event_site_name, s.site_type_description AS event_site_type, s.location AS event_site_location, s.contact_email AS event_site_contact, s.latitude AS event_site_latitude, s.longitude AS event_site_longitude, e.event_date_time_value, e.event_length_mm, e.event_weight_g, e.cth_count, e.water_temperature_c, e.water_depth_m FROM events AS e JOIN sites AS s ON e.event_site_code_value = s.site_code), AccessDetails AS (SELECT a.event_id, a.access_id, a.access_date, a.access_type, u.user_name AS accessed_by, u.role AS user_role FROM access_logs AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id) SELECT ed.event_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(fd.species_name, ',', fd.rearing_type_name, ',', fd.initial_mark_site_code, ',', fd.initial_mark_date_time, ',', fd.initial_length_mm, ',', fd.initial_weight_g, ',', fd.sex, ',', fd.genetic_stock, ',', fd.fin_clip_code, ',', ed.event_type_name, ',', ed.event_site_name, ',', ed.event_site_type, ',', ed.event_site_location, ',', ed.event_site_contact, ',', ed.event_site_latitude, ',', ed.event_site_longitude, ',', ed.event_date_time_value, ',', ed.event_length_mm, ',', ed.event_weight_g, ',', ed.cth_count, ',', ed.water_temperature_c, ',', ed.water_depth_m, ',', ad.access_id, ',', ad.access_date, ',', ad.access_type, ',', ad.accessed_by, ',', ad.user_role) SEPARATOR ',') AS event_summary FROM EventDetails AS ed JOIN FishDetails AS fd ON ed.fish_id = fd.fish_id JOIN AccessDetails AS ad ON ed.event_id = ad.event_id GROUP BY ed.event_id

SELECT DISTINCT dv.patient_id FROM data_values AS dv INNER JOIN validation_rules AS vr ON dv.data_point_id = vr.data_point_id WHERE vr.rule_id = 0 AND (CAST(dv.value AS SIGNED) < 18 OR CAST(dv.value AS SIGNED) > 65)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread_notification_count FROM notifications WHERE user_id = 0 AND `read` = 0

SELECT sd.sag_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ua.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, CAST(COUNT(um.metric_id) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT sd.data_id) AS avg_metrics_accessed_per_day FROM user_access_logs AS ua INNER JOIN sag_mill_data AS sd ON ua.data_id = sd.data_id INNER JOIN performance_metrics AS um ON sd.data_id = um.data_id GROUP BY sd.sag_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ua.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY sd.sag_id, date

SELECT a.account_type_id, a.product_category, apy.apy, mb.min_balance FROM account_types AS a INNER JOIN annual_percentage_yields AS apy ON a.account_type_id = apy.account_type_id INNER JOIN minimum_balances AS mb ON a.account_type_id = mb.account_type_id INNER JOIN interest_rates AS ir ON a.account_type_id = ir.account_type_id WHERE a.account_status = 'Active' AND mb.effective_start_date >= '2010-01-01' AND CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('%' FROM ir.interest_rate), ',', '') AS FLOAT) > 1.5

WITH TopDishes AS (SELECT de.dish_id, de.average_effectiveness_rating FROM dish_effectiveness AS de WHERE de.is_archived = 0 ORDER BY de.average_effectiveness_rating DESC LIMIT 5), DishIngredients AS (SELECT di.dish_id, GROUP_CONCAT(i.ingredient_name SEPARATOR ',') AS ingredient_list FROM dish_ingredients AS di INNER JOIN ingredients AS i ON di.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE di.is_archived = 0 AND i.is_archived = 0 GROUP BY di.dish_id) SELECT d.dish_name, di.ingredient_list FROM TopDishes AS td INNER JOIN dishes AS d ON td.dish_id = d.dish_id INNER JOIN DishIngredients AS di ON d.dish_id = di.dish_id WHERE d.is_archived = 0 ORDER BY td.average_effectiveness_rating DESC

SELECT CONCAT(b.first_name, ' ', b.last_name) AS `Awardee Name`, c.chapter_name AS `Chapter Name`, COUNT(a.award_id) AS `Number of Awards` FROM awards AS a INNER JOIN awardees AS b ON a.awardee_id = b.awardee_id INNER JOIN chapters AS c ON a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id GROUP BY CONCAT(b.first_name, ' ', b.last_name), c.chapter_name ORDER BY COUNT(a.award_id) DESC

WITH LongestSessionUsers AS (SELECT ub.user_id, ub.total_duration FROM user_behavior AS ub WHERE ub.total_duration = (SELECT MAX(total_duration) FROM user_behavior)), UserSegments AS (SELECT ub.user_id, u.user_name, GROUP_CONCAT(s.segment_name SEPARATOR ',') AS segments FROM LongestSessionUsers AS ub JOIN users AS u ON ub.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_segments AS us ON ub.user_id = us.user_id LEFT JOIN segments AS s ON us.segment_id = s.segment_id GROUP BY ub.user_id, u.user_name) SELECT us.user_name, us.segments FROM UserSegments AS us

WITH JournalCTE AS (SELECT publication_id FROM publications WHERE publication_name = 'Journal of Machine Learning'), PapersCTE AS (SELECT p.paper_id, p.title, p.times_cited_all_databases FROM papers AS p INNER JOIN paper_publications AS pp ON p.paper_id = pp.paper_id INNER JOIN JournalCTE AS j ON pp.publication_id = j.publication_id WHERE p.publication_year = 2021), AuthorsCTE AS (SELECT pa.paper_id, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors FROM paper_authors AS pa INNER JOIN authors AS a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY pa.paper_id) SELECT p.title, a.authors, p.times_cited_all_databases AS total_citations FROM PapersCTE AS p INNER JOIN AuthorsCTE AS a ON p.paper_id = a.paper_id ORDER BY p.times_cited_all_databases DESC LIMIT 3

WITH RECURSIVE PageHierarchy AS (SELECT p.page_id, p.name, p.path, 1 AS level, CAST(p.page_id AS CHAR) AS hierarchy_path FROM pages AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_hierarchy WHERE child_page_id = p.page_id) UNION ALL SELECT p.page_id, p.name, p.path, ph.level + 1, CONCAT(ph.hierarchy_path, '->', CAST(p.page_id AS CHAR)) AS hierarchy_path FROM pages AS p INNER JOIN page_hierarchy AS phierarchy ON p.page_id = phierarchy.child_page_id INNER JOIN PageHierarchy AS ph ON phierarchy.parent_page_id = ph.page_id), PagePerformance AS (SELECT p.page_id, pp.load_time, pp.bounce_rate, pp.exit_rate, COUNT(v.view_id) AS total_views, AVG(v.view_duration) AS avg_view_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id) AS unique_visitors FROM pages AS p LEFT JOIN page_performance AS pp ON p.page_id = pp.page_id LEFT JOIN page_views AS v ON p.page_id = v.page_id GROUP BY p.page_id, pp.load_time, pp.bounce_rate, pp.exit_rate), PageUserInteractions AS (SELECT p.page_id, u.username, u.role, COUNT(v.view_id) AS user_views, AVG(v.view_duration) AS user_avg_view_duration FROM pages AS p INNER JOIN page_views AS v ON p.page_id = v.page_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY p.page_id, u.username, u.role) SELECT ph.name AS page_name, ph.path AS page_path, pp.load_time, pp.bounce_rate, pp.exit_rate, pp.total_views, pp.avg_view_duration, pp.unique_visitors, pui.username, pui.role, pui.user_views, pui.user_avg_view_duration FROM PageHierarchy AS ph LEFT JOIN PagePerformance AS pp ON ph.page_id = pp.page_id LEFT JOIN PageUserInteractions AS pui ON ph.page_id = pui.page_id ORDER BY ph.level, ph.hierarchy_path
SELECT hour_id, energy_source, SUM(`load`) AS total_load FROM energy_consumption WHERE year_id = 1 AND source_type = 'residential' GROUP BY hour_id, energy_source ORDER BY hour_id

WITH DatasetActivity AS (SELECT d.dataset_id, d.name AS dataset_name, d.description, d.upload_date, d.last_modified, u.name AS owner_name, d.privacy_level, COUNT(DISTINCT al.access_id) AS access_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.preprocessing_id) AS preprocess_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ml.model_id) AS model_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.visualization_id) AS visualization_count, COUNT(DISTINCT res.result_id) AS result_count FROM datasets AS d LEFT JOIN users AS u ON d.owner_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON d.dataset_id = al.dataset_id LEFT JOIN data_preprocessing AS dp ON d.dataset_id = dp.dataset_id LEFT JOIN machine_learning_models AS ml ON d.dataset_id = ml.dataset_id LEFT JOIN data_visualizations AS dv ON d.dataset_id = dv.dataset_id LEFT JOIN results AS res ON ml.model_id = res.model_id OR dv.visualization_id = res.visualization_id GROUP BY d.dataset_id, d.name, d.description, d.upload_date, d.last_modified, u.name, d.privacy_level), VersionHistory AS (SELECT dv.dataset_id, MAX(CAST(dv.version_number AS SIGNED)) AS latest_version_number, MAX(CASE WHEN dv.version_status = 'published' THEN CAST(dv.version_number AS SIGNED) END) AS latest_published_version, MAX(dv.update_date) AS last_update_date FROM dataset_versions AS dv GROUP BY dv.dataset_id), TopModelAccuracy AS (SELECT ml.dataset_id, MAX(ml.model_accuracy) AS top_accuracy FROM machine_learning_models AS ml GROUP BY ml.dataset_id), OverallAnalysis AS (SELECT da.dataset_id, da.dataset_name, da.description, da.upload_date, da.last_modified, da.owner_name, da.privacy_level, vh.latest_version_number, vh.latest_published_version, vh.last_update_date, ma.top_accuracy, da.access_count, da.preprocess_count, da.model_count, da.visualization_count, da.result_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY da.model_count DESC) AS model_rank FROM DatasetActivity AS da LEFT JOIN VersionHistory AS vh ON da.dataset_id = vh.dataset_id LEFT JOIN TopModelAccuracy AS ma ON da.dataset_id = ma.dataset_id) SELECT DISTINCT oa.dataset_id, oa.dataset_name, oa.description, oa.upload_date, oa.last_modified, oa.owner_name, oa.privacy_level, oa.latest_version_number, oa.latest_published_version, oa.last_update_date, oa.top_accuracy, oa.access_count, oa.preprocess_count, oa.model_count, oa.visualization_count, oa.result_count, oa.model_rank FROM OverallAnalysis AS oa WHERE oa.model_count > 0 ORDER BY oa.model_rank

SELECT a.account_name, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS `Number_of_Customers` FROM customers AS c JOIN accounts AS acc ON c.customer_id = acc.customer_id JOIN account_types AS a ON acc.account_type_id = a.account_type_id WHERE acc.account_status = 'Active' GROUP BY a.account_name ORDER BY COUNT(c.customer_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name FROM players AS p JOIN player_statistics AS ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id JOIN player_match_records AS pmr ON p.player_id = pmr.player_id WHERE pmr.role_in_match = 'batsman' AND ps.total_matches > 10 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(pmr.batting_score AS CHAR), 1, LOCATE('/', CAST(pmr.batting_score AS CHAR)) - 1) AS SIGNED)) > 30

WITH AddressAggregation AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.p_f_name, c.p_l_name, COUNT(ca.customer_address_id) AS total_active_addresses, GROUP_CONCAT(at.address_type_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS address_types FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN customer_addresses AS ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id INNER JOIN address_types AS at ON ca.address_type_id = at.address_type_id INNER JOIN addresses AS a ON ca.address_id = a.address_id WHERE a.address_status = 'active' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.p_f_name, c.p_l_name) SELECT CONCAT(p_f_name, ' ', p_l_name) AS full_name, total_active_addresses, address_types FROM AddressAggregation ORDER BY total_active_addresses DESC

WITH ModelPerformance AS (SELECT m.model_id, m.name AS model_name, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.model_id ORDER BY mp.cv_score DESC) AS rank_cv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.model_id ORDER BY mp.holdout_roc_auc_score DESC) AS rank_auc FROM models AS m LEFT JOIN model_performance AS mp ON m.model_id = mp.model_id), HyperparameterDetails AS (SELECT h.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(h.name, ': ', h.value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS hyperparameters FROM hyperparameters AS h GROUP BY h.model_id), CombinedModelInfo AS (SELECT mp.model_id, mp.model_name, CASE WHEN mp.rank_cv = 1 THEN 'Best CV Score' WHEN mp.rank_auc = 1 THEN 'Best AUC Score' ELSE 'Other' END AS performance_label, hp.hyperparameters FROM ModelPerformance AS mp LEFT JOIN HyperparameterDetails AS hp ON mp.model_id = hp.model_id) SELECT cmi.model_name, cmi.performance_label, cmi.hyperparameters FROM CombinedModelInfo AS cmi WHERE NOT cmi.hyperparameters IS NULL ORDER BY cmi.model_name, cmi.performance_label

WITH SalesAmountCTE AS (SELECT s.outlet_id, s.item_id, SUM(s.sale_amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM sales AS s GROUP BY s.outlet_id, s.item_id), RankedSalesCTE AS (SELECT sa.outlet_id, sa.item_id, sa.total_sales_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.outlet_id ORDER BY sa.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank FROM SalesAmountCTE AS sa) SELECT o.outlet_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(i.item_name, ' (', rs.total_sales_amount, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_items FROM RankedSalesCTE AS rs JOIN items AS i ON rs.item_id = i.item_id JOIN outlets AS o ON rs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY o.outlet_id ORDER BY o.outlet_id

WITH DishNutrition AS (SELECT di.dish_id, SUM(i.calories) AS total_calories, GROUP_CONCAT(i.nutritional_value SEPARATOR ', ') AS nutritional_values FROM dish_ingredients AS di JOIN ingredients AS i ON di.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE di.is_archived = 0 AND i.is_archived = 0 GROUP BY di.dish_id), TopDishes AS (SELECT d.dish_id, d.dish_name, d.num_ingredients, de.average_effectiveness_rating, de.effectiveness_rating_count FROM dishes AS d JOIN dish_effectiveness AS de ON d.dish_id = de.dish_id WHERE d.is_archived = 0 AND de.average_effectiveness_rating >= 7.0 ORDER BY de.average_effectiveness_rating DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT t.dish_name, t.num_ingredients, dn.total_calories, dn.nutritional_values, t.average_effectiveness_rating, t.effectiveness_rating_count FROM TopDishes AS t JOIN DishNutrition AS dn ON t.dish_id = dn.dish_id ORDER BY t.average_effectiveness_rating DESC

SELECT employee_id, review_date, rating, comments, goals, AVG(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id) AS avg_rating, CASE WHEN rating >= 4 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN rating >= 3 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Needs Improvement' END AS performance_level, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(review_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS review_year FROM performance_reviews WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(review_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' ORDER BY employee_id, review_date DESC

WITH DraftSummary AS (SELECT d.draft_id, d.league_id, d.draft_date, d.rounds, COUNT(dp.pick_id) AS total_picks, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.round <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_round_picks FROM drafts AS d LEFT JOIN draft_picks AS dp ON d.draft_id = dp.draft_id GROUP BY d.draft_id, d.league_id, d.draft_date, d.rounds), FantasyTeamHealth AS (SELECT ft.team_id, ft.team_name, COUNT(pi.injury_id) AS number_of_injured_players, COUNT(pi.injury_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ftr.player_id) AS injury_rate FROM fantasy_teams AS ft LEFT JOIN fantasy_team_rosters AS ftr ON ft.team_id = ftr.team_id LEFT JOIN player_injuries AS pi ON ftr.player_id = pi.player_id GROUP BY ft.team_id, ft.team_name), DraftPerformance AS (SELECT dp.team_id, dp.draft_id, SUM(gs.rush_yds) + SUM(gs.rec_yds) + SUM(gs.pass_yds) AS total_yards, SUM(gs.rush_td) + SUM(gs.rec_td) + SUM(gs.pass_td) AS total_tds, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.player_id) AS distinct_players_drafted FROM draft_picks AS dp LEFT JOIN game_stats AS gs ON dp.player_id = gs.player_id GROUP BY dp.team_id, dp.draft_id) SELECT fth.team_name, dp.total_yards, dp.total_tds, fth.number_of_injured_players, fth.injury_rate, ds.draft_date, ds.rounds, ds.total_picks, dp.distinct_players_drafted FROM FantasyTeamHealth AS fth JOIN DraftPerformance AS dp ON fth.team_id = dp.team_id JOIN DraftSummary AS ds ON dp.draft_id = ds.draft_id WHERE fth.injury_rate > 0.1 ORDER BY fth.injury_rate DESC

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_category_id, CAST(category_name AS CHAR) AS full_path FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CONCAT(ch.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name) FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), ActivityDetails AS (SELECT la.activity_id, la.category_id, la.activity_type_id, la.number_of_sessions, la.length, la.student_hours, la.comments, la.course_id, la.instructor_id, c.full_path AS category_path FROM learning_activities AS la JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS c ON la.category_id = c.category_id), CourseDetails AS (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, c.department_id, c.credits, c.prerequisites, c.learning_outcomes, c.instructor_id AS course_instructor_id, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS primary_instructor_name FROM courses AS c JOIN users AS u ON c.instructor_id = u.user_id), AttendanceStats AS (SELECT activity_id, COUNT(student_id) AS total_students, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_present, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_absent, SUM(CASE WHEN late_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_late FROM attendance_records GROUP BY activity_id), FeedbackAggregate AS (SELECT activity_id, AVG(rating) AS average_feedback_rating FROM feedback GROUP BY activity_id) SELECT ad.activity_id, ad.category_path, ad.activity_type_id, ad.number_of_sessions, ad.length, ad.student_hours, ad.comments, ad.course_id, ad.instructor_id, cd.course_name, cd.department_id, cd.credits, cd.prerequisites AS course_prerequisites, cd.learning_outcomes AS course_learning_outcomes, cd.primary_instructor_name, at.total_students, at.total_present, at.total_absent, at.total_late, fb.average_feedback_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.course_id ORDER BY fb.average_feedback_rating DESC, at.total_students DESC) AS rank_within_course FROM ActivityDetails AS ad JOIN CourseDetails AS cd ON ad.course_id = cd.course_id LEFT JOIN AttendanceStats AS at ON ad.activity_id = at.activity_id LEFT JOIN FeedbackAggregate AS fb ON ad.activity_id = fb.activity_id ORDER BY fb.average_feedback_rating DESC, at.total_students DESC

WITH RankedDiseases AS (SELECT ch.crop_name, d.disease_name, ds.severity_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.crop_name ORDER BY ds.severity_level DESC) AS severity_rank FROM crop_histories AS ch JOIN diseases AS d ON LOCATE(d.disease_name, ch.previous_diseases) > 0 JOIN disease_severity AS ds ON ch.crop_history_id = ds.severity_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leaf_conditions AS lc WHERE lc.leaf_mild = 0 AND lc.chlorosis = 0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stem_conditions AS sc WHERE sc.stem = 1 AND sc.lodging = 0)) SELECT crop_name, disease_name, severity_level FROM RankedDiseases WHERE severity_rank <= 3

WITH HomeownershipStatsCTE AS (SELECT h.year, h.percentage, h.ethnicity_id, h.age_group_id, h.location_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY h.year DESC) AS year_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.ethnicity_id, h.age_group_id, h.location_id ORDER BY h.percentage DESC) AS percentage_rank FROM homeownership_stats AS h), RelevantPoliciesCTE AS (SELECT p.policy_name, p.effective_date, p.impact_description, p.target_ethnicity_id, p.target_age_group_id, p.target_location_id, h.year, h.percentage, h.ethnicity_id, h.age_group_id, h.location_id, h.year_rank, h.percentage_rank FROM government_policies AS p INNER JOIN HomeownershipStatsCTE AS h ON p.target_ethnicity_id = h.ethnicity_id AND p.target_age_group_id = h.age_group_id AND p.target_location_id = h.location_id AND h.year >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(p.effective_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) + 3), FinalSummaryCTE AS (SELECT rp.policy_name, rp.year, e.ethnicity_name, a.age_group_name, l.city, l.region, l.country, rp.impact_description FROM RelevantPoliciesCTE AS rp INNER JOIN ethnicities AS e ON rp.ethnicity_id = e.ethnicity_id INNER JOIN age_groups AS a ON rp.age_group_id = a.age_group_id INNER JOIN geographic_locations AS l ON rp.location_id = l.location_id WHERE rp.year_rank <= 3 AND rp.percentage_rank <= 3) SELECT CONCAT('Policy: ', fs.policy_name, ', Year: ', fs.year, ', Ethnicity: ', fs.ethnicity_name, ', Age Group: ', fs.age_group_name, ', City: ', fs.city, ', Region: ', fs.region, ', Country: ', fs.country, ', Impact: ', fs.impact_description) AS summary FROM FinalSummaryCTE AS fs

WITH EventMetrics AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.ride_date, e.team_name, r.`rank`, t.team_leader, a.participation_count FROM events AS e JOIN results AS r ON e.event_id = r.event_id JOIN teams AS t ON r.team_id = t.team_id JOIN analytics AS a ON e.event_id = a.event_id) SELECT em.event_id, CONCAT(em.team_name, ' (', em.team_leader, ') ', CASE WHEN em.`rank` = 1 THEN '1st' WHEN em.`rank` = 2 THEN '2nd' WHEN em.`rank` = 3 THEN '3rd' ELSE CONCAT(CAST(em.`rank` AS CHAR), 'th') END) AS team_performance, SUM(em.participation_count) OVER (PARTITION BY em.event_id) AS total_teams_participating FROM EventMetrics AS em ORDER BY em.event_id, em.`rank`

WITH MissRate2023 AS (SELECT lh.latch_id, lh.timestamp, (CAST(CAST(REPLACE(lh.misses, ',', '') AS SIGNED) / CAST(REPLACE(lh.get_requests, ',', '') AS SIGNED) AS SIGNED)) * 100 AS miss_rate FROM latch_history AS lh WHERE lh.timestamp BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND CAST(REPLACE(lh.get_requests, ',', '') AS SIGNED) > 0), HighestMissRate AS (SELECT mr.latch_id, mr.timestamp, mr.miss_rate FROM MissRate2023 AS mr WHERE (mr.latch_id, mr.miss_rate) IN (SELECT lr.latch_id, MAX(lr.miss_rate) FROM MissRate2023 AS lr GROUP BY lr.latch_id)), LatchConfig AS (SELECT lc.latch_id, lc.config_key, lc.config_value, lc.last_updated FROM latch_configurations AS lc WHERE lc.last_updated BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'), AlertsForHighMissLatches AS (SELECT a.alert_id, a.latch_id, a.alert_type, a.alert_message, a.threshold, a.severity, a.acknowledged_by, a.alerted_at FROM alerts AS a WHERE a.latch_id IN (SELECT hmrl.latch_id FROM HighestMissRate AS hmrl) AND a.alerted_at BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'), ResolvedAlerts AS (SELECT al.alert_id, al.action_taken, u.user_name AS resolved_by, al.resolved_at, al.resolution_comments FROM alert_logs AS al INNER JOIN users AS u ON al.resolved_by = u.user_id WHERE al.resolved_at BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') SELECT hmr.latch_id, hmr.timestamp AS high_miss_rate_timestamp, hmr.miss_rate AS high_miss_rate, lc.config_key, lc.config_value, a.alert_type, a.alert_message, a.threshold, a.severity, ra.resolved_by, ra.resolved_at, ra.resolution_comments FROM HighestMissRate AS hmr LEFT JOIN LatchConfig AS lc ON hmr.latch_id = lc.latch_id LEFT JOIN AlertsForHighMissLatches AS a ON hmr.latch_id = a.latch_id LEFT JOIN ResolvedAlerts AS ra ON a.alert_id = ra.alert_id ORDER BY hmr.latch_id, hmr.timestamp DESC

WITH UserActivityCTE AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.username, COUNT(ua.activity_id) AS activity_count FROM users AS u INNER JOIN user_activity AS ua ON u.user_id = ua.user_id INNER JOIN daily_prices AS dp ON ua.resource = CAST(dp.price_id AS CHAR) INNER JOIN trading_sessions AS ts ON dp.date = ts.date AND ts.exchange = 'NASDAQ' AND ts.session_type = 'regular' WHERE ua.action = 'trade' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username), TopUsersCTE AS (SELECT user_id, username, activity_count FROM UserActivityCTE ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 3), TradingDataCTE AS (SELECT tu.user_id, AVG(dp.close) AS avg_closing_price, AVG(dp.volume) AS avg_volume FROM TopUsersCTE AS tu INNER JOIN user_activity AS ua ON tu.user_id = ua.user_id INNER JOIN daily_prices AS dp ON ua.resource = CAST(dp.price_id AS CHAR) INNER JOIN trading_sessions AS ts ON dp.date = ts.date AND ts.exchange = 'NASDAQ' AND ts.session_type = 'regular' WHERE ua.action = 'trade' GROUP BY tu.user_id) SELECT tu.user_id, tu.username, tu.activity_count, td.avg_closing_price, td.avg_volume FROM TopUsersCTE AS tu JOIN TradingDataCTE AS td ON tu.user_id = td.user_id

WITH disease_losses AS (SELECT d.disease_name, SUM(ch.yield) AS total_yield_loss FROM diseases AS d JOIN crop_histories AS ch ON LOCATE(CONCAT(',', d.disease_name, ','), CONCAT(',', ch.previous_diseases, ',')) > 0 GROUP BY d.disease_name HAVING SUM(ch.yield) < 150) SELECT disease_name, total_yield_loss FROM disease_losses ORDER BY total_yield_loss DESC LIMIT 1

WITH TestCaseExecutions AS (SELECT tc.case_id, tc.case_name, ts.suite_name, tc.priority, COUNT(te.execution_id) AS execution_count FROM test_cases AS tc JOIN test_suites AS ts ON tc.suite_id = ts.suite_id JOIN test_execution AS te ON tc.case_id = te.case_id GROUP BY tc.case_id, tc.case_name, ts.suite_name, tc.priority), RankedTestCases AS (SELECT tce.case_id, tce.case_name, tce.suite_name, tce.priority, tce.execution_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tce.suite_name ORDER BY tce.priority ASC, tce.execution_count DESC) AS rn FROM TestCaseExecutions AS tce) SELECT rtc.suite_name, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('Test Case: ', rtc.case_name, ', Priority: ', rtc.priority, ', Executions: ', rtc.execution_count) SEPARATOR '; ') AS top_test_cases FROM RankedTestCases AS rtc WHERE rtc.rn <= 3 GROUP BY rtc.suite_name

SELECT DISTINCT b.boat_name FROM races AS r JOIN race_participants AS rp ON r.race_id = rp.race_id JOIN boats AS b ON rp.boat_id = b.boat_id WHERE r.race_status = 'completed' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(r.race_duration, 1, LOCATE(':', r.race_duration) - 1) AS SIGNED) > 1

WITH FirstPlaceWinners AS (SELECT athlete_id, year, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM earnings), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS total_earnings FROM annual_stats WHERE first_place > 0 GROUP BY athlete_id, year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sport_id) >= 2) SELECT athlete_id, year, AVG(total_earnings) AS average_earnings FROM FirstPlaceWinners GROUP BY athlete_id, year ORDER BY year

SELECT COUNT(*) AS Number_of_incidents FROM incidents INNER JOIN highways ON incidents.highway_id = highways.highway_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(incident_date AS DATETIME), '%m') IN ('06', '07', '08') AND highways.speed_limit < 50

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, COUNT(ci.interaction_id) AS interactions_count FROM employees AS e JOIN customer_interactions AS ci ON e.employee_id = ci.employee_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ci.interaction_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' AND ci.interaction_type = 'meeting' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name HAVING COUNT(ci.interaction_id) > 1

SELECT COUNT(b.book_id) AS total_books, a.author_name FROM books AS b JOIN authors AS a ON b.author_id = a.author_id WHERE b.available_copies > 0 AND b.publication_year >= (SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) - 10) GROUP BY a.author_name HAVING COUNT(b.book_id) > 0

WITH TeamPlayerCount AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM players GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(p.height, 1, LOCATE('''', p.height) - 1) AS FLOAT) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(p.height, LOCATE('''', p.height) + 2, LENGTH(p.height) - LOCATE('''', p.height)) AS FLOAT)) AS average_height_inches FROM players AS p INNER JOIN teams AS t ON p.team_id = t.team_id INNER JOIN TeamPlayerCount AS tpc ON p.team_id = tpc.team_id WHERE tpc.player_count > 3 GROUP BY t.team_name

WITH EngagedUsers AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.username, SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) AS total_engagement FROM users AS u INNER JOIN user_engagement AS ue ON u.user_id = ue.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username HAVING SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) > 100), HighEngagementTweets AS (SELECT t.tweet_id, t.timestamp, t.username, t.text, t.hashtags, t.sentiment, SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) AS total_engagement FROM tweets AS t INNER JOIN user_engagement AS ue ON t.tweet_id = ue.tweet_id INNER JOIN EngagedUsers AS eu ON t.username = eu.username WHERE t.sentiment = 'positive' GROUP BY t.tweet_id, t.timestamp, t.username, t.text, t.hashtags, t.sentiment HAVING SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) > 50), HashtagUsage AS (SELECT h.hashtag, COUNT(t.tweet_id) AS tweet_count, SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) AS total_engagement FROM HighEngagementTweets AS t INNER JOIN hashtags AS h ON LOCATE(h.hashtag, t.hashtags) > 0 INNER JOIN user_engagement AS ue ON t.tweet_id = ue.tweet_id GROUP BY h.hashtag HAVING COUNT(t.tweet_id) > 5) SELECT hu.hashtag, hu.tweet_count, hu.total_engagement FROM HashtagUsage AS hu ORDER BY hu.total_engagement DESC

WITH TotalSpending AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(CAST(o.total_price AS FLOAT)) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.customer_id), RankedCustomers AS (SELECT ts.customer_id, ts.total_spent, ts.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM TotalSpending AS ts), TopCustomers AS (SELECT rc.customer_id, rc.total_spent, rc.order_count FROM RankedCustomers AS rc WHERE rc.customer_rank <= 5), CustomerDetails AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, tc.total_spent, tc.order_count FROM TopCustomers AS tc JOIN customers AS c ON tc.customer_id = c.customer_id), CustomerProducts AS (SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.customer_name, cd.total_spent, cd.order_count, p.product_name FROM CustomerDetails AS cd JOIN order_items AS oi ON cd.customer_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id) SELECT cp.customer_id, cp.customer_name, cp.total_spent, cp.order_count, GROUP_CONCAT(cp.product_name SEPARATOR ',') AS products_purchased FROM CustomerProducts AS cp GROUP BY cp.customer_id, cp.customer_name, cp.total_spent, cp.order_count ORDER BY cp.total_spent DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT latch_name, category, get_requests, misses, last_updated FROM latches WHERE CAST(get_requests AS SIGNED) > 1000 ORDER BY last_updated DESC

SELECT s.name AS song_name, a.name AS album_name, ar.name AS artist_name FROM songs AS s JOIN albums AS a ON s.album_id = a.album_id JOIN artists AS ar ON s.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(s.release_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2019' AND s.popularity > 80 ORDER BY s.name ASC

SELECT b.date_sampled AS date, GROUP_CONCAT(b.element SEPARATOR ',') AS elements_measured FROM biochemical_data AS b WHERE b.method = 'Spectrophotometry' GROUP BY b.date_sampled HAVING COUNT(b.element) > 1

WITH JobDetails AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.title, c.company_name, e.type_name, l.level_name, j.years_exp, j.country, j.skills, j.salary_range, j.benefits, j.posted_date, j.deadline, r.name AS recruiter_name FROM jobs AS j INNER JOIN companies AS c ON j.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN employment_types AS e ON j.type = e.type_id INNER JOIN experience_levels AS l ON j.level = l.level_id INNER JOIN recruiters AS r ON j.recruiter_id = r.recruiter_id), ApplicantDetails AS (SELECT a.job_id, ap.name AS applicant_name, ap.email AS applicant_email, ap.phone AS applicant_phone, ap.linkedin_profile, ap.portfolio_url, s.status_name, s.description AS status_description, a.application_date, a.last_updated FROM job_applications AS a INNER JOIN applicants AS ap ON a.applicant_id = ap.applicant_id INNER JOIN application_status AS s ON a.status_id = s.status_id), JobStats AS (SELECT a.job_id, COUNT(a.application_id) AS total_applications, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(jd.years_exp, 1, LOCATE('-', jd.years_exp) - 1) AS SIGNED)) AS avg_years_exp_required FROM job_applications AS a INNER JOIN JobDetails AS jd ON a.job_id = jd.job_id GROUP BY a.job_id) SELECT jd.title, jd.company_name, jd.type_name AS employment_type, jd.level_name AS experience_level, jd.years_exp, jd.country, jd.skills, jd.salary_range, jd.benefits, jd.posted_date, jd.deadline, jd.recruiter_name, js.total_applications, js.avg_years_exp_required, ad.applicant_name, ad.applicant_email, ad.applicant_phone, ad.linkedin_profile, ad.portfolio_url, ad.status_name, ad.status_description, ad.application_date, ad.last_updated FROM JobDetails AS jd LEFT JOIN JobStats AS js ON jd.job_id = js.job_id LEFT JOIN ApplicantDetails AS ad ON jd.job_id = ad.job_id ORDER BY jd.title, ad.applicant_name

WITH LatestVersions AS (SELECT mv.model_id, mv.version, mv.created_at, mv.version_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.model_id ORDER BY mv.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM model_versions AS mv), HyperparametersAgg AS (SELECT h.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(h.name, ': ', h.value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS hyperparameters FROM hyperparameters AS h GROUP BY h.model_id), CommentsAgg AS (SELECT mc.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(mc.comment SEPARATOR ' | ') AS comments FROM model_comments AS mc GROUP BY mc.model_id), OwnersCollaborators AS (SELECT mo.model_id, MAX(CASE WHEN mo.ownership_type = 'owner' THEN mo.user_id ELSE NULL END) AS owner_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN mo.ownership_type = 'collaborator' THEN CAST(mo.user_id AS CHAR) ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ', ') AS collaborator_id FROM model_ownership AS mo GROUP BY mo.model_id) SELECT m.model_id, m.name, m.algorithm, lv.version, lv.created_at AS latest_version_created_at, vp.cv_score, vp.holdout_score, vp.holdout_roc_auc_score, vp.training_time, vp.evaluation_time, ha.hyperparameters, ca.comments, oc.owner_id, oc.collaborator_id FROM models AS m LEFT JOIN LatestVersions AS lv ON m.model_id = lv.model_id AND lv.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN version_performance AS vp ON lv.version_id = vp.version_id LEFT JOIN HyperparametersAgg AS ha ON m.model_id = ha.model_id LEFT JOIN CommentsAgg AS ca ON m.model_id = ca.model_id LEFT JOIN OwnersCollaborators AS oc ON m.model_id = oc.model_id ORDER BY m.model_id, lv.created_at DESC

WITH TopPerformers AS (SELECT d.driver_id, d.name AS driver_name, d.wins, d.championships, t.team_id, t.team_name FROM drivers AS d INNER JOIN teams AS t ON d.team_id = t.team_id WHERE d.wins > 0 AND d.championships > 0), ChampionshipEvents AS (SELECT cp.championship_id, cp.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, cp.year FROM championships AS cp INNER JOIN events AS e ON cp.event_id = e.event_id) SELECT tp.driver_id, tp.driver_name, tp.wins, tp.championships, tp.team_id, tp.team_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ce.event_name, ' on ', ce.event_date, ' (', ce.year, ')') SEPARATOR ',') AS championship_events FROM TopPerformers AS tp INNER JOIN championships AS ch ON tp.driver_id = ch.driver_id INNER JOIN ChampionshipEvents AS ce ON ch.event_id = ce.event_id GROUP BY tp.driver_id, tp.driver_name, tp.wins, tp.championships, tp.team_id, tp.team_name ORDER BY tp.championships DESC, tp.wins DESC

SELECT t.tech_name, COUNT(*) AS ResourceCount, GROUP_CONCAT(r.purpose SEPARATOR ', ') AS Purposes FROM resources AS r JOIN resource_technologies AS rt ON r.resource_id = rt.resource_id JOIN technologies AS t ON rt.tech_id = t.tech_id GROUP BY t.tech_name ORDER BY ResourceCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT account_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(payment_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS Month, COUNT(payment_id) AS Number_of_Payments FROM interest_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY account_id, Month

SELECT p.title, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors FROM papers AS p JOIN paper_publications AS pp ON p.paper_id = pp.paper_id JOIN publications AS pub ON pub.publication_id = pp.publication_id JOIN paper_authors AS pa ON p.paper_id = pa.paper_id JOIN authors AS a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id JOIN citations AS c ON p.paper_id = c.paper_id WHERE pub.publication_name = 'Neural Information Processing Systems' GROUP BY p.paper_id, p.title ORDER BY COUNT(c.citation_id) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.proposed_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS proposed_month, AVG(rd.file_size) AS average_document_size FROM resolutions AS r JOIN resolution_documents AS rd ON r.resolution_id = rd.resolution_id WHERE NOT r.proposed_date IS NULL AND NOT rd.file_size IS NULL GROUP BY proposed_month ORDER BY proposed_month

WITH PatientConditions AS (SELECT p.patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(mc.condition_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS conditions, AVG(CASE mc.severity_level WHEN 'mild' THEN 1 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'severe' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS average_severity FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN medical_conditions AS mc ON p.patient_id = mc.patient_id WHERE p.patient_id = 0 GROUP BY p.patient_id), PatientLifestyle AS (SELECT pl.patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(pl.exercise_frequency, ', ', pl.diet_type, ', ', pl.alcohol_consumption, ', ', pl.sleep_quality, ', ', pl.stress_level) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS lifestyle_description FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN lifestyle_factors AS pl ON p.patient_id = pl.patient_id WHERE p.patient_id = 0 GROUP BY pl.patient_id), HealthOutcomes AS (SELECT ho.patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ho.outcome_type, ': ', ho.outcome_value, ' ', ho.unit_of_measure) SEPARATOR '; ') AS health_outcomes FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN health_outcomes AS ho ON p.patient_id = ho.patient_id WHERE p.patient_id = 0 GROUP BY ho.patient_id), HealthProviders AS (SELECT pp.patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(hp.provider_name, ': ', hp.specialty) SEPARATOR ',') AS providers FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN patient_provider AS pp ON p.patient_id = pp.patient_id INNER JOIN healthcare_providers AS hp ON pp.provider_id = hp.provider_id WHERE p.patient_id = 0 GROUP BY pp.patient_id) SELECT p.patient_id, p.gender, p.age, p.ethnicity, p.income, p.zip_code, p.address, p.phone_number, p.email, p.date_of_birth, p.registration_date, pc.conditions, pc.average_severity, pl.lifestyle_description, ho.health_outcomes, hp.providers FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN PatientConditions AS pc ON p.patient_id = pc.patient_id LEFT JOIN PatientLifestyle AS pl ON p.patient_id = pl.patient_id LEFT JOIN HealthOutcomes AS ho ON p.patient_id = ho.patient_id LEFT JOIN HealthProviders AS hp ON p.patient_id = hp.patient_id WHERE p.patient_id = 0

WITH TotalDelays AS (SELECT airport_id, SUM(carrier_delays + late_aircraft_delays + national_aviation_system_delays + security_delays + weather_delays) AS total_delays FROM delay_statistics WHERE airport_id = 1 AND year = 2003 AND month = 6 GROUP BY airport_id), CarrierDelays AS (SELECT f.carrier_id, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT fd.delay_reason_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights FROM flights AS f LEFT JOIN flight_delays AS fd ON f.flight_id = fd.flight_id WHERE f.airport_id = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.departure_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2003-06' GROUP BY f.carrier_id), DelayPercentage AS (SELECT cd.carrier_id, td.total_delays, cd.total_flights, cd.delayed_flights, (cd.delayed_flights * 100.0 / td.total_delays) AS delay_percentage FROM CarrierDelays AS cd JOIN TotalDelays AS td ON NOT cd.carrier_id IS NULL AND td.airport_id = 1) SELECT c.carrier_id, c.name AS carrier_name, dp.delay_percentage FROM DelayPercentage AS dp JOIN carriers AS c ON dp.carrier_id = c.carrier_id ORDER BY dp.delay_percentage DESC
SELECT year_id, AVG(`rank`) AS average_rank FROM ranks WHERE indicator_id = 1 GROUP BY year_id

WITH SchoolDataAccess AS (SELECT ds.data_set_id, ds.year AS data_set_year, ds.description AS data_set_description, COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_accesses, AVG(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(al.access_duration AS DATETIME), '%s') AS FLOAT)) AS avg_access_duration, MAX(al.access_date) AS latest_access_date FROM data_sets AS ds INNER JOIN schools AS s ON ds.school_id = s.school_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON ds.data_set_id = al.data_set_id WHERE s.school_name = 'Powell High School' GROUP BY ds.data_set_id, ds.year, ds.description), LatestAccess AS (SELECT sda.data_set_id, sda.data_set_year, sda.data_set_description, sda.total_accesses, sda.avg_access_duration, sda.latest_access_date, u.user_name AS last_access_admin FROM SchoolDataAccess AS sda LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON sda.data_set_id = al.data_set_id AND sda.latest_access_date = al.access_date LEFT JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id AND u.role = 'administrator') SELECT lda.data_set_id, lda.data_set_year, lda.data_set_description, lda.total_accesses, lda.avg_access_duration, lda.latest_access_date, lda.last_access_admin FROM LatestAccess AS lda ORDER BY lda.latest_access_date DESC, lda.data_set_id

WITH RECURSIVE WorkflowDependency AS (SELECT tw.task_id, tw.workflow_id, tw.sequence, tw.dependency_task_id, CAST(tw.task_id AS CHAR) AS dependency_chain FROM task_workflows AS tw WHERE tw.dependency_task_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT tw.task_id, tw.workflow_id, tw.sequence, tw.dependency_task_id, CAST(CONCAT(wd.dependency_chain, ' -> ', tw.task_id) AS CHAR) AS dependency_chain FROM task_workflows AS tw INNER JOIN WorkflowDependency AS wd ON tw.dependency_task_id = wd.task_id), TaskPerformance AS (SELECT p.run_id, p.task_id, p.production_quantity, t.priority, t.machine_id, SUM(p.production_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY p.task_id ORDER BY p.run_id) AS cumulative_production, SUM(p.production_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY p.machine_id ORDER BY p.run_id) AS machine_cumulative_production FROM production_runs AS p INNER JOIN tasks AS t ON p.task_id = t.task_id), InventoryStatus AS (SELECT i.part_id, i.inventory_level, i.reorder_point, (SELECT SUM(tp.production_quantity) FROM production_runs AS tp WHERE tp.task_id IN (SELECT tp2.task_id FROM task_parts AS tp2 WHERE tp2.part_id = i.part_id)) AS total_production, (CASE WHEN i.inventory_level < i.reorder_point THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'OK' END) AS inventory_status FROM inventories AS i), TaskAndPartAnalysis AS (SELECT tp.task_id, tp.part_id, tp.production_rate, tp.required_quantity, ws.dependency_chain, ws.sequence, ts.inventory_status, ts.total_production, ts.inventory_level FROM task_parts AS tp INNER JOIN WorkflowDependency AS ws ON tp.task_id = ws.task_id INNER JOIN InventoryStatus AS ts ON tp.part_id = ts.part_id), FutureInventoryAnalysis AS (SELECT tap.task_id, tap.part_id, tap.production_rate, tap.required_quantity, tap.dependency_chain, tap.sequence, tap.inventory_status, tap.inventory_level + tap.total_production - (tap.required_quantity * tap.sequence) AS future_inventory_level FROM TaskAndPartAnalysis AS tap) SELECT fa.task_id, fa.future_inventory_level FROM FutureInventoryAnalysis AS fa ORDER BY fa.sequence, fa.future_inventory_level

SELECT u.username, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(gd.size_in_bytes, 1, LENGTH(gd.size_in_bytes) - 2) AS SIGNED)) AS average_size_bytes FROM users AS u INNER JOIN generated_datasets AS gd ON u.user_id = gd.user_id WHERE u.is_active = 1 AND gd.is_archived = 0 GROUP BY u.username HAVING AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(gd.size_in_bytes, 1, LENGTH(gd.size_in_bytes) - 2) AS SIGNED)) > 1024

WITH TeamPerformanceCTE AS (SELECT s.team_id, s.season_id, s.`rank`, s.pct, t.team_name, d.division_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.season_id, d.division_id ORDER BY s.pct DESC, s.`rank` ASC) AS performance_rank FROM standings AS s INNER JOIN teams AS t ON s.team_id = t.team_id INNER JOIN divisions AS d ON t.division_id = d.division_id), TopPerformanceCTE AS (SELECT team_id, season_id, `rank`, pct, team_name, division_name, performance_rank FROM TeamPerformanceCTE WHERE performance_rank <= 3) SELECT tp.team_name AS top_team_name, tp.division_name, tp.pct AS win_percentage, tp.`rank` AS division_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tp.team_id) AS times_in_top_three FROM TopPerformanceCTE AS tp ORDER BY tp.team_id, tp.season_id

WITH DelayReasons AS (SELECT dr.delay_reason_id, dr.name AS delay_reason_name FROM delay_reasons AS dr), CarrierInfo AS (SELECT c.carrier_id, c.name AS carrier_name FROM carriers AS c), FlightDelays AS (SELECT f.flight_id, f.airport_id, f.carrier_id, fd.delay_reason_id, fd.delay_minutes, fd.delay_description FROM flights AS f INNER JOIN flight_delays AS fd ON f.flight_id = fd.flight_id), TotalFlights AS (SELECT fs.airport_id, fs.year, fs.month, fs.total, fs.`delayed`, fs.diverted, fs.on_time, fs.cancelled FROM flight_statistics AS fs), UserAccess AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, GROUP_CONCAT(a.code SEPARATOR ',') AS accessible_airports FROM users AS u INNER JOIN user_airport_access AS uaa ON u.user_id = uaa.user_id INNER JOIN airports AS a ON uaa.airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email) SELECT ci.carrier_name, tf.total, tf.`delayed`, tf.diverted, tf.on_time, tf.cancelled, dr.delay_reason_name, fd.delay_minutes, fd.delay_description, ua.first_name, ua.last_name, ua.email, ua.accessible_airports, tf.year, tf.month FROM CarrierInfo AS ci INNER JOIN FlightDelays AS fd ON ci.carrier_id = fd.carrier_id INNER JOIN DelayReasons AS dr ON fd.delay_reason_id = dr.delay_reason_id INNER JOIN TotalFlights AS tf ON fd.airport_id = tf.airport_id INNER JOIN UserAccess AS ua ON ua.accessible_airports LIKE CONCAT('%', (SELECT a.code FROM airports AS a WHERE a.airport_id = tf.airport_id), '%') ORDER BY ci.carrier_name, fd.delay_minutes DESC

WITH ProgramDetails AS (SELECT tp.program_id, tp.program_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) AS total_sessions, AVG(s.duration) AS avg_session_duration FROM training_programs AS tp LEFT JOIN sessions AS s ON tp.program_id = s.program_id GROUP BY tp.program_id, tp.program_name), ParticipantEngagement AS (SELECT p.participant_id, p.name, COUNT(a.attendance_id) AS total_sessions_attended, AVG(f.rating) AS avg_feedback_rating FROM participants AS p LEFT JOIN attendances AS a ON p.participant_id = a.participant_id LEFT JOIN feedbacks AS f ON a.session_id = f.session_id AND a.participant_id = f.participant_id GROUP BY p.participant_id, p.name), TrainingPerformance AS (SELECT pd.program_id, pd.program_name, pe.participant_id, pe.name, pe.total_sessions_attended, pe.avg_feedback_rating, pd.total_sessions, CASE WHEN pe.total_sessions_attended / pd.total_sessions > 0.8 THEN 'High' WHEN pe.total_sessions_attended / pd.total_sessions > 0.5 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Low' END AS engagement_level FROM ProgramDetails AS pd INNER JOIN ParticipantEngagement AS pe ON 1 = 1), ProgramEvaluation AS (SELECT program_id, AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_program_rating, COUNT(evaluation_id) AS total_evaluations FROM program_evaluations GROUP BY program_id) SELECT tp.program_name, tp.participant_id, tp.name, tp.engagement_level, pe.avg_program_rating, pe.total_evaluations FROM TrainingPerformance AS tp LEFT JOIN ProgramEvaluation AS pe ON tp.program_id = pe.program_id ORDER BY tp.program_name, tp.participant_id

WITH FilteredData AS (SELECT d.age, d.education, d.occupation, d.income FROM demographic_data AS d WHERE d.occupation IN (SELECT occupation_name FROM occupations WHERE average_salary > 75000) AND d.education IN (SELECT education_level FROM educational_levels WHERE degree_duration >= 4)), AvgIncomePerDemographic AS (SELECT age, education, occupation, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(i.income_bracket, 1, LENGTH(i.income_bracket) - 2) AS SIGNED)) AS avg_income FROM FilteredData AS fd INNER JOIN income_brackets AS i ON fd.income = i.income_bracket GROUP BY age, education, occupation), RankedDemographics AS (SELECT age, education, occupation, avg_income, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_income DESC) AS income_rank FROM AvgIncomePerDemographic) SELECT age FROM RankedDemographics WHERE income_rank <= 5 ORDER BY income_rank

WITH PolicyImpactCTE AS (SELECT g.policy_id, g.policy_name, g.effective_date, hs.year, hs.percentage AS homeownership_percentage FROM government_policies AS g INNER JOIN homeownership_stats AS hs ON hs.ethnicity_id = g.target_ethnicity_id AND hs.age_group_id = g.target_age_group_id AND hs.year >= CAST(SUBSTRING(g.effective_date, 1, 4) AS SIGNED)) SELECT policy_name, AVG(homeownership_percentage) AS average_homeownership_percentage FROM PolicyImpactCTE GROUP BY policy_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) > 3 ORDER BY average_homeownership_percentage DESC
SELECT nuts2_code, year_id, SUM(`load`) AS total_load FROM energy_consumption WHERE nuts2_code = '0' AND year_id = (SELECT year_id FROM years WHERE year = 2010) GROUP BY nuts2_code, year_id

SELECT p.patient_id, (CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name)) AS full_name, d.disease_name, pdr.diagnosis_date, pdr.follow_up_date, GROUP_CONCAT(tp.treatment_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS treatments, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS doctors, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count, MAX(a.access_date) AS last_access_date FROM patients AS p INNER JOIN patient_disease_records AS pdr ON p.patient_id = pdr.patient_id INNER JOIN diseases AS d ON pdr.disease_id = d.disease_id LEFT JOIN treatment_plans AS tp ON p.patient_id = tp.patient_id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON tp.prescribed_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS a ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, d.disease_name, pdr.diagnosis_date, pdr.follow_up_date, u.first_name, u.last_name ORDER BY p.patient_id

WITH LatchPerformance AS (SELECT l.latch_id, l.latch_name, l.category, lh.timestamp, CAST(lh.get_requests AS SIGNED) AS get_requests, CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED) AS misses, CAST(lh.sleeps AS SIGNED) AS sleeps, CAST(lh.spin_gets AS SIGNED) AS spin_gets FROM latches AS l INNER JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id), CumulativeMetrics AS (SELECT lp.latch_id, lp.latch_name, lp.category, lp.timestamp, lp.get_requests, lp.misses, lp.sleeps, lp.spin_gets, SUM(lp.get_requests) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.latch_id ORDER BY lp.timestamp) AS cumulative_get_requests, SUM(lp.misses) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.latch_id ORDER BY lp.timestamp) AS cumulative_misses, SUM(lp.sleeps) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.latch_id ORDER BY lp.timestamp) AS cumulative_sleeps, SUM(lp.spin_gets) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.latch_id ORDER BY lp.timestamp) AS cumulative_spin_gets FROM LatchPerformance AS lp), AlertDetails AS (SELECT a.latch_id, a.alert_type, a.alert_message, a.threshold, a.severity, a.alerted_at, u.user_name AS acknowledged_by FROM alerts AS a LEFT JOIN users AS u ON a.acknowledged_by = u.user_id) SELECT cm.latch_name, cm.category, cm.timestamp, cm.get_requests AS total_get_requests, cm.misses AS total_misses, cm.sleeps AS total_sleeps, cm.spin_gets AS total_spin_gets, cm.cumulative_get_requests, cm.cumulative_misses, cm.cumulative_sleeps, cm.cumulative_spin_gets, ad.alert_type, ad.alert_message, ad.threshold, ad.severity, ad.alerted_at, ad.acknowledged_by FROM CumulativeMetrics AS cm LEFT JOIN AlertDetails AS ad ON cm.latch_id = ad.latch_id AND cm.timestamp >= ad.alerted_at ORDER BY cm.latch_id, cm.timestamp

WITH ConfigSuccessRate AS (SELECT dc.config_id, dc.connector, COUNT(dgl.log_id) AS total_attempts, COUNT(CASE WHEN dgl.status = 'success' THEN 1 END) AS success_attempts, (COUNT(CASE WHEN dgl.status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(dgl.log_id)) AS success_rate FROM data_generation_configs AS dc LEFT JOIN data_generation_logs AS dgl ON dc.config_id = dgl.config_id GROUP BY dc.config_id, dc.connector), MaxSuccessRatePerConnector AS (SELECT connector, MAX(success_rate) AS max_success_rate FROM ConfigSuccessRate GROUP BY connector), NormalizedSuccessRate AS (SELECT csr.config_id, csr.connector, csr.success_rate, msr.max_success_rate, (csr.success_rate / msr.max_success_rate) AS normalized_success_rate FROM ConfigSuccessRate AS csr JOIN MaxSuccessRatePerConnector AS msr ON csr.connector = msr.connector) SELECT nsr.connector, AVG(nsr.normalized_success_rate) AS avg_normalized_success_rate FROM NormalizedSuccessRate AS nsr GROUP BY nsr.connector ORDER BY AVG(nsr.normalized_success_rate) DESC

WITH PlayerAverage AS (SELECT ps.player_id, ps.bowling_average AS overall_bowling_average FROM player_statistics AS ps), MatchPerformance AS (SELECT pmr.player_id, pmr.match_id, pmr.bowling_wickets, pmr.bowling_runs, (pmr.bowling_runs * 1.0 / pmr.bowling_wickets) AS match_bowling_average FROM player_match_records AS pmr WHERE pmr.role_in_match = 'bowler') SELECT p.player_name, ma.match_bowling_average, pa.overall_bowling_average, ma.match_bowling_average - pa.overall_bowling_average AS difference FROM MatchPerformance AS ma JOIN players AS p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerAverage AS pa ON ma.player_id = pa.player_id WHERE ma.match_bowling_average > pa.overall_bowling_average ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 5

WITH FilteredMortalityRates AS (SELECT hospital_id FROM mortality_rates WHERE `condition` = 'heart failure' AND rate < national_average), FilteredReadmissionRates AS (SELECT hospital_id FROM readmission_rates WHERE `condition` = 'heart failure' AND rate < national_average), BestHospitals AS (SELECT h.hospital_id, h.name, h.city FROM hospitals AS h INNER JOIN FilteredMortalityRates AS m ON h.hospital_id = m.hospital_id INNER JOIN FilteredReadmissionRates AS r ON h.hospital_id = r.hospital_id), LatestRatings AS (SELECT hr.hospital_id, MAX(hr.year) AS latest_year FROM hospital_ratings_over_time AS hr INNER JOIN BestHospitals AS bh ON hr.hospital_id = bh.hospital_id GROUP BY hr.hospital_id) SELECT bh.name, bh.city, hr.overall_rating FROM BestHospitals AS bh JOIN hospital_ratings_over_time AS hr ON bh.hospital_id = hr.hospital_id AND hr.year = (SELECT latest_year FROM LatestRatings AS lr WHERE lr.hospital_id = bh.hospital_id)

WITH ActiveUsersCTE AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.username, COUNT(ua.activity_id) AS activity_count FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN user_activity AS ua ON u.user_id = ua.user_id AND ua.resource = 'S&P 500 market index' AND ua.action = 'download' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username HAVING COUNT(ua.activity_id) > 1), FilteredActivityCTE AS (SELECT ua.user_id, ua.timestamp, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ua.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) AS year FROM user_activity AS ua WHERE ua.resource = 'S&P 500 market index' AND ua.action = 'download'), IndexPricesCTE AS (SELECT ip.date, ip.opening_value, ip.closing_value, ip.index_id FROM index_prices AS ip INNER JOIN market_indices AS mi ON ip.index_id = mi.index_id AND mi.index_name = 'S&P 500' WHERE ip.opening_value < ip.closing_value) SELECT au.username, fa.timestamp FROM ActiveUsersCTE AS au INNER JOIN FilteredActivityCTE AS fa ON au.user_id = fa.user_id AND fa.year = 2022 INNER JOIN IndexPricesCTE AS ipc ON CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(fa.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR) = ipc.date ORDER BY fa.timestamp DESC, au.username ASC

SELECT l.latch_name, u.user_name, SUM(CAST(lh.get_requests AS SIGNED)) AS total_get_requests FROM latches AS l INNER JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON lh.created_by = u.user_id GROUP BY l.latch_name, u.user_name HAVING SUM(CAST(lh.get_requests AS SIGNED)) > 1000 ORDER BY total_get_requests DESC

SELECT jr.role_name AS `Job Role`, jc.category_name AS `Job Category`, jp.location AS `Location`, jp.year AS `Year`, pg.growth_rate AS `Projected Growth Rate`, ep.estimated_postings AS `Estimated Postings` FROM job_roles AS jr JOIN job_categories AS jc ON jr.category_id = jc.category_id JOIN job_postings AS jp ON jr.role_id = jp.role_id JOIN projected_growth AS pg ON jr.role_id = pg.role_id JOIN estimated_postings AS ep ON jr.role_id = ep.role_id WHERE jp.year = 2022 AND jp.industry = 'Technology' AND jr.job_type = 'Full-time' AND jr.experience_required <= 3 ORDER BY pg.growth_rate DESC

SELECT m.marital_status, e.education_level, c.country_name, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(d.income, 3) AS SIGNED)) AS average_income FROM demographic_data AS d JOIN marital_statuses AS m ON d.marital_status = m.marital_status JOIN educational_levels AS e ON d.education = e.education_level JOIN occupations AS o ON d.occupation = o.occupation_name JOIN countries AS c ON d.country = c.country_name JOIN (SELECT user_id, AVG(hours_per_week) AS avg_hours_per_week FROM hours_worked WHERE employment_status = 'full-time' GROUP BY user_id) AS hw ON d.id = hw.user_id WHERE o.occupation_name = 'Software Developer' AND e.education_level = 'Bachelors' AND hw.avg_hours_per_week > 40 GROUP BY m.marital_status, e.education_level, c.country_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY average_income DESC

WITH OlympicEvents AS (SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE is_olympic = 1), SwimmerOlympicResults AS (SELECT r.swimmer_id, r.time, r.nisca_score, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.nationality FROM results AS r JOIN swimmers AS s ON r.swimmer_id = s.swimmer_id WHERE r.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM OlympicEvents)), SwimmerPerformance AS (SELECT swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(time, LOCATE(':', time) + 1) AS FLOAT)) AS average_time_seconds, AVG(nisca_score) AS average_nisca_score FROM SwimmerOlympicResults GROUP BY swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality), RankedSwimmers AS (SELECT swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality, average_time_seconds, average_nisca_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nationality ORDER BY average_time_seconds ASC, average_nisca_score DESC) AS rank_within_nationality FROM SwimmerPerformance) SELECT first_name, last_name, nationality, average_time_seconds FROM RankedSwimmers WHERE rank_within_nationality <= 5 ORDER BY nationality, average_time_seconds
SELECT u.user_name FROM users AS u WHERE u.user_id IN (SELECT `of`.user_id FROM order_frequency AS `of` WHERE `of`.order_count > 3)

WITH ConfigSummary AS (SELECT dgc.config_id, dgc.connector, dgc.rows_per_second, dgc.number_of_rows, dgc.created_by, COUNT(gd.dataset_id) AS total_datasets, SUM(CAST(gd.size_in_bytes AS SIGNED)) / 1048576 AS total_size_mb, MAX(CAST(gd.quality_score AS FLOAT)) AS max_quality_score, u.username AS created_by_username FROM data_generation_configs AS dgc JOIN generated_datasets AS gd ON dgc.config_id = gd.config_id JOIN users AS u ON dgc.created_by = u.user_id GROUP BY dgc.config_id, dgc.connector, dgc.rows_per_second, dgc.number_of_rows, dgc.created_by, u.username HAVING MAX(CAST(gd.quality_score AS FLOAT)) > 0.9), LatestLog AS (SELECT config_id, MAX(timestamp) AS latest_log_timestamp FROM data_generation_logs GROUP BY config_id) SELECT cs.connector, cs.rows_per_second, cs.number_of_rows, cs.total_datasets, cs.total_size_mb, cs.max_quality_score, cs.created_by_username, dl.status AS latest_generation_status FROM ConfigSummary AS cs LEFT JOIN data_generation_logs AS dl ON cs.config_id = dl.config_id AND dl.timestamp = (SELECT latest_log_timestamp FROM LatestLog AS ll WHERE ll.config_id = cs.config_id) ORDER BY cs.total_size_mb DESC
SELECT year_id, energy_source, `load` FROM energy_consumption WHERE nuts2_code = '1' AND year_id = 0 ORDER BY year_id, `load`

SELECT rt.type_name AS road_type, vc.class_name AS allowed_vehicle_class, COUNT(rm.maintenance_id) AS total_maintenance_activities, AVG(rm.cost) AS average_maintenance_cost, MAX(rm.maintenance_date) AS latest_maintenance_date FROM road_types AS rt INNER JOIN road_maintenance AS rm ON rt.road_type_id = rm.road_type_id INNER JOIN vehicle_classes AS vc ON LOCATE(vc.class_name, rt.allowed_vehicle_classes) > 0 GROUP BY rt.type_name, vc.class_name HAVING AVG(rm.cost) > 10000 ORDER BY total_maintenance_activities DESC

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, 1 AS level, c.category_name AS full_path FROM categories AS c WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, ch.level + 1 AS level, CONCAT(ch.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS full_path FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), ActivityDetails AS (SELECT la.activity_id, la.activity_type_id, la.category_id, la.number_of_sessions, la.length, la.student_hours, la.online_onsite, la.learning_objectives, la.prerequisites, la.course_id, la.instructor_id, at.type_name, ch.full_path AS category_path FROM learning_activities AS la INNER JOIN activity_types AS at ON la.activity_type_id = at.activity_type_id INNER JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON la.category_id = ch.category_id), ResourceDetails AS (SELECT r.activity_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(r.resource_type, ': ', r.description) SEPARATOR '; ') AS resources FROM resources AS r GROUP BY r.activity_id), FeedbackSummary AS (SELECT f.activity_id, AVG(f.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count FROM feedback AS f GROUP BY f.activity_id) SELECT ad.activity_id, ad.activity_type_id, ad.category_id, ad.number_of_sessions, ad.length, ad.student_hours, ad.online_onsite, ad.learning_objectives, ad.prerequisites, ad.course_id, ad.instructor_id, ad.type_name, ad.category_path, rd.resources, fs.average_rating, fs.feedback_count FROM ActivityDetails AS ad LEFT JOIN ResourceDetails AS rd ON ad.activity_id = rd.activity_id LEFT JOIN FeedbackSummary AS fs ON ad.activity_id = fs.activity_id ORDER BY ad.category_path, ad.activity_id

WITH ActiveSignals AS (SELECT rt.road_type_id, COUNT(ts.signal_id) AS signal_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.signal_status = 'operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operational_signals FROM traffic_signals AS ts JOIN road_types AS rt ON ts.road_type_id = rt.road_type_id GROUP BY rt.road_type_id), RoadConditionsSummary AS (SELECT rc.road_type_id, COUNT(rc.condition_id) AS condition_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN rc.condition_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS closed_count, AVG(CASE WHEN rc.condition_status = 'closed' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(rc.estimated_repair_time, 1, LOCATE(' ', rc.estimated_repair_time) - 1) AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_repair_time FROM road_conditions AS rc GROUP BY rc.road_type_id), MaintenanceSummary AS (SELECT rm.road_type_id, COUNT(rm.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_count, SUM(rm.cost) AS total_cost, AVG(rm.cost) AS avg_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rm.maintenance_type = 'emergency' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS emergency_maint_count FROM road_maintenance AS rm GROUP BY rm.road_type_id), RoadStats AS (SELECT rt.road_type_id, rt.type_name, rt.lanes, rt.speed, rt.priority, rt.allowed_vehicle_classes, COALESCE(ac.signal_count, 0) AS signal_count, COALESCE(ac.operational_signals, 0) AS operational_signals, COALESCE(rcs.condition_count, 0) AS condition_count, COALESCE(rcs.closed_count, 0) AS closed_count, COALESCE(rcs.avg_repair_time, 0) AS avg_repair_time, COALESCE(ms.emergency_maint_count, 0) AS emergency_maint_count, COALESCE(ms.maintenance_count, 0) AS maintenance_count, COALESCE(ms.total_cost, 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(ms.avg_cost, 0) AS avg_cost FROM road_types AS rt LEFT JOIN ActiveSignals AS ac ON rt.road_type_id = ac.road_type_id LEFT JOIN RoadConditionsSummary AS rcs ON rt.road_type_id = rcs.road_type_id LEFT JOIN MaintenanceSummary AS ms ON rt.road_type_id = ms.road_type_id) SELECT rs.type_name, rs.lanes, rs.speed, rs.priority, rs.allowed_vehicle_classes, rs.signal_count, rs.operational_signals, rs.condition_count, rs.closed_count, rs.avg_repair_time, rs.emergency_maint_count, rs.maintenance_count, rs.total_cost, rs.avg_cost, SUM(rs.total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY rs.type_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost FROM RoadStats AS rs ORDER BY rs.type_name

WITH BestDecisionTrees AS (SELECT r.name AS researcher_name, t.tree_name, t.accuracy, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.researcher_id ORDER BY t.accuracy DESC) AS tree_rank FROM researchers AS r JOIN studies AS s ON r.researcher_id = s.researcher_id JOIN feature_values AS fv ON s.study_id = fv.tree_id JOIN decision_trees AS t ON fv.tree_id = t.tree_id) SELECT CONCAT(researcher_name, ' - ', tree_name, ' - Accuracy: ', CAST(accuracy AS CHAR)) AS best_tree_summary FROM BestDecisionTrees WHERE tree_rank = 1

WITH VolatilityCTE AS (SELECT index_id, date, (high_value - low_value) / opening_value AS volatility FROM index_prices), HighVolatilityCTE AS (SELECT index_id, date FROM VolatilityCTE WHERE volatility > 0.01), UserActivityCTE AS (SELECT user_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS activity_date FROM user_activity WHERE resource LIKE '%market index%'), UserVolatilityCTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT uac.user_id FROM UserActivityCTE AS uac INNER JOIN HighVolatilityCTE AS hvc ON uac.activity_date = hvc.date) SELECT u.email FROM users AS u INNER JOIN UserVolatilityCTE AS uvc ON u.user_id = uvc.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name FROM customers AS c JOIN accounts AS a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN minimum_balances AS mb ON a.account_type_id = mb.account_type_id WHERE CAST(mb.min_balance AS SIGNED) > 1000 AND CAST(a.balance AS SIGNED) > CAST(mb.min_balance AS SIGNED)

WITH PerformanceCTE AS (SELECT p.competitor_id, c.event_name, st.difficulty_level, p.`rank`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.competition_id ORDER BY p.`rank` ASC) AS performance_rank FROM performances AS p JOIN competitions AS c ON p.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN stack_types AS st ON p.stack_type_id = st.stack_type_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(c.event_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2015'), FilteredPerformances AS (SELECT p.competitor_id, p.event_name, p.difficulty_level, p.`rank` FROM PerformanceCTE AS p WHERE p.performance_rank <= 5) SELECT comp.name AS competitor_name, f.`rank` AS performance_rank FROM FilteredPerformances AS f JOIN competitors AS comp ON f.competitor_id = comp.competitor_id ORDER BY f.difficulty_level ASC, f.`rank` ASC

WITH ProductRevenue AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS SIGNED) * CAST(oi.price AS FLOAT)) AS total_revenue, SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS SIGNED)) AS total_quantity_sold FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY oi.product_id), RankedProducts AS (SELECT product_id, total_revenue, total_quantity_sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM ProductRevenue) SELECT p.product_name, p.product_brand, p.product_model, s.supplier_name, s.contact_email, s.phone_number, rp.total_revenue, rp.total_quantity_sold FROM RankedProducts AS rp INNER JOIN products AS p ON rp.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN product_suppliers AS ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id INNER JOIN suppliers AS s ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE rp.revenue_rank <= 5

SELECT c.customer_name, at.account_name, a.account_status FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN accounts AS a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id INNER JOIN account_types AS at ON a.account_type_id = at.account_type_id WHERE a.account_status = 'Active' AND a.opened_date > '2022-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_name, at.account_name, a.account_status HAVING MIN(CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM a.balance), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) > 5000

SELECT ac.category_name, COUNT(v.view_id) AS view_count FROM awards AS a INNER JOIN award_categories AS ac ON a.category_id = ac.category_id INNER JOIN views AS v ON a.award_id = v.award_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(v.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY ac.category_name ORDER BY view_count DESC
SELECT DISTINCT b.branch_name FROM branches AS b JOIN releases AS r ON b.branch_id = r.branch_id WHERE CAST(r.build_number AS SIGNED) < 10000

SELECT f.facility_name AS `Facility`, et.energy_type_name AS `Energy Type`, SUM(ec.consumption_value) AS `Total Consumption`, SUM(ecn.net_consumption_value) AS `Net Consumption` FROM facilities AS f JOIN energy_consumption AS ec ON f.facility_id = ec.facility_id JOIN energy_consumption_net AS ecn ON f.facility_id = ecn.facility_id AND ec.consumption_date_time = ecn.consumption_date_time JOIN energy_types AS et ON ec.energy_type_id = et.energy_type_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ec.consumption_date_time AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY f.facility_name, et.energy_type_name ORDER BY f.facility_name

WITH ConfigUsage AS (SELECT dgc.config_id, dgc.created_by AS user_id, COUNT(dgl.log_id) AS total_logs, COUNT(CASE WHEN dgl.status = 'success' THEN 1 END) AS successful_logs FROM data_generation_configs AS dgc LEFT JOIN data_generation_logs AS dgl ON dgc.config_id = dgl.config_id GROUP BY dgc.config_id, dgc.created_by), UserSuccessRates AS (SELECT cu.user_id, AVG(CAST(cu.successful_logs AS FLOAT) / cu.total_logs) AS avg_success_rate FROM ConfigUsage AS cu GROUP BY cu.user_id) SELECT us.user_id, us.avg_success_rate FROM UserSuccessRates AS us ORDER BY us.avg_success_rate DESC

SELECT s.study_name, GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_name SEPARATOR ',') AS accessing_users FROM studies AS s JOIN user_study_access AS usa ON s.study_id = usa.study_id JOIN users AS u ON usa.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.study_status = 'active' AND usa.access_level = 'read-only' GROUP BY s.study_name HAVING COUNT(u.user_id) > 1

SELECT at.account_name, at.product_category, mb.min_balance, apy.apy FROM account_types AS at INNER JOIN minimum_balances AS mb ON at.account_type_id = mb.account_type_id INNER JOIN annual_percentage_yields AS apy ON at.account_type_id = apy.account_type_id WHERE at.account_status = 'Active' AND CAST(mb.min_balance AS SIGNED) <= 500

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_category_id, category_name AS full_path FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CONCAT(ch.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS full_path FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), BusinessPerformance AS (SELECT b.business_id, b.name, b.city, ch.full_path AS category_path, COALESCE(a.visits, 0) AS visits, COALESCE(a.ratings_count, 0) AS ratings_count, COALESCE(a.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(a.revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM businesses AS b LEFT JOIN analytics AS a ON b.business_id = a.business_id LEFT JOIN business_categories AS bc ON b.business_id = bc.business_id LEFT JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON bc.category_id = ch.category_id), TransactionSummary AS (SELECT business_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY business_id), ReviewSummary AS (SELECT business_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS review_average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY business_id) SELECT bp.name, bp.city, bp.category_path, bp.revenue, bp.visits, ts.transaction_count, ts.total_transaction_amount, rs.review_count, bp.average_rating, rs.review_average_rating FROM BusinessPerformance AS bp LEFT JOIN TransactionSummary AS ts ON bp.business_id = ts.business_id LEFT JOIN ReviewSummary AS rs ON bp.business_id = rs.business_id ORDER BY bp.revenue DESC, bp.average_rating DESC, bp.visits DESC

WITH SurveyEngagement AS (SELECT s.survey_id, s.survey_name, COUNT(sp.user_id) AS participant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.participation_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count FROM surveys AS s LEFT JOIN survey_participants AS sp ON s.survey_id = sp.survey_id LEFT JOIN feedback AS f ON s.survey_id = f.survey_id GROUP BY s.survey_id, s.survey_name), SurveyAnalytics AS (SELECT a.survey_id, a.average_satisfaction, a.average_usefulness, a.average_effectiveness, a.average_visual_attractiveness, a.average_intention, a.total_responses, a.response_rate FROM analytics AS a) SELECT se.survey_name, se.participant_count, se.completed_count, (se.completed_count / CAST(se.participant_count AS FLOAT) * 100) AS completion_rate, se.feedback_count, (se.feedback_count / CAST(se.participant_count AS FLOAT) * 100) AS feedback_rate, sa.average_satisfaction, sa.average_usefulness, sa.average_effectiveness, sa.average_visual_attractiveness, sa.average_intention, sa.total_responses, sa.response_rate FROM SurveyEngagement AS se LEFT JOIN SurveyAnalytics AS sa ON se.survey_id = sa.survey_id ORDER BY completion_rate DESC

WITH ResolutionVoteSummary AS (SELECT r.resolution_id, r.resolution_text, rs.status_name AS current_status, COUNT(rv.vote_id) AS vote_count, MAX(vs.voting_end_date) AS latest_voting_end_date FROM resolutions AS r JOIN resolution_status AS rs ON r.resolution_status_id = rs.status_id LEFT JOIN resolution_votes AS rv ON r.resolution_id = rv.resolution_id LEFT JOIN voting_sessions AS vs ON r.resolution_id = vs.resolution_id GROUP BY r.resolution_id, r.resolution_text, rs.status_name), TopStakeholders AS (SELECT rs.resolution_id, rs.stakeholder_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.resolution_id ORDER BY rs.stakeholder_id) AS stakeholder_rank FROM resolution_stakeholders AS rs) SELECT rvs.resolution_id, rvs.resolution_text, rvs.current_status, rvs.vote_count, rvs.latest_voting_end_date, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ts.stakeholder_rank <= 3 THEN ts.stakeholder_name ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_three_stakeholders FROM ResolutionVoteSummary AS rvs JOIN TopStakeholders AS ts ON rvs.resolution_id = ts.resolution_id GROUP BY rvs.resolution_id, rvs.resolution_text, rvs.current_status, rvs.vote_count, rvs.latest_voting_end_date
