generated_sql: WITH BillboardEntries AS (SELECT ce.entry_date, ce.entry_position, ce.peak_position, s.title, s.duration, a.name AS artist_name FROM chart_entries AS ce JOIN songs AS s ON ce.song_id = s.song_id JOIN artists AS a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id WHERE ce.chart_id = 1), CumulativeDuration AS (SELECT title, artist_name, peak_position, entry_date, entry_position, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(duration, ':', '') AS SIGNED)) OVER (PARTITION BY entry_date ORDER BY entry_position ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration FROM BillboardEntries) SELECT title, artist_name, peak_position, cumulative_duration FROM CumulativeDuration ORDER BY entry_date, entry_position

SELECT rm.name FROM releases AS r JOIN release_managers AS rm ON r.release_manager_id = rm.release_manager_id WHERE r.release_type = 'major' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.actual_date AS DATETIME), '%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%m')

WITH FlaggedData AS (SELECT wdf.weather_id, wdf.flag_id, wdf.flag_type, wdf.flag_date, wdf.flag_description, wdf.priority, wdf.resolution_date, wdf.resolved_by, wdc.comment_id, wdc.comment_date, wdc.comment_text, wdc.is_approved, wdc.like_count, wdm.metadata_id, wdm.metadata_key, wdm.metadata_value, wdm.metadata_type, wdm.created_date, wdm.modified_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wdf.weather_id ORDER BY wdf.flag_date DESC) AS flag_row_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wdf.weather_id ORDER BY wdc.comment_date DESC) AS comment_row_num FROM weather_data_flags AS wdf LEFT JOIN weather_data_comments AS wdc ON wdf.weather_id = wdc.weather_id LEFT JOIN weather_data_metadata AS wdm ON wdf.weather_id = wdm.weather_id WHERE wdf.resolution_date IS NULL), RecentFlagsComments AS (SELECT weather_id, flag_id, flag_type, flag_date, flag_description, priority, resolution_date, resolved_by, comment_id, comment_date, comment_text, is_approved, like_count, metadata_id, metadata_key, metadata_value, metadata_type, created_date, modified_date FROM FlaggedData WHERE flag_row_num = 1 AND comment_row_num = 1) SELECT weather_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(flag_type, ': ', flag_description, ' (Priority: ', priority, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS recent_flag_details, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(comment_text, ' (Approved: ', is_approved, ', Likes: ', like_count, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS recent_comment_details FROM RecentFlagsComments GROUP BY weather_id

WITH PlayerPerformance AS (SELECT pmr.match_id, pmr.player_id, pmr.batting_score, pmr.bowling_wickets, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pmr.match_id ORDER BY CAST(pmr.batting_score AS SIGNED) DESC, pmr.bowling_wickets DESC) AS performance_rank FROM player_match_records AS pmr) SELECT pp.match_id, pp.player_id FROM PlayerPerformance AS pp WHERE pp.performance_rank = 1

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(md.close, ' | ', md.daily_hv, ' | ', md.intra_hv, ' | ', mi.indicator_name, ' - ', mi.indicator_value, ' | ', dv.visualization_name) SEPARATOR ',') AS market_details FROM market_data AS md JOIN market_indicators AS mi ON md.market_id = mi.market_id JOIN data_visualizations AS dv ON md.market_id = dv.market_id WHERE md.market_id = 1

WITH PatientRiskAssessment AS (SELECT p.patient_id, p.age, p.sex, p.cholesterol, p.blood_pressure, p.medical_history, p.family_history, ra.risk_level, ra.recommendations, ra.assessment_method, ra.recommended_interventions, AVG(cv.result) AS avg_test_result FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN risk_assessments AS ra ON p.patient_id = ra.patient_id LEFT JOIN cardiovascular_tests AS cv ON p.patient_id = cv.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.age, p.sex, p.cholesterol, p.blood_pressure, p.medical_history, p.family_history, ra.risk_level, ra.recommendations, ra.assessment_method, ra.recommended_interventions), PatientMedications AS (SELECT patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(medication_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS medications FROM medications GROUP BY patient_id), PatientLifestyle AS (SELECT patient_id, smoking_status, exercise_frequency, diet_quality, physical_activity_level, dietary_preferences FROM lifestyle_factors), PatientAppointments AS (SELECT patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(date, ' - ', appointment_type) SEPARATOR ', ') AS appointments FROM appointments GROUP BY patient_id) SELECT pra.patient_id, pra.age, pra.sex, pra.cholesterol, pra.blood_pressure, pra.medical_history, pra.family_history, pra.risk_level, pra.recommendations, pra.assessment_method, pra.recommended_interventions, pra.avg_test_result, pm.medications, pl.smoking_status, pl.exercise_frequency, pl.diet_quality, pl.physical_activity_level, pl.dietary_preferences, pa.appointments FROM PatientRiskAssessment AS pra LEFT JOIN PatientMedications AS pm ON pra.patient_id = pm.patient_id LEFT JOIN PatientLifestyle AS pl ON pra.patient_id = pl.patient_id LEFT JOIN PatientAppointments AS pa ON pra.patient_id = pa.patient_id ORDER BY pra.patient_id

generated_sql: WITH SmokersData AS (SELECT sd.region_id, r.region_name, r.population_density, (sd.smoke_cigars_pipe + sd.smoke_both + sd.smoke_cigarettes) * 100.0 / sd.population AS smoker_percentage, sd.deaths * 1.0 / (sd.smoke_cigars_pipe + sd.smoke_both + sd.smoke_cigarettes) AS avg_mortality_rate FROM smoking_data AS sd JOIN regions AS r ON sd.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.population_density > 100) SELECT sd.region_name, AVG(sd.avg_mortality_rate) AS average_mortality_rate FROM SmokersData AS sd GROUP BY sd.region_name HAVING AVG(sd.smoker_percentage) > 10 ORDER BY average_mortality_rate DESC

SELECT c.county_name, u.user_type_name, AVG(i.user_speed) AS avg_speed, COUNT(i.incident_id) AS num_incidents, SUM(i.non_suicide_fatality) AS total_fatalities, SUM(i.non_suicide_injury) AS total_injuries, h.speed_limit, h.average_daily_traffic, re.rail_equipment_name, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(i.incident_date AS DATETIME), '%m') AS month, COUNT(il.incident_id) AS num_incidents_logged FROM incidents AS i JOIN counties AS c ON i.county_id = c.county_id JOIN user_types AS u ON i.user_type_id = u.user_type_id JOIN highways AS h ON i.highway_id = h.highway_id JOIN rail_equipment_types AS re ON i.rail_equipment_id = re.rail_equipment_id LEFT JOIN incident_logs AS il ON i.incident_id = il.incident_id GROUP BY c.county_name, u.user_type_name, h.speed_limit, h.average_daily_traffic, re.rail_equipment_name, month ORDER BY c.county_name, month

WITH EngagementCTE AS (SELECT h.hashtag, u.username, t.tweet_id, SUM(ue.retweets + ue.favorites) AS total_engagement FROM hashtags AS h INNER JOIN tweets AS t ON LOCATE(h.hashtag, t.hashtags) > 0 INNER JOIN user_engagement AS ue ON ue.tweet_id = t.tweet_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON ue.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY h.hashtag, u.username, t.tweet_id), RankedEngagementCTE AS (SELECT hashtag, username, tweet_id, total_engagement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hashtag ORDER BY total_engagement DESC) AS user_engagement_rank FROM EngagementCTE) SELECT hashtag, username, total_engagement FROM RankedEngagementCTE WHERE user_engagement_rank <= 3

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_ordered FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN order_frequency AS `of` ON o.user_id = `of`.user_id WHERE `of`.order_count > 5 AND `of`.reordered = 1 GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_ordered DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, AVG(o.total_cost) AS average_order_cost FROM users AS u INNER JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id INNER JOIN order_frequency AS `of` ON u.user_id = `of`.user_id WHERE `of`.reordered = 1 GROUP BY u.user_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1

SELECT event_id FROM conflict_events JOIN locations ON conflict_events.location_id = locations.location_id WHERE conflict_events.date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND locations.location_id = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT u.username, COUNT(dgl.log_id) AS total_generations, SUM(CASE WHEN dgl.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_generations, AVG(CAST(dgl.duration AS SIGNED)) AS average_duration_seconds, COUNT(DISTINCT g.dataset_id) AS distinct_datasets_generated, MAX(g.creation_date) AS latest_dataset_creation_date, AVG(g.quality_score) AS average_quality_score FROM users AS u INNER JOIN data_generation_logs AS dgl ON u.user_id = dgl.user_id LEFT JOIN generated_datasets AS g ON dgl.config_id = g.config_id AND u.user_id = g.user_id WHERE u.is_active = 1 GROUP BY u.username HAVING COUNT(dgl.log_id) > 0

WITH RouteStats AS (SELECT t.route_id, COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count, AVG(t.ride_quality) AS average_ride_quality, t.weather_conditions, t.maintenance_flag, s1.station_name AS start_station, s2.station_name AS end_station FROM trips AS t JOIN stations AS s1 ON t.start_station_number = s1.station_number JOIN stations AS s2 ON t.end_station_number = s2.station_number GROUP BY t.route_id, t.weather_conditions, t.maintenance_flag, s1.station_name, s2.station_name HAVING COUNT(t.trip_id) > 10), MemberNames AS (SELECT rs.route_id, rs.trip_count, rs.average_ride_quality, rs.weather_conditions, rs.maintenance_flag, rs.start_station, rs.end_station, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.first_name, ' ', m.last_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS members FROM RouteStats AS rs JOIN trips AS t ON rs.route_id = t.route_id JOIN members AS m ON t.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY rs.route_id, rs.trip_count, rs.average_ride_quality, rs.weather_conditions, rs.maintenance_flag, rs.start_station, rs.end_station) SELECT CONCAT('Route ID: ', route_id, ', Start Station: ', start_station, ', End Station: ', end_station, ', Trip Count: ', trip_count, ', Average Ride Quality: ', average_ride_quality, ', Weather Conditions: ', weather_conditions, ', Maintenance Status: ', CASE WHEN maintenance_flag = 1 THEN 'Needs Maintenance' ELSE 'No Maintenance' END, ', Members: ', members) AS route_info FROM MemberNames ORDER BY trip_count DESC, average_ride_quality DESC

WITH MostCitedPapers AS (SELECT paper_id, title, publication_year, times_cited_all_databases FROM papers ORDER BY times_cited_all_databases DESC LIMIT 5), AuthorList AS (SELECT paper_id, GROUP_CONCAT(author_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors FROM paper_authors AS pa JOIN authors AS a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY paper_id), PublicationName AS (SELECT paper_id, publication_name FROM paper_publications AS pp JOIN publications AS p ON pp.publication_id = p.publication_id), AccessCounts AS (SELECT paper_id, COUNT(*) AS total_accesses FROM access_logs GROUP BY paper_id) SELECT mc.title, mc.publication_year, mc.times_cited_all_databases, al.authors, pub.publication_name, ac.total_accesses FROM MostCitedPapers AS mc JOIN AuthorList AS al ON mc.paper_id = al.paper_id JOIN PublicationName AS pub ON mc.paper_id = pub.paper_id JOIN AccessCounts AS ac ON mc.paper_id = ac.paper_id ORDER BY mc.times_cited_all_databases DESC

SELECT ma.asset_id, (SUM(ma.actual_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT `of`.outfall_id)) AS cost_per_outfall FROM maintenance_activities AS ma INNER JOIN outfalls AS `of` ON ma.asset_id = `of`.asset_id WHERE ma.status = 'Completed' AND `of`.water_quality IN ('Good', 'Fair') GROUP BY ma.asset_id HAVING (SUM(ma.actual_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT `of`.outfall_id)) > 100 ORDER BY cost_per_outfall DESC

WITH EmployeeEducationCTE AS (SELECT ee.employee_id, ee.education_id, ee.gpa, e.total_years AS total_working_years FROM employee_education AS ee INNER JOIN total_working_years AS e ON ee.employee_id = e.employee_id), EducationAverages AS (SELECT ee.education_id, AVG(ee.total_working_years) AS avg_working_years, AVG(ee.gpa) AS avg_gpa FROM EmployeeEducationCTE AS ee GROUP BY ee.education_id) SELECT GREATEST(avg_working_years, avg_gpa) AS max_average FROM EducationAverages

WITH RecentSuccessfulRuns AS (SELECT run_id, config_id, run_status, start_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY config_id ORDER BY start_time DESC) AS rn FROM test_runs WHERE run_status = 'success') SELECT ts.config_id, tc.config_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.metric_type SEPARATOR ',') AS metrics_types, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT n.note_text SEPARATOR ',') AS config_notes FROM RecentSuccessfulRuns AS ts JOIN test_configurations AS tc ON ts.config_id = tc.config_id JOIN performance_metrics AS pm ON ts.run_id = pm.run_id LEFT JOIN notes AS n ON tc.config_id = n.entity_id AND n.entity_type = 'test_config' WHERE ts.rn = 1 AND tc.active_status = 1 GROUP BY ts.config_id, tc.config_name

SELECT c.concept_id, c.number_incorrect, c.`rank`, c.english, GROUP_CONCAT(ct.translation SEPARATOR ', ') AS translations, ct.language AS translation_language FROM concepts AS c JOIN studies AS s ON c.study_id = s.study_id JOIN concept_translations AS ct ON c.concept_id = ct.concept_id WHERE s.study_name = 'Nicholas-1989' GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.number_incorrect, c.`rank`, c.english, ct.language ORDER BY c.`rank`

WITH MonthlySales AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.order_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS OrderMonth, p.producer AS Producer, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS ProductCount FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY OrderMonth, Producer) SELECT ms.OrderMonth AS Month, ms.Producer, ms.TotalSales FROM MonthlySales AS ms WHERE ms.ProductCount > 1

SELECT u.user_name, LENGTH(ec.comment) AS CommentLength FROM users AS u INNER JOIN error_comments AS ec ON u.user_id = ec.user_id WHERE LOCATE('bug', ec.comment) > 0

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CAST(c.category_name AS CHAR) AS category_path FROM categories AS c WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CONCAT(ch.category_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS category_path FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), ResourceAggregation AS (SELECT r.activity_id, COUNT(r.resource_id) AS total_resources, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.resource_type SEPARATOR ',') AS resource_types, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.file_path SEPARATOR ',') AS file_paths FROM resources AS r GROUP BY r.activity_id), AttendanceAggregation AS (SELECT a.activity_id, COUNT(a.student_id) AS total_attendees, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS present_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent_count FROM attendance_records AS a GROUP BY a.activity_id), FeedbackAggregation AS (SELECT f.activity_id, COUNT(f.student_id) AS total_feedback, AVG(f.rating) AS average_rating, GROUP_CONCAT(f.comments SEPARATOR ',') AS feedback_comments FROM feedback AS f GROUP BY f.activity_id) SELECT ch.category_path, la.activity_id, ra.total_resources, ra.resource_types, ra.file_paths, aa.total_attendees, aa.present_count, aa.absent_count, fa.total_feedback, fa.average_rating, fa.feedback_comments FROM learning_activities AS la JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON la.category_id = ch.category_id LEFT JOIN ResourceAggregation AS ra ON la.activity_id = ra.activity_id LEFT JOIN AttendanceAggregation AS aa ON la.activity_id = aa.activity_id LEFT JOIN FeedbackAggregation AS fa ON la.activity_id = fa.activity_id ORDER BY ch.category_path, la.activity_id

SELECT CONCAT(CAST(i.year AS CHAR), ', ', c.country_name, ': ', SUM(i.num_injuries)) AS yearly_injury_summary FROM injury_data AS i JOIN countries AS c ON i.country_id = c.country_id GROUP BY i.year, c.country_name ORDER BY i.year, c.country_name

WITH AvgValues AS (SELECT country_id, indicator_id, AVG(value) AS avg_value FROM data_values GROUP BY country_id, indicator_id), Trends AS (SELECT country_id, indicator_id, (MAX(value) - MIN(value)) / (MAX(year_id) - MIN(year_id)) AS trend FROM data_values GROUP BY country_id, indicator_id), LatestNotifications AS (SELECT country_id, indicator_id, MAX(notification_date) AS latest_notification_date FROM notifications GROUP BY country_id, indicator_id), AccessCounts AS (SELECT country_id, indicator_id, COUNT(access_id) AS access_count FROM access_logs GROUP BY country_id, indicator_id) SELECT c.country_name, i.indicator_name, av.avg_value, t.trend, ln.latest_notification_date, ac.access_count FROM countries AS c JOIN AvgValues AS av ON c.country_id = av.country_id JOIN Trends AS t ON av.country_id = t.country_id AND av.indicator_id = t.indicator_id JOIN indicators AS i ON av.indicator_id = i.indicator_id LEFT JOIN LatestNotifications AS ln ON av.country_id = ln.country_id AND av.indicator_id = ln.indicator_id LEFT JOIN AccessCounts AS ac ON av.country_id = ac.country_id AND av.indicator_id = ac.indicator_id ORDER BY c.country_name, i.indicator_name

WITH HighPerformancePlayers AS (SELECT pmr.player_id, MAX(CAST(REPLACE(pmr.batting_score, '*', '') AS SIGNED)) AS max_score, MAX(pmr.bowling_wickets) AS max_wickets, pmr.match_id FROM player_match_records AS pmr GROUP BY pmr.player_id, pmr.match_id HAVING MAX(CAST(REPLACE(pmr.batting_score, '*', '') AS SIGNED)) >= 100 OR MAX(pmr.bowling_wickets) >= 5), RecentUserAccess AS (SELECT a.user_id, u.user_name, MAX(a.access_date) AS last_access_date FROM access_logs AS a INNER JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.resource_type = 'player_performance' GROUP BY a.user_id, u.user_name) SELECT hpp.player_id, rua.user_name FROM HighPerformancePlayers AS hpp CROSS JOIN RecentUserAccess AS rua

WITH TeamPerformanceCTE AS (SELECT t.team_name, s.season_name, st.`rank` AS team_rank, d.division_name, st.wins AS total_wins, st.losses AS total_losses, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.season_id, d.division_id ORDER BY st.`rank`) AS team_position, (SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(g.score, 1, LOCATE('-', g.score) - 1) AS SIGNED)) FROM games AS g WHERE g.team_id = st.team_id AND g.game_type = 'regular season' AND g.game_date BETWEEN s.start_date AND s.end_date) AS avg_points_scored FROM standings AS st INNER JOIN teams AS t ON st.team_id = t.team_id INNER JOIN seasons AS s ON st.season_id = s.season_id INNER JOIN divisions AS d ON t.division_id = d.division_id WHERE s.start_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') SELECT team_name, season_name, division_name, team_rank, total_wins, total_losses, avg_points_scored, team_position AS games_behind FROM TeamPerformanceCTE WHERE team_position <= 3 ORDER BY season_name, division_name, team_rank

WITH HighMissesCTE AS (SELECT l.latch_id, l.latch_name, l.category, CAST(l.misses AS SIGNED) AS misses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.category ORDER BY CAST(l.misses AS SIGNED) DESC) AS miss_rank FROM latches AS l WHERE CAST(l.misses AS SIGNED) > 1000) SELECT hm.latch_name, hm.category, u.user_name, u.role FROM HighMissesCTE AS hm INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON hm.latch_id = al.resource_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE hm.miss_rank <= 5 ORDER BY hm.category, hm.misses DESC, al.access_date DESC

WITH LatestExecution AS (SELECT ter.test_case_id, ter.execution_id, ter.status AS execution_status, ter.execution_date, ter.executed_by, ter.duration, ter.comments, ter.ci_cd_pipeline_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ter.test_case_id ORDER BY ter.execution_date DESC) AS rn FROM test_execution_results AS ter) SELECT tc.test_case_id, tc.summary, tc.pre_conditions, tc.test_data, tc.expected_results, tc.status AS test_case_status, tc.priority, tc.created_by, tc.created_date, tc.last_modified_by, tc.last_modified_date, tc.category, le.execution_id, le.execution_status, le.execution_date, le.executed_by, le.duration, le.comments, le.ci_cd_pipeline_id, u.user_name, u.email, u.role, u.department, u.phone_number, u.created_date AS user_created_date, u.last_login_date, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tl.log_message SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM test_logs AS tl WHERE tl.execution_id = le.execution_id GROUP BY tl.execution_id), 'No logs available') AS log_messages FROM test_cases AS tc JOIN LatestExecution AS le ON tc.test_case_id = le.test_case_id AND le.rn = 1 JOIN users AS u ON tc.created_by = u.user_id

WITH HighMissesSleeps AS (SELECT l.latch_id, l.latch_name, l.description, l.category, SUM(CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED)) AS total_misses, SUM(CAST(lh.sleeps AS SIGNED)) AS total_sleeps FROM latches AS l JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id GROUP BY l.latch_id, l.latch_name, l.description, l.category HAVING SUM(CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED)) > 1000 OR SUM(CAST(lh.sleeps AS SIGNED)) > 1000), UsersAccessed AS (SELECT a.resource_id, GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_name SEPARATOR ',') AS accessed_by FROM access_logs AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id JOIN resources AS r ON a.resource_id = r.resource_id AND r.resource_type = 'latch' GROUP BY a.resource_id), LatchesWithAlerts AS (SELECT a.latch_id, GROUP_CONCAT(a.alert_message SEPARATOR ',') AS alerts FROM alerts AS a GROUP BY a.latch_id) SELECT hms.latch_name, hms.description, hms.category, hms.total_misses, hms.total_sleeps, COALESCE(ua.accessed_by, 'No access') AS accessed_by, COALESCE(lwa.alerts, 'No alerts') AS alerts FROM HighMissesSleeps AS hms LEFT JOIN UsersAccessed AS ua ON hms.latch_id = ua.resource_id LEFT JOIN LatchesWithAlerts AS lwa ON hms.latch_id = lwa.latch_id ORDER BY hms.total_misses DESC, hms.total_sleeps DESC

WITH SevereDiseases AS (SELECT ch.crop_name, d.disease_id, ds.severity_level FROM crop_histories AS ch JOIN diseases AS d ON d.disease_name = SUBSTRING(ch.previous_diseases, 1, LOCATE(',', ch.previous_diseases) - 1) JOIN disease_severity AS ds ON d.disease_id = ds.severity_id WHERE ds.severity_level > 3), CropSevereDiseaseCount AS (SELECT crop_name, COUNT(disease_id) AS severe_disease_count FROM SevereDiseases GROUP BY crop_name) SELECT crop_name FROM CropSevereDiseaseCount WHERE severe_disease_count > 1

WITH FrequentlyRequestedDatasets AS (SELECT dataset_id FROM data_requests GROUP BY dataset_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), MonthlyAnalysisCounts AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(analysis_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS analysis_month, dataset_id, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM analyses WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM FrequentlyRequestedDatasets) GROUP BY analysis_month, dataset_id) SELECT analysis_month, COUNT(*) AS number_of_datasets_analyzed FROM MonthlyAnalysisCounts GROUP BY analysis_month ORDER BY analysis_month

WITH VaccineInventory AS (SELECT v.vaccine_name, wh.warehouse_name, inv.date, SUM(inv.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM vaccines AS v JOIN inventory AS inv ON v.vaccine_id = inv.vaccine_id JOIN warehouses AS wh ON inv.warehouse_id = wh.warehouse_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(inv.date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2023-01' GROUP BY v.vaccine_name, wh.warehouse_name, inv.date), VaccineShipments AS (SELECT v.vaccine_name, wh.warehouse_name, sh.shipping_date, SUM(sh.quantity) AS total_shipped FROM vaccines AS v JOIN shipments AS sh ON v.vaccine_id = sh.vaccine_id JOIN warehouses AS wh ON sh.warehouse_id = wh.warehouse_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(sh.shipping_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2023-01' GROUP BY v.vaccine_name, wh.warehouse_name, sh.shipping_date), VaccineAdministration AS (SELECT fa.facility_name, v.vaccine_name, a.administration_date, COUNT(*) AS total_administrations FROM administration AS a JOIN vaccines AS v ON a.vaccine_id = v.vaccine_id JOIN healthcare_facilities AS fa ON a.facility_id = fa.facility_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.administration_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2023-01' GROUP BY fa.facility_name, v.vaccine_name, a.administration_date), PatientDemographics AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patients AS p), FacilityOccupancy AS (SELECT fa.facility_name, fa.capacity, fa.current_occupancy FROM healthcare_facilities AS fa) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(inv.vaccine_name, ',', inv.warehouse_name, ',', inv.date, ',', inv.total_quantity, ',', COALESCE(ship.total_shipped, 0), ',', COALESCE(admin.total_administrations, 0), ',', demo.patient_count, ',', fac.capacity, ',', fac.current_occupancy) SEPARATOR ',') AS report_data FROM VaccineInventory AS inv LEFT JOIN VaccineShipments AS ship ON inv.vaccine_name = ship.vaccine_name AND inv.warehouse_name = ship.warehouse_name AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(inv.date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ship.shipping_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') LEFT JOIN VaccineAdministration AS admin ON inv.vaccine_name = admin.vaccine_name CROSS JOIN PatientDemographics AS demo CROSS JOIN FacilityOccupancy AS fac

SELECT h.hashtag AS Hashtag, SUM(u.retweets + u.favorites) AS TotalEngagement FROM hashtags AS h INNER JOIN tweets AS t ON h.hashtag = COALESCE(TRIM(LEADING '#' FROM t.hashtags), '') INNER JOIN user_engagement AS u ON t.tweet_id = u.tweet_id WHERE h.trending_status = 'trending' GROUP BY h.hashtag HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tweet_id) > 0

WITH CitationsAndDatabases AS (SELECT p.paper_id, p.title, COUNT(c.citation_id) AS total_citations, GROUP_CONCAT(d.database_name SEPARATOR ',') AS cited_in_databases FROM papers AS p JOIN citations AS c ON p.paper_id = c.paper_id JOIN paper_databases AS pd ON p.paper_id = pd.paper_id JOIN `databases` AS d ON pd.database_id = d.database_id GROUP BY p.paper_id, p.title), RankedPapers AS (SELECT paper_id, title, total_citations, cited_in_databases, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_citations DESC) AS citation_rank FROM CitationsAndDatabases) SELECT CONCAT(title, ' (', total_citations, ' citations in ', cited_in_databases, ')') AS result FROM RankedPapers WHERE citation_rank <= 5 ORDER BY citation_rank

generated_sql: SELECT a.code AS airport_code, dr.name AS delay_reason_name, COUNT(fd.flight_delay_id) AS total_delays, AVG(fd.delay_minutes) AS average_delay_minutes FROM flight_delays AS fd INNER JOIN flights AS f ON fd.flight_id = f.flight_id INNER JOIN airports AS a ON f.airport_id = a.airport_id INNER JOIN delay_reasons AS dr ON fd.delay_reason_id = dr.delay_reason_id WHERE a.code = 'ATL' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.departure_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2022-01' GROUP BY a.code, dr.name HAVING COUNT(fd.flight_delay_id) > 0 ORDER BY a.code, dr.name

WITH EnergySummary AS (SELECT n.node_id, n.node_name, n.location_description AS location, SUM(ed.energy_consumption) AS total_energy_consumption, SUM(ef.energy_forecast) AS total_energy_forecast FROM nodes AS n LEFT JOIN energy_data AS ed ON n.node_id = ed.node_id LEFT JOIN energy_forecasts AS ef ON n.node_id = ef.node_id WHERE ed.reading_date BETWEEN '2023-05-01' AND '2023-05-31' AND ef.forecast_date BETWEEN '2023-05-01' AND '2023-05-31' GROUP BY n.node_id, n.node_name, n.location_description), TechSpecs AS (SELECT n.node_id, ts.min_annual_hours, ts.max_annual_hours, ts.min_load_kwh, ts.min_units, ts.max_units FROM nodes AS n LEFT JOIN tech_specifications AS ts ON n.node_id = ts.node_id), NodeCategories AS (SELECT n.node_id, GROUP_CONCAT(nc.category_name SEPARATOR ',') AS categories FROM nodes AS n LEFT JOIN node_category_map AS ncm ON n.node_id = ncm.node_id LEFT JOIN node_categories AS nc ON ncm.category_id = nc.category_id GROUP BY n.node_id) SELECT es.node_name, es.location, es.total_energy_consumption, es.total_energy_forecast, ts.min_annual_hours, ts.max_annual_hours, ts.min_load_kwh, ts.min_units, ts.max_units, nc.categories FROM EnergySummary AS es LEFT JOIN TechSpecs AS ts ON es.node_id = ts.node_id LEFT JOIN NodeCategories AS nc ON es.node_id = nc.node_id WHERE es.total_energy_consumption > 500 ORDER BY es.total_energy_consumption DESC

SELECT s.station_name, s.station_id, COUNT(b.bike_id) AS bikes_in_station, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentals AS r WHERE r.start_station_id = s.station_id AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') = '2023-05-01') AS total_rentals_on_date FROM stations AS s LEFT JOIN bikes AS b ON s.station_id = b.current_station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name ORDER BY bikes_in_station DESC, total_rentals_on_date DESC

WITH TaskEnergyCTE AS (SELECT tp.task_type_id, tp.energy_consumption, tp.output_quality, rm.model_name AS robot_model, ra.arm_name, rt.task_name, u.user_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.task_type_id ORDER BY tp.energy_consumption DESC) AS energy_rank FROM tasks_performed AS tp INNER JOIN robot_arms AS ra ON tp.arm_id = ra.arm_id INNER JOIN robots AS r ON ra.robot_id = r.robot_id INNER JOIN robot_models AS rm ON r.model_id = rm.model_id INNER JOIN robot_tasks AS rt ON tp.task_type_id = rt.task_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON tp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE tp.status = 'completed' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(tp.start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023'), AverageEnergyCTE AS (SELECT task_type_id, AVG(energy_consumption) AS avg_energy_consumption, COUNT(task_type_id) AS task_count FROM TaskEnergyCTE GROUP BY task_type_id) SELECT te.task_name, ae.avg_energy_consumption, ae.task_count, te.robot_model, te.arm_name, te.user_name FROM AverageEnergyCTE AS ae INNER JOIN TaskEnergyCTE AS te ON ae.task_type_id = te.task_type_id WHERE te.energy_rank = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.order_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month

WITH CampaignLandConversion AS (SELECT lc.district_id, lc.campaign_id, SUM(lc.area_in_hectares) AS total_area_converted, SUM(lc.conversion_cost) AS total_conversion_cost FROM land_conversion AS lc GROUP BY lc.district_id, lc.campaign_id), CampaignEnterpriseStats AS (SELECT e.district_id, e.campaign_id, COUNT(e.enterprise_id) AS total_enterprises, SUM(e.investment_amount) AS total_investment, SUM(e.annual_revenue) AS total_annual_revenue FROM enterprises AS e GROUP BY e.district_id, e.campaign_id), CampaignJlgFormation AS (SELECT jf.campaign_id, COUNT(jf.jlg_id) AS total_jlgs_formed, 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_participations FROM jlg_participation AS jp GROUP BY jp.campaign_id), CampaignStats AS (SELECT c.campaign_id, c.district_id, c.campaign_name, clc.total_area_converted, clc.total_conversion_cost, ces.total_enterprises, ces.total_investment, ces.total_annual_revenue, cjf.total_jlgs_formed, cjf.total_members_formed, COALESCE(cpo.successful_participations, 0) AS successful_participations, COALESCE(cpo.partial_success_participations, 0) AS partial_success_participations, COALESCE(cpo.failed_participations, 0) AS failed_participations FROM jlg_campaigns AS c LEFT JOIN CampaignLandConversion AS clc ON c.campaign_id = clc.campaign_id AND c.district_id = clc.district_id LEFT JOIN CampaignEnterpriseStats AS ces ON c.campaign_id = ces.campaign_id AND c.district_id = ces.district_id LEFT JOIN CampaignJlgFormation AS cjf ON c.campaign_id = cjf.campaign_id LEFT JOIN CampaignParticipationOutcome AS cpo ON c.campaign_id = cpo.campaign_id) SELECT cs.campaign_name, d.district_name, cs.total_area_converted, cs.total_conversion_cost, cs.total_enterprises, cs.total_investment, cs.total_annual_revenue, cs.total_jlgs_formed, cs.total_members_formed, cs.successful_participations, cs.partial_success_participations, cs.failed_participations, (cs.successful_participations + cs.partial_success_participations) * 1.0 / (cs.successful_participations + cs.partial_success_participations + cs.failed_participations) AS participation_success_rate FROM CampaignStats AS cs JOIN districts AS d ON cs.district_id = d.district_id ORDER BY cs.campaign_name, d.district_name

WITH PlayerRents AS (SELECT gp.player_id, SUM(p.rent * 24) AS total_rent_paid FROM game_player AS gp JOIN property AS p ON gp.properties_owned LIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(p.property_id AS CHAR), '%') GROUP BY gp.player_id), RankedPlayers AS (SELECT player_id, total_rent_paid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_rent_paid DESC) AS rent_rank FROM PlayerRents) SELECT player_id FROM RankedPlayers WHERE rent_rank = 1

WITH Feedback2023 AS (SELECT f.reservation_id, f.customer_id, r.table_id, f.rating FROM feedback AS f INNER JOIN reservations AS r ON f.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.date_of_visit AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023'), CustomerTableFeedbacks AS (SELECT f2023.customer_id, f2023.table_id, AVG(f2023.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(f2023.reservation_id) AS feedback_count FROM Feedback2023 AS f2023 GROUP BY f2023.customer_id, f2023.table_id HAVING COUNT(f2023.reservation_id) > 3), RankedFeedbacks AS (SELECT ctf.customer_id, ctf.table_id, ctf.average_rating, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ctf.table_id ORDER BY ctf.average_rating DESC) AS table_rank FROM CustomerTableFeedbacks AS ctf) SELECT CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS customer_name, t.table_number FROM RankedFeedbacks AS rf INNER JOIN customers AS c ON rf.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN tables AS t ON rf.table_id = t.table_id WHERE rf.table_rank = 1 ORDER BY t.table_number

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, AVG(cf.fit_rating) AS average_fit_rating, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cf.size_accuracy SEPARATOR ',') AS size_accuracies FROM products AS p INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id INNER JOIN customer_feedback AS cf ON oi.order_id = cf.order_id INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.is_subscribed = 1 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING AVG(cf.fit_rating) < 4

WITH TeamPerformance AS (SELECT ws.team_id_winner AS team_id, ws.wins, ws.losses, ws.year_id, t.city, t.state, y.year AS season_year, 'Win' AS result FROM world_series AS ws INNER JOIN teams AS t ON ws.team_id_winner = t.team_id INNER JOIN years AS y ON ws.year_id = y.year_id UNION ALL SELECT ws.team_id_loser AS team_id, ws.losses AS wins, ws.wins AS losses, ws.year_id, t.city, t.state, y.year AS season_year, 'Loss' AS result FROM world_series AS ws INNER JOIN teams AS t ON ws.team_id_loser = t.team_id INNER JOIN years AS y ON ws.year_id = y.year_id), CumulativePerformance AS (SELECT team_id, season_year, SUM(wins) OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY season_year) AS cumulative_wins, SUM(losses) OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY season_year) AS cumulative_losses FROM TeamPerformance), GameDetails AS (SELECT ws.game_id, ws.game_date, ws.game_location, u.umpire_name, dv.version_number, dv.update_date, dv.description FROM world_series AS ws INNER JOIN umpires AS u ON ws.umpire_id = u.umpire_id INNER JOIN data_versions AS dv ON ws.year_id = dv.version_id), FullAnalysis AS (SELECT cp.season_year, cp.team_id, cp.cumulative_wins, cp.cumulative_losses, tp.city, tp.state, gd.game_date, gd.game_location, gd.umpire_name, gd.version_number, gd.update_date, gd.description FROM CumulativePerformance AS cp INNER JOIN TeamPerformance AS tp ON cp.team_id = tp.team_id AND cp.season_year = tp.season_year INNER JOIN GameDetails AS gd ON gd.game_date BETWEEN CONCAT(cp.season_year, '-01-01') AND CONCAT(cp.season_year, '-12-31')) SELECT season_year, team_id, city, state, cumulative_wins, cumulative_losses, game_date, game_location, umpire_name, version_number, update_date, description FROM FullAnalysis ORDER BY season_year, team_id, game_date

generated_sql: WITH SalesByDecade AS (SELECT d.decade_name, m.manufacturer_name, o.origin_name, t.type_name, COUNT(s.sale_id) AS total_sales FROM car_sales AS s JOIN car_models AS cm ON s.model_id = cm.model_id JOIN manufacturers AS m ON cm.manufacturer_id = m.manufacturer_id JOIN origins AS o ON cm.origin_id = o.origin_id JOIN types AS t ON cm.type_id = t.type_id JOIN decades AS d ON s.sale_date >= CAST(d.start_year AS CHAR) AND s.sale_date < CAST(d.end_year AS CHAR) GROUP BY d.decade_name, m.manufacturer_name, o.origin_name, t.type_name), RankedSales AS (SELECT sd.decade_name, sd.manufacturer_name, sd.origin_name, sd.type_name, sd.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.decade_name ORDER BY sd.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM SalesByDecade AS sd) SELECT rs.decade_name, rs.manufacturer_name, rs.origin_name, rs.type_name, rs.total_sales FROM RankedSales AS rs WHERE rs.sales_rank = 1 ORDER BY rs.decade_name

WITH ModelBaseInfo AS (SELECT m.model_id, m.name AS model_name, m.algorithm, m.description AS model_desc, mo.user_id, u.name AS owner_name, u.email AS owner_email FROM models AS m INNER JOIN model_ownership AS mo ON m.model_id = mo.model_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON mo.user_id = u.user_id WHERE mo.ownership_type = 'owner'), ModelData AS (SELECT mb.model_id, mb.model_name, mb.algorithm, mb.model_desc, mb.owner_name, mb.owner_email, ds.dataset_id, ds.name AS dataset_name, ds.description AS dataset_desc, ds.size AS dataset_size, md.split_ratio FROM ModelBaseInfo AS mb INNER JOIN model_dataset AS md ON mb.model_id = md.model_id INNER JOIN datasets AS ds ON md.dataset_id = ds.dataset_id), ModelPerformance AS (SELECT mp.model_id, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time FROM model_performance AS mp), ModelHyperparameters AS (SELECT mh.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(hp.name, '=', hp.value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS hyperparameters FROM models AS mh INNER JOIN hyperparameters AS hp ON mh.model_id = hp.model_id GROUP BY mh.model_id), ModelComments AS (SELECT mc.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(mc.comment SEPARATOR ' | ') AS comments FROM model_comments AS mc GROUP BY mc.model_id) SELECT md.model_id, md.model_name, md.algorithm, md.model_desc, md.owner_name, md.owner_email, md.dataset_name, md.dataset_desc, md.dataset_size, md.split_ratio, mp.cv_score, mp.holdout_score, mp.holdout_roc_auc_score, mp.training_time, mp.evaluation_time, mh.hyperparameters, mc.comments FROM ModelData AS md LEFT JOIN ModelPerformance AS mp ON md.model_id = mp.model_id LEFT JOIN ModelHyperparameters AS mh ON md.model_id = mh.model_id LEFT JOIN ModelComments AS mc ON md.model_id = mc.model_id ORDER BY md.model_name

WITH CompanyRevenue AS (SELECT r.company_id, r.year, r.quarter, SUM(r.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM revenue_distribution AS r WHERE r.year >= 2018 GROUP BY r.company_id, r.year, r.quarter), CompanyHistory AS (SELECT h.company_id, h.date, h.mkt_cap, h.ind_rev, h.percent_tot_rev, h.quarter FROM historical_data AS h WHERE h.date >= '2018-01-01'), AccessCount AS (SELECT a.company_id, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count FROM access_logs AS a WHERE a.access_date >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY a.company_id) SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, c.ticker, c.ceo_name, c.headquarters_location, c.founded_year, c.website, COALESCE(i.industry_name, 'Unknown') AS industry_name, cr.year, cr.quarter, cr.total_revenue, ch.mkt_cap, ch.ind_rev, ch.percent_tot_rev, ac.access_count FROM companies AS c JOIN company_industries AS ci ON c.company_id = ci.company_id AND ci.primary_classification = 1 LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON ci.industry_id = i.industry_id AND i.active_status = 1 LEFT JOIN CompanyRevenue AS cr ON c.company_id = cr.company_id LEFT JOIN CompanyHistory AS ch ON c.company_id = ch.company_id AND cr.year = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ch.date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) AND cr.quarter = ch.quarter LEFT JOIN AccessCount AS ac ON c.company_id = ac.company_id WHERE c.active_status = 1 ORDER BY c.company_id, cr.year, cr.quarter

WITH MovieRatings AS (SELECT r.movie_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS num_reviews FROM reviews AS r GROUP BY r.movie_id), MovieAwards AS (SELECT m.movie_id, COUNT(a.award_id) AS num_awards FROM movies AS m LEFT JOIN awards AS a ON m.movie_id = a.movie_id GROUP BY m.movie_id), MovieDirectors AS (SELECT md.movie_id, GROUP_CONCAT(d.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS director_names FROM movie_directors AS md JOIN directors AS d ON md.director_id = d.director_id GROUP BY md.movie_id), TopRatedMovies AS (SELECT m.movie_id, m.title, mr.avg_rating, mr.num_reviews, COALESCE(ma.num_awards, 0) AS num_awards FROM movies AS m JOIN MovieRatings AS mr ON m.movie_id = mr.movie_id LEFT JOIN MovieAwards AS ma ON m.movie_id = ma.movie_id WHERE mr.avg_rating >= 4 ORDER BY mr.avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT trm.title AS Title, ROUND(trm.avg_rating, 2) AS `Average Rating`, trm.num_reviews AS `Number of Reviews`, trm.num_awards AS `Number of Awards`, COALESCE(md.director_names, 'Unknown') AS Directors FROM TopRatedMovies AS trm LEFT JOIN MovieDirectors AS md ON trm.movie_id = md.movie_id

WITH CampaignEngagement AS (SELECT c.campaign_id, COUNT(cc.customer_id) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN cc.engagement_status = 'engaged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN cc.engagement_status = 'engaged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.customer_id) AS engagement_rate FROM marketing_campaigns AS c LEFT JOIN campaign_customers AS cc ON c.campaign_id = cc.campaign_id GROUP BY c.campaign_id), SalesPerformance AS (SELECT ci.campaign_id, SUM(ti.quantity * ti.item_price) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ti.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM campaign_items AS ci LEFT JOIN transaction_items AS ti ON ci.item_id = ti.item_id GROUP BY ci.campaign_id), ItemRecommendations AS (SELECT c.campaign_id, AVG(a.confidence) AS avg_recommendation_confidence, AVG(a.lift) AS avg_recommendation_lift, AVG(a.rule_strength) AS avg_recommendation_strength FROM marketing_campaigns AS c LEFT JOIN campaign_items AS ci ON c.campaign_id = ci.campaign_id LEFT JOIN association_rules AS a ON a.antecedent_items LIKE CONCAT('%', ci.item_id, '%') WHERE a.confidence > 0.9 AND a.lift > 1.0 GROUP BY c.campaign_id), EffectiveCampaigns AS (SELECT ce.campaign_id, ce.engagement_rate, sp.total_sales, sp.transaction_count, ir.avg_recommendation_confidence, ir.avg_recommendation_lift, ir.avg_recommendation_strength, (ce.engagement_rate + sp.total_sales + ir.avg_recommendation_strength) AS campaign_effectiveness FROM CampaignEngagement AS ce LEFT JOIN SalesPerformance AS sp ON ce.campaign_id = sp.campaign_id LEFT JOIN ItemRecommendations AS ir ON ce.campaign_id = ir.campaign_id) SELECT ec.campaign_id, ec.campaign_effectiveness FROM EffectiveCampaigns AS ec ORDER BY ec.campaign_effectiveness DESC

WITH CourseInstructorDetails AS (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, i.instructor_name FROM courses AS c INNER JOIN instructors AS i ON c.instructor_id = i.instructor_id), FeedbackSessionDetails AS (SELECT fs.session_id, fs.course_id, fs.session_name, fs.status, fs.responses, fs.response_rate FROM feedback_sessions AS fs), SessionStudentCount AS (SELECT s.course_id, COUNT(s.student_id) AS total_students FROM students AS s GROUP BY s.course_id), CalculatedResponseRates AS (SELECT fsd.session_id, fsd.course_id, fsd.session_name, fsd.status, fsd.responses, fsd.response_rate, (fsd.responses * 1.0 / ssc.total_students) AS calculated_response_rate FROM FeedbackSessionDetails AS fsd LEFT JOIN SessionStudentCount AS ssc ON fsd.course_id = ssc.course_id), ActionsTaken AS (SELECT a.session_id, GROUP_CONCAT(a.action_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS actions FROM actions AS a GROUP BY a.session_id), RemindersSent AS (SELECT r.session_id, COUNT(r.reminder_id) AS reminders_sent FROM reminders AS r GROUP BY r.session_id), PublicationStatus AS (SELECT pr.session_id, pr.is_public FROM publish_results AS pr) SELECT cid.course_name, cid.instructor_name, fsd.session_name, fsd.status, fsd.responses, fsd.response_rate, COALESCE(crr.calculated_response_rate, 0) AS calculated_response_rate, COALESCE(at.actions, 'No actions') AS actions_taken, COALESCE(rs.reminders_sent, 0) AS reminders_sent, COALESCE(ps.is_public, 0) AS is_public FROM FeedbackSessionDetails AS fsd INNER JOIN CourseInstructorDetails AS cid ON fsd.course_id = cid.course_id LEFT JOIN CalculatedResponseRates AS crr ON fsd.session_id = crr.session_id LEFT JOIN ActionsTaken AS at ON fsd.session_id = at.session_id LEFT JOIN RemindersSent AS rs ON fsd.session_id = rs.session_id LEFT JOIN PublicationStatus AS ps ON fsd.session_id = ps.session_id ORDER BY cid.course_name, fsd.session_name

SELECT p.title AS paper_title, GROUP_CONCAT(a.author_name SEPARATOR ',') AS authors, pub.publication_name AS publication FROM papers AS p INNER JOIN paper_authors AS pa ON p.paper_id = pa.paper_id INNER JOIN authors AS a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id INNER JOIN paper_publications AS pp ON p.paper_id = pp.paper_id INNER JOIN publications AS pub ON pp.publication_id = pub.publication_id GROUP BY p.paper_id, p.title, pub.publication_name HAVING AVG(p.times_cited_all_databases) > 100 ORDER BY AVG(p.times_cited_all_databases) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT incidents.incident_date, incidents.non_suicide_fatality FROM incidents JOIN user_types ON incidents.user_type_id = user_types.user_type_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(incidents.incident_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2015' AND user_types.user_type_name = 'Pick-up truck' AND incidents.non_suicide_fatality > 0 AND incidents.severity = 'critical' ORDER BY incidents.non_suicide_fatality DESC

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(ip.payment_amount, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS total_interest_paid, COUNT(ip.payment_id) AS interest_payment_count FROM customers AS c JOIN accounts AS a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN interest_payments AS ip ON a.account_id = ip.account_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ip.payment_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name

SELECT b.buyer_name FROM buyers AS b JOIN buyer_searches AS bs ON b.buyer_id = bs.buyer_id JOIN sales AS s ON bs.search_results LIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(s.listing_id AS CHAR), '%') GROUP BY b.buyer_id, b.buyer_name HAVING COUNT(s.sale_id) > 0

WITH CareerAverages AS (SELECT player_id, batting_average, bowling_average FROM player_statistics WHERE batting_average > 40 AND bowling_average < 7), IndividualMatchDetails AS (SELECT pmr.player_id, pmr.batting_score, pmr.bowling_overs, pmr.bowling_runs, ps.batting_average AS career_batting_avg, ps.bowling_average AS career_bowling_avg FROM player_match_records AS pmr JOIN players AS p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id JOIN CareerAverages AS ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id), IndividualAverages AS (SELECT player_id, CASE WHEN batting_score LIKE '%D%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(batting_score, 1, LOCATE('D', batting_score) - 1) AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END AS match_batting_score, bowling_overs, bowling_runs, career_batting_avg, career_bowling_avg FROM IndividualMatchDetails WHERE bowling_overs > 0) SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM players AS p JOIN IndividualAverages AS ia ON p.player_id = ia.player_id WHERE ia.match_batting_score / 1 > ia.career_batting_avg AND ia.bowling_runs / ia.bowling_overs < ia.career_bowling_avg ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH SeasonScores AS (SELECT t.team_name, CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name) AS player_name, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(m.match_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS season, s.final_score, MAX(s.final_score) OVER (PARTITION BY t.team_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(m.match_date AS DATETIME), '%Y')) AS max_team_score, MAX(s.final_score) OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(m.match_date AS DATETIME), '%Y')) AS max_player_score FROM scores AS s JOIN matches AS m ON s.match_id = m.match_id JOIN players AS p ON s.player_id = p.player_id JOIN teams AS t ON s.team_id = t.team_id) SELECT team_name, player_name, season, max_team_score, max_player_score FROM SeasonScores WHERE final_score = max_team_score OR final_score = max_player_score ORDER BY season, team_name

SELECT a.coach_id, AVG(CAST(ast.earnings AS SIGNED)) AS average_earnings FROM athletes AS a INNER JOIN annual_stats AS ast ON a.athlete_id = ast.athlete_id WHERE a.athlete_id = a.coach_id GROUP BY a.coach_id

WITH FrequentItemPairs AS (SELECT t1.item_id AS item_id_1, t2.item_id AS item_id_2, COUNT(*) AS pair_count FROM transaction_items AS t1 INNER JOIN transaction_items AS t2 ON t1.transaction_id = t2.transaction_id INNER JOIN transactions AS tr ON t1.transaction_id = tr.transaction_id INNER JOIN customers AS c ON tr.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN campaign_customers AS cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id INNER JOIN marketing_campaigns AS mc ON cc.campaign_id = mc.campaign_id WHERE t1.item_id < t2.item_id AND c.loyalty_member = 1 AND mc.campaign_name = 'Winter Promo 2023' GROUP BY t1.item_id, t2.item_id), RankedItemPairs AS (SELECT item_id_1, item_id_2, pair_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pair_count DESC) AS ranking FROM FrequentItemPairs) SELECT rip.item_id_1, rip.item_id_2, ar.confidence FROM RankedItemPairs AS rip LEFT JOIN association_rules AS ar ON rip.item_id_1 = CAST(SUBSTRING(ar.antecedent, 2) AS SIGNED) AND rip.item_id_2 = CAST(SUBSTRING(ar.consequent, 2) AS SIGNED) WHERE rip.ranking <= 3

WITH ApartmentViewsCTE AS (SELECT a.apartment_id, a.building_name, l.city, a.views, a.interest_level, COUNT(ua.action_id) AS selections, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.city ORDER BY a.views DESC) AS view_rank FROM apartments AS a JOIN locations AS l ON a.location_id = l.location_id LEFT JOIN user_actions AS ua ON a.apartment_id = ua.apartment_id AND ua.action_type = 'select' GROUP BY a.apartment_id, a.building_name, l.city, a.views, a.interest_level) SELECT city, building_name, apartment_id, views, selections, AVG(CAST(interest_level AS SIGNED)) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS avg_interest_level FROM ApartmentViewsCTE WHERE view_rank <= 5 ORDER BY city, view_rank

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_category_id, category_name AS full_category_path FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CONCAT(ch.full_category_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS full_category_path FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), ProductReviews AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(review_id) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM product_reviews GROUP BY product_id), ProductInventory AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_inventory FROM skus JOIN inventory ON skus.sku_id = inventory.sku_id GROUP BY product_id) SELECT p.product_id, p.description, p.price, p.weight, p.material, p.color, p.size, p.style, COALESCE(pr.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(pr.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(pi.total_inventory, 0) AS total_inventory, b.brand_name, ch.full_category_path FROM products AS p JOIN brands AS b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON p.category_id = ch.category_id LEFT JOIN ProductReviews AS pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id LEFT JOIN ProductInventory AS pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id ORDER BY pr.average_rating DESC, pi.total_inventory DESC, p.price ASC

WITH RECURSIVE ConfigHierarchy AS (SELECT config_id, connector, rows_per_second, number_of_rows, created_by, created_at, updated_at, description, is_active, 1 AS level FROM data_generation_configs WHERE NOT config_id IN (SELECT config_id FROM data_generation_configs WHERE config_id IN (SELECT config_id FROM data_generation_configs)) UNION ALL SELECT dgc.config_id, dgc.connector, dgc.rows_per_second, dgc.number_of_rows, dgc.created_by, dgc.created_at, dgc.updated_at, dgc.description, dgc.is_active, ch.level + 1 AS level FROM data_generation_configs AS dgc INNER JOIN ConfigHierarchy AS ch ON dgc.config_id = ch.config_id), LogStats AS (SELECT c.config_id, COUNT(log.log_id) AS log_count, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(log.duration, ' ', '') AS SIGNED)) AS avg_duration, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(log.duration, ' ', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_duration FROM ConfigHierarchy AS c LEFT JOIN data_generation_logs AS log ON c.config_id = log.config_id GROUP BY c.config_id), DatasetMetrics AS (SELECT config_id, COUNT(dataset_id) AS dataset_count, SUM(CAST(size_in_bytes AS SIGNED)) AS total_size_bytes, AVG(quality_score) AS avg_quality_score FROM generated_datasets GROUP BY config_id) SELECT ch.config_id, ch.connector, ch.rows_per_second, ch.number_of_rows, u.username, u.email, u.role_id, ls.log_count, ls.avg_duration, ls.total_duration, dm.dataset_count, dm.total_size_bytes, dm.avg_quality_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ls.total_duration DESC, dm.avg_quality_score DESC) AS rank_by_duration_quality FROM ConfigHierarchy AS ch LEFT JOIN users AS u ON ch.created_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN LogStats AS ls ON ch.config_id = ls.config_id LEFT JOIN DatasetMetrics AS dm ON ch.config_id = dm.config_id ORDER BY ls.total_duration DESC, dm.avg_quality_score DESC

WITH RECURSIVE RegionHierarchy AS (SELECT region_id, region_name, type, parent_region_id, CAST(region_name AS CHAR) AS full_path, 1 AS level FROM geographic_regions WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT gr.region_id, gr.region_name, gr.type, gr.parent_region_id, CONCAT(rh.full_path, ' > ', gr.region_name) AS full_path, rh.level + 1 AS level FROM geographic_regions AS gr JOIN RegionHierarchy AS rh ON gr.parent_region_id = rh.region_id), ActiveDatasets AS (SELECT rd.region_id, COUNT(rd.dataset_id) AS active_datasets FROM region_dataset AS rd JOIN datasets AS ds ON rd.dataset_id = ds.dataset_id WHERE ds.is_active = 1 GROUP BY rd.region_id) SELECT rh.full_path AS region_path, COALESCE(ad.active_datasets, 0) AS active_datasets FROM RegionHierarchy AS rh LEFT JOIN ActiveDatasets AS ad ON rh.region_id = ad.region_id ORDER BY rh.level, rh.full_path

SELECT ci.customer_id, COUNT(ci.interaction_id) AS interaction_count, GROUP_CONCAT(e.employee_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS employee_names FROM customer_interactions AS ci JOIN employees AS e ON ci.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE ci.interaction_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY ci.customer_id HAVING COUNT(ci.interaction_id) > 1 ORDER BY interaction_count DESC

WITH PerformanceStatistics AS (SELECT d.department_id, AVG(pr.rating) AS average_rating FROM departments AS d INNER JOIN employees AS e ON d.department_id = e.department_id INNER JOIN performance_reviews AS pr ON e.employee_id = pr.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id), OverallAverageRating AS (SELECT AVG(rating) AS overall_average_rating FROM performance_reviews), HighPerformingDepartments AS (SELECT ps.department_id FROM PerformanceStatistics AS ps WHERE ps.average_rating > (SELECT overall_average_rating FROM OverallAverageRating)), HighPerformingEmployees AS (SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.department_id, AVG(pr.rating) AS employee_average_rating FROM employees AS e INNER JOIN performance_reviews AS pr ON e.employee_id = pr.employee_id WHERE e.department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM HighPerformingDepartments) GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.department_id), TrainingCompletions AS (SELECT et.employee_id, tp.training_name, et.completion_date, et.rating AS training_rating FROM employee_training AS et INNER JOIN training_programs AS tp ON et.training_id = tp.training_id), HRAccesses AS (SELECT a.employee_id, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count FROM access_logs AS a WHERE a.access_by IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE role = 'hr') GROUP BY a.employee_id) SELECT hpe.first_name, hpe.last_name, hpe.department_id, hpe.employee_average_rating, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(tc.training_name, ', ', tc.completion_date, ', ', tc.training_rating) SEPARATOR ',') AS training_details, COALESCE(ha.access_count, 0) AS hr_access_count FROM HighPerformingEmployees AS hpe LEFT JOIN TrainingCompletions AS tc ON hpe.employee_id = tc.employee_id LEFT JOIN HRAccesses AS ha ON hpe.employee_id = ha.employee_id GROUP BY hpe.first_name, hpe.last_name, hpe.department_id, hpe.employee_average_rating, ha.access_count

WITH RecentLatchPerformance AS (SELECT l.latch_id, l.latch_name, lh.get_requests, lh.misses, lh.sleeps, lh.spin_gets, lh.timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.latch_id ORDER BY lh.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM latches AS l JOIN latch_history AS lh ON l.latch_id = lh.latch_id WHERE CAST(lh.misses AS SIGNED) > 1000 OR CAST(lh.sleeps AS SIGNED) > 500) SELECT latch_name FROM RecentLatchPerformance WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY CAST(misses AS SIGNED) DESC, CAST(sleeps AS SIGNED) DESC

SELECT CONCAT(c.county_name, ' - Turnout: ', CAST(ecr.voter_turnout_percentage AS CHAR), '%') AS county_voter_turnout FROM election_county_results AS ecr JOIN counties AS c ON ecr.county_id = c.county_id JOIN elections AS e ON ecr.election_id = e.election_id WHERE e.election_name = '2023 General Election' AND e.status = 'completed'

WITH LatestPerformanceReviews AS (SELECT p.employee_id, p.score, p.review_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.employee_id ORDER BY p.review_date DESC) AS review_order FROM employee_performance AS p), TopPerformers AS (SELECT lpr.employee_id, lpr.score, lpr.review_date FROM LatestPerformanceReviews AS lpr WHERE lpr.review_order = 1), EmployeeTrainingDetails AS (SELECT et.employee_id, GROUP_CONCAT(et.training_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS training_names FROM employee_training AS et GROUP BY et.employee_id), CumulativeSalary AS (SELECT s.employee_id, SUM(CAST(s.base_salary AS FLOAT)) AS cumulative_salary FROM salary AS s GROUP BY s.employee_id) SELECT tp.employee_id, e.full_name, e.department_id, tp.score, tp.review_date, COALESCE(etr.training_names, 'No Training') AS training_names, cs.cumulative_salary FROM TopPerformers AS tp JOIN employees AS e ON tp.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN EmployeeTrainingDetails AS etr ON tp.employee_id = etr.employee_id LEFT JOIN CumulativeSalary AS cs ON tp.employee_id = cs.employee_id ORDER BY e.department_id, tp.score DESC, tp.review_date DESC

WITH RECURSIVE kernel_hierarchy AS (SELECT kernel_id, version, description, released_at, is_stable, maintainer, CAST(version AS FLOAT) AS version_number, 1 AS level FROM kernels WHERE maintainer IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT k.kernel_id, k.version, k.description, k.released_at, k.is_stable, k.maintainer, CAST(k.version AS FLOAT) AS version_number, h.level + 1 FROM kernels AS k JOIN kernel_hierarchy AS h ON k.maintainer = h.kernel_id), patch_platforms_stats AS (SELECT pp.patch_id, GROUP_CONCAT(p.platform_name SEPARATOR ',') AS platforms FROM patch_platforms AS pp JOIN platforms AS p ON pp.platform_id = p.platform_id GROUP BY pp.patch_id), patch_test_stats AS (SELECT tr.patch_id, GROUP_CONCAT(tr.test_result SEPARATOR ',') AS test_results FROM test_results AS tr GROUP BY tr.patch_id) SELECT u.user_name AS Submitter, p.name AS PatchName, kh.version AS BaseKernelVersion, pp.platforms AS Platforms, pts.test_results AS TestResults FROM users AS u JOIN patches AS p ON u.user_id = p.submitted_by JOIN kernel_hierarchy AS kh ON p.base_kernel_id = kh.kernel_id LEFT JOIN patch_platforms_stats AS pp ON p.patch_id = pp.patch_id LEFT JOIN patch_test_stats AS pts ON p.patch_id = pts.patch_id ORDER BY kh.level, kh.version_number DESC

SELECT m.method_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.method_name, ';', rr.recommendation, ';', c.commit_hash, ';', c.commit_message) SEPARATOR ';') AS method_info FROM methods AS m INNER JOIN refactor_recommendations AS rr ON m.method_id = rr.method_id INNER JOIN commits AS c ON m.file_id = c.file_id WHERE rr.status = 'accepted' GROUP BY m.method_id HAVING COUNT(c.commit_id) > 0

WITH DecadeSales AS (SELECT d.decade_id, d.decade_name, cs.model_id, cm.model_name, m.manufacturer_name, cs.sale_region, COUNT(cs.sale_id) AS total_sales FROM car_sales AS cs JOIN car_models AS cm ON cs.model_id = cm.model_id JOIN manufacturers AS m ON cm.manufacturer_id = m.manufacturer_id JOIN decades AS d ON cs.sale_date BETWEEN CONCAT(d.start_year, '-01-01') AND CONCAT(d.end_year, '-12-31') GROUP BY d.decade_id, d.decade_name, cs.model_id, cm.model_name, m.manufacturer_name, cs.sale_region), SalesTrends AS (SELECT ds.decade_id, ds.decade_name, ds.model_id, ds.model_name, ds.manufacturer_name, ds.sale_region, ds.total_sales, LAG(ds.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.model_id, ds.sale_region ORDER BY ds.decade_id) AS prev_decade_sales FROM DecadeSales AS ds), SalesGrowth AS (SELECT st.decade_id, st.decade_name, st.model_id, st.model_name, st.manufacturer_name, st.sale_region, st.total_sales, st.prev_decade_sales, (st.total_sales - COALESCE(st.prev_decade_sales, 0)) * 100.0 / COALESCE(st.prev_decade_sales, 1) AS sales_growth_rate FROM SalesTrends AS st) SELECT st.decade_name, st.manufacturer_name, st.model_name, st.sale_region, st.sales_growth_rate FROM SalesGrowth AS st ORDER BY st.decade_id, st.manufacturer_name, st.model_name, st.sale_region, st.sales_growth_rate DESC

WITH UserAccessCounts AS (SELECT ua.dataset_id, ua.user_id, u.user_name, COUNT(ua.access_id) AS access_count FROM user_access AS ua JOIN users AS u ON ua.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY ua.dataset_id, ua.user_id, u.user_name), TopUsersPerDataset AS (SELECT uac.dataset_id, uac.user_name, uac.access_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uac.dataset_id ORDER BY uac.access_count DESC) AS user_rank FROM UserAccessCounts AS uac), DatasetTopUsers AS (SELECT tu.dataset_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(tu.user_name, ' (', tu.access_count, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_users FROM TopUsersPerDataset AS tu WHERE tu.user_rank <= 5 GROUP BY tu.dataset_id), DatasetSummary AS (SELECT gd.dataset_id, gd.dataset_name, COALESCE(dtu.top_users, 'No Top Users') AS top_users FROM geospatial_datasets AS gd LEFT JOIN DatasetTopUsers AS dtu ON gd.dataset_id = dtu.dataset_id) SELECT ds.dataset_name, ds.top_users FROM DatasetSummary AS ds ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(ua.access_id) FROM user_access AS ua WHERE ua.dataset_id = ds.dataset_id) DESC

SELECT latches.latch_name, SUM(CAST(latches.get_requests AS SIGNED)) AS total_get_requests, SUM(CAST(latches.misses AS SIGNED)) AS total_misses FROM latches GROUP BY latches.latch_name ORDER BY total_get_requests DESC

WITH EventFeedback AS (SELECT ef.event_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(CAST(ef.rating AS CHAR), ': ', ef.comments) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS feedback_summary FROM event_feedback AS ef GROUP BY ef.event_id), EventSponsors AS (SELECT es.event_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(es.sponsor_name, ' (', es.sponsor_type, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS sponsors_summary FROM event_sponsors AS es GROUP BY es.event_id), EventPenalties AS (SELECT p.event_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(CAST(p.penalty_time AS CHAR), ' min (', p.penalty_type, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS penalties_summary FROM penalties AS p GROUP BY p.event_id), EventDetails AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.location, e.total_participants, ef.feedback_summary, es.sponsors_summary, ep.penalties_summary FROM events AS e LEFT JOIN EventFeedback AS ef ON e.event_id = ef.event_id LEFT JOIN EventSponsors AS es ON e.event_id = es.event_id LEFT JOIN EventPenalties AS ep ON e.event_id = ep.event_id) SELECT CONCAT(event_id, ': ', event_name, ' (', event_date, ')', ' - ', location, ' - ', 'Participants: ', total_participants, ', ', 'Feedback: ', COALESCE(feedback_summary, 'No feedback'), ', ', 'Sponsors: ', COALESCE(sponsors_summary, 'No sponsors'), ', ', 'Penalties: ', COALESCE(penalties_summary, 'No penalties')) AS event_summary FROM EventDetails ORDER BY event_id
