SELECT c.class_id, l.label_value, d.description_value, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.role SEPARATOR ',') AS roles FROM classes AS c JOIN labels AS l ON c.class_id = l.class_id JOIN descriptions AS d ON c.class_id = d.class_id JOIN users AS u ON c.created_by = u.user_id WHERE c.created_by = 101 GROUP BY c.class_id, l.label_value, d.description_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.role) > 1

SELECT g.group_name, a.year, a.attack_type_id, COUNT(a.attack_id) AS total_attacks, SUM(CASE WHEN a.attack_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_attacks, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attack_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(a.attack_id) AS completion_rate FROM attacks AS a JOIN `groups` AS g ON a.group_id = g.group_id WHERE a.year = 2023 GROUP BY g.group_name, a.year, a.attack_type_id ORDER BY g.group_name, a.year, a.attack_type_id

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_category_id, CAST(category_name AS CHAR) AS full_path FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, CAST(CONCAT(ch.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS CHAR) AS full_path FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id), ProductSales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(oi.quantity * o.total / oi.quantity) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.product_id), ProductInventory AS (SELECT i.product_id, i.quantity AS current_quantity, i.last_updated FROM inventory AS i INNER JOIN (SELECT product_id, MAX(last_updated) AS max_last_updated FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id) AS imax ON i.product_id = imax.product_id AND i.last_updated = imax.max_last_updated) SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.price, p.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, ch.category_id, ch.category_name, ch.full_path, ps.total_quantity_sold, ps.total_revenue, pi.current_quantity, pi.last_updated, SUM(ps.total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.category_id ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS cumulative_revenue FROM products AS p JOIN ProductSales AS ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN ProductInventory AS pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id JOIN product_categories AS pc ON p.product_id = pc.product_id JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON pc.category_id = ch.category_id JOIN suppliers AS s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE ps.total_quantity_sold > 0 AND pi.current_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ch.category_id, ps.total_revenue DESC

WITH OwnersHorses AS (SELECT h.horse_id FROM horses AS h INNER JOIN horse_owners AS ho ON h.horse_id = ho.horse_id INNER JOIN owners AS o ON ho.owner_id = o.owner_id WHERE o.owner_name = 'Bob Williams'), AqueductWinners AS (SELECT rr.race_id, rr.finish_time, r.race_name FROM race_results AS rr INNER JOIN OwnersHorses AS oh ON rr.horse_id = oh.horse_id INNER JOIN races AS r ON rr.race_id = r.race_id INNER JOIN tracks AS t ON r.track_id = t.track_id WHERE t.track_name = 'Aqueduct' AND rr.place = 1) SELECT aw.race_name, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(aw.finish_time, 1, 2) AS SIGNED) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTRING(aw.finish_time, 4, 2) AS SIGNED) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(aw.finish_time, 7, 2) AS SIGNED)) AS average_winning_time_seconds FROM AqueductWinners AS aw GROUP BY aw.race_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(tabled_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(item_id) AS item_count, MAX(tabled_date) AS latest_tabled_date FROM plenary_items WHERE tabled_date LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH FilmFirearms AS (SELECT m.movie_id, m.title, m.release_date, m.director, a.actor_name, c.character_name, fp.fp_name AS firearm_name, COUNT(mfp.movie_id) AS firearm_usage_count, MAX(l.created_at) AS last_user_action_timestamp FROM movies AS m INNER JOIN characters AS c ON m.movie_id = c.movie_id INNER JOIN actors AS a ON c.actor_id = a.actor_id INNER JOIN movie_firearms_props AS mfp ON m.movie_id = mfp.movie_id AND c.character_id = mfp.character_id INNER JOIN firearms_props AS fp ON mfp.fp_id = fp.fp_id LEFT JOIN logs AS l ON m.movie_id = l.record_id AND l.table_name = 'movies' GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title, m.release_date, m.director, a.actor_name, c.character_name, fp.fp_name), UserPermissions AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.role, GROUP_CONCAT(up.permission SEPARATOR ', ') AS permissions FROM users AS u INNER JOIN user_permissions AS up ON u.user_id = up.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.role) SELECT ffmpeg.movie_id, ffmpeg.title, ffmpeg.release_date, ffmpeg.director, ffmpeg.actor_name, ffmpeg.character_name, ffmpeg.firearm_name, ffmpeg.firearm_usage_count, ffmpeg.last_user_action_timestamp, COALESCE(up.username, 'No User') AS last_user, COALESCE(up.permissions, 'No Permissions') AS user_permissions FROM FilmFirearms AS ffmpeg LEFT JOIN UserPermissions AS up ON ffmpeg.last_user_action_timestamp = (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM logs WHERE user_id = up.user_id) ORDER BY ffmpeg.movie_id, ffmpeg.firearm_usage_count DESC

WITH PlayerTournamentStats AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, t.team_name, c.coach_name, tr.tournament_id, tor.year AS tournament_year, tr.comp_score, tr.rounds_won, tr.`rank`, (tr.comp_score + tr.rounds_won) / tr.`rank` AS comprehensive_rating FROM players AS p INNER JOIN teams AS t ON p.team_id = t.team_id INNER JOIN coaches AS c ON t.coach_id = c.coach_id INNER JOIN tournament_results AS tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id INNER JOIN tournaments AS tor ON tr.tournament_id = tor.tournament_id), TopPlayers AS (SELECT player_id, player_name, team_name, coach_name, tournament_id, tournament_year, comp_score, rounds_won, `rank`, comprehensive_rating, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tournament_id ORDER BY comprehensive_rating DESC) AS player_rank_in_tournament FROM PlayerTournamentStats), FinalResults AS (SELECT player_name, team_name, coach_name, tournament_name, tournament_year, comp_score, rounds_won, `rank`, comprehensive_rating, CASE WHEN player_rank_in_tournament = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN player_rank_in_tournament = 2 THEN 'Runner-Up' ELSE 'Competed' END AS tournament_outcome FROM TopPlayers AS top INNER JOIN tournaments AS tor ON top.tournament_id = tor.tournament_id WHERE top.player_rank_in_tournament <= 3) SELECT tournament_outcome FROM FinalResults ORDER BY tournament_year, comprehensive_rating DESC

SELECT s.spacecraft_name, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.maintenance_type, ' (', m.description, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS recent_maintenance_activities, SUM(m.maintenance_cost) AS total_maintenance_cost, COUNT(*) AS number_of_maintenances, MAX(m.maintenance_date) AS last_maintenance_date, GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS maintenance_performed_by FROM maintenance_logs AS m JOIN spacecrafts AS s ON m.spacecraft_id = s.spacecraft_id JOIN users AS u ON m.performed_by = u.user_id WHERE m.maintenance_cost > 1000 GROUP BY s.spacecraft_name HAVING SUM(m.maintenance_cost) > 1000 ORDER BY total_maintenance_cost DESC

SELECT a.artist_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.song_id) AS number_of_songs, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(s.length, 1, LOCATE(':', s.length) - 1) AS SIGNED) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(s.length, LOCATE(':', s.length) + 1) AS SIGNED)) AS average_song_length, COUNT(DISTINCT aw.award_id) AS number_of_awards FROM artists AS a LEFT JOIN songs AS s ON a.artist_id = s.artist_id LEFT JOIN awards AS aw ON a.artist_id = aw.artist_id GROUP BY a.artist_name

WITH ISPDetails AS (SELECT i.isp_id, i.name, i.technology, i.max_download_speed, i.max_upload_speed, i.availability, i.price, i.data_limit, i.contract_length, i.installation_fee, i.customer_support, i.website, i.logo_url, t.description AS tech_description, t.speed_range AS tech_speed_range, t.cost_effectiveness AS tech_cost_effectiveness, t.environmental_impact AS tech_environmental_impact FROM isps AS i INNER JOIN technologies AS t ON i.technology = t.tech_name), ISPStats AS (SELECT r.isp_id, r.`rank`, r.total_reviews, r.average_rating FROM rankings AS r), ISPReviews AS (SELECT r.isp_id, COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating, MAX(r.usefulness) AS max_usefulness FROM reviews AS r GROUP BY r.isp_id) SELECT id.name, id.technology, id.max_download_speed, id.max_upload_speed, id.availability, id.price, id.data_limit, id.contract_length, id.installation_fee, id.customer_support, id.website, id.logo_url, id.tech_description, id.tech_speed_range, id.tech_cost_effectiveness, id.tech_environmental_impact, COALESCE(isps.total_reviews, 0) AS total_reviews, COALESCE(isps.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(isr.total_reviews, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(isr.average_rating, 0) AS review_average_rating, COALESCE(isr.max_usefulness, 0) AS max_usefulness FROM ISPDetails AS id LEFT JOIN ISPStats AS isps ON id.isp_id = isps.isp_id LEFT JOIN ISPReviews AS isr ON id.isp_id = isr.isp_id WHERE id.availability >= 95 AND id.price <= 60 AND (isps.`rank` <= 5 OR isps.`rank` IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN isps.`rank` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, isps.`rank` ASC, isr.average_rating DESC, id.max_download_speed DESC LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE LatestDeploymentCTE AS (SELECT mdh.model_id, mdh.deployment_id, mdh.deployment_date, mdh.model_version, mdh.environment, mdh.deployment_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mdh.model_id ORDER BY mdh.deployment_date DESC) AS rn FROM model_deployment_history AS mdh), HyperparametersSummary AS (SELECT m.model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(hp.hyperparameter_name, ': ', hp.hyperparameter_value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS hyperparameters FROM models AS m JOIN hyperparameters AS hp ON m.model_id = hp.model_id GROUP BY m.model_id), EvaluationMetricsCTE AS (SELECT em.model_id, AVG(em.train_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_train_loss, AVG(em.valid_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_valid_loss, MAX(em.accuracy) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_accuracy, MAX(em.`precision`) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_precision, MAX(em.recall) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_recall, MAX(em.f1_score) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_f1_score, MAX(em.auc) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_auc, MAX(em.mean_squared_error) OVER (PARTITION BY em.model_id ORDER BY em.epoch ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_mean_squared_error FROM evaluation_metrics AS em), UserDetailsCTE AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.role FROM users AS u) SELECT md.model_id, m.model_name, m.model_type, md.deployment_date, md.model_version, md.environment, md.deployment_status, hps.hyperparameters, ems.cumulative_train_loss, ems.cumulative_valid_loss, ems.max_accuracy, ems.max_precision, ems.max_recall, ems.max_f1_score, ems.max_auc, ems.max_mean_squared_error, us.username, us.email, us.role FROM LatestDeploymentCTE AS md JOIN models AS m ON md.model_id = m.model_id JOIN HyperparametersSummary AS hps ON hps.model_id = m.model_id JOIN EvaluationMetricsCTE AS ems ON ems.model_id = m.model_id JOIN experiments AS exp ON exp.model_id = m.model_id JOIN UserDetailsCTE AS us ON us.user_id = exp.user_id WHERE md.rn = 1 AND md.deployment_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY md.deployment_date DESC

WITH EventDetails AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, p.program_name, p.program_type, GROUP_CONCAT(t.team_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS organizing_teams, COUNT(r.registration_id) AS total_registrations FROM events AS e JOIN programs AS p ON e.program_id = p.program_id LEFT JOIN event_teams AS et ON e.event_id = et.event_id LEFT JOIN teams AS t ON et.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN registrations AS r ON e.event_id = r.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, p.program_name, p.program_type) SELECT ed.event_id, ed.event_name, ed.event_date, ed.program_name, ed.program_type, ed.organizing_teams, ed.total_registrations FROM EventDetails AS ed ORDER BY ed.event_date DESC, ed.total_registrations DESC

SELECT vc.config_name AS Vehicle_Configuration, sv.version_number AS Software_Version, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(tr.success_rate, 1, LOCATE('%', tr.success_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT)) AS Average_Success_Rate FROM test_runs AS tr INNER JOIN vehicle_configurations AS vc ON tr.vehicle_config_id = vc.config_id INNER JOIN software_versions AS sv ON tr.software_version_id = sv.version_id GROUP BY vc.config_name, sv.version_number HAVING AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(tr.success_rate, 1, LOCATE('%', tr.success_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT)) > 90

SELECT c.ascii_value AS `ASCII Value`, COUNT(al.access_id) AS `Number of Accesses` FROM characters AS c INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON c.char_id = al.char_id WHERE al.access_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' GROUP BY c.ascii_value HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) > 10 ORDER BY COUNT(al.access_id) DESC

WITH CitationDetails AS (SELECT c.citation_id, c.vehicle_plate, n.neighborhood_name, v.make, v.model, v.year, f.fine_amount AS citation_fine_amount, f.payment_status FROM citations AS c JOIN neighborhoods AS n ON c.neighborhood_id = n.neighborhood_id LEFT JOIN vehicles AS v ON c.vehicle_plate = v.vehicle_plate AND c.vehicle_plate_state = v.vehicle_plate_state LEFT JOIN fines AS f ON c.citation_id = f.citation_id WHERE c.citation_month_and_year = 'January 2023'), NeighborhoodFinesSummary AS (SELECT cd.neighborhood_name, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.payment_status = 'unpaid' THEN CAST(cd.citation_fine_amount AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_fine_total, SUM(CAST(cd.citation_fine_amount AS SIGNED)) AS total_fine_amount FROM CitationDetails AS cd GROUP BY cd.neighborhood_name) SELECT cd.citation_id, cd.vehicle_plate, cd.neighborhood_name, cd.make, cd.model, cd.year, cd.citation_fine_amount, cd.payment_status, nfs.unpaid_fine_total, nfs.total_fine_amount FROM CitationDetails AS cd JOIN NeighborhoodFinesSummary AS nfs ON cd.neighborhood_name = nfs.neighborhood_name ORDER BY cd.neighborhood_name, cd.payment_status DESC

WITH EmployeeBenefits AS (SELECT eb.employee_id, GROUP_CONCAT(b.benefit_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS benefits FROM employee_benefits AS eb INNER JOIN benefits AS b ON eb.benefit_id = b.benefit_id GROUP BY eb.employee_id) SELECT e.employee_id, j.job_title, d.department_name, p.salary, COALESCE(eb.benefits, 'None') AS benefits FROM employees AS e INNER JOIN job_titles AS j ON e.job_title_id = j.job_title_id INNER JOIN departments AS d ON j.department_id = d.department_id INNER JOIN payroll AS p ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id LEFT JOIN EmployeeBenefits AS eb ON e.employee_id = eb.employee_id WHERE e.status_id = 1 LIMIT 1

WITH PoliticalEventsCTE AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.name AS event_name FROM events AS e INNER JOIN event_event_type AS eet ON e.event_id = eet.event_id INNER JOIN event_types AS et ON eet.type_id = et.type_id WHERE et.type_name = 'political event'), IndividualsInEventsCTE AS (SELECT ei.event_id, ei.individual_id, i.name AS individual_name FROM event_individual AS ei INNER JOIN individuals AS i ON ei.individual_id = i.individual_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(i.birth_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '1900'), FilteredEventsCTE AS (SELECT pe.event_id, pe.event_name, ie.individual_id, ie.individual_name FROM PoliticalEventsCTE AS pe INNER JOIN IndividualsInEventsCTE AS ie ON pe.event_id = ie.event_id) SELECT fe.event_name, GROUP_CONCAT(fe.individual_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS involved_individuals FROM FilteredEventsCTE AS fe GROUP BY fe.event_name HAVING COUNT(fe.individual_id) > 1

SELECT e.engagement_score FROM user_engagements AS e JOIN comments AS c ON e.comment_id = c.comment_id JOIN toxicity_scores AS t ON c.toxicity_score BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t.score_range, 1, LOCATE('-', t.score_range) - 1) AS SIGNED) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(t.score_range, LOCATE('-', t.score_range) + 1) AS SIGNED) WHERE e.user_id = 0 AND e.engagement_type = 'like' AND c.split = 'test' AND c.is_toxic = 0 AND t.description = 'Non-toxic'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(p.production_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS production_year, AVG(q.quality_score) AS average_quality_score FROM quality_ratings AS q JOIN production_batches AS p ON q.wine_id = p.wine_id JOIN users AS u ON p.producer_id = u.user_id WHERE u.username = 'jane.smith' AND p.quality_control_status = 'passed' GROUP BY production_year

SELECT f.family_name, GROUP_CONCAT(s.common_name SEPARATOR ',') AS common_names FROM species AS s JOIN genus AS g ON s.genus = g.genus_name JOIN genus_family AS gf ON g.genus_id = gf.genus_id JOIN family AS f ON gf.family_id = f.family_id WHERE s.average_lifespan > 10 GROUP BY f.family_name HAVING AVG(s.average_lifespan) > 10

SELECT o.outbreak_id, e.name AS pathogen_name, f.factor_description AS most_common_factor, COUNT(c.case_id) AS total_cases FROM outbreaks AS o INNER JOIN etiologies AS e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id INNER JOIN outbreak_factors AS `of` ON o.outbreak_id = `of`.outbreak_id INNER JOIN factors AS f ON `of`.factor_id = f.factor_id INNER JOIN cases AS c ON o.outbreak_id = c.outbreak_id GROUP BY o.outbreak_id, e.name, f.factor_description HAVING COUNT(c.case_id) > 10 ORDER BY total_cases DESC
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM albums INNER JOIN ratings ON albums.album_id = ratings.album_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(albums.release_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '1996'

WITH ActiveWords AS (SELECT word_id, word_form, pos FROM words WHERE status = 'active'), UsageByPeriod AS (SELECT us.word_id, hp.period_name, SUM(us.usage_count) AS total_usage FROM usage_stats AS us JOIN historical_periods AS hp ON us.date BETWEEN CONCAT(hp.start_year, '-01-01') AND CONCAT(hp.end_year, '-12-31') GROUP BY us.word_id, hp.period_name), RankedWords AS (SELECT aw.word_id, aw.word_form, aw.pos, ubp.period_name, ubp.total_usage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aw.word_id ORDER BY ubp.total_usage DESC) AS period_rank FROM ActiveWords AS aw JOIN UsageByPeriod AS ubp ON aw.word_id = ubp.word_id) SELECT word_form, pos, period_name, total_usage FROM RankedWords WHERE period_rank = 1 ORDER BY total_usage DESC

WITH AnalystAccess AS (SELECT ua.commodity_id, ua.market_id FROM users AS u JOIN user_access AS ua ON u.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE u.user_id = 0), PriceData2021 AS (SELECT p.commodity_id, p.market_id, p.low_price, p.high_price, p.price_date FROM price_data AS p WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(p.price_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2021'), RecentPrices AS (SELECT pd21.commodity_id, pd21.market_id, MIN(pd21.low_price) AS min_price, MAX(pd21.high_price) AS max_price, MAX(pd21.price_date) AS latest_date FROM PriceData2021 AS pd21 GROUP BY pd21.commodity_id, pd21.market_id) SELECT c.commodity_name, m.market_name, rp.min_price, rp.max_price, rp.latest_date FROM RecentPrices AS rp JOIN AnalystAccess AS aa ON rp.commodity_id = aa.commodity_id AND rp.market_id = aa.market_id JOIN commodities AS c ON c.commodity_id = rp.commodity_id JOIN markets AS m ON m.market_id = rp.market_id

SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_name, AVG(CAST(e.salary AS FLOAT)) AS avg_salary, d.location, d.dept_description, e_manager.emp_name AS manager_name, e_manager.mgr_ssn, GROUP_CONCAT(jt.job_title SEPARATOR ',') AS roles FROM departments AS d INNER JOIN employees AS e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id INNER JOIN department_managers AS dm ON d.dept_id = dm.dept_id INNER JOIN employees AS e_manager ON dm.emp_id = e_manager.emp_id LEFT JOIN employee_roles AS er ON e_manager.emp_id = er.emp_id LEFT JOIN job_titles AS jt ON er.role_id = jt.job_title_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.location, d.dept_description, e_manager.emp_name, e_manager.mgr_ssn

WITH ApprovedLoans AS (SELECT la.application_id, la.loan_type_id, la.risk_score FROM loan_applications AS la WHERE la.status = 'approved'), LoanTypesInRange AS (SELECT lt.loan_type_id, lt.interest_rate_range FROM loan_types AS lt WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.interest_rate_range, 1, LOCATE('-', lt.interest_rate_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) BETWEEN 3 AND 7 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.interest_rate_range, LOCATE('-', lt.interest_rate_range) + 1) AS FLOAT) BETWEEN 3 AND 7), RankedApplications AS (SELECT al.application_id, al.loan_type_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY al.loan_type_id ORDER BY al.risk_score ASC) AS risk_rank FROM ApprovedLoans AS al) SELECT ra.application_id FROM RankedApplications AS ra JOIN LoanTypesInRange AS ltr ON ra.loan_type_id = ltr.loan_type_id WHERE ra.risk_rank <= 3

WITH ExperimentDetails AS (SELECT e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name, e.experiment_type, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.status, u.user_name AS created_by_user_name, u1.user_name AS last_modified_by_user_name FROM experiments AS e JOIN users AS u ON e.created_by = u.user_id JOIN users AS u1 ON e.last_modified_by = u1.user_id), ReplicateOutcomes AS (SELECT r.replicate_id, r.sample_id, r.`condition`, r.outcome, m.temperature, m.time, m.od, m.unit, m.measurement_type FROM replicates AS r LEFT JOIN measurements AS m ON r.replicate_id = m.replicate_id), SampleAccessLogs AS (SELECT a.experiment_id, MAX(a.access_date) AS last_access_date, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count, GROUP_CONCAT(a.user_agent SEPARATOR ',') AS access_agents FROM access_logs AS a GROUP BY a.experiment_id) SELECT ed.experiment_name, ed.experiment_type, ed.status, ed.start_date, ed.end_date, ed.created_by_user_name, ed.last_modified_by_user_name, ro.`condition`, ro.outcome, ro.temperature, ro.time, ro.od, ro.unit, ro.measurement_type, sal.last_access_date, sal.access_count, sal.access_agents FROM ExperimentDetails AS ed JOIN ReplicateOutcomes AS ro ON ed.experiment_id = ro.sample_id JOIN SampleAccessLogs AS sal ON ed.experiment_id = sal.experiment_id ORDER BY ed.experiment_name, ro.`condition`, ro.outcome

WITH CarSalesStats AS (SELECT c.car_id, c.car_name, ct.type_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.feature_id) AS total_features, SUM(CASE WHEN f.feature_group = 'safety' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_features, SUM(s.quantity) AS total_sales FROM cars AS c INNER JOIN sales AS s ON c.car_id = s.car_id INNER JOIN features AS f ON c.car_id = f.car_id INNER JOIN car_types AS ct ON c.type_id = ct.type_id WHERE s.sale_date >= '2022-01-01' GROUP BY c.car_id, c.car_name, ct.type_name) SELECT car_name, type_name, CAST(AVG(total_sales) AS SIGNED) AS avg_sales_per_type FROM CarSalesStats WHERE total_features > 3 AND safety_features > 0 GROUP BY car_name, type_name ORDER BY avg_sales_per_type DESC

SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(lr.leave_id) AS approved_leave_requests FROM leave_requests AS lr JOIN employees AS e ON lr.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN departments AS d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE lr.status = 'Approved' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(lr.start_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') GROUP BY d.department_name

WITH FilteredIndividuals AS (SELECT i.education, e.education_category, i.income, i.hours_per_week, i.final_weight FROM individuals AS i JOIN educations AS e ON i.education = e.education_name WHERE i.veteran = 1 AND i.disability = 0 AND i.income = '>50K'), EducationStats AS (SELECT fi.education_category, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(fi.income, '>', '') AS SIGNED)) AS average_income, COUNT(*) AS total_individuals, SUM(fi.hours_per_week) AS total_hours_per_week, AVG(fi.final_weight) AS average_final_weight FROM FilteredIndividuals AS fi GROUP BY fi.education_category), RankedEducationStats AS (SELECT es.education_category, es.average_income, es.total_individuals, es.total_hours_per_week, es.average_final_weight, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY es.average_income DESC) AS income_rank FROM EducationStats AS es) SELECT res.education_category, res.average_income, res.total_individuals, res.total_hours_per_week, res.average_final_weight, res.income_rank FROM RankedEducationStats AS res ORDER BY res.income_rank

WITH ExamShiftCounts AS (SELECT exam_id, COUNT(shift_id) AS shift_count FROM exam_shifts GROUP BY exam_id HAVING COUNT(shift_id) > 1), ClassAverageScores AS (SELECT e.exam_id, s.class_id, AVG(er.score) AS average_score FROM exams AS e JOIN students AS s ON LOCATE(s.class_id, e.class_ids) > 0 JOIN exam_results AS er ON e.exam_id = er.exam_id AND s.student_id = er.student_id WHERE e.exam_id IN (SELECT exam_id FROM ExamShiftCounts) GROUP BY e.exam_id, s.class_id) SELECT cas.exam_id, cas.class_id, cas.average_score, t.teacher_name FROM ClassAverageScores AS cas JOIN classes AS c ON cas.class_id = c.class_id JOIN teachers AS t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id ORDER BY cas.exam_id, cas.class_id

WITH InterviewCounts AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.post_title, COUNT(i.interview_id) AS interview_count FROM job_postings AS j LEFT JOIN applications AS a ON j.job_id = a.job_id LEFT JOIN interviews AS i ON a.application_id = i.application_id GROUP BY j.job_id, j.post_title), OfferCounts AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.post_title, COUNT(o.offer_id) AS offer_count FROM job_postings AS j LEFT JOIN applications AS a ON j.job_id = a.job_id LEFT JOIN job_offers AS o ON a.application_id = o.application_id GROUP BY j.job_id, j.post_title), AverageSalaries AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.post_title, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(o.salary_offered, 1, LOCATE(' ', o.salary_offered) - 1), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS average_salary FROM job_postings AS j LEFT JOIN applications AS a ON j.job_id = a.job_id LEFT JOIN job_offers AS o ON a.application_id = o.application_id GROUP BY j.job_id, j.post_title) SELECT ic.post_title, ic.interview_count, oc.offer_count, asl.average_salary, (CASE WHEN ic.interview_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(oc.offer_count AS FLOAT) / ic.interview_count END) AS offer_rate, j.salary_range, j.number_of_vacancies, j.location, j.last_date FROM InterviewCounts AS ic JOIN OfferCounts AS oc ON ic.job_id = oc.job_id JOIN AverageSalaries AS asl ON ic.job_id = asl.job_id JOIN job_postings AS j ON ic.job_id = j.job_id ORDER BY offer_rate DESC, interview_count DESC

WITH GenresPerMovie AS (SELECT mg.movie_id, COUNT(mg.genre_id) AS genre_count FROM movie_genres AS mg GROUP BY mg.movie_id), AverageRatings AS (SELECT r.movie_id, AVG(CAST(r.rating AS FLOAT)) AS average_rating FROM ratings AS r GROUP BY r.movie_id), ReviewCounts AS (SELECT rv.movie_id, COUNT(rv.review_id) AS review_count FROM reviews AS rv GROUP BY rv.movie_id), WatchlistCounts AS (SELECT wl.movie_id, COUNT(wl.watchlist_id) AS watchlist_count FROM watchlists AS wl GROUP BY wl.movie_id), MovieGenres AS (SELECT mg.movie_id, GROUP_CONCAT(g.genre_name SEPARATOR ',') AS genres FROM movie_genres AS mg JOIN genres AS g ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY mg.movie_id) SELECT m.movie_id, m.name, mg.genres, m.release_date, ar.average_rating, rc.review_count, wc.watchlist_count FROM movies AS m JOIN GenresPerMovie AS gpm ON m.movie_id = gpm.movie_id JOIN AverageRatings AS ar ON m.movie_id = ar.movie_id JOIN ReviewCounts AS rc ON m.movie_id = rc.movie_id JOIN WatchlistCounts AS wc ON m.movie_id = wc.movie_id JOIN MovieGenres AS mg ON m.movie_id = mg.movie_id ORDER BY ar.average_rating DESC, gpm.genre_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT r.register_id FROM registers AS r JOIN register_access AS ra ON r.register_id = ra.register_id JOIN users AS u ON ra.user_id = u.user_id JOIN user_privileges AS up ON u.user_id = up.user_id JOIN privileges AS p ON up.privilege_id = p.privilege_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.last_modified AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' AND p.privilege_name = 'Non-Privileged'

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(cd.call_duration) AS total_call_duration FROM customers AS c JOIN call_details AS cd ON c.customer_id = cd.customer_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(cd.call_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_call_duration DESC LIMIT 10

WITH SafetyProgramsWithCrashes AS (SELECT tsp.program_id, tsp.program_name, COUNT(cd.crash_id) AS total_crashes, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(cd.speed_of_vehicles, 1, LOCATE(' ', cd.speed_of_vehicles) - 1) AS FLOAT)) AS avg_speed_of_vehicles FROM traffic_safety_programs AS tsp LEFT JOIN crash_data AS cd ON cd.crash_date BETWEEN tsp.start_date AND tsp.end_date GROUP BY tsp.program_id, tsp.program_name) SELECT spc.program_name, spc.total_crashes, spc.avg_speed_of_vehicles FROM SafetyProgramsWithCrashes AS spc ORDER BY spc.total_crashes DESC

SELECT b.recipient_name, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(b.amount_assisted, ',', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_assistance FROM businesses AS b JOIN cbsa AS c ON b.cbsa = c.cbsa_code WHERE c.cbsa_code = '17980' AND b.establishment_year < 2000 AND b.jobs_created > 50 GROUP BY b.business_id, b.recipient_name ORDER BY total_assistance DESC

WITH UserActivity AS (SELECT ut.team_id, u.user_id, u.username, COUNT(ual.log_id) AS activity_count FROM user_teams AS ut JOIN users AS u ON ut.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_activity_logs AS ual ON u.user_id = ual.user_id GROUP BY ut.team_id, u.user_id, u.username), RankedUsers AS (SELECT team_id, user_id, username, activity_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY activity_count DESC) AS activity_rank FROM UserActivity) SELECT t.team_name, GROUP_CONCAT(ru.username SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_10_users FROM RankedUsers AS ru JOIN teams AS t ON ru.team_id = t.team_id WHERE ru.activity_rank <= 10 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name

SELECT a.airport_name, COUNT(fs.schedule_id) AS total_scheduled_flights FROM airports AS a INNER JOIN flight_schedules AS fs ON a.airport_id = fs.airport_id INNER JOIN maintenance_records AS mr ON a.airport_id = mr.airport_id WHERE a.airport_country = 'USA' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(mr.maintenance_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY a.airport_name HAVING COUNT(fs.schedule_id) > 10

SELECT m.station_name, CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(e.time AS DATETIME), '%H') BETWEEN '06' AND '11' THEN 'Morning' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(e.time AS DATETIME), '%H') BETWEEN '12' AND '17' THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(e.time AS DATETIME), '%H') BETWEEN '18' AND '23' THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Night' END AS time_of_day, AVG(e.solar_irradiation_w_m2) AS avg_solar_irradiation, AVG(e.electricity_demand_kw) AS avg_electricity_demand FROM environmental_data AS e INNER JOIN monitoring_stations AS m ON e.station_id = m.station_id INNER JOIN locations AS l ON m.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.geographic_area = 'urban' GROUP BY m.station_name, time_of_day ORDER BY m.station_name, time_of_day

WITH TestRunDetails AS (SELECT tr.run_id, tr.run_number, tr.test_scenario_id, tr.success_rate, tr.test_run_status FROM test_runs AS tr), ScenarioPerformance AS (SELECT trd.test_scenario_id, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(success_rate, 1, LOCATE('%', success_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT)) AS avg_success_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN test_run_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tests_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(success_rate, 1, LOCATE('%', success_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT)) DESC, COUNT(CASE WHEN test_run_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) DESC) AS scenario_rank FROM TestRunDetails AS trd GROUP BY trd.test_scenario_id), TopScenarios AS (SELECT tsp.test_scenario_id, tsp.avg_success_rate, tsp.completed_tests_count FROM ScenarioPerformance AS tsp WHERE tsp.scenario_rank <= 10) SELECT ts.test_scenario_id, ts.avg_success_rate, ts.completed_tests_count FROM TopScenarios AS ts ORDER BY ts.avg_success_rate DESC, ts.completed_tests_count DESC

SELECT SUM(ps.goals) AS total_goals FROM players AS p JOIN player_statistics AS ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id JOIN match_results AS mr ON ps.match_id = mr.match_id WHERE p.team_id = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(mr.match_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y')

WITH LatestNetworkMetrics AS (SELECT metric_id, network_id, nodes, isolates, edges, self_loops, degree, max_degree, density, distance, max_distance, clustering, latency, packet_loss, jitter, fnm.isolates, fnm.edges, fnm.self_loops, fnm.degree, fnm.max_degree, fnm.density, fnm.distance, fnm.max_distance, fnm.clustering, fnm.latency AS network_latency, fnm.packet_loss AS network_packet_loss, fnm.jitter AS network_jitter, fnm.bandwidth_utilization, fnm.error_rate, fnm.timestamp, fns.node_id, fns.node_name, fns.status AS node_status, fns.last_updated AS node_last_updated, fes.edge_id, fes.source_node_id, fes.target_node_id, fes.status AS edge_status, fes.last_updated AS edge_last_updated, fes.bandwidth, fes.latency, fes.packet_loss, fes.jitter FROM FilteredNetworkMetrics AS fnm JOIN FilteredNodeStatus AS fns ON fnm.network_id = 1 AND fns.node_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM network_nodes) JOIN FilteredEdgeStatus AS fes ON fns.node_id = fes.source_node_id WHERE fnm.network_id = 1), ConditionFilteredData AS (SELECT cd.*, CASE WHEN cd.node_status = 'active' AND cd.edge_status = 'active' THEN 'Critical' WHEN cd.node_status = 'inactive' OR cd.edge_status = 'inactive' THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Error' END AS `condition` FROM CombinedData AS cd) SELECT metric_id, network_latency, network_packet_loss, network_jitter, bandwidth_utilization, bandwidth_utilization, error_rate, timestamp

SELECT c.city, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN `usage` AS u ON c.customer_id = u.customer_id INNER JOIN services AS s ON u.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN churn AS ch ON c.customer_id = ch.customer_id WHERE s.service_name = 'Internet' AND (ch.has_churned = 0 OR ch.has_churned IS NULL) GROUP BY c.city HAVING SUM(u.usage_amount) > 500 ORDER BY total_usage DESC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_tech_companies, SUM(CASE WHEN c.mental_health_policy = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_companies_with_mental_health_policy, AVG(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' THEN CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(c.no_employees, 1, LOCATE('-', c.no_employees) - 1), ',', '') AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS average_employees_in_tech_companies, AVG(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' THEN e.age ELSE NULL END) AS average_age_in_tech_companies, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' AND c.mental_health_policy = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_tech_companies_with_mental_health_policy, AVG(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' AND c.mental_health_policy = 'Yes' THEN md.anxiety_level ELSE NULL END) AS average_anxiety_level_in_tech_companies_with_mental_health_policy FROM companies AS c LEFT JOIN employees AS e ON c.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN mental_health_data AS md ON e.employee_id = md.employee_id

WITH UserAccessCTE AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count FROM access_logs GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), VideoDurationCTE AS (SELECT video_id, video_name FROM videos WHERE duration > 3600), ObjectWithHeightCTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT v.video_id, v.video_name FROM videos AS v JOIN frames AS f ON v.video_id = f.video_id JOIN objects AS o ON f.frame_id = o.frame_id JOIN object_features AS `of` ON o.object_id = `of`.object_id WHERE `of`.feature_name = 'height' AND `of`.feature_value > 150), AnnotatedFramesCTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT v.video_id, v.video_name FROM videos AS v JOIN frames AS f ON v.video_id = f.video_id JOIN frame_annotations AS fa ON f.frame_id = fa.frame_id WHERE fa.annotation = 'Car''s license plate') SELECT DISTINCT vd.video_name FROM VideoDurationCTE AS vd JOIN ObjectWithHeightCTE AS oh ON vd.video_id = oh.video_id JOIN AnnotatedFramesCTE AS af ON vd.video_id = af.video_id JOIN access_logs AS al ON vd.video_id = al.video_id JOIN UserAccessCTE AS uac ON al.user_id = uac.user_id

WITH TransactionTaxes AS (SELECT tr.transaction_id, SUM(CAST(tr.amount AS FLOAT)) AS total_tax_paid FROM tax_records AS tr GROUP BY tr.transaction_id), TransactionDetails AS (SELECT t.transaction_id, t.hscode, t.entity_id, t.quantity, t.transaction_date, t.total_value, t.transaction_type, t.origin_country, t.destination_country, t.currency, t.status, COALESCE(tt.total_tax_paid, 0) AS total_tax_paid FROM trade_transactions AS t LEFT JOIN TransactionTaxes AS tt ON t.transaction_id = tt.transaction_id), CommodityDetails AS (SELECT td.transaction_id, td.hscode, td.entity_id, td.quantity, td.transaction_date, td.total_value, td.transaction_type, td.origin_country, td.destination_country, td.currency, td.status, td.total_tax_paid, c.description, c.country_of_origin, c.trade_category, c.unit_of_measure FROM TransactionDetails AS td JOIN commodities AS c ON td.hscode = c.hscode), CountryAnalysis AS (SELECT cd.origin_country, cd.destination_country, cd.hscode, SUM(CAST(cd.quantity AS SIGNED)) AS total_quantity, SUM(CAST(cd.total_value AS FLOAT)) AS total_value, SUM(cd.total_tax_paid) AS total_tax_paid FROM CommodityDetails AS cd GROUP BY cd.origin_country, cd.destination_country, cd.hscode), EffectiveTaxRates AS (SELECT ca.origin_country, ca.destination_country, ca.hscode, ca.total_quantity, ca.total_value, ca.total_tax_paid, (ca.total_tax_paid / ca.total_value) * 100 AS effective_tax_rate FROM CountryAnalysis AS ca WHERE ca.total_value > 0) SELECT etr.origin_country, etr.destination_country, etr.hscode, etr.total_quantity, etr.total_value, etr.total_tax_paid, etr.effective_tax_rate FROM EffectiveTaxRates AS etr ORDER BY etr.origin_country

SELECT `cases`.`province`, `cases`.`country`, `cases`.`last_update`, `cases`.`confirmed`, `cases`.`deaths`, `cases`.`recovered`, `cases`.`travel_history`, `cases`.`is_vaccinated`, `cases`.`vaccination_date`, `cases`.`vaccination_type`, `provinces`.`province_name`, `provinces`.`population_density`, `provinces`.`iso_code` FROM `cases` INNER JOIN `provinces` ON `cases`.`province` = `provinces`.`province_name` WHERE `cases`.`age` > 65 ORDER BY `cases`.`last_update` DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT v.name AS vulnerability_name, s.severity_name AS severity, i.impact_name AS impact, COUNT(p.patch_id) AS patch_count, GROUP_CONCAT(pv.affected_product_version SEPARATOR ', ') AS affected_products FROM vulnerabilities AS v JOIN severity_levels AS s ON v.severity_id = s.severity_id JOIN impact_assessments AS i ON v.impact_id = i.impact_id LEFT JOIN patches AS p ON v.vuln_id = p.vuln_id JOIN product_vulnerabilities AS pv ON v.vuln_id = pv.vuln_id WHERE s.severity_name IN ('Critical', 'High') AND i.impact_name IN ('Total', 'High') GROUP BY v.name, s.severity_name, i.impact_name ORDER BY s.severity_name DESC, i.impact_name DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM alerts WHERE user_id = 1 AND `condition` = 'price below 20' AND triggered_at BETWEEN '2008-03-18 00:00:00' AND '2008-03-20 23:59:59'

WITH SharedDatasets AS (SELECT ds.dataset_id, ds.name AS dataset_name, ds.version AS latest_version, COUNT(ds_sh.share_id) AS share_count, MAX(ds_sh.shared_date) AS last_shared_date FROM datasets AS ds JOIN dataset_sharing AS ds_sh ON ds.dataset_id = ds_sh.dataset_id GROUP BY ds.dataset_id, ds.name, ds.version HAVING COUNT(ds_sh.share_id) > 1), UserDetails AS (SELECT ds_sh.user_id, ud.name AS user_name FROM dataset_sharing AS ds_sh JOIN users AS ud ON ds_sh.user_id = ud.user_id) SELECT sd.dataset_name, sd.latest_version, GROUP_CONCAT(ud.user_name SEPARATOR ',') AS sharers, sd.share_count, sd.last_shared_date FROM SharedDatasets AS sd JOIN UserDetails AS ud ON sd.dataset_id = (SELECT ds_sh.dataset_id FROM dataset_sharing AS ds_sh WHERE ds_sh.user_id = ud.user_id AND ds_sh.shared_date = sd.last_shared_date) GROUP BY sd.dataset_name, sd.latest_version, sd.share_count, sd.last_shared_date ORDER BY sd.last_shared_date DESC

WITH AvgSalariesPerTeamSeason AS (SELECT p.team, s.season_name, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.salary, '$', ''), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS avg_salary FROM players AS p JOIN seasons AS s ON p.draft_year BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(s.start_date, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) - 1 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(s.end_date, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) GROUP BY p.team, s.season_name), TopPlayers AS (SELECT p.player_name, p.team, s.season_name, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.salary, '$', ''), ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS player_avg_salary FROM players AS p JOIN seasons AS s ON p.draft_year BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(s.start_date, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) - 1 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(s.end_date, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) GROUP BY p.player_name, p.team, s.season_name) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.team, tp.season_name FROM TopPlayers AS tp JOIN AvgSalariesPerTeamSeason AS ats ON tp.team = ats.team AND tp.season_name = ats.season_name WHERE tp.player_avg_salary = ats.avg_salary ORDER BY tp.season_name, tp.team

SELECT v.variable_name, AVG(LENGTH(v.description)) AS avg_description_length FROM variables AS v JOIN datasets AS d ON LOCATE(v.variable_name, d.variables) > 0 GROUP BY v.variable_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.dataset_id) >= 2 AND AVG(LENGTH(v.description)) > (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(description)) FROM variables)

SELECT f.file_name, u.user_name AS owner_name, g.group_name AS group_name, COUNT(fp.permission_id) AS write_permission_count FROM files AS f INNER JOIN users AS u ON f.owner_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN `groups` AS g ON f.group_id = g.group_id INNER JOIN file_permissions AS fp ON f.file_id = fp.file_id WHERE f.is_read_only = 0 AND fp.write_permission = 1 GROUP BY f.file_id, f.file_name, u.user_name, g.group_name HAVING COUNT(fp.permission_id) >= 1

SELECT ds.dataset_name, ds.start_date, ds.end_date, ds.climo_available, ds.description AS dataset_description, ds.spatial_resolution, ds.temporal_resolution, ds.update_frequency, al.user_id, al.access_date, dv.version_number, dv.release_date AS version_release_date, dv.description AS version_description, v.variable_name, v.description AS variable_description, v.unit FROM datasets AS ds INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON ds.dataset_id = al.dataset_id INNER JOIN dataset_versions AS dv ON ds.dataset_id = dv.dataset_id CROSS JOIN variables AS v WHERE al.access_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND LOCATE(v.variable_name, ds.variables) > 0

WITH TopicStats AS (SELECT rt.topic_id, rt.topic_name, COALESCE(SUM(c.score_value), 0) AS total_concept_score, COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS distinct_users, COALESCE(SUM(p.citation_count), 0) AS total_citations, rt.publications_by_all_authors FROM research_topics AS rt LEFT JOIN concept_scores AS c ON rt.topic_id = c.topic_id LEFT JOIN publications AS p ON rt.topic_id = p.topic_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON rt.topic_id = al.topic_id GROUP BY rt.topic_id, rt.topic_name, rt.publications_by_all_authors), FinalMetric AS (SELECT ts.topic_id, ts.topic_name, (ts.total_concept_score * ts.total_citations) / (ts.publications_by_all_authors * COALESCE(ts.distinct_users, 1)) AS normalized_metric FROM TopicStats AS ts) SELECT fm.topic_id, fm.topic_name, fm.normalized_metric FROM FinalMetric AS fm ORDER BY fm.normalized_metric DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM add_to_carts WHERE product_id = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(atc_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') = '2023-01'

WITH ChurnedCustomers AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ch.churn_date FROM customers AS c JOIN churn AS ch ON c.customer_id = ch.customer_id WHERE ch.has_churned = 1), TotalDataUsage AS (SELECT u.customer_id, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_data_used FROM `usage` AS u JOIN ChurnedCustomers AS cc ON u.customer_id = cc.customer_id WHERE u.usage_date < cc.churn_date GROUP BY u.customer_id), TotalPayments AS (SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_amount_paid FROM payments AS p JOIN ChurnedCustomers AS cc ON p.customer_id = cc.customer_id WHERE p.payment_date < cc.churn_date GROUP BY p.customer_id) SELECT CONCAT(cc.first_name, ' ', cc.last_name) AS customer_name, COALESCE(tdu.total_data_used, 0) AS total_data_used, COALESCE(tp.total_amount_paid, 0) AS total_amount_paid FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cc LEFT JOIN TotalDataUsage AS tdu ON cc.customer_id = tdu.customer_id LEFT JOIN TotalPayments AS tp ON cc.customer_id = tp.customer_id ORDER BY cc.churn_date DESC

WITH ViewInteraction AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(view_id) AS view_count, SUM(duration) AS total_view_duration FROM views GROUP BY product_id), ClickInteraction AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(click_id) AS click_count, SUM(duration) AS total_click_duration FROM clicks GROUP BY product_id), InteractionScore AS (SELECT v.product_id, COALESCE(v.view_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.click_count, 0) AS interaction_score, COALESCE(v.total_view_duration, 0) + COALESCE(c.total_click_duration, 0) AS total_interaction_duration FROM ViewInteraction AS v LEFT OUTER JOIN ClickInteraction AS c ON v.product_id = c.product_id UNION ALL SELECT v.product_id, COALESCE(v.view_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.click_count, 0) AS interaction_score, COALESCE(v.total_view_duration, 0) + COALESCE(c.total_click_duration, 0) AS total_interaction_duration FROM ViewInteraction AS v RIGHT OUTER JOIN ClickInteraction AS c ON v.product_id = c.product_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ViewInteraction AS v WHERE v.product_id = c.product_id)) SELECT p.product_name, i.interaction_score, i.total_interaction_duration FROM InteractionScore AS i JOIN products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY i.interaction_score DESC LIMIT 5

WITH SpacecraftTypesCTE AS (SELECT sc.spacecraft_id, sc.spacecraft_name, st.spacecraft_type_name, st.description AS type_description, st.max_capacity, st.max_charge_level, st.maintenance_interval FROM spacecrafts AS sc JOIN spacecraft_types AS st ON sc.spacecraft_type = st.spacecraft_type_id), LocationCTE AS (SELECT sc.spacecraft_id, l.location_name, l.coordinates, l.environmental_conditions FROM spacecrafts AS sc JOIN locations AS l ON sc.location_id = l.location_id), ResourceCTE AS (SELECT sc.spacecraft_id, r.resource_id, r.resource_name, r.capacity, r.charge, r.last_charge_date, r.next_charge_due, r.critical_threshold, rt.resource_type_name, rt.critical_threshold AS type_critical_threshold FROM spacecrafts AS sc JOIN resources AS r ON sc.spacecraft_id = r.spacecraft_id JOIN resource_types AS rt ON r.resource_type_id = rt.resource_type_id), AccessLogsCTE AS (SELECT a.spacecraft_id, u.user_name AS access_user, a.access_date, a.access_type, a.access_time, a.ip_address, a.device_info FROM access_logs AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id), MaintenanceLogsCTE AS (SELECT m.spacecraft_id, u.user_name AS maintenance_performed_by, m.maintenance_date, m.description AS maintenance_description, m.maintenance_type, m.maintenance_duration, m.maintenance_cost FROM maintenance_logs AS m JOIN users AS u ON m.performed_by = u.user_id), CombinedDataCTE AS (SELECT st.spacecraft_id, st.spacecraft_name, st.spacecraft_type_name, st.type_description, st.max_capacity, st.max_charge_level, st.maintenance_interval, l.location_name, l.coordinates, l.environmental_conditions, r.resource_name, r.capacity, r.charge, r.last_charge_date, r.next_charge_due, r.critical_threshold, r.type_critical_threshold, a.access_user, a.access_date, a.access_type, a.access_time, a.ip_address, a.device_info, m.maintenance_performed_by, m.maintenance_date, m.maintenance_description, m.maintenance_type, m.maintenance_duration, m.maintenance_cost FROM SpacecraftTypesCTE AS st JOIN LocationCTE AS l ON st.spacecraft_id = l.spacecraft_id JOIN ResourceCTE AS r ON st.spacecraft_id = r.spacecraft_id LEFT JOIN AccessLogsCTE AS a ON st.spacecraft_id = a.spacecraft_id LEFT JOIN MaintenanceLogsCTE AS m ON st.spacecraft_id = m.spacecraft_id) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(spacecraft_name, ' - ', spacecraft_type_name, ' - ', location_name, ' - ', resource_name, ' - ', access_user, ' - ', maintenance_performed_by, ' - ', maintenance_description, ' - ', maintenance_cost) SEPARATOR ',') AS detailed_report FROM CombinedDataCTE

SELECT COUNT(ar.access_request_id) AS pending_requests_count FROM access_requests AS ar JOIN access_types AS at ON ar.access_type_id = at.access_type_id JOIN `databases` AS db ON ar.database_id = db.database_id WHERE db.database_name = 'Database 1' AND at.access_type_name = 'Admin Console' AND ar.status = 'pending'

SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(vp.vulnerability_id) AS num_vulnerabilities FROM products AS p INNER JOIN vulnerability_products AS vp ON p.product_id = vp.product_id INNER JOIN vulnerabilities AS v ON vp.vulnerability_id = v.vulnerability_id WHERE p.vendor = 'Microsoft' AND v.severity = 'Critical' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(v.cvss_score, 1, LOCATE('/', v.cvss_score) - 1) AS FLOAT) > 7.0 GROUP BY p.product_name HAVING COUNT(vp.vulnerability_id) > 2

SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS equipment_count, AVG(current_value) AS average_current_value, MAX(current_value) AS max_current_value, MIN(current_value) AS min_current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'in repair' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_repair_count FROM marine_equipment WHERE acquisition_date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND `condition` IN ('A', 'B') AND federal_participation = 100.0 GROUP BY manufacturer HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY average_current_value DESC

WITH customer_policy_details AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(p.policy_id) AS count_policies, MAX(p.policy_coverage_limit) AS max_coverage_limit FROM customers AS c JOIN policies AS p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE c.customer_age BETWEEN 26 AND 34 AND c.customer_gender_male = 1 GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_name, LEAST(count_policies, max_coverage_limit) AS score FROM customers AS c JOIN customer_policy_details AS cpd ON c.customer_id = cpd.customer_id ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 1

WITH GeneRatiosCTE AS (SELECT g.gene_id, g.gene_name, s.species_name, d.dn_ds_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.gene_id ORDER BY d.dn_ds_ratio DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM genes AS g JOIN dn_ds_ratios AS d ON g.gene_id = d.gene_id JOIN species AS s ON d.species_id = s.species_id), GenesTreesCTE AS (SELECT gt.tree_id, g.gene_id, g.gene_name, s.species_name, gt.tree_data, LOCATE('ELAVL4', gt.tree_data) AS elavl4_position FROM gene_trees AS gt JOIN genes AS g ON gt.gene_id = g.gene_id JOIN species AS s ON gt.species_id = s.species_id) SELECT gr.gene_name, gr.species_name, gr.dn_ds_ratio, gt.tree_id, gt.tree_data FROM GeneRatiosCTE AS gr JOIN GenesTreesCTE AS gt ON gr.gene_id = gt.gene_id AND gr.species_name = gt.species_name WHERE gr.ratio_rank = 1 AND gt.elavl4_position > 0
SELECT pin_name, `signal` FROM gpio_pins WHERE gpio_mode = 'Alternate Function Push Pull' ORDER BY pin_name ASC

SELECT c.country_name, AVG(fs.guns_per_100_inhabitants) AS avg_guns_per_100_inhabitants FROM countries AS c INNER JOIN firearm_statistics AS fs ON c.country_id = fs.country_id INNER JOIN population_data AS pd ON c.country_id = pd.country_id AND fs.year = pd.year WHERE CAST(pd.population AS SIGNED) > 10000000 GROUP BY c.country_name HAVING SUM(fs.number_of_mass_shootings) > 0 ORDER BY avg_guns_per_100_inhabitants DESC

WITH MovieStats AS (SELECT m.movie_id, m.name AS movie_name, m.directed_by AS director, AVG(CAST(r.rating AS FLOAT)) AS average_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews, COUNT(w.watchlist_id) AS total_watchlists FROM movies AS m LEFT JOIN reviews AS r ON m.movie_id = r.movie_id LEFT JOIN watchlists AS w ON m.movie_id = w.movie_id GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.name, m.directed_by), GenreDetails AS (SELECT mg.movie_id, GROUP_CONCAT(g.genre_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS genres FROM movie_genres AS mg JOIN genres AS g ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY mg.movie_id), DirectorNames AS (SELECT m.movie_id, d.director_name AS director FROM movies AS m JOIN directors AS d ON m.directed_by = d.director_name) SELECT ms.movie_name, dn.director, gd.genres, ms.average_rating, ms.total_reviews, ms.total_watchlists FROM MovieStats AS ms JOIN GenreDetails AS gd ON ms.movie_id = gd.movie_id JOIN DirectorNames AS dn ON ms.movie_id = dn.movie_id ORDER BY ms.movie_name, dn.director, gd.genres

WITH UserCurrencyAssociation AS (SELECT u.user_id, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(u.email, LOCATE('@', u.email) + 1) LIKE '%com%' THEN 'USD' WHEN SUBSTRING(u.email, LOCATE('@', u.email) + 1) LIKE '%eu%' THEN 'EUR' ELSE 'USD' END AS currency_code FROM users AS u), AccessLogsWithCurrency AS (SELECT al.user_id, al.instrument_id, al.access_date, uca.currency_code FROM access_logs AS al JOIN UserCurrencyAssociation AS uca ON uca.user_id = al.user_id), AccessSummary AS (SELECT acl.currency_code, acl.access_date, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY acl.currency_code ORDER BY acl.access_date) AS cumulative_access_count FROM AccessLogsWithCurrency AS acl) SELECT currency_code, access_date, cumulative_access_count FROM AccessSummary ORDER BY currency_code, access_date

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, AVG(cp.customer_engagement) AS avg_customer_engagement, AVG(cp.sales_volume) AS avg_sales_volume FROM product_categories AS pc INNER JOIN category_performance AS cp ON pc.category_id = cp.category_id INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON pc.category_id = al.category_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.role = 'admin' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(al.access_time AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY pc.name HAVING AVG(cp.customer_engagement) > 300 ORDER BY avg_customer_engagement DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.product_id) AS unique_products FROM `databases` AS d JOIN database_updates AS du ON d.database_id = du.database_id

SELECT sp.product_name, COALESCE((SELECT du.description FROM database_updates AS du INNER JOIN `databases` AS d ON du.database_id = d.database_id WHERE d.product_id = sp.product_id ORDER BY du.update_date DESC LIMIT 1), 'No Updates Found') AS latest_update_description FROM software_products AS sp WHERE sp.development_status = 'released' ORDER BY sp.product_name

SELECT d.department_name, AVG(lb.remaining) AS avg_leave_balance FROM employees AS e INNER JOIN departments AS d ON e.department_id = d.department_id INNER JOIN leave_balances AS lb ON e.employee_id = lb.employee_id WHERE lb.year = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING COUNT(e.employee_id) > 1

WITH ActiveDBMS AS (SELECT dbms_id, name AS dbms_name, CASE WHEN dbms_model_id = (SELECT dbms_model_id FROM dbms_models WHERE name = 'relational') THEN 'Relational' WHEN dbms_model_id = (SELECT dbms_model_id FROM dbms_models WHERE name = 'document') THEN 'Document' ELSE 'Other' END AS dbms_type FROM dbms WHERE cloud_based_only = 0), DetailedReleases AS (SELECT dbms_id, release_date, version, CASE WHEN is_major_release = 1 THEN 'Major' ELSE 'Minor' END AS release_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dbms_id) AS release_count FROM dbms_releases WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-01-01'), UserPermissions AS (SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, GROUP_CONCAT(p.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS permissions FROM users AS u JOIN user_role_mappings AS urm ON u.user_id = urm.user_id JOIN role_permission_mappings AS rpm ON urm.role_id = rpm.role_id JOIN user_permissions AS p ON rpm.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE u.is_active = 1 GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role), UserWithDBMS AS (SELECT up.user_id, up.user_name, up.role, up.permissions, a.dbms_name, a.dbms_type, dr.release_type, dr.version, dr.release_date FROM UserPermissions AS up JOIN ActiveDBMS AS a ON up.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM dbms WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', a.dbms_name, '%')) LEFT JOIN DetailedReleases AS dr ON a.dbms_id = dr.dbms_id AND dr.release_date = (SELECT MAX(release_date) FROM dbms_releases WHERE dbms_id = dr.dbms_id)) SELECT DISTINCT uwdb.user_name, uwdb.role, uwdb.permissions, uwdb.dbms_name, uwdb.dbms_type, uwdb.release_type, uwdb.version, uwdb.release_date, SUM(CASE WHEN uwdb.release_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY uwdb.user_id) AS recent_releases_count FROM UserWithDBMS AS uwdb ORDER BY uwdb.user_name, uwdb.release_date DESC

WITH MaintenanceImpact AS (SELECT ep.panel_id, ep.timestamp, m.maintenance_status, ep.power_out, ep.power_usage, ((ep.power_out - ep.power_usage) / ep.power_out * 100) AS efficiency_percentage FROM energy_production AS ep LEFT JOIN maintenance AS m ON ep.timestamp >= m.timestamp AND ep.panel_id = m.panel_id WHERE ep.panel_id = 0) SELECT CASE WHEN maintenance_status = 'completed' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS maintenance_completed, AVG(efficiency_percentage) AS avg_efficiency FROM MaintenanceImpact GROUP BY maintenance_completed ORDER BY maintenance_completed

WITH top_actors AS (SELECT c.content_id, c.title, TRIM(LEADING '[]' FROM RTRIM(c.cast)) AS cleaned_cast, SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(TRIM(LEADING '[]' FROM RTRIM(c.cast)), 1, LOCATE(',', TRIM(LEADING '[]' FROM RTRIM(c.cast))) - 1), 2) AS top_actor, g.genre_name, c.rating, c.runtime, c.release_year FROM content AS c INNER JOIN content_genres AS cg ON c.content_id = cg.content_id INNER JOIN genres AS g ON cg.genre_id = g.genre_id INNER JOIN content_tags AS ct ON c.content_id = ct.content_id INNER JOIN content_ratings AS cr ON c.content_id = cr.content_id WHERE g.genre_name IN ('Comedy', 'Drama') AND ct.tag_name IN ('80s', '90s') AND cr.rating_score > 7.0), filtered_content AS (SELECT ta.*, LAG(ta.top_actor) OVER (PARTITION BY ta.genre_name ORDER BY ta.rating DESC) AS previous_top_actor FROM top_actors AS ta), unique_top_actors AS (SELECT f.content_id, f.top_actor, f.genre_name, f.rating, f.runtime, f.release_year FROM filtered_content AS f WHERE f.top_actor <> f.previous_top_actor OR f.previous_top_actor IS NULL) SELECT LOWER(uta.top_actor) AS top_actor, uta.genre_name, AVG(uta.rating) OVER (PARTITION BY uta.genre_name) AS genre_avg_rating, uta.runtime, uta.release_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY uta.top_actor) AS actor_appearances FROM unique_top_actors AS uta ORDER BY uta.rating DESC

WITH TopRankedTeams AS (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE `rank` <= 3), UserActivity AS (SELECT al.user_id, al.access_date, SUBSTRING(u.user_name, 1, 15) AS short_user_name, al.duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY al.team_id ORDER BY al.duration DESC) AS activity_rank FROM access_logs AS al JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id JOIN TopRankedTeams AS trt ON al.team_id = trt.team_id) SELECT access_date, short_user_name FROM UserActivity WHERE activity_rank <= 3 ORDER BY access_date DESC, activity_rank

SELECT DISTINCT features.feature_name FROM editions JOIN edition_features ON editions.edition_id = edition_features.edition_id JOIN features ON edition_features.feature_id = features.feature_id WHERE editions.is_popular = 1 AND edition_features.is_available = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comparisons WHERE selected_editions LIKE CONCAT('%,', editions.edition_id, ',%') OR selected_editions LIKE CONCAT(editions.edition_id, ',%') OR selected_editions LIKE CONCAT('%,', editions.edition_id) OR selected_editions = CAST(editions.edition_id AS CHAR)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users JOIN user_roles ON users.role = user_roles.role_name WHERE user_roles.permissions LIKE '%can_make_recommendations%')

SELECT u.user_name, AVG(al.access_duration) AS avg_access_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT c.conversation_id) AS num_conversations, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.conversation_type SEPARATOR ',') AS conversation_types FROM users AS u INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON u.user_id = al.user_id INNER JOIN conversations AS c ON al.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE u.role_id = 1 AND al.access_type IN ('download', 'edit') AND al.access_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31' GROUP BY u.user_name HAVING AVG(al.access_duration) > 60 ORDER BY avg_access_duration DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(pc.contract_start AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS season, SUM(pc.salary) AS total_salary_per_season FROM player_contract AS pc JOIN players AS p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.team_id = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(pc.contract_start AS DATETIME), '%Y') HAVING SUM(pc.salary) > 0

SELECT customer_id, service_id, SUM(usage_amount) AS total_usage, MIN(usage_amount) AS min_usage, MAX(usage_amount) AS max_usage, AVG(usage_amount) AS avg_usage FROM `usage` GROUP BY customer_id, service_id ORDER BY customer_id, service_id

WITH RECURSIVE EmployeeHierarchy AS (SELECT e.employee_id, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS full_name, e.supervisor_id, e.department_id, 1 AS level FROM employees AS e WHERE e.supervisor_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.employee_id, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS full_name, e.supervisor_id, e.department_id, eh.level + 1 FROM employees AS e JOIN EmployeeHierarchy AS eh ON e.supervisor_id = eh.employee_id), CurrentPositions AS (SELECT ep.employee_id, p.position_name, p.salary_range FROM employee_positions AS ep JOIN positions AS p ON ep.position_id = p.position_id WHERE ep.end_date IS NULL), CumulativeSalaries AS (SELECT eh.employee_id, eh.full_name, eh.level, eh.department_id, cp.position_name, cp.salary_range, CAST(SUBSTRING(cp.salary_range, 2, LOCATE('-', cp.salary_range) - 3) AS FLOAT) AS salary, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(cp.salary_range, 2, LOCATE('-', cp.salary_range) - 3) AS FLOAT)) OVER (PARTITION BY eh.department_id ORDER BY eh.level, eh.full_name) AS cumulative_salary FROM EmployeeHierarchy AS eh JOIN CurrentPositions AS cp ON eh.employee_id = cp.employee_id) SELECT cs.department_id, cs.level, cs.full_name, cs.position_name, cs.salary, cs.cumulative_salary FROM CumulativeSalaries AS cs ORDER BY cs.department_id, cs.level, cs.full_name
SELECT patient_id, COUNT(treatment_id) AS total_treatments, SUM(CAST(duration AS SIGNED)) AS total_treatment_duration FROM treatments GROUP BY patient_id ORDER BY total_treatment_duration DESC

WITH ReliableData AS (SELECT f.* FROM financial_data AS f INNER JOIN data_sources AS ds ON f.data_source_id = ds.data_source_id WHERE ds.reliability_score >= 8) SELECT r.date, r.close_price, AVG(CAST(r.volume AS SIGNED)) AS average_volume, SUM(r.num_trades) AS total_trades FROM ReliableData AS r WHERE r.instrument_id = 1 AND r.date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY r.date, r.close_price HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY r.date ASC

SELECT b.name AS business_name, COUNT(i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT vt.name SEPARATOR ',') AS violation_types FROM businesses AS b JOIN inspections AS i ON b.business_id = i.business_id JOIN violations AS v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id JOIN violation_types AS vt ON v.violation_type_id = vt.violation_type_id GROUP BY b.business_id, b.name HAVING COUNT(i.inspection_id) > 0 ORDER BY total_inspections DESC

WITH DesignRevisions AS (SELECT r.revision_id, r.revision_date, u1.user_name AS created_by, u2.user_name AS approved_by FROM revisions AS r LEFT JOIN users AS u1 ON r.created_by = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN users AS u2 ON r.approved_by = u2.user_id WHERE r.design_id = 1), DesignAccessLogs AS (SELECT a.access_id, a.access_date, a.access_type, u.user_name, a.ip_address, a.user_agent FROM access_logs AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.design_id = 1), DesignPinConfigurations AS (SELECT dp.pin_id, p.pin_name, p.io_type, p.functionality, pp.notes AS pin_config_notes FROM design_pins AS dp JOIN pins AS p ON dp.pin_id = p.pin_id JOIN picture_pins AS pp ON pp.pin_id = p.pin_id WHERE dp.design_id = 1), CombinedData AS (SELECT dr.revision_id, dr.revision_date, dr.created_by, dr.approved_by, dal.access_id, dal.access_date, dal.access_type, dal.user_name AS access_user, dal.ip_address, dal.user_agent, dp.pin_id, dp.pin_name, dp.io_type, dp.functionality, dp.pin_config_notes FROM DesignRevisions AS dr LEFT JOIN DesignAccessLogs AS dal ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN DesignPinConfigurations AS dp ON 1 = 1) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(revision_id, ', ', revision_date, ', ', created_by, ', ', approved_by, ', ', access_id, ', ', access_date, ', ', access_type, ', ', access_user, ', ', ip_address, ', ', user_agent, ', ', pin_id, ', ', pin_name, ', ', io_type, ', ', functionality, ', ', pin_config_notes) SEPARATOR ',') AS detailed_report FROM CombinedData

SELECT at.attack_type_name AS attack_type, g.group_name AS terrorist_group, SUM(a.killed + a.wounded) AS total_casualties FROM attacks AS a JOIN cities AS c ON a.city_id = c.city_id JOIN `groups` AS g ON a.group_id = g.group_id JOIN attack_types AS at ON a.attack_type_id = at.attack_type_id WHERE c.city_name = 'New York City' GROUP BY at.attack_type_name, g.group_name HAVING SUM(a.killed + a.wounded) > 0

SELECT s.state_name, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(b.total_expenditure, ',', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_expenditure FROM budget_data AS b INNER JOIN states AS s ON b.state = s.abbreviation WHERE b.year = 2023 GROUP BY s.state_name HAVING SUM(CAST(REPLACE(b.total_expenditure, ',', '') AS SIGNED)) > 100000000 ORDER BY total_expenditure DESC

WITH StationHumidity AS (SELECT ed.station_id, AVG(ed.humidity) AS avg_humidity, MAX(ed.humidity) AS max_humidity FROM environmental_data AS ed WHERE ed.record_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY ed.station_id), FilteredStations AS (SELECT sh.station_id, sh.avg_humidity, sh.max_humidity FROM StationHumidity AS sh WHERE sh.max_humidity > 80) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ms.contact_person, ', ', ms.location, ', ', ms.installation_date, ', ', CAST(fs.max_humidity AS CHAR), ', ', CAST(fs.avg_humidity AS CHAR)) SEPARATOR '; ') AS station_details FROM FilteredStations AS fs JOIN monitoring_stations AS ms ON fs.station_id = ms.station_id

WITH EssentialServices AS (SELECT ss.store_id, GROUP_CONCAT(s.service_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS essential_services FROM store_services AS ss JOIN services AS s ON ss.service_id = s.service_id WHERE s.is_essential = 1 GROUP BY ss.store_id) SELECT s.name AS store_name, COALESCE(es.essential_services, 'No essential services') AS essential_services FROM stores AS s LEFT JOIN EssentialServices AS es ON s.store_id = es.store_id ORDER BY s.name

SELECT v.video_name, AVG(f.quality) AS average_frame_quality, COUNT(f.frame_id) AS total_frames, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.alert_message SEPARATOR ',') FROM alerts AS a WHERE a.video_id = v.video_id) AS alert_messages FROM videos AS v INNER JOIN frames AS f ON v.video_id = f.video_id WHERE v.video_source = 'camera' GROUP BY v.video_id, v.video_name HAVING COUNT(f.frame_id) > 0

WITH SummaryData AS (SELECT y.year_value, pc.change_value, pc.change_type, d.population, gr.growth_rate, gr.method, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count FROM population_changes AS pc JOIN demographics AS d ON pc.demographic_id = d.demographic_id JOIN years AS y ON pc.year = y.year_id LEFT JOIN growth_rates AS gr ON gr.demographic_id = d.demographic_id AND gr.year = pc.year LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON al.demographic_id = d.demographic_id GROUP BY y.year_value, pc.change_value, pc.change_type, d.population, gr.growth_rate, gr.method) SELECT CONCAT('Year: ', CAST(year_value AS CHAR), ', Change Value: ', CAST(change_value AS CHAR), ', Change Type: ', change_type, ', Population: ', CAST(population AS CHAR), ', Growth Rate: ', CAST(growth_rate AS CHAR), ', Growth Method: ', method, ', Access Count: ', CAST(access_count AS CHAR)) AS summary FROM SummaryData ORDER BY year_value

WITH high_performance_models AS (SELECT model_id FROM model_performance WHERE accuracy > 0.8 AND `precision` > 0.8), hate_speech_offensive_classifications AS (SELECT social_media_id, model_id FROM classifications WHERE (hate_speech > 0.8 OR offensive_language > 0.8)) SELECT smd.text FROM social_media_data AS smd JOIN hate_speech_offensive_classifications AS hso ON smd.id = hso.social_media_id JOIN high_performance_models AS hpm ON hso.model_id = hpm.model_id WHERE smd.platform = 'Twitter' ORDER BY smd.create_date DESC LIMIT 10

WITH AnomalyCounts AS (SELECT dd.session_id, COUNT(a.anomaly_id) AS anomaly_count, GROUP_CONCAT(a.anomaly_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS anomaly_types FROM device_data AS dd LEFT JOIN anomalies AS a ON dd.data_id = a.data_id GROUP BY dd.session_id), FilteredSessions AS (SELECT ns.session_id, d.device_name, ac.anomaly_count, ac.anomaly_types FROM network_sessions AS ns JOIN devices AS d ON ns.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN AnomalyCounts AS ac ON ns.session_id = ac.session_id WHERE ns.session_status = 'completed') SELECT fs.session_id, fs.device_name, fs.anomaly_types FROM FilteredSessions AS fs WHERE fs.anomaly_count > 0 ORDER BY fs.anomaly_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sp.product_name FROM software_products AS sp JOIN versions AS v ON sp.product_id = v.product_id JOIN `databases` AS d ON sp.product_id = d.product_id JOIN database_updates AS du ON d.database_id = du.database_id WHERE v.major_release = 1 AND du.update_date > v.release_date GROUP BY sp.product_name

WITH SchoolRushingStats AS (SELECT s.school_name, SUM(CAST(ss.stat_value AS SIGNED)) AS total_rushing_yards FROM schools AS s JOIN season_statistics AS ss ON s.school_id = ss.school_id WHERE ss.stat_name = 'total rushing yards' AND ss.season_id = 1 GROUP BY s.school_name) SELECT school_name FROM SchoolRushingStats ORDER BY total_rushing_yards DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT w.word_form, AVG(us.usage_count) AS average_usage_count, GROUP_CONCAT(te.synonym SEPARATOR ',') AS synonyms FROM words AS w INNER JOIN usage_stats AS us ON w.word_id = us.word_id LEFT JOIN thesaurus_entries AS te ON w.word_id = te.word_id WHERE us.context = 'Research' GROUP BY w.word_form HAVING AVG(us.usage_count) > 10

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS (SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category, CAST(c.category_name AS CHAR) AS full_path FROM categories AS c WHERE c.parent_category IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category, CONCAT(ch.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name) AS full_path FROM categories AS c JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON c.parent_category = ch.category_name), SalesDetails AS (SELECT sd.sale_id, sd.sale_date, ch.category_id, ch.category_name, ch.full_path, sd.maker, sd.sales_amount, sd.store_id FROM sales_data AS sd JOIN CategoryHierarchy AS ch ON sd.category1 = ch.category_name), SalesSummary AS (SELECT s.category_id, s.category_name, s.full_path, m.maker_name, s.store_id, SUM(s.sales_amount) AS total_sales FROM SalesDetails AS s JOIN makers AS m ON s.maker = m.maker_name GROUP BY s.category_id, s.category_name, s.full_path, m.maker_name, s.store_id), TopSales AS (SELECT ss.category_name, ss.full_path, ss.maker_name, ss.store_id, ss.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.category_id, ss.store_id ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM SalesSummary AS ss) SELECT ts.category_name, ts.full_path, ts.maker_name, ts.total_sales FROM TopSales AS ts WHERE ts.sales_rank = 1 ORDER BY ts.category_name, ts.store_id

SELECT a.article_id, s.source_name, GROUP_CONCAT(i.industry_name SEPARATOR ',') AS industries, COUNT(v.view_id) AS view_count FROM articles AS a JOIN sources AS s ON a.source_id = s.source_id JOIN article_industries AS ai ON a.article_id = ai.article_id JOIN industries AS i ON ai.industry_id = i.industry_id JOIN article_views AS v ON a.article_id = v.article_id GROUP BY a.article_id, s.source_name HAVING COUNT(v.view_id) > 0

WITH StudentQualifications AS (SELECT s.student_id, q.course_id, q.date_awarded, g.percentage_range FROM students AS s INNER JOIN qualifications AS q ON s.student_id = q.student_id INNER JOIN grades AS g ON q.grade_id = g.grade_id), ExtractedPercentage AS (SELECT student_id, course_id, date_awarded, CAST(SUBSTRING(percentage_range, 1, LOCATE('-', percentage_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AS average_percentage FROM StudentQualifications), CumulativeAverages AS (SELECT student_id, course_id, SUM(average_percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY date_awarded) AS cumulative_average FROM ExtractedPercentage) SELECT course_id, MAX(cumulative_average) AS top_cumulative_average FROM CumulativeAverages GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY top_cumulative_average DESC

SELECT AVG(td.density) AS average_density_during_incidents FROM traffic_data AS td INNER JOIN incident_reports AS ir ON td.region_id = ir.region_id WHERE td.region_id = 1 AND ir.incident_type = 'Accident' AND ir.start_time BETWEEN '2023-04-01 00:00:00' AND '2023-04-01 23:59:59' AND td.hour BETWEEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ir.start_time AS DATETIME), '%H') AS SIGNED) AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ir.end_time AS DATETIME), '%H') AS SIGNED)

WITH ApplicationCounts AS (SELECT job_id, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM applications GROUP BY job_id), ApplicationStatusDistribution AS (SELECT job_id, status, COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM applications GROUP BY job_id, status), JobDetails AS (SELECT p.job_id, p.job_title, c.category_name, l.location_name, l.contact_email, p.skills_required FROM job_postings AS p INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id INNER JOIN locations AS l ON p.location_id = l.location_id), ApplicantSkills AS (SELECT a.job_id, u.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(us.skill SEPARATOR ',') AS applicant_skills FROM applications AS a INNER JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_skills AS us ON u.user_id = us.user_id GROUP BY a.job_id, u.user_id), JobApplicantSkillMatch AS (SELECT js.job_id, js.skills_required, askill.user_id, CASE WHEN askill.applicant_skills LIKE CONCAT('%', js.skills_required, '%') THEN 'Match' ELSE 'No Match' END AS skill_match FROM JobDetails AS js INNER JOIN ApplicantSkills AS askill ON js.job_id = askill.job_id) SELECT jd.job_id, jd.job_title, jd.category_name, jd.location_name, jd.contact_email, ac.application_count, acd.status, acd.status_count, js.skill_match FROM JobDetails AS jd LEFT JOIN ApplicationCounts AS ac ON jd.job_id = ac.job_id LEFT JOIN ApplicationStatusDistribution AS acd ON jd.job_id = acd.job_id LEFT JOIN JobApplicantSkillMatch AS js ON jd.job_id = js.job_id ORDER BY jd.job_id, acd.status

WITH ChurnedCustomers AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM churn AS ch INNER JOIN customers AS c ON ch.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE ch.has_churned = 1), TotalUsage AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cu LEFT JOIN `usage` AS u ON cu.customer_id = u.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id), TotalPayments AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cu LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON cu.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id) SELECT CONCAT(cc.first_name, ' ', cc.last_name) AS customer_name, COALESCE(tu.total_usage, 0) AS total_usage, COALESCE(tp.total_paid, 0) AS total_paid FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cc LEFT JOIN TotalUsage AS tu ON cc.customer_id = tu.customer_id LEFT JOIN TotalPayments AS tp ON cc.customer_id = tp.customer_id ORDER BY total_paid DESC, total_usage DESC

WITH PatientEngagementSummary AS (SELECT p.patient_id, CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name) AS full_name, pd.disease_id, COUNT(pe.engagement_id) AS total_engagements, SUM(CASE WHEN pe.engagement_type = 'Nutrition Plan Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nutrition_reviews, SUM(CASE WHEN pe.engagement_type = 'Precaution Consultation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS precaution_consultations FROM patients AS p JOIN patient_diseases AS pd ON p.patient_id = pd.patient_id LEFT JOIN patient_engagement AS pe ON p.patient_id = pe.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, pd.disease_id), DiseasePrecautions AS (SELECT dp.disease_id, GROUP_CONCAT(pr.precaution_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS precautions_summary FROM disease_precautions AS dp JOIN precautions AS pr ON dp.precaution_id = pr.precaution_id GROUP BY dp.disease_id) SELECT pes.full_name, d.disease_name, CONCAT(pes.total_engagements, ' Engagements: ', pes.nutrition_reviews, ' Nutrition Plan Reviews, ', pes.precaution_consultations, ' Precaution Consultations, Precautions: ', dp.precautions_summary) AS patient_summary FROM PatientEngagementSummary AS pes JOIN diseases AS d ON pes.disease_id = d.disease_id LEFT JOIN DiseasePrecautions AS dp ON pes.disease_id = dp.disease_id

WITH WeatherHabits AS (SELECT r.respondent_id, r.email, w.check_method FROM respondents AS r INNER JOIN weather_checking_habits AS w ON r.respondent_id = w.respondent_id WHERE r.is_active = 1), SmartwatchPref AS (SELECT sp.respondent_id, sp.smartwatch_likelihood FROM smartwatch_preferences AS sp INNER JOIN smartwatch_likelihoods AS sl ON sp.smartwatch_likelihood = sl.likelihood_id WHERE sl.likelihood_name = 'Somewhat likely'), CombinedHabits AS (SELECT wh.respondent_id, wh.email, wh.check_method, sp.smartwatch_likelihood FROM WeatherHabits AS wh INNER JOIN SmartwatchPref AS sp ON wh.respondent_id = sp.respondent_id INNER JOIN us_regions AS ur ON wh.respondent_id = (SELECT r.respondent_id FROM respondents AS r WHERE r.us_region = ur.region_id) WHERE ur.region_name = 'South Atlantic') SELECT SUBSTRING(c.email, 1, LOCATE('@', c.email) - 1) AS respondent_name, c.check_method AS check_weather_method FROM CombinedHabits AS c

WITH ModelMetrics AS (SELECT model_id, AVG(`precision`) AS avg_precision FROM evaluation_metrics GROUP BY model_id), LatestDeployments AS (SELECT model_id, deployment_date, model_version, environment, deployment_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_id ORDER BY deployment_date DESC) AS latest_deployment FROM model_deployment_history), UserActivity AS (SELECT model_id, u.username, u.email, m.updated_at AS last_updated FROM models AS m INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM model_comments WHERE model_id = m.model_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)), ModelComments AS (SELECT model_id, GROUP_CONCAT(comment SEPARATOR ' | ') AS all_comments FROM model_comments GROUP BY model_id) SELECT m.model_name, mm.avg_precision, ld.deployment_date, ld.model_version, ld.environment, ld.deployment_status, ua.username, ua.email, ua.last_updated, mc.all_comments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mm.avg_precision DESC) AS model_rank FROM models AS m JOIN ModelMetrics AS mm ON m.model_id = mm.model_id LEFT JOIN LatestDeployments AS ld ON m.model_id = ld.model_id AND ld.latest_deployment = 1 JOIN UserActivity AS ua ON m.model_id = ua.model_id LEFT JOIN ModelComments AS mc ON m.model_id = mc.model_id ORDER BY model_rank

WITH LatestDocumentVersions AS (SELECT doc_type_id, MAX(version_nbr) AS latest_version FROM document_versions GROUP BY doc_type_id), ActiveDocumentAttributes AS (SELECT dt.doc_type_id, dt.doc_type_name, a.attr_name, a.attr_value FROM document_types AS dt JOIN attributes AS a ON dt.doc_type_id = a.doc_type_id WHERE a.active_ind = 'Y'), ObjectStats AS (SELECT ot.obj_type_id, ot.obj_type_name, COUNT(oa.obj_attr_id) AS attribute_count, AVG(oa.version_nbr) AS avg_version FROM object_types AS ot LEFT JOIN object_attributes AS oa ON ot.obj_type_id = oa.obj_type_id GROUP BY ot.obj_type_id, ot.obj_type_name) SELECT dt.doc_type_id, dt.doc_type_name, dt.category, dt.created_by, dt.created_date, ldv.latest_version, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ada.attr_name, ': ', ada.attr_value) SEPARATOR ',') AS active_attributes, os.obj_type_name, os.attribute_count, os.avg_version FROM document_types AS dt LEFT JOIN LatestDocumentVersions AS ldv ON dt.doc_type_id = ldv.doc_type_id LEFT JOIN ActiveDocumentAttributes AS ada ON dt.doc_type_id = ada.doc_type_id LEFT JOIN ObjectStats AS os ON os.obj_type_name = dt.doc_type_name GROUP BY dt.doc_type_id, dt.doc_type_name, dt.category, dt.created_by, dt.created_date, ldv.latest_version, os.obj_type_name, os.attribute_count, os.avg_version ORDER BY dt.doc_type_id

SELECT p.endpoint_id, AVG(p.average_response_time) AS avg_response_time, f.failures_per_second FROM performance_metrics AS p LEFT JOIN failure_rates AS f ON p.endpoint_id = f.endpoint_id AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(p.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST(f.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY p.endpoint_id, f.failures_per_second HAVING COUNT(p.metric_id) > 1 ORDER BY avg_response_time DESC

SELECT c.course_name, ce.grade, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(i.first_name, ' ', i.last_name) SEPARATOR ',') AS advising_instructors FROM course_enrollments AS ce INNER JOIN courses AS c ON ce.course_id = c.course_id INNER JOIN students AS s ON ce.student_id = s.student_id INNER JOIN student_instructors AS si ON s.student_id = si.student_id INNER JOIN instructors AS i ON si.instructor_id = i.instructor_id WHERE ce.grade BETWEEN 'B' AND 'A' AND si.advisor_type = 'academic' GROUP BY c.course_name, ce.grade ORDER BY c.course_name, ce.grade DESC
