WITH RaceStats AS (SELECT r.race_id, rr.boat_id, rr.`rank`, rr.elapsed_time, rr.corrected_time, rr.final_rank, rr.final_points, b.boat_name, b.boat_type, b.hcap, o.owner_name, o.owner_email, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.race_id ORDER BY rr.final_points DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM races AS r INNER JOIN race_results AS rr ON r.race_id = rr.race_id INNER JOIN boats AS b ON rr.boat_id = b.boat_id INNER JOIN owners AS o ON b.owner_id = o.owner_id WHERE r.race_status = 'Completed'), TopBoats AS (SELECT race_id, boat_id, boat_name, boat_type, hcap, owner_name, owner_email, `rank`, elapsed_time, corrected_time, final_rank, final_points, rank_by_points FROM RaceStats WHERE rank_by_points <= 3) SELECT tb.race_id, tb.boat_name, tb.boat_type, tb.hcap, tb.owner_name, tb.owner_email, tb.`rank`, tb.elapsed_time, tb.corrected_time, tb.final_rank, tb.final_points, tb.rank_by_points FROM TopBoats AS tb ORDER BY tb.race_id, tb.rank_by_points

WITH ActiveUsersInMultipleGroups AS (SELECT gm.usrkeypk FROM group_memberships AS gm WHERE gm.is_active = 1 GROUP BY gm.usrkeypk HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gm.grpkeypk) > 1), UserPermissions AS (SELECT pa.usrkeypk, GROUP_CONCAT(p.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS permissions FROM permission_assignments AS pa JOIN permissions AS p ON pa.permissionpk = p.permissionpk WHERE pa.is_active = 1 AND p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY pa.usrkeypk) SELECT u.username, up.permissions FROM users AS u JOIN ActiveUsersInMultipleGroups AS aumg ON u.usrkeypk = aumg.usrkeypk JOIN UserPermissions AS up ON u.usrkeypk = up.usrkeypk WHERE u.is_active = 1 ORDER BY u.username

SELECT bt.type_name, c.cbsa_code, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(b.amount_assisted, ',', '') AS SIGNED)) / c.cbsa_population AS average_assistance_per_capita FROM businesses AS b INNER JOIN business_types AS bt ON b.business_type = bt.type_id INNER JOIN cbsa AS c ON b.cbsa = c.cbsa_code GROUP BY bt.type_name, c.cbsa_code, c.cbsa_population ORDER BY c.cbsa_code, average_assistance_per_capita DESC

WITH CitationSummary AS (SELECT n.neighborhood_name, c.citation_year, c.citation_month, COUNT(c.citation_id) AS total_citations, AVG(CAST(c.fine_amount AS FLOAT)) AS avg_fine_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.vehicle_plate) AS unique_vehicles_cited FROM citations AS c JOIN neighborhoods AS n ON c.neighborhood_id = n.neighborhood_id WHERE c.citation_year >= (CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) - 1) GROUP BY n.neighborhood_name, c.citation_year, c.citation_month), RankedCitations AS (SELECT neighborhood_name, citation_year, citation_month, total_citations, avg_fine_amount, unique_vehicles_cited, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY neighborhood_name ORDER BY citation_year DESC, citation_month DESC) AS row_num FROM CitationSummary) SELECT neighborhood_name, citation_year, citation_month, total_citations, avg_fine_amount, unique_vehicles_cited FROM RankedCitations WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY neighborhood_name, citation_year DESC, citation_month DESC

WITH LootItemConditions AS (SELECT li.item_id, li.probability, lc.condition_type, lc.condition_value, lc.condition_operator FROM loot_items AS li LEFT JOIN loot_conditions AS lc ON li.item_id = lc.item_id WHERE li.bucket_id = 1 AND li.item_id = 1), CharacterConditionsMet AS (SELECT lic.item_id, lic.probability, CASE WHEN lic.condition_type = 'character_level' AND lic.condition_operator = '=' AND c.character_level = CAST(lic.condition_value AS SIGNED) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible_for_item FROM LootItemConditions AS lic JOIN characters AS c ON c.character_id = 1) SELECT lic.probability AS item_receiving_probability FROM CharacterConditionsMet AS lic WHERE lic.item_id = 1 AND lic.eligible_for_item = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT at.attack_type_name, COUNT(a.attack_id) AS number_of_attacks FROM attacks AS a JOIN `groups` AS g ON a.group_id = g.group_id JOIN attack_types AS at ON a.attack_type_id = at.attack_type_id WHERE g.group_name = 'ISIS' GROUP BY at.attack_type_name

SELECT u.user_name, e.entity_name, y.year_name, AVG(al.session_duration) AS average_session_duration, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count, y.global_economic_conditions, y.major_events FROM access_logs AS al INNER JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN entities AS e ON al.data_id = e.entity_id INNER JOIN years AS y ON y.year_name = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(al.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS SIGNED) WHERE y.year_name = 1970 AND u.status = 'active' GROUP BY u.user_name, e.entity_name, y.year_name, y.global_economic_conditions, y.major_events HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) > 1

WITH UserPreferences AS (SELECT up.user_id, up.preferred_genre, up.preferred_tempo_range, up.preferred_loudness_range, up.preferred_key FROM user_preferences AS up JOIN users AS u ON up.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.country = 'United States'), TrackFeatures AS (SELECT t.track_id, t.track_title, t.tempo, t.loudness, t.`key` FROM tracks AS t), TrackEngagement AS (SELECT tal.track_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tal.user_id) AS unique_listeners, AVG(tr.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.comment_id) AS total_comments FROM track_access_logs AS tal LEFT JOIN track_ratings AS tr ON tal.track_id = tr.track_id LEFT JOIN track_comments AS tc ON tal.track_id = tc.track_id GROUP BY tal.track_id), TrackMatchScore AS (SELECT tf.track_id, tf.track_title, tf.tempo, tf.loudness, tf.`key`, te.unique_listeners, te.average_rating, te.total_comments, SUM((CASE WHEN tf.tempo BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_tempo_range, 1, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_tempo_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_tempo_range, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_tempo_range) + 1) AS FLOAT) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN tf.loudness BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_loudness_range, 1, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_loudness_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_loudness_range, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_loudness_range) + 1) AS FLOAT) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN tf.`key` = CAST(up.preferred_key AS SIGNED) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS match_score FROM TrackFeatures AS tf JOIN TrackEngagement AS te ON tf.track_id = te.track_id JOIN UserPreferences AS up ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY tf.track_id, tf.track_title, tf.tempo, tf.loudness, tf.`key`, te.unique_listeners, te.average_rating, te.total_comments), FinalTrackScores AS (SELECT tms.track_id, tms.track_title, tms.match_score, tms.unique_listeners, tms.average_rating, tms.total_comments, (tms.match_score * 0.4 + COALESCE(tms.average_rating, 0) * 0.3 + tms.total_comments * 0.2 + tms.unique_listeners * 0.1) AS final_score FROM TrackMatchScore AS tms) SELECT track_title FROM FinalTrackScores ORDER BY final_score DESC LIMIT 5

WITH BuildStats AS (SELECT c.config_id, c.config_version, COUNT(b.build_status) AS total_builds, SUM(CASE WHEN b.build_status = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_builds FROM configurations AS c LEFT JOIN build_logs AS b ON c.config_id = b.config_id GROUP BY c.config_id, c.config_version) SELECT bs.config_id, bs.config_version FROM BuildStats AS bs WHERE (bs.successful_builds * 1.0 / bs.total_builds) > 0.75 ORDER BY (bs.successful_builds * 1.0 / bs.total_builds) DESC

WITH BuildingExits AS (SELECT b.building_name, e.exit_id, e.exit_name, e.exit_type, e.exit_capacity, e.is_emergency_only, f.floor_id FROM buildings AS b JOIN floors AS f ON b.building_id = f.building_id JOIN exits AS e ON f.floor_id = e.floor_id WHERE b.building_name = 'Office Building' AND b.city = 'Othertown'), ExitResults AS (SELECT er.exit_id, SUM(er.number_of_students) AS total_students, AVG(er.average_exit_time) AS average_exit_time, GROUP_CONCAT(er.bottleneck_report SEPARATOR ',') AS bottlenecks FROM simulation_results AS er JOIN BuildingExits AS be ON er.exit_id = be.exit_id GROUP BY er.exit_id), RankedExits AS (SELECT be.building_name, be.exit_id, be.exit_name, be.exit_type, be.exit_capacity, be.is_emergency_only, er.total_students, er.average_exit_time, er.bottlenecks, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(er.total_students, 0) DESC) AS exit_rank FROM BuildingExits AS be LEFT JOIN ExitResults AS er ON be.exit_id = er.exit_id) SELECT exit_rank, exit_name, exit_type, exit_capacity, is_emergency_only, total_students, average_exit_time, bottlenecks FROM RankedExits

SELECT ws.station_name, AVG(wd.value) AS average_precipitation, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count, ws.location, MAX(ws.last_maintenance_date) AS last_maintenance, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name SEPARATOR ',') AS accessed_by_users FROM weather_data AS wd INNER JOIN weather_stations AS ws ON wd.station_id = ws.station_id INNER JOIN parameters AS p ON wd.parameter_id = p.parameter_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON wd.data_id = al.data_id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.parameter_name = 'precipitation_amount' GROUP BY ws.station_name, ws.location HAVING AVG(wd.value) > 50 ORDER BY average_precipitation DESC

SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, p.position, AVG(ps.batting_average) AS avg_batting_avg, AVG(ps.on_base_percentage) AS avg_on_base_percentage FROM players AS p JOIN player_stats AS ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id JOIN teams AS t ON p.team_id = t.team_id WHERE ps.game_id IN (SELECT game_id FROM games WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(game_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023') GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, t.team_name, p.position HAVING COUNT(ps.game_id) > 10 ORDER BY avg_batting_avg DESC

WITH RankedParticipants AS (SELECT p.name AS participant_name, e.event_name, r.`rank`, r.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_score DESC) AS participant_rank FROM participants AS p JOIN rankings AS r ON p.participant_id = r.participant_id JOIN events AS e ON r.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.event_id = 1) SELECT participant_name, event_name, `rank`, total_score FROM RankedParticipants WHERE participant_rank <= 3

WITH SubjectPerformance AS (SELECT e.subject_id, e.`condition`, COUNT(e.experiment_id) AS total_trials, SUM(e.correct) AS correct_trials, CAST(SUM(e.correct) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(e.experiment_id) AS success_rate FROM experiments AS e GROUP BY e.subject_id, e.`condition`), TopPerformers AS (SELECT `condition`, MAX(success_rate) AS success_rate FROM SubjectPerformance GROUP BY `condition`), FilteredResults AS (SELECT sp.subject_id, sp.`condition`, sp.success_rate, s.subject_name, c.condition_name FROM SubjectPerformance AS sp JOIN TopPerformers AS tp ON sp.`condition` = tp.`condition` AND sp.success_rate = tp.success_rate JOIN subjects AS s ON sp.subject_id = s.subject_id JOIN conditions AS c ON sp.`condition` = c.condition_id) SELECT subject_name, condition_name, success_rate FROM FilteredResults ORDER BY success_rate DESC LIMIT 10

WITH MediaAccessCounts AS (SELECT ma.media_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(session_duration, ' minutes', '') AS SIGNED)) AS avg_session_duration FROM media_access AS ma GROUP BY ma.media_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), CompanyDetails AS (SELECT mr.media_id, c.company_name, pm.performer_name, mf.format_name, mt.type_name FROM media_records AS mr LEFT JOIN companies AS c ON mr.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN performers AS pm ON mr.primary_performer_id = pm.performer_id LEFT JOIN media_formats AS mf ON mr.format_id = mf.format_id LEFT JOIN media_types AS mt ON mr.media_type_id = mt.type_id) SELECT mac.media_id, cd.company_name, cd.performer_name, cd.format_name, cd.type_name, mac.access_count, mac.avg_session_duration FROM MediaAccessCounts AS mac JOIN CompanyDetails AS cd ON mac.media_id = cd.media_id ORDER BY mac.access_count DESC

SELECT j.title AS journal_title, p.name AS publisher_name FROM journals AS j JOIN publishers AS p ON j.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN impact_factors AS `if` ON j.journal_id = `if`.journal_id JOIN publication_metrics AS pm ON j.journal_id = pm.journal_id WHERE `if`.impact_factor_value > 2.5 AND pm.metric_name = 'downloads' AND pm.metric_value > 150 GROUP BY j.title, p.name HAVING AVG(pm.metric_value) > 180 ORDER BY AVG(pm.metric_value) DESC

WITH MatchResults AS (SELECT m.home_team_id AS team_id, m.score, m.attendance, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(m.score, 1, LOCATE(' ', m.score) - 1) > SUBSTRING(m.score, LOCATE('-', m.score) + 1) THEN 3 WHEN SUBSTRING(m.score, 1, LOCATE(' ', m.score) - 1) < SUBSTRING(m.score, LOCATE('-', m.score) + 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS points_earned FROM matches AS m UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_id AS team_id, m.score, m.attendance, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(m.score, LOCATE(' ', m.score) + 1, LOCATE('-', m.score) - LOCATE(' ', m.score) - 1) > SUBSTRING(m.score, LOCATE('-', m.score) + 1) THEN 3 WHEN SUBSTRING(m.score, LOCATE(' ', m.score) + 1, LOCATE('-', m.score) - LOCATE(' ', m.score) - 1) < SUBSTRING(m.score, LOCATE('-', m.score) + 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS points_earned FROM matches AS m), TeamStats AS (SELECT mr.team_id, SUM(mr.points_earned) AS total_points, COUNT(mr.attendance) AS matches_played, AVG(mr.attendance) AS avg_attendance FROM MatchResults AS mr GROUP BY mr.team_id), TopTeams AS (SELECT ts.team_id, ts.total_points, ts.matches_played, ts.avg_attendance FROM TeamStats AS ts WHERE ts.matches_played > 10 ORDER BY ts.total_points DESC, ts.avg_attendance DESC LIMIT 5), TeamSponsorships AS (SELECT s.team_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(s.sponsorship_type, ' (', s.sponsorship_amount, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS sponsorships_info FROM sponsors AS s WHERE s.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM TopTeams) GROUP BY s.team_id) SELECT t.team_name, tt.total_points, tt.matches_played, tt.avg_attendance, ts.sponsorships_info FROM teams AS t JOIN TopTeams AS tt ON t.team_id = tt.team_id LEFT JOIN TeamSponsorships AS ts ON t.team_id = ts.team_id

WITH LatestPerformance AS (SELECT motor_id, MAX(timestamp) AS latest_timestamp FROM motor_performance_metrics GROUP BY motor_id), LatestModel AS (SELECT motor_id, MAX(last_trained) AS latest_training FROM predictive_maintenance_models GROUP BY motor_id), MaintenanceActions AS (SELECT motor_id, GROUP_CONCAT(action_taken SEPARATOR '; ') AS maintenance_actions FROM maintenance_logs GROUP BY motor_id) SELECT CONCAT('Motor ID: ', m.motor_id, '; Status: ', m.status, '; Location: ', m.location, '; Motor Type: ', m.motor_type, '; Fault Code: ', COALESCE(f.code, 'None'), '; Fault Description: ', COALESCE(f.description, 'None'), '; Severity Level: ', COALESCE(f.severity_level, 'None'), '; Category: ', COALESCE(f.category, 'None'), '; Maintenance Actions: ', COALESCE(ma.maintenance_actions, 'None'), '; Latest Performance: ', COALESCE(mp.timestamp, 'None'), '; Speed: ', COALESCE(mp.speed, 'None'), '; Temperature: ', COALESCE(mp.temperature, 'None'), '; Vibration Level: ', COALESCE(mp.vibration_level, 'None'), '; Predictive Model: ', COALESCE(pm.model_type, 'None'), '; Model Accuracy: ', COALESCE(pm.model_accuracy, 'None'), '; Last Trained: ', COALESCE(pm.last_trained, 'None')) AS motor_summary FROM motor_states AS m LEFT JOIN diagnostic_reports AS dr ON m.motor_id = dr.motor_id LEFT JOIN fault_codes AS f ON dr.fault_code_id = f.fault_code_id LEFT JOIN MaintenanceActions AS ma ON m.motor_id = ma.motor_id LEFT JOIN motor_performance_metrics AS mp ON m.motor_id = mp.motor_id AND mp.timestamp = (SELECT latest_timestamp FROM LatestPerformance WHERE motor_id = m.motor_id) LEFT JOIN predictive_maintenance_models AS pm ON m.motor_id = pm.motor_id AND pm.last_trained = (SELECT latest_training FROM LatestModel WHERE motor_id = m.motor_id) ORDER BY m.motor_id

generated_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS month, CASE WHEN ups <> '' THEN 'UPS' WHEN ko <> '' THEN 'KO' END AS stock, AVG(CASE WHEN ups <> '' THEN CAST(ups AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_adj_close, AVG(CAST(mkt_rf AS FLOAT)) AS avg_mkt_rf FROM market_data WHERE ups <> '' OR ko <> '' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m'), CASE WHEN ups <> '' THEN 'UPS' WHEN ko <> '' THEN 'KO' END ORDER BY month, stock

WITH ScenarioDetails AS (SELECT s.scenario_id, s.scenario_name, s.description, u.username AS created_by_username, u.first_name AS created_by_first_name, u.last_name AS created_by_last_name FROM scenarios AS s INNER JOIN users AS u ON s.created_by = u.user_id), BSPDetails AS (SELECT bsp.bsp_id, bsp.bsp_name, bsp.grid_supply_point, bsp.licence_area, bsp.latitude, bsp.longitude, bsp.capacity, bsp.status, bsp.installation_date FROM bulk_supply_points AS bsp), ForecastData AS (SELECT f.bsp_id, f.scenario_id, f.year, f.forecast_value, f.confidence_level, f.methodology, u.username AS last_updated_by_username, u.first_name AS last_updated_by_first_name, u.last_name AS last_updated_by_last_name FROM forecasts AS f INNER JOIN users AS u ON f.last_updated_by = u.user_id), AccessLogData AS (SELECT al.user_id, al.access_time, al.action, al.ip_address, al.user_agent, al.session_id, u.username AS accessed_by_username, u.first_name AS accessed_by_first_name, u.last_name AS accessed_by_last_name FROM access_logs AS al INNER JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id), CombinedData AS (SELECT sd.scenario_id, sd.scenario_name, sd.description, sd.created_by_username, sd.created_by_first_name, sd.created_by_last_name, bsp.bsp_id, bsp.bsp_name, bsp.grid_supply_point, bsp.licence_area, bsp.latitude, bsp.longitude, bsp.capacity, bsp.status, bsp.installation_date, fd.year, fd.forecast_value, fd.confidence_level, fd.methodology, fd.last_updated_by_username, fd.last_updated_by_first_name, fd.last_updated_by_last_name, ald.access_time, ald.action, ald.ip_address, ald.user_agent, ald.session_id, ald.accessed_by_username, ald.accessed_by_first_name, ald.accessed_by_last_name FROM ScenarioDetails AS sd CROSS JOIN BSPDetails AS bsp LEFT JOIN ForecastData AS fd ON fd.bsp_id = bsp.bsp_id AND fd.scenario_id = sd.scenario_id LEFT JOIN AccessLogData AS ald ON DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ald.access_time AS DATETIME), '%Y') = CAST(fd.year AS CHAR)) SELECT CONCAT('Year: ', year, ', Scenario: ', scenario_name, ', BSP: ', bsp_name, ', Forecast: ', forecast_value, ', Last Updated By: ', last_updated_by_username, ', Accessed By: ', accessed_by_username) AS summary FROM CombinedData ORDER BY year, bsp_id, scenario_id

SELECT g.group_name, a.year, COUNT(a.attack_id) AS total_attacks FROM attacks AS a INNER JOIN `groups` AS g ON a.group_id = g.group_id INNER JOIN regions AS r ON a.region_id = r.region_id WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020 AND g.group_name IN ('ISIS', 'Al-Qaeda') AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY g.group_name, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.attack_id) > 0

SELECT sp.product_name, v.version_number, COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_accesses FROM software_products AS sp JOIN versions AS v ON sp.product_id = v.product_id JOIN access_logs AS al ON v.version_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(al.resource_accessed, LENGTH('version') + 1) AS SIGNED) JOIN changelogs AS c ON v.version_id = c.version_id JOIN change_types AS ct ON c.change_type_id = ct.change_type_id WHERE al.access_type = 'view' AND al.resource_accessed LIKE '%version%' AND NOT al.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE role = 'QA engineer') AND ct.change_type_category = 'major' GROUP BY sp.product_name, v.version_number ORDER BY total_accesses DESC

WITH VesselDetails AS (SELECT v.*, b.builder_name, b.builder_address, b.builder_contact, b.builder_website, b.builder_country, b.builder_established_year FROM vessels AS v JOIN builders AS b ON v.builder_id = b.builder_id), RegistrationHistory AS (SELECT r.vessel_id, MAX(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.expiry_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR)) AS latest_expiry_date, MAX(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.registration_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR)) AS latest_registration_date, COUNT(r.registration_id) AS number_of_registrations FROM registrations AS r GROUP BY r.vessel_id), OwnershipTimeline AS (SELECT o.vessel_id, MIN(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.ownership_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR)) AS first_ownership_date, MAX(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.ownership_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') AS CHAR)) AS last_ownership_date, COUNT(o.history_id) AS number_of_owners FROM ownership_history AS o GROUP BY o.vessel_id), CombinedVesselInfo AS (SELECT vd.*, rh.latest_expiry_date, rh.latest_registration_date, rh.number_of_registrations, ot.first_ownership_date, ot.last_ownership_date, ot.number_of_owners FROM VesselDetails AS vd LEFT JOIN RegistrationHistory AS rh ON vd.vessel_id = rh.vessel_id LEFT JOIN OwnershipTimeline AS ot ON vd.vessel_id = ot.vessel_id) SELECT cvi.* FROM CombinedVesselInfo AS cvi ORDER BY cvi.vessel_id

SELECT v.variant_name, d.disease_name, COUNT(e.evidence_id) AS evidence_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dr.drug_name SEPARATOR ',') AS associated_drugs FROM variants AS v INNER JOIN diseases AS d ON v.disease_id = d.disease_id INNER JOIN evidence AS e ON v.variant_id = e.variant_id INNER JOIN drugs AS dr ON e.drug_id = dr.drug_id WHERE d.disease_name = 'Chronic Myeloid Leukemia' GROUP BY v.variant_name, d.disease_name ORDER BY evidence_count DESC LIMIT 5

WITH ArticleDetails AS (SELECT a.article_id, a.title AS article_title, a.doi, a.abstract, a.publication_date, a.article_type, a.keywords, a.funding_sources, a.article_status, j.title AS journal_title, j.issn, j.e_issn, j.country, j.status AS journal_status, j.description, j.subject_area, p.name AS publisher_name, pm.metric_value AS citation_count, pm.year AS citation_year FROM articles AS a INNER JOIN journal_issues AS ji ON a.issue_id = ji.issue_id INNER JOIN journals AS j ON ji.journal_id = j.journal_id INNER JOIN publishers AS p ON j.publisher_id = p.publisher_id INNER JOIN publication_metrics AS pm ON j.journal_id = pm.journal_id WHERE p.name = 'ROUTLEDGE JOURNALS, TAYLOR & FRANCIS LTD' AND j.subject_area = 'Medicine' AND pm.metric_name = 'citations' AND pm.metric_value > 100), AuthorDetails AS (SELECT aa.article_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(a.first_name, ' ', a.last_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS authors FROM article_authors AS aa INNER JOIN authors AS a ON aa.author_id = a.author_id GROUP BY aa.article_id) SELECT ad.article_title, ad.doi, ad.abstract, ad.publication_date, ad.article_type, ad.keywords, ad.funding_sources, ad.article_status, ad.journal_title, ad.issn, ad.e_issn, ad.country, ad.journal_status, ad.description, ad.subject_area, ad.publisher_name, ad.citation_count, ad.citation_year, a.authors FROM ArticleDetails AS ad INNER JOIN AuthorDetails AS a ON ad.article_id = a.article_id ORDER BY ad.citation_count DESC

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(m.pregnant_women_registered_first_trimester) AS avg_first_trimester_registration, SUM(m.total_pregnant_women) AS total_pregnancies FROM regions AS r JOIN maternal_health AS m ON r.region_id = m.region_id WHERE r.healthcare_facilities > 50 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(m.last_updated AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING AVG(m.pregnant_women_registered_first_trimester) > 1000 ORDER BY total_pregnancies DESC

WITH OutbreakDetails AS (SELECT o.outbreak_id, e.name AS etiology_name, o.total_cases, o.outbreak_year, l.location_name, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.status FROM outbreaks AS o JOIN etiologies AS e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id JOIN locations AS l ON o.location_id = l.location_id), FactorDetails AS (SELECT `of`.outbreak_id, GROUP_CONCAT(f.factor_description SEPARATOR ',') AS factors FROM outbreak_factors AS `of` JOIN factors AS f ON `of`.factor_id = f.factor_id GROUP BY `of`.outbreak_id), InterventionDetails AS (SELECT i.outbreak_id, GROUP_CONCAT(i.intervention_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS interventions FROM interventions AS i GROUP BY i.outbreak_id), ReportDetails AS (SELECT orp.outbreak_id, GROUP_CONCAT(ra.agency_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS reporting_agencies FROM outbreak_reports AS orp JOIN reporting_agencies AS ra ON orp.agency_id = ra.agency_id GROUP BY orp.outbreak_id), CombinedOutbreakData AS (SELECT od.outbreak_id, od.etiology_name, od.total_cases, od.outbreak_year, od.location_name, od.start_date, od.end_date, od.status, fd.factors, id.interventions, rd.reporting_agencies FROM OutbreakDetails AS od LEFT JOIN FactorDetails AS fd ON od.outbreak_id = fd.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN InterventionDetails AS id ON od.outbreak_id = id.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN ReportDetails AS rd ON od.outbreak_id = rd.outbreak_id), RankedOutbreaks AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY etiology_name ORDER BY total_cases DESC) AS row_num FROM CombinedOutbreakData) SELECT outbreak_id, etiology_name, total_cases, outbreak_year, location_name, start_date, end_date, status, factors, interventions, reporting_agencies FROM RankedOutbreaks WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY total_cases DESC

WITH StudentDetails AS (SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, m.major_name, d.dept_name AS department_name FROM students AS s LEFT JOIN majors AS m ON s.major_id = m.major_id LEFT JOIN departments AS d ON m.dept_id = d.dept_id), StudentDemographics AS (SELECT sd.student_id, GROUP_CONCAT(dc.demographic_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS demographic_info FROM student_demographics AS sd JOIN demographic_categories AS dc ON sd.demographic_id = dc.demographic_id GROUP BY sd.student_id), CourseEnrollmentDetails AS (SELECT ce.student_id, GROUP_CONCAT(c.course_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS course_names, COUNT(ce.course_id) AS total_courses FROM course_enrollments AS ce JOIN courses AS c ON ce.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY ce.student_id) SELECT sd.student_id, sd.student_name, sd.major_name, sd.department_name, sdd.demographic_info, cd.course_names, cd.total_courses FROM StudentDetails AS sd LEFT JOIN StudentDemographics AS sdd ON sd.student_id = sdd.student_id LEFT JOIN CourseEnrollmentDetails AS cd ON sd.student_id = cd.student_id

WITH MaintenanceSummary AS (SELECT e.equipment_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_count, AVG(m.cost) AS avg_maintenance_cost, MAX(m.maintenance_date) AS last_maintenance_date, MIN(m.maintenance_date) AS first_maintenance_date FROM equipment AS e LEFT JOIN maintenance_records AS m ON e.equipment_id = m.equipment_id GROUP BY e.equipment_id), PerformanceBaseline AS (SELECT p.equipment_id, AVG(p.rpm) AS avg_rpm, AVG(p.thrust) AS avg_thrust, AVG(p.efficiency) AS avg_efficiency, AVG(p.energy_consumption) AS avg_energy_consumption FROM performance_metrics AS p GROUP BY p.equipment_id), AlertsAnalysis AS (SELECT a.equipment_id, COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.severity_level = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_severity_alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN a.severity_level = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium_severity_alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN a.severity_level = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_severity_alerts FROM alerts AS a GROUP BY a.equipment_id), RecentPerformance AS (SELECT p.equipment_id, p.rpm, p.thrust, p.efficiency, p.energy_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.equipment_id ORDER BY p.recorded_time DESC) AS row_num FROM performance_metrics AS p), LatestPerformance AS (SELECT rp.equipment_id, rp.rpm, rp.thrust, rp.efficiency, rp.energy_consumption FROM RecentPerformance AS rp WHERE rp.row_num = 1) SELECT e.equipment_name, ((lp.rpm / pb.avg_rpm) + (lp.thrust / pb.avg_thrust) + (pb.avg_efficiency / lp.efficiency) - (lp.energy_consumption / pb.avg_energy_consumption) - ms.maintenance_count - aa.alert_count) / 5 AS comparative_score FROM equipment AS e JOIN MaintenanceSummary AS ms ON e.equipment_id = ms.equipment_id JOIN PerformanceBaseline AS pb ON e.equipment_id = pb.equipment_id JOIN LatestPerformance AS lp ON e.equipment_id = lp.equipment_id JOIN AlertsAnalysis AS aa ON e.equipment_id = aa.equipment_id ORDER BY comparative_score DESC

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(p.project_name, ', ', f.file_name, ', ', CAST(c.lines_added AS CHAR), ', ', CAST(c.lines_removed AS CHAR), ', ', c.change_type, ', ', b.severity, ', ', u.user_name) SEPARATOR ',') AS details FROM projects AS p JOIN project_files AS pf ON p.project_id = pf.project_id JOIN files AS f ON pf.file_id = f.file_id JOIN revisions AS r ON f.file_id = r.file_id JOIN changes AS c ON r.revision_id = c.revision_id JOIN bugs AS b ON c.bug_id = b.bug_id JOIN users AS u ON r.author_id = u.user_id WHERE b.severity = 'major' GROUP BY p.project_name, f.file_name, c.lines_added, c.lines_removed, c.change_type, b.severity, u.user_name

WITH StoreData AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.name, s.address, st.type_name, GROUP_CONCAT(ps.service_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS pharmacy_services, COUNT(ss.staff_id) AS staff_count, COUNT(sa.sale_id) AS total_sales, SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS FLOAT)) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(sc.supplier_id) AS supply_chain_count, SUM(sc.quantity) AS total_supply_quantity FROM stores AS s LEFT JOIN store_store_types AS stt ON s.store_id = stt.store_id LEFT JOIN store_types AS st ON st.type_id = stt.type_id LEFT JOIN store_pharmacy_services AS sps ON s.store_id = sps.store_id LEFT JOIN pharmacy_services AS ps ON ps.service_id = sps.service_id LEFT JOIN store_staff AS ss ON ss.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN sales AS sa ON sa.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN supply_chain AS sc ON sc.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name, s.address, st.type_name), RankedStores AS (SELECT sd.store_id, sd.name, sd.address, sd.type_name, sd.pharmacy_services, sd.staff_count, sd.total_sales, sd.total_sales_amount, sd.supply_chain_count, sd.total_supply_quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sd.total_sales_amount ASC) AS sales_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sd.total_supply_quantity DESC) AS supply_chain_bucket FROM StoreData AS sd) SELECT rs.name, rs.type_name, rs.pharmacy_services, rs.staff_count, rs.total_sales, rs.total_sales_amount, rs.supply_chain_count, rs.total_supply_quantity, rs.sales_rank, rs.supply_chain_bucket, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.supply_chain_bucket) AS bucket_size, AVG(rs.total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.supply_chain_bucket) AS bucket_avg_sales_amount FROM RankedStores AS rs ORDER BY rs.sales_rank ASC

WITH ModelUsageStats AS (SELECT m.model_id, m.model_name, m.framework, m.devices, AVG(m.batch_size_gpu) AS avg_batch_size_gpu, AVG(m.batch_size_dla) AS avg_batch_size_dla, SUM(CASE WHEN mal.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_access_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mal.status = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_access_count, COUNT(DISTINCT mal.user_id) AS distinct_users_count FROM models AS m LEFT JOIN model_access_logs AS mal ON m.model_id = mal.model_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.model_name, m.framework, m.devices), PerformanceMetrics AS (SELECT mv.model_id, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(mv.performance_metrics, LOCATE('"accuracy":', mv.performance_metrics) + 11, LOCATE(', "f1_score"', mv.performance_metrics) - LOCATE('"accuracy":', mv.performance_metrics) - 11) AS FLOAT)) AS avg_accuracy, AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(mv.performance_metrics, LOCATE('"f1_score":', mv.performance_metrics) + 10, LOCATE('}', mv.performance_metrics) - LOCATE('"f1_score":', mv.performance_metrics) - 10) AS FLOAT)) AS avg_f1_score FROM model_versions AS mv GROUP BY mv.model_id), UserActivity AS (SELECT mal.user_id, um.username, COUNT(mal.model_id) AS models_accessed_count FROM model_access_logs AS mal INNER JOIN user_management AS um ON mal.user_id = um.user_id GROUP BY mal.user_id, um.username), ModelUserActivity AS (SELECT mus.model_id, mus.model_name, mus.framework, mus.devices, mus.avg_batch_size_gpu, mus.avg_batch_size_dla, mus.successful_access_count, mus.failed_access_count, mus.distinct_users_count, pm.avg_accuracy, pm.avg_f1_score, uac.username, uac.models_accessed_count FROM ModelUsageStats AS mus LEFT JOIN PerformanceMetrics AS pm ON mus.model_id = pm.model_id LEFT JOIN UserActivity AS uac ON uac.user_id = mus.distinct_users_count) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mua.successful_access_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_models_count FROM ModelUserActivity AS mua

SELECT c.country_name, AVG(d.gdp_per_capita) AS average_gdp_per_capita, GROUP_CONCAT(l.language_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS official_languages, GROUP_CONCAT(gf.feature_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS geographical_features FROM countries AS c INNER JOIN demographics AS d ON c.country_id = d.country_id INNER JOIN languages AS l ON c.country_id = l.country_id AND l.is_official = 1 INNER JOIN geographical_features AS gf ON c.country_id = gf.country_id WHERE d.gdp_per_capita > 20000 GROUP BY c.country_name HAVING COUNT(gf.feature_id) > 0

WITH Analysts AS (SELECT user_id, user_name, email FROM users WHERE role = 'analyst'), FinancialDataWithCumulativeVolume AS (SELECT instrument_id, date, close_price, volume, SUM(CAST(volume AS SIGNED)) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument_id ORDER BY date) AS cumulative_volume, data_source_id FROM financial_data) SELECT fdf.instrument_id, fdf.date, fdf.close_price, fdf.cumulative_volume, a.user_name AS analyst_name, ds.source_name, a.email FROM FinancialDataWithCumulativeVolume AS fdf JOIN data_sources AS ds ON fdf.data_source_id = ds.data_source_id JOIN Analysts AS a ON 1 = 1 /* Joining all analysts with each row; adjust if a specific analyst is required ORDER BY fdf.instrument_id, fdf.date */

SELECT p.product_name, p.product_description FROM products AS p WHERE p.product_family IN ('IES6800-48X6Q', 'RG-S5310 Switch Series') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_documents AS pd WHERE pd.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(pd.upload_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023')
SELECT name, cultural_significance, origin, meaning, `rank` FROM baby_names WHERE NOT cultural_significance IS NULL AND `rank` >= 100 ORDER BY `rank` ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT f.file_name, f.file_size, f.last_modified_date, COUNT(l.log_id) AS access_log_count, f.is_read_only FROM files AS f INNER JOIN file_types AS ft ON f.file_type_id = ft.type_id INNER JOIN file_permissions AS fp ON f.file_id = fp.file_id INNER JOIN `groups` AS g ON fp.group_id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN file_access_logs AS l ON f.file_id = l.file_id WHERE ft.type_name = 'Text' AND g.group_name = 'developers' AND fp.read_permission = 1 GROUP BY f.file_id, f.file_name, f.file_size, f.last_modified_date, f.is_read_only HAVING COUNT(l.log_id) > 0

SELECT p.personnel_id, p.name, r.rank_name, o.occupation_name, res.residence_name, p.service_branch, GROUP_CONCAT(e.event_description SEPARATOR ', ') AS event_descriptions FROM personnel AS p INNER JOIN ranks AS r ON p.rank_id = r.rank_id INNER JOIN occupations AS o ON p.occupation_id = o.occupation_id INNER JOIN residences AS res ON p.residence_id = res.residence_id INNER JOIN events AS e ON p.personnel_id = e.personnel_id WHERE p.service_branch = 'Army' GROUP BY p.personnel_id, p.name, r.rank_name, o.occupation_name, res.residence_name, p.service_branch

WITH LevelProgressStats AS (SELECT l.level_id, l.name AS level_name, AVG(p.progress) AS avg_progress, AVG(p.score) AS avg_score, COUNT(p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_progress AS p JOIN game_levels AS l ON p.level_id = l.level_id WHERE l.game_mode = 'Multi-player' AND l.difficulty_level = 'Medium' GROUP BY l.level_id, l.name), FilteredLevels AS (SELECT lsp.*, s.value AS max_players FROM LevelProgressStats AS lsp JOIN game_settings AS s ON s.name = 'MaxPlayers' WHERE CAST(s.value AS SIGNED) > 2) SELECT fl.level_id, fl.level_name, fl.avg_progress, fl.avg_score, fl.player_count FROM FilteredLevels AS fl ORDER BY fl.avg_score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.region_name, td.hour, td.total_output, td.density, td.average_speed, SUM(td.total_output) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY td.hour) AS cumulative_total_output, ir.incident_type, ir.incident_severity, tp.predicted_output, tp.predicted_density, tp.predicted_speed FROM traffic_data AS td JOIN regions AS r ON td.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN incident_reports AS ir ON td.region_id = ir.region_id AND td.hour BETWEEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ir.start_time AS DATETIME), '%H') AS SIGNED) AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ir.end_time AS DATETIME), '%H') AS SIGNED) LEFT JOIN traffic_predictions AS tp ON td.region_id = tp.region_id AND td.hour = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(tp.prediction_time AS DATETIME), '%H') AS SIGNED) ORDER BY r.region_name, td.hour

WITH RECURSIVE RegionHierarchy AS (SELECT region_id, region_name, CAST(region_name AS CHAR) AS region_path FROM regions WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name, CAST(CONCAT(rh.region_path, ' > ', r.region_name) AS CHAR) AS region_path FROM regions AS r JOIN RegionHierarchy AS rh ON r.parent_region_id = rh.region_id) SELECT h.holiday_name, rh.region_path AS region_hierarchy FROM holidays AS h JOIN holiday_region_mapping AS hrm ON h.holiday_id = hrm.holiday_id JOIN RegionHierarchy AS rh ON hrm.region_id = rh.region_id ORDER BY h.holiday_name, rh.region_path
SELECT official_name FROM election_officials WHERE official_party_affiliation = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name) AS player_name, ps.points_per_game, ps.player_efficiency_rating FROM players AS p JOIN player_seasons AS ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id JOIN player_awards AS pa ON p.player_id = pa.player_id WHERE pa.award_name = 'MVP' AND ps.season_year = CAST(pa.award_year AS CHAR) ORDER BY ps.points_per_game DESC

WITH ChannelVideoEngagementCTE AS (SELECT c.channel_id, c.title AS channel_title, v.video_id, v.title AS video_title, ve.view_count, ve.like_count, ve.comment_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id ORDER BY ve.view_count DESC) AS view_rank FROM channels AS c INNER JOIN videos AS v ON c.channel_id = v.channel_id INNER JOIN video_engagement AS ve ON v.video_id = ve.video_id), VideoCategoryCTE AS (SELECT vc.video_id, GROUP_CONCAT(cc.category_name SEPARATOR ',') AS categories FROM video_categories AS vc INNER JOIN channel_categories AS cc ON vc.category_id = cc.category_id GROUP BY vc.video_id) SELECT cve.channel_title, cve.video_title, cve.view_count, cve.like_count, cve.comment_count, vc.categories, cve.view_rank FROM ChannelVideoEngagementCTE AS cve INNER JOIN VideoCategoryCTE AS vc ON cve.video_id = vc.video_id WHERE cve.view_rank <= 3 ORDER BY cve.channel_title, cve.view_rank

SELECT robot_class, currently_registered, waiting_list, currently_registered + waiting_list AS total_robots FROM robot_classes WHERE is_active = 1 AND waiting_list > 0 AND currently_registered + waiting_list <= CAST(maximum_capacity AS SIGNED) ORDER BY total_robots DESC

WITH PopulationGrowth AS (SELECT c.country_id, c.country_name, MIN(h.year) AS earliest_year, MAX(h.year) AS latest_year, MIN(h.population) AS earliest_population, MAX(h.population) AS latest_population, (MAX(h.population) - MIN(h.population)) / (MAX(h.year) - MIN(h.year)) AS population_growth_rate FROM countries AS c INNER JOIN historical_data AS h ON c.country_id = h.country_id GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name) SELECT pg.country_name, pg.population_growth_rate FROM PopulationGrowth AS pg ORDER BY pg.population_growth_rate DESC

SELECT it.icon_type_name, COUNT(piu.project_icon_usage_id) AS usage_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name SEPARATOR ',') AS user_names FROM icon_types AS it INNER JOIN project_icon_usage AS piu ON it.icon_type_id = piu.icon_type_id INNER JOIN user_access AS ua ON piu.project_id = ua.project_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON ua.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY it.icon_type_id, it.icon_type_name HAVING COUNT(piu.project_icon_usage_id) > 1 ORDER BY usage_count DESC

SELECT ccd.county_congressional_district_name, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(bd.medical_care, ',', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_medical_care_expenditure FROM budget_data AS bd INNER JOIN states AS s ON bd.state = s.abbreviation INNER JOIN counties_congressional_districts AS ccd ON bd.county_congressional_district = ccd.county_congressional_district_name WHERE s.state_name = 'Kentucky' GROUP BY ccd.county_congressional_district_name HAVING SUM(CAST(REPLACE(bd.medical_care, ',', '') AS SIGNED)) > 0 ORDER BY total_medical_care_expenditure DESC
SELECT customer_id, SUM(usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM `usage` WHERE service_id = 1 AND usage_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-01-31' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_usage DESC

SELECT s.symbol, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(t.transact_id) AS num_transactions FROM transactions AS t JOIN symbols AS s ON t.symbol = s.symbol WHERE t.transaction_status = 'completed' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(t.transact_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2019' AND t.buyer_id = 1 GROUP BY s.symbol HAVING COUNT(t.transact_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC
SELECT image_id FROM diagnosis_results WHERE `condition` = 'Atelectasis'

WITH RankedTasks AS (SELECT task_id, stream_id, wait_time, duration_time, device_id, iter_id, tasktype, status, priority, created_at, updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wait_time DESC) AS wait_time_rank FROM tasks), TopTasks AS (SELECT task_id, stream_id, wait_time, duration_time, device_id, iter_id, tasktype, status, priority, created_at, updated_at FROM RankedTasks WHERE wait_time_rank <= 5), TaskMetrics AS (SELECT task_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(metric_name, ': ', metric_value, ' ', metric_unit) SEPARATOR ', ') AS metrics FROM task_metrics GROUP BY task_id) SELECT tt.task_id, s.stream_name, tt.wait_time, tt.duration_time, d.device_name, i.iter_name, tt.tasktype, tt.status, tt.priority, tt.created_at, tt.updated_at, COALESCE(tm.metrics, 'No metrics') AS metrics FROM TopTasks AS tt JOIN streams AS s ON tt.stream_id = s.stream_id JOIN devices AS d ON tt.device_id = d.device_id JOIN iterations AS i ON tt.iter_id = i.iter_id LEFT JOIN TaskMetrics AS tm ON tt.task_id = tm.task_id ORDER BY tt.wait_time DESC
SELECT eo.official_name FROM election_officials AS eo INNER JOIN election_areas AS ea ON LOCATE(ea.area_type, eo.official_title) > 0 WHERE eo.official_party_affiliation = 1 AND ea.area_type = 'state'

WITH TestRunCTE AS (SELECT tr.test_scenario_id, tr.software_version_id, sv.version_number, vs.scenario_name, tr.success_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tr.test_scenario_id, tr.software_version_id ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(tr.success_rate, 1, LOCATE('%', tr.success_rate) - 1) AS FLOAT) DESC) AS success_rate_rank FROM test_runs AS tr JOIN test_scenarios AS vs ON tr.test_scenario_id = vs.scenario_id JOIN software_versions AS sv ON tr.software_version_id = sv.version_id JOIN vehicle_health AS vh ON tr.vehicle_config_id = vh.vehicle_config_id WHERE tr.test_run_status = 'completed' AND vh.health_status = 'good') SELECT scenario_name, version_number, MAX(success_rate) AS best_success_rate FROM TestRunCTE WHERE success_rate_rank = 1 GROUP BY scenario_name, version_number

WITH SignificantActions AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS action_count FROM audit_trails GROUP BY user_id), MultipleLogIns AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS ip_count FROM user_activity_logs WHERE activity_type = 'login' GROUP BY user_id), UserRoles AS (SELECT u.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(ur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_ids FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN user_role_assignments AS ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id) SELECT u.user_id, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS full_name, sa.action_count, mil.ip_count, ur.role_ids FROM SignificantActions AS sa JOIN MultipleLogIns AS mil ON sa.user_id = mil.user_id JOIN UserRoles AS ur ON sa.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN users AS u ON sa.user_id = u.user_id WHERE sa.action_count >= 10 AND mil.ip_count >= 2

WITH CategoryPerformanceCTE AS (SELECT category_id, SUM(sales_volume) AS total_sales_volume, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(customer_engagement) AS average_customer_engagement, MAX(record_date) AS latest_record_date FROM category_performance GROUP BY category_id), PromotionCTE AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(promotion_id) AS promotion_count, GROUP_CONCAT(promotion_details SEPARATOR ',') AS promotion_details FROM category_promotions GROUP BY category_id), LatestMarketTrendCTE AS (SELECT cp.category_id, cp.market_trend FROM category_performance AS cp INNER JOIN (SELECT category_id, MAX(record_date) AS latest_record_date FROM category_performance GROUP BY category_id) AS latest_cp ON cp.category_id = latest_cp.category_id AND cp.record_date = latest_cp.latest_record_date), TopUsersCTE AS (SELECT cl.category_id, u.username, u.job_title, COUNT(cl.log_id) AS change_count FROM category_logs AS cl INNER JOIN users AS u ON cl.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY cl.category_id, u.username, u.job_title), TopContributorCTE AS (SELECT category_id, MAX(change_count) AS max_change_count FROM TopUsersCTE GROUP BY category_id) SELECT pc.category_id, pc.name, pc.description, cp.total_sales_volume, cp.total_revenue, cp.average_customer_engagement, COALESCE(p.promotion_count, 0) AS promotion_count, p.promotion_details, lmt.market_trend, tu.username, tu.job_title, tu.change_count FROM product_categories AS pc LEFT JOIN CategoryPerformanceCTE AS cp ON pc.category_id = cp.category_id LEFT JOIN PromotionCTE AS p ON pc.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN LatestMarketTrendCTE AS lmt ON pc.category_id = lmt.category_id LEFT JOIN TopUsersCTE AS tu ON pc.category_id = tu.category_id AND tu.change_count = (SELECT max_change_count FROM TopContributorCTE WHERE category_id = pc.category_id) ORDER BY cp.total_revenue DESC

WITH HighAlertCases AS (SELECT c.case_id, COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count FROM cases AS c LEFT JOIN alerts AS a ON c.case_id = a.case_id GROUP BY c.case_id HAVING COUNT(a.alert_id) > 3), CaseStatusHistory AS (SELECT h.case_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(h.previous_status, ' -> ', h.current_status) SEPARATOR ', ') AS status_changes FROM case_history AS h GROUP BY h.case_id), CaseLocations AS (SELECT l.case_id, GROUP_CONCAT(l.city SEPARATOR ', ') AS cities, GROUP_CONCAT(l.postcode SEPARATOR ', ') AS postcodes, GROUP_CONCAT(l.address SEPARATOR ', ') AS addresses FROM locations AS l GROUP BY l.case_id) SELECT hc.case_id, hc.alert_count, csh.status_changes, cl.cities, cl.postcodes, cl.addresses FROM HighAlertCases AS hc JOIN CaseStatusHistory AS csh ON hc.case_id = csh.case_id JOIN CaseLocations AS cl ON hc.case_id = cl.case_id ORDER BY hc.alert_count DESC

SELECT t.trade_date, GROUP_CONCAT(t.transaction_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS transaction_types FROM transactions AS t INNER JOIN clients AS c ON t.client_internal = c.client_id WHERE c.client_name = 'John Doe' AND t.status = 'completed' GROUP BY t.trade_date HAVING COUNT(t.txn_id) > 1

WITH DailyTraffic AS (SELECT site_id, SUM(total_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(collection_date AS DATETIME), '%H')) AS hours_count FROM traffic_data WHERE DATE(collection_date) = '2018-08-31' GROUP BY site_id), SiteStats AS (SELECT dt.site_id, dt.total_vehicles, dt.hours_count, dt.total_vehicles / dt.hours_count AS avg_vehicles_per_hour, MAX(dt.total_vehicles) OVER () AS max_total, MIN(dt.total_vehicles) OVER () AS min_total FROM DailyTraffic AS dt) SELECT ms.site_name, ms.location, ss.total_vehicles, ss.avg_vehicles_per_hour, CASE WHEN ss.total_vehicles = ss.max_total THEN 'Highest' WHEN ss.total_vehicles = ss.min_total THEN 'Lowest' ELSE 'Average' END AS traffic_volume_rank FROM SiteStats AS ss JOIN monitoring_sites AS ms ON ss.site_id = ms.site_id ORDER BY ss.total_vehicles DESC
SELECT item_id, description, price FROM clothing_items WHERE availability = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(date_added AS DATETIME), '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST('now' AS DATETIME), '%Y') ORDER BY price ASC

WITH ProductOrderCTE AS (SELECT o.product_id, p.product_name, DATE(o.order_date) AS order_date, oi.quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.order_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY oi.quantity DESC) AS row_num, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id) AS total_orders, SUM(oi.quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.order_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m')) AS total_quantity, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(o.order_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY oi.quantity DESC) AS cum_dist FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN brands AS b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id WHERE b.brand_name = 'The North Face') SELECT DISTINCT product_name FROM ProductOrderCTE WHERE total_orders >= 2 AND cum_dist > 0.5 AND row_num = 1

WITH ArticleInfluence AS (SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.doi, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.author_id) AS author_count, SUM(c.citation_count) AS total_citations, (SUM(c.citation_count) / COUNT(DISTINCT aa.author_id)) AS influence_score FROM articles AS a LEFT JOIN article_authors AS aa ON a.article_id = aa.article_id LEFT JOIN citations AS c ON a.article_id = c.article_id GROUP BY a.article_id, a.title, a.doi), RankedArticles AS (SELECT article_id, title, doi, author_count, total_citations, influence_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY influence_score DESC) AS influence_rank FROM ArticleInfluence) SELECT title FROM RankedArticles WHERE influence_rank <= 3

SELECT CONCAT(c.country_name, ', Region: ', r.region_name, ', Official Languages: ', GROUP_CONCAT(l.language_name SEPARATOR ', ')) AS country_region_languages FROM countries AS c JOIN country_regions AS cr ON c.country_id = cr.country_id JOIN regions AS r ON cr.region_id = r.region_id JOIN languages AS l ON c.country_id = l.country_id WHERE l.is_official = 1 AND l.percentage_speakers > 0.8 GROUP BY c.country_name, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(l.language_id) > 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(completion_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_requests, MIN(request_date) AS first_request_date FROM barcode_generation_requests WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(completion_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

WITH RECURSIVE split_corrected_text AS (SELECT c.sample_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING(c.corrected_text, 1, LOCATE(' ', CONCAT(c.corrected_text, ' ')) - 1)) AS word, SUBSTRING(c.corrected_text, LOCATE(' ', CONCAT(c.corrected_text, ' ')) + 1) AS remaining_text FROM corrections AS c JOIN users AS u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.role = 'Analyst' UNION ALL SELECT sample_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING(remaining_text, 1, LOCATE(' ', CONCAT(remaining_text, ' ')) - 1)) AS word, SUBSTRING(remaining_text, LOCATE(' ', CONCAT(remaining_text, ' ')) + 1) AS remaining_text FROM split_corrected_text WHERE remaining_text <> ''), word_counts AS (SELECT word, COUNT(*) AS word_count FROM split_corrected_text WHERE word <> '' GROUP BY word) SELECT word, word_count FROM word_counts ORDER BY word_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH TotalSalesByRegion AS (SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.total) AS total_sales FROM orders AS o JOIN regions AS r ON o.shipping_address LIKE CONCAT('%', r.region_name) GROUP BY r.region_name), AverageSales AS (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM TotalSalesByRegion) SELECT tsr.region_name FROM TotalSalesByRegion AS tsr, AverageSales AS asr WHERE tsr.total_sales > asr.avg_sales ORDER BY tsr.region_name

WITH SoukousUsers AS (SELECT user_id FROM user_preferences WHERE preferred_genre = 'Soukous'), LikedArtists AS (SELECT user_id, TRIM(SUBSTRING(liked_artists, 1 + (LENGTH(liked_artists) - LENGTH(REPLACE(liked_artists, ',', '')) * LENGTH(',')), LENGTH(liked_artists))) AS artist_name FROM user_preferences WHERE preferred_genre = 'Soukous'), SuitableTracks AS (SELECT t.track_id FROM tracks AS t INNER JOIN artists AS a ON t.artist_id = a.artist_id INNER JOIN LikedArtists AS la ON a.artist_name = la.artist_name INNER JOIN user_preferences AS up ON la.user_id = up.user_id WHERE t.tempo BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_tempo_range, 1, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_tempo_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_tempo_range, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_tempo_range) + 1) AS FLOAT) AND t.loudness BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_loudness_range, 1, LOCATE(' to ', up.preferred_loudness_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_loudness_range, LOCATE(' to ', up.preferred_loudness_range) + 4) AS FLOAT)), UserTrackRatings AS (SELECT tr.user_id, AVG(tr.rating) AS avg_rating FROM track_ratings AS tr INNER JOIN SuitableTracks AS st ON tr.track_id = st.track_id GROUP BY tr.user_id) SELECT u.username, utr.avg_rating FROM users AS u INNER JOIN SoukousUsers AS su ON u.user_id = su.user_id INNER JOIN UserTrackRatings AS utr ON u.user_id = utr.user_id ORDER BY utr.avg_rating DESC, u.username

WITH StockAccessLog AS (SELECT al.user_id, al.access_type, COUNT(*) AS access_count FROM access_logs AS al JOIN stocks AS s ON al.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE s.stock_symbol = 'AAPL' GROUP BY al.user_id, al.access_type) SELECT sal.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sal.access_type, ': ', sal.access_count) SEPARATOR ', ') AS access_counts FROM StockAccessLog AS sal GROUP BY sal.user_id

SELECT users.username, GROUP_CONCAT(projects.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS project_names FROM users JOIN project_collaborators ON users.id = project_collaborators.user_id JOIN projects ON project_collaborators.project_id = projects.id GROUP BY users.username

WITH AwardWinningMovies AS (SELECT a.movie_id, m.title, m.year, m.director_id FROM awards AS a JOIN movies AS m ON a.movie_id = m.movie_id WHERE a.award_name = 'Academy Award'), MovieDirectors AS (SELECT am.movie_id, d.director_name FROM AwardWinningMovies AS am JOIN directors AS d ON am.director_id = d.director_id), MovieWriters AS (SELECT am.movie_id, w.writer_name, mw.writing_credit FROM AwardWinningMovies AS am JOIN movie_writers AS mw ON am.movie_id = mw.movie_id JOIN writers AS w ON mw.writer_id = w.writer_id), UserRatings AS (SELECT ur.movie_id, AVG(ur.rating_value) AS avg_user_rating FROM user_ratings AS ur GROUP BY ur.movie_id), ProfessionalRatings AS (SELECT r.movie_id, AVG(r.rating_value) AS avg_professional_rating FROM ratings AS r GROUP BY r.movie_id), ReviewCounts AS (SELECT r.movie_id, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count FROM reviews AS r GROUP BY r.movie_id) SELECT am.title, am.year, md.director_name, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(mw.writer_name, ' (', mw.writing_credit, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS writers, ur.avg_user_rating, pr.avg_professional_rating, rc.review_count FROM AwardWinningMovies AS am JOIN MovieDirectors AS md ON am.movie_id = md.movie_id JOIN MovieWriters AS mw ON am.movie_id = mw.movie_id JOIN UserRatings AS ur ON am.movie_id = ur.movie_id JOIN ProfessionalRatings AS pr ON am.movie_id = pr.movie_id JOIN ReviewCounts AS rc ON am.movie_id = rc.movie_id GROUP BY am.movie_id, am.title, am.year, md.director_name, ur.avg_user_rating, pr.avg_professional_rating, rc.review_count ORDER BY am.year, am.title

WITH ApplicationDetails AS (SELECT la.application_id, a.full_name, lt.loan_type_name, la.application_date, la.purpose, la.status, lo.full_name AS loan_officer_name, MAX(lr.review_date) AS last_review_date, MAX(lr.status) AS last_review_status, MAX(lr.notes) AS last_review_notes FROM loan_applications AS la JOIN applicants AS a ON la.applicant_id = a.applicant_id JOIN loan_types AS lt ON la.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id JOIN loan_officers AS lo ON la.loan_officer_id = lo.officer_id LEFT JOIN application_reviews AS lr ON la.application_id = lr.application_id GROUP BY la.application_id, a.full_name, lt.loan_type_name, la.application_date, la.purpose, la.status, lo.full_name) SELECT application_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('Application ID: ', application_id, ' | ', 'Applicant: ', full_name, ' | ', 'Loan Type: ', loan_type_name, ' | ', 'Application Date: ', application_date, ' | ', 'Purpose: ', purpose, ' | ', 'Status: ', status, ' | ', 'Loan Officer: ', loan_officer_name, ' | ', 'Last Review: ', COALESCE(last_review_date, 'N/A'), ' | ', 'Review Status: ', COALESCE(last_review_status, 'N/A'), ' | ', 'Review Notes: ', COALESCE(last_review_notes, 'N/A')) SEPARATOR ',') AS application_details FROM ApplicationDetails GROUP BY application_id

WITH ProviderPatientData AS (SELECT hp.provider_id, hp.provider_name, hp.location, pp.patient_id, dp.confidence_score, dp.actual_diabetes FROM healthcare_providers AS hp INNER JOIN patients_providers AS pp ON hp.provider_id = pp.provider_id INNER JOIN diabetes_predictions AS dp ON pp.patient_id = dp.patient_id WHERE dp.predicted_on >= '2022-01-01'), ProviderPerformance AS (SELECT provider_id, provider_name, location, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total_patients, SUM(CASE WHEN actual_diabetes = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diabetic_patients, AVG(confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score, SUM(CASE WHEN actual_diabetes = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS actual_diabetes_rate FROM ProviderPatientData GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name, location), RankedProviders AS (SELECT provider_id, provider_name, location, total_patients, diabetic_patients, avg_confidence_score, actual_diabetes_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_patients DESC, avg_confidence_score DESC) AS provider_rank FROM ProviderPerformance) SELECT provider_id, provider_name, location, total_patients, diabetic_patients, avg_confidence_score, actual_diabetes_rate, CONCAT('Rank: ', CAST(provider_rank AS CHAR)) AS provider_rank_info FROM RankedProviders WHERE provider_rank <= 10 ORDER BY provider_rank

SELECT p.team, s.season_name, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(p.salary, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS average_salary FROM players AS p CROSS JOIN seasons AS s WHERE p.position = 'forward' AND s.season_name IN ('2021-2022', '2022-2023') AND p.draft_year BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(s.season_name, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) - 1 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(s.season_name, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) + 1 GROUP BY p.team, s.season_name HAVING AVG(CAST(REPLACE(p.salary, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) > 4000000

WITH UsageRankCTE AS (SELECT iu.usage_id, iu.instrument_id, iu.department_id, iu.operator_name, iu.usage_duration, d.department_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iu.department_id ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(iu.usage_duration, 1, LOCATE(' ', iu.usage_duration) - 1) AS FLOAT) DESC) AS usage_rank FROM instrument_usage AS iu INNER JOIN departments AS d ON iu.department_id = d.department_id) SELECT ur.operator_name, ur.department_name FROM UsageRankCTE AS ur WHERE ur.usage_rank = 1 ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(ur.usage_duration, 1, LOCATE(' ', ur.usage_duration) - 1) AS FLOAT) DESC LIMIT 2

WITH AnomalyDetails AS (SELECT a.run_id, a.anomaly_type, v.config_name FROM anomalies AS a JOIN test_runs AS tr ON a.run_id = tr.run_id JOIN vehicle_configurations AS v ON tr.vehicle_config_id = v.config_id) SELECT tr.run_id AS RunID, ad.config_name AS VehicleConfiguration, GROUP_CONCAT(ad.anomaly_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS AnomalyTypes FROM test_runs AS tr JOIN AnomalyDetails AS ad ON tr.run_id = ad.run_id GROUP BY tr.run_id, ad.config_name HAVING COUNT(ad.anomaly_type) > 1 ORDER BY tr.run_id

SELECT AVG(efi.overall_score) AS average_efi_score FROM countries AS c INNER JOIN economic_freedom_indices AS efi ON c.country_id = efi.country_id WHERE c.continent = 'Europe' AND CAST(REPLACE(c.population, ',', '') AS SIGNED) > 1000000 GROUP BY c.country_id HAVING AVG(efi.overall_score) > 60

WITH CountyOutbreaks AS (SELECT county_id, MAX(number_outbreaks) AS max_outbreaks, MAX(date_last_outbreak) AS last_outbreak_date FROM outbreaks GROUP BY county_id), CountyCovidData AS (SELECT county_id, SUM(positive_cases) AS total_positive_cases, AVG(rate_per_100000) AS avg_rate_per_100000 FROM covid_data GROUP BY county_id), CountyBasics AS (SELECT county_id, population_density, median_age, county_name FROM counties) SELECT cb.county_name, co.max_outbreaks, co.last_outbreak_date, ccd.total_positive_cases, ccd.avg_rate_per_100000, cb.population_density, cb.median_age, GREATEST(ccd.avg_rate_per_100000, cb.population_density) AS max_metric FROM CountyOutbreaks AS co JOIN CountyCovidData AS ccd ON co.county_id = ccd.county_id JOIN CountyBasics AS cb ON co.county_id = cb.county_id ORDER BY cb.county_name

WITH StoreOperations AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, fr.franchise_name, o.opening_hours, o.closing_hours, o.days_open FROM stores AS s LEFT JOIN store_franchises AS sf ON s.store_id = sf.store_id LEFT JOIN franchises AS fr ON sf.franchise_id = fr.franchise_id LEFT JOIN operations AS o ON s.store_id = o.store_id), SalesSummary AS (SELECT ss.store_id, SUM(ss.quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(ss.total_amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(ss.sale_id) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.quantity_sold) AS avg_quantity_sold, AVG(ss.total_amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM sales AS ss GROUP BY ss.store_id), FeedbackSummary AS (SELECT f.store_id, COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS total_feedback, AVG(f.rating) AS average_feedback_rating FROM feedback AS f GROUP BY f.store_id), StoreAnalysis AS (SELECT so.store_id, so.store_name, so.franchise_name, so.opening_hours, so.closing_hours, so.days_open, ss.total_quantity_sold, ss.total_sales_amount, ss.total_sales, ss.avg_quantity_sold, ss.avg_sales_amount, fb.total_feedback, fb.average_feedback_rating FROM StoreOperations AS so LEFT JOIN SalesSummary AS ss ON so.store_id = ss.store_id LEFT JOIN FeedbackSummary AS fb ON so.store_id = fb.store_id), FinalSummary AS (SELECT sa.store_name, sa.franchise_name, sa.opening_hours, sa.closing_hours, sa.days_open, sa.total_quantity_sold, sa.total_sales_amount, sa.total_sales, sa.avg_quantity_sold, sa.avg_sales_amount, sa.total_feedback, sa.average_feedback_rating, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_feedback) AS feedback_quartile FROM StoreAnalysis AS sa) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(store_name, ', ', franchise_name, ', ', opening_hours, ' - ', closing_hours, ', ', days_open, ', ', total_quantity_sold, ', ', total_sales_amount, ', ', total_sales, ', ', avg_quantity_sold, ', ', avg_sales_amount, ', ', total_feedback, ', ', average_feedback_rating, ', ', sales_rank, ', ', feedback_quartile) SEPARATOR ',') AS report FROM FinalSummary

WITH FacultySpring2017 AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.faculty_name FROM course_sections_faculties AS csf JOIN faculties AS f ON csf.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN course_sections AS c ON csf.section_id = c.section_id JOIN sessions AS s ON c.semester = s.session_name AND c.year = CAST(SUBSTRING(s.start_date, 6, 4) AS SIGNED) WHERE s.session_name = 'Spring 2017'), FacultyAfterSpring2017 AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.faculty_name FROM course_sections_faculties AS csf JOIN faculties AS f ON csf.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN course_sections AS c ON csf.section_id = c.section_id JOIN sessions AS s ON c.semester = s.session_name AND c.year = CAST(SUBSTRING(s.start_date, 6, 4) AS SIGNED) WHERE s.session_name <> 'Spring 2017' AND s.start_date > (SELECT start_date FROM sessions WHERE session_name = 'Spring 2017')) SELECT fs.faculty_name FROM FacultySpring2017 AS fs JOIN FacultyAfterSpring2017 AS fa ON fs.faculty_name = fa.faculty_name

WITH ProductReviews AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN r.review_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(r.review_id) * 100 AS positive_review_percentage, p.brand_id, p.category_id FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN reviews AS r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand_id, p.category_id), StockLevels AS (SELECT i.product_id, i.stock_quantity, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY i.stock_quantity) AS stock_quartile FROM inventory AS i), ProductAnalysis AS (SELECT pr.product_id, pr.product_name, pr.average_rating, pr.review_count, pr.positive_review_percentage, sl.stock_quantity, sl.stock_quartile, b.brand_name, c.category_name FROM ProductReviews AS pr INNER JOIN StockLevels AS sl ON pr.product_id = sl.product_id INNER JOIN brands AS b ON pr.brand_id = b.brand_id INNER JOIN categories AS c ON pr.category_id = c.category_id) SELECT pa.product_name, pa.average_rating, pa.review_count, pa.positive_review_percentage, pa.stock_quantity, pa.stock_quartile, pa.brand_name, pa.category_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.stock_quartile ORDER BY pa.average_rating DESC) AS rank_within_quartile FROM ProductAnalysis AS pa ORDER BY pa.stock_quartile, rank_within_quartile

WITH MonthlyTraffic AS (SELECT site_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(collection_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_vehicle_count) AS total_monthly_traffic FROM traffic_data GROUP BY site_id, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(collection_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m')), MonthlyTrafficWithPrevious AS (SELECT mt.month, mt.site_id, mt.total_monthly_traffic, LAG(mt.total_monthly_traffic, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY mt.site_id ORDER BY mt.month) AS previous_monthly_traffic FROM MonthlyTraffic AS mt), MonthlyTrafficChange AS (SELECT mtwp.month, mtwp.site_id, ms.site_name, ms.location, mtwp.total_monthly_traffic, mtwp.previous_monthly_traffic, ((mtwp.total_monthly_traffic - mtwp.previous_monthly_traffic) * 100.0 / mtwp.previous_monthly_traffic) AS percentage_change FROM MonthlyTrafficWithPrevious AS mtwp INNER JOIN monitoring_sites AS ms ON mtwp.site_id = ms.site_id WHERE NOT mtwp.previous_monthly_traffic IS NULL) SELECT mtc.month, mtc.site_name, mtc.location, mtc.percentage_change FROM MonthlyTrafficChange AS mtc ORDER BY mtc.site_name, mtc.month
