SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(tr.actual_result, 1, LOCATE('°C', tr.actual_result) - 1) AS FLOAT)) AS average_temperature FROM test_results AS tr JOIN quality_tests AS qt ON tr.test_id = qt.test_id JOIN users AS u ON qt.test_conducted_by = u.user_id WHERE u.user_name = 'John Doe' AND tr.actual_result LIKE '%°C' GROUP BY qt.test_conducted_by HAVING COUNT(tr.result_id) > 1

WITH RECURSIVE EventTypesHierarchy AS (SELECT type_id, type_name, description, parent_type_id, 1 AS level FROM event_types WHERE parent_type_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT et.type_id, et.type_name, et.description, et.parent_type_id, eht.level + 1 FROM event_types AS et INNER JOIN EventTypesHierarchy AS eht ON et.parent_type_id = eht.type_id), EventTypesCTE AS (SELECT et.type_id, et.type_name, et.description, eht.level FROM event_types AS et LEFT JOIN EventTypesHierarchy AS eht ON et.type_id = eht.type_id), IndividualsCTE AS (SELECT ei.event_id, i.individual_id, i.name, ei.role, ei.role_description FROM event_individual AS ei INNER JOIN individuals AS i ON ei.individual_id = i.individual_id), MediaCTE AS (SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(i.image_id) AS image_count, COUNT(v.video_id) AS video_count, COUNT(a.audio_id) AS audio_count FROM events AS e LEFT JOIN images AS i ON e.event_id = i.event_id LEFT JOIN videos AS v ON e.event_id = v.event_id LEFT JOIN audio AS a ON e.event_id = a.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id), MediaRollupCTE AS (SELECT m.event_id, m.image_count, m.video_count, m.audio_count, SUM(m.image_count) OVER (ORDER BY m.event_id) AS cumulative_image_count, SUM(m.video_count) OVER (ORDER BY m.event_id) AS cumulative_video_count, SUM(m.audio_count) OVER (ORDER BY m.event_id) AS cumulative_audio_count FROM MediaCTE AS m), EventDetailsCTE AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.name, et.type_name, GROUP_CONCAT(i.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS involved_individuals FROM events AS e INNER JOIN event_event_type AS eet ON e.event_id = eet.event_id INNER JOIN EventTypesCTE AS et ON eet.type_id = et.type_id INNER JOIN IndividualsCTE AS i ON e.event_id = i.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name, et.type_name) SELECT ed.event_id, ed.name, ed.type_name, ed.involved_individuals, mr.image_count, mr.video_count, mr.audio_count, mr.cumulative_image_count, mr.cumulative_video_count, mr.cumulative_audio_count FROM EventDetailsCTE AS ed INNER JOIN MediaRollupCTE AS mr ON ed.event_id = mr.event_id ORDER BY ed.event_id

WITH ResearchersCTE AS (SELECT u.user_name, qt.quality_parameter FROM quality_tests AS qt INNER JOIN users AS u ON qt.test_conducted_by = u.user_id WHERE qt.research_conducted = 'Experiment 2') SELECT user_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT quality_parameter SEPARATOR ',') AS quality_parameters FROM ResearchersCTE GROUP BY user_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT quality_parameter) > 1 ORDER BY user_name

WITH SeizureICURecords AS (SELECT ir.patient_id, ir.sz_num AS number_of_seizures, ir.mean_sz_len AS mean_seizure_length, p.age, p.sex, p.ethnicity FROM icu_records AS ir INNER JOIN patients AS p ON ir.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE ir.sz_presence = 1), PatientMedications AS (SELECT pm.patient_id, m.medication_name FROM patient_medications AS pm INNER JOIN medications AS m ON pm.medication_id = m.medication_id) SELECT sir.patient_id, sir.age, sir.sex, sir.ethnicity, sir.number_of_seizures, sir.mean_seizure_length, GROUP_CONCAT(pm.medication_name SEPARATOR ',') AS prescribed_medications FROM SeizureICURecords AS sir LEFT JOIN PatientMedications AS pm ON sir.patient_id = pm.patient_id GROUP BY sir.patient_id, sir.age, sir.sex, sir.ethnicity, sir.number_of_seizures, sir.mean_seizure_length ORDER BY sir.patient_id

SELECT s.stock_symbol, AVG(CAST(sd.volume_weighted_average_price AS FLOAT)) AS avg_vwap FROM stocks AS s JOIN stock_data AS sd ON s.stock_id = sd.stock_id GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.stock_symbol HAVING SUM(CAST(sd.volume AS SIGNED)) > 1000000 ORDER BY avg_vwap DESC

WITH TransferredManagers AS (SELECT dh.emp_id, dh.change_date, dh.previous_dept_id, dh.dept_id AS new_dept_id, e.salary AS current_salary, e2.salary AS previous_salary FROM dept_history AS dh JOIN employees AS e ON dh.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN employees AS e2 ON dh.emp_id = e2.emp_id AND dh.previous_dept_id = e2.dept_id WHERE dh.change_type = 'transfer'), SalaryIncreaseManagers AS (SELECT tm.emp_id, tm.current_salary, tm.previous_salary FROM TransferredManagers AS tm JOIN employees AS e ON tm.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN employee_roles AS er ON e.emp_id = er.emp_id JOIN user_roles AS ur ON er.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.role_name = 'Manager' AND CAST(tm.current_salary AS SIGNED) > CAST(tm.previous_salary AS SIGNED)) SELECT e.emp_name, sim.current_salary, ur.role_name FROM SalaryIncreaseManagers AS sim JOIN employees AS e ON sim.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN employee_roles AS er ON sim.emp_id = er.emp_id JOIN user_roles AS ur ON er.role_id = ur.role_id

WITH ToxicEngagements AS (SELECT ue.user_id, ue.comment_id, ue.is_positive FROM user_engagements AS ue JOIN comments AS c ON ue.comment_id = c.comment_id WHERE ue.is_positive = 1 AND c.is_toxic = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(ue.engagement_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023'), UserEngagementCounts AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_positive_engagements FROM ToxicEngagements GROUP BY user_id) SELECT u.username, uec.total_positive_engagements, te.comment_id FROM UserEngagementCounts AS uec JOIN ToxicEngagements AS te ON uec.user_id = te.user_id JOIN users AS u ON te.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY uec.total_positive_engagements DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(discovery_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') AS discovery_year, COUNT(exoplanet_id) AS exoplanet_count FROM discovery_details GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(discovery_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') ORDER BY discovery_year ASC

SELECT CONCAT(sp.first_name, ' ', sp.last_name) AS salesperson_name, SUM(sd.sales_amount) AS total_sales FROM sales_data AS sd INNER JOIN salespeople AS sp ON sd.salesperson_id = sp.salesperson_id INNER JOIN makers AS m ON sd.maker = m.maker_name WHERE sd.category1 = 'Electronics' AND m.maker_name = 'Nanase' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(sd.sale_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2017' GROUP BY sp.first_name, sp.last_name HAVING SUM(sd.sales_amount) > 10000
SELECT pin_name, `signal` FROM gpio_pins

SELECT s.state_name, AVG(hd.active_cases) AS average_active_cases FROM health_data AS hd INNER JOIN states AS s ON hd.state_id = s.state_id WHERE hd.total_confirmed > 1000 AND CAST(REPLACE(hd.vaccination_rate, '%', '') AS FLOAT) < 50 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(hd.date_recorded AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2021' GROUP BY s.state_name HAVING AVG(hd.active_cases) > 100

SELECT SUM(group_attack_count) AS total_attacks FROM (SELECT COUNT(a.attack_id) AS group_attack_count FROM attacks AS a INNER JOIN `groups` AS g ON a.group_id = g.group_id GROUP BY g.group_id HAVING COUNT(a.attack_id) > 1) AS subquery

WITH ActiveUsers AS (SELECT usrkeypk, username FROM users WHERE is_active = 1), UsersWithReadPermission AS (SELECT pa.usrkeypk FROM permission_assignments AS pa INNER JOIN permissions AS p ON pa.permissionpk = p.permissionpk WHERE p.name = 'Read' AND pa.is_active = 1), UsersInAdminGroup AS (SELECT gm.usrkeypk FROM group_memberships AS gm INNER JOIN `groups` AS g ON gm.grpkeypk = g.grpkeypk WHERE g.name = 'Admin' AND gm.is_active = 1), UsersInProject1 AS (SELECT pm.usrkeypk FROM project_memberships AS pm INNER JOIN projects AS p ON pm.projectno = p.projectno WHERE p.name = 'Project 1' AND pm.is_active = 1), UsersWithActiveLicense AS (SELECT la.usrkeypk FROM license_assignments AS la INNER JOIN licenses AS l ON la.license_id = l.license_id WHERE l.is_active = 1 AND la.is_active = 1), UsersInAnyActiveProject AS (SELECT pm.usrkeypk FROM project_memberships AS pm INNER JOIN projects AS p ON pm.projectno = p.projectno WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND pm.is_active = 1) SELECT au.username FROM ActiveUsers AS au INNER JOIN UsersWithReadPermission AS urp ON au.usrkeypk = urp.usrkeypk INNER JOIN UsersInAdminGroup AS uag ON au.usrkeypk = uag.usrkeypk INNER JOIN UsersInProject1 AS uip ON au.usrkeypk = uip.usrkeypk INNER JOIN UsersWithActiveLicense AS ual ON au.usrkeypk = ual.usrkeypk INNER JOIN UsersInAnyActiveProject AS uap ON au.usrkeypk = uap.usrkeypk

SELECT a.age_range, c.country_name, COUNT(r.registration_id) AS total_registrations, AVG(COUNT(r.registration_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.age_range, c.country_name) AS average_registrations, a.description FROM analytics AS an INNER JOIN ages AS a ON an.age_id = a.age_id INNER JOIN countries AS c ON an.country_id = c.country_id INNER JOIN registrations AS r ON an.individual_id = r.individual_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.registration_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2017' AND a.age_range IN ('25-34', '35-44') GROUP BY a.age_range, c.country_name, a.description HAVING COUNT(r.registration_id) > 100 ORDER BY a.age_range, c.country_name

WITH AnalyzedMetabolites AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.metabolite_id FROM metabolites AS m INNER JOIN modifications AS `mod` ON m.metabolite_id = `mod`.metabolite_id INNER JOIN analytical_results AS ar ON `mod`.modification_id = ar.modification_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT metabolite_id) AS total_analyzed_metabolites FROM AnalyzedMetabolites

SELECT s.season_name, AVG(uf.rating) AS average_sentiment FROM user_feedback AS uf JOIN seasons AS s ON (DATE_FORMAT(CAST(uf.feedback_date AS DATETIME), '%m') BETWEEN '01' AND '03' AND s.season_name = 'Spring') OR (DATE_FORMAT(CAST(uf.feedback_date AS DATETIME), '%m') BETWEEN '04' AND '06' AND s.season_name = 'Summer') OR (DATE_FORMAT(CAST(uf.feedback_date AS DATETIME), '%m') BETWEEN '07' AND '09' AND s.season_name = 'Autumn') OR (DATE_FORMAT(CAST(uf.feedback_date AS DATETIME), '%m') BETWEEN '10' AND '12' AND s.season_name = 'Winter') GROUP BY s.season_name HAVING COUNT(uf.feedback_id) >= 2

WITH ConfigurationDetails AS (SELECT c.config_id, c.config_version, c.created_date, c.last_modified_date, c.build_environment, u.username AS created_by_username, u2.username AS last_modified_by_username, f.file_name, f.file_path FROM configurations AS c JOIN users AS u ON c.created_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN users AS u2 ON c.last_modified_by = u2.user_id JOIN files AS f ON c.file_id = f.file_id), VersionHistory AS (SELECT v.config_id, MAX(CAST(v.version_number AS SIGNED)) AS latest_version_number, MAX(v.change_date) AS latest_change_date FROM version_history AS v GROUP BY v.config_id), BuildLogDetails AS (SELECT bl.config_id, MAX(bl.build_date) AS latest_build_date, MAX(bl.build_status) AS latest_build_status, MAX(bl.message) AS latest_build_message, MAX(bl.build_duration) AS latest_build_duration FROM build_logs AS bl GROUP BY bl.config_id), UserPermissions AS (SELECT p.config_id, COUNT(p.permission_id) AS permission_count, MAX(CASE WHEN p.can_edit = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS can_edit, MAX(CASE WHEN p.can_view = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS can_view FROM user_permissions AS p GROUP BY p.config_id), DependencyCounts AS (SELECT d.config_id, COUNT(d.dependency_id) AS dependency_count FROM dependencies AS d GROUP BY d.config_id) SELECT cd.config_id, cd.config_version, cd.created_date, cd.last_modified_date, cd.build_environment, cd.created_by_username, cd.last_modified_by_username, cd.file_name, cd.file_path, vh.latest_version_number, vh.latest_change_date, bl.latest_build_date, bl.latest_build_status, bl.latest_build_message, bl.latest_build_duration, up.permission_count, up.can_edit, up.can_view, dc.dependency_count, CASE WHEN bl.latest_build_status = 'Success' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS configuration_status FROM ConfigurationDetails AS cd LEFT JOIN VersionHistory AS vh ON cd.config_id = vh.config_id LEFT JOIN BuildLogDetails AS bl ON cd.config_id = bl.config_id LEFT JOIN UserPermissions AS up ON cd.config_id = up.config_id LEFT JOIN DependencyCounts AS dc ON cd.config_id = dc.config_id ORDER BY cd.config_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CAST(dp.created_at AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS creation_month, AVG(dp.float_col) AS avg_float_value FROM data_points AS dp JOIN data_point_types AS dpt ON dp.id = dpt.data_point_id JOIN data_types AS dt ON dpt.type_id = dt.type_id WHERE dt.type_name = 'boolean' AND dp.created_by = 1 AND dp.data_source_id = 1 GROUP BY creation_month HAVING AVG(dp.float_col) > 0.5

WITH SupplierPerformance AS (SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN od.delivery_status = 'Delivered' AND od.expected_delivery_date >= po.order_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_delivered_on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN qc.status = 'Passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS relays_passed_qc, COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_detail_id) AS total_relays FROM suppliers AS s LEFT JOIN purchase_orders AS po ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id LEFT JOIN order_details AS od ON po.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN quality_control AS qc ON od.relay_id = qc.relay_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name) SELECT supplier_name, total_orders, CAST(orders_delivered_on_time AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_orders AS on_time_delivery_percentage, CAST(relays_passed_qc AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_relays AS qc_pass_percentage FROM SupplierPerformance ORDER BY on_time_delivery_percentage DESC, qc_pass_percentage DESC

SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count, GROUP_CONCAT(a.ip_address SEPARATOR ', ') AS ip_addresses FROM users AS u JOIN access_logs AS a ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.instrument_id IN (SELECT counterparty_id FROM counterparties) GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name

WITH ClientUnitsCTE AS (SELECT u.current_client_id, c.client_name, COUNT(u.unit_id) AS unit_count, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(u.unit_number, ' - ', u.status) SEPARATOR ', ') AS unit_details FROM units AS u INNER JOIN clients AS c ON u.current_client_id = c.client_id WHERE u.status = 'in transit' GROUP BY u.current_client_id, c.client_name), RankedClientsCTE AS (SELECT current_client_id, client_name, unit_count, unit_details, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unit_count DESC) AS client_rank FROM ClientUnitsCTE) SELECT client_name, unit_count, unit_details FROM RankedClientsCTE WHERE client_rank <= 3

WITH ChurnedCustomers AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ch.churn_date FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN churn AS ch ON c.customer_id = ch.customer_id WHERE ch.has_churned = 1), FinancialImpact AS (SELECT cc.customer_id, SUM(b.total_charge) AS total_churned_revenue FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cc INNER JOIN bills AS b ON cc.customer_id = b.customer_id WHERE b.bill_date <= cc.churn_date GROUP BY cc.customer_id), ServiceImpact AS (SELECT cc.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.service_id) AS total_services, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cc LEFT JOIN customer_services AS cs ON cc.customer_id = cs.customer_id LEFT JOIN `usage` AS u ON cc.customer_id = u.customer_id AND cs.service_id = u.service_id GROUP BY cc.customer_id) SELECT cc.customer_id, CONCAT(cc.first_name, ' ', cc.last_name) AS full_name, fi.total_churned_revenue, si.total_services FROM ChurnedCustomers AS cc LEFT JOIN FinancialImpact AS fi ON cc.customer_id = fi.customer_id LEFT JOIN ServiceImpact AS si ON cc.customer_id = si.customer_id ORDER BY fi.total_churned_revenue DESC, si.total_services DESC

WITH RankedStations AS (SELECT w.date, w.station_id, w.precipitation, st.station_name, w.category_id, SUM(w.precipitation) OVER (PARTITION BY w.date) AS total_daily_precipitation, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.date ORDER BY w.precipitation DESC) AS precipitation_rank FROM weather_data AS w INNER JOIN weather_stations AS st ON w.station_id = st.station_id), TopPrecipitation AS (SELECT rs.date, rs.station_id, rs.precipitation, rs.station_name, rs.category_id, rs.total_daily_precipitation FROM RankedStations AS rs WHERE rs.precipitation_rank = 1) SELECT tp.date, tp.station_name, tp.precipitation, tp.total_daily_precipitation, (tp.precipitation * 100.0 / tp.total_daily_precipitation) AS percentage_contribution, wdc.category_name FROM TopPrecipitation AS tp INNER JOIN weather_data_categories AS wdc ON tp.category_id = wdc.category_id ORDER BY tp.date DESC

SELECT e.name AS pathogen_name, `of`.factor_description AS contributing_factor FROM outbreaks AS o INNER JOIN etiologies AS e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id INNER JOIN outbreak_factors AS `of` ON o.outbreak_id = `of`.outbreak_id INNER JOIN interventions AS i ON i.outbreak_id = o.outbreak_id INNER JOIN outbreak_reports AS ors ON ors.outbreak_id = o.outbreak_id WHERE i.intervention_type = 'Public Warning' AND ors.agency_id = 0 AND ors.report_status = 'approved' GROUP BY e.name, `of`.factor_description HAVING COUNT(o.outbreak_id) > 1

WITH ConversationSummary AS (SELECT c.conversation_id, c.conversation_title, COUNT(DISTINCT t.speaker_id) AS num_speakers, AVG(t.sentiment_score) AS avg_sentiment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT al.access_id) AS num_accesses FROM conversations AS c LEFT JOIN turns AS t ON c.conversation_id = t.conversation_id LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON c.conversation_id = al.conversation_id GROUP BY c.conversation_id, c.conversation_title) SELECT CONCAT(conversation_title, ': ', 'Speakers: ', num_speakers, ', ', 'Avg Sentiment Score: ', CAST(avg_sentiment_score AS CHAR), ', ', 'Accesses: ', num_accesses) AS conversation_summary FROM ConversationSummary WHERE num_speakers > 1 AND avg_sentiment_score > 0 AND num_accesses > 0 ORDER BY num_accesses DESC

SELECT s.school_name, AVG(ga.total_attendance) AS average_game_attendance FROM games AS g JOIN game_attendance AS ga ON g.game_id = ga.game_id JOIN schools AS s ON g.school_id = s.school_id WHERE s.conference_id = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(g.game_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY s.school_name HAVING AVG(ga.total_attendance) > 10000

SELECT ut.name AS territory_name, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ul.is_additional = 0 THEN l.name ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS primary_languages, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN ul.is_additional = 1 THEN l.name ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS additional_languages FROM union_territories AS ut JOIN ut_languages AS ul ON ut.ut_id = ul.ut_id JOIN languages AS l ON ul.language_id = l.language_id GROUP BY ut.name

SELECT r.name, r.avg_hours_worked_per_week, r.willing_to_work_extra_hours FROM respondents AS r INNER JOIN `databases` AS d ON r.respondent_id = d.respondent_id WHERE d.`database` = 'Oracle 12c' AND d.proficiency_level = 'Advanced' AND r.willing_to_work_extra = 1 AND r.avg_hours_worked_per_week > 40

WITH RankedAccessLogs AS (SELECT a.destination_ip, u.user_name, db.database_name, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS access_month, a.duration, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m'), db.database_name ORDER BY a.duration DESC) AS duration_rank FROM access_logs AS a INNER JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN `databases` AS db ON a.database_id = db.database_id) SELECT destination_ip, user_name, database_name, access_month, duration FROM RankedAccessLogs WHERE duration_rank <= 3 ORDER BY access_month, database_name, duration DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_respondents FROM respondents AS r JOIN weather_checking_habits AS wch ON r.respondent_id = wch.respondent_id WHERE wch.checks_weather = 'Yes' AND wch.check_method = 'The default weather app on your phone' AND r.us_region = '0' AND r.household_income = '0' AND LOCATE('-', wch.specific_app_or_website) > 0

SELECT r.name, js.satisfaction_level FROM respondents AS r INNER JOIN `databases` AS d ON r.respondent_id = d.respondent_id INNER JOIN job_satisfaction AS js ON r.respondent_id = js.respondent_id WHERE d.`database` = 'Cassandra' AND js.satisfaction_level IN ('Satisfied', 'Most satisfied')

WITH CountryData AS (SELECT r.region_name, d.population, d.gdp, d.urbanization_rate, COUNT(l.language_id) AS num_official_languages FROM countries AS c INNER JOIN country_regions AS cr ON c.country_id = cr.country_id INNER JOIN regions AS r ON cr.region_id = r.region_id INNER JOIN demographics AS d ON c.country_id = d.country_id LEFT JOIN languages AS l ON c.country_id = l.country_id AND l.is_official = 1 GROUP BY r.region_name, d.population, d.gdp, d.urbanization_rate HAVING COUNT(l.language_id) >= 3), RegionAverages AS (SELECT region_name, AVG(gdp) AS avg_gdp, AVG(population) AS avg_population, AVG(urbanization_rate) AS avg_urbanization_rate FROM CountryData GROUP BY region_name) SELECT region_name, CAST(avg_gdp AS FLOAT) AS average_gdp, CAST(avg_population AS SIGNED) AS average_population, CAST(avg_urbanization_rate AS FLOAT) AS average_urbanization_rate FROM RegionAverages

SELECT c.course_name AS `Course Name`, CAST(c.credit_hours AS CHAR) AS `Credit Hours`, d.department_name AS `Department`, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS `Enrolled Students`, CONCAT(i.first_name, ' ', i.last_name) AS `Instructor` FROM courses AS c JOIN departments AS d ON c.department_id = d.department_id JOIN course_schedules AS cs ON c.course_id = cs.course_id JOIN instructors AS i ON cs.instructor_id = i.instructor_id LEFT JOIN course_enrollments AS e ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE c.course_format = 'in-person' GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name, c.department_id, c.credit_hours, d.department_name, i.first_name, i.last_name HAVING COUNT(e.enrollment_id) >= 10 ORDER BY COUNT(e.enrollment_id) DESC

SELECT a.adviser_name, s.student_name, AVG(g.grade) AS average_grade, GROUP_CONCAT(c.course_name SEPARATOR ',') AS courses_taken, MAX(str.difficulty_level) AS highest_struggle_level FROM students AS s INNER JOIN grades AS g ON s.student_id = g.student_id INNER JOIN courses AS c ON g.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN struggle AS str ON s.student_id = str.student_id AND g.course_id = str.course_id INNER JOIN advisers AS a ON s.adviser_id = a.adviser_id WHERE g.grade_type = 'numerical' AND s.enrollment_year >= 2020 GROUP BY a.adviser_name, s.student_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) > 2 ORDER BY average_grade DESC

WITH EconomicData AS (SELECT ei.county_id, ei.median_household_income, ei.median_home_value, ed.high_school_graduation_rate, dd.unemployment_rate FROM economic_indicators AS ei JOIN education_data AS ed ON ei.county_id = ed.county_id AND ei.year = ed.year JOIN demographic_data AS dd ON ei.county_id = dd.county_id AND dd.year = 2020 WHERE ei.year = 2020 AND ed.year = 2020), CombinedData AS (SELECT e.county_id, c.county_name, c.state_name, e.median_household_income, e.median_home_value, e.high_school_graduation_rate, e.unemployment_rate, LEAST(e.high_school_graduation_rate, e.unemployment_rate) AS min_rate, (e.median_home_value - e.median_household_income) * (e.high_school_graduation_rate / 100) AS impact_index FROM EconomicData AS e JOIN counties AS c ON e.county_id = c.county_id), FinalAnalysis AS (SELECT cd.county_name, cd.state_name, cd.min_rate, cd.impact_index FROM CombinedData AS cd) SELECT fa.county_name, fa.state_name, MAX(fa.min_rate) AS max_min_rate, SUM(fa.impact_index) AS total_impact_index FROM FinalAnalysis AS fa GROUP BY fa.county_name, fa.state_name ORDER BY total_impact_index DESC

WITH LatestRankings AS (SELECT r.player_id, r.`rank`, r.points FROM rankings AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT player_id, MAX(date) AS max_date FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) AS latest ON r.player_id = latest.player_id AND r.date = latest.max_date), PlayerWins AS (SELECT m.player1_id AS player_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.score LIKE '%-0,%-0' THEN 1 END) AS wins FROM matches AS m GROUP BY m.player1_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT s.player_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_type = 'aces' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS aces, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_type = 'double faults' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS double_faults FROM statistics AS s GROUP BY s.player_id) SELECT p.player_name, (lr.`rank` * 0.5 + COALESCE(pw.wins, 0) * 1.5 + COALESCE(ps.aces, 0) * 0.2 - COALESCE(ps.double_faults, 0) * 0.1) AS performance_score FROM players AS p LEFT JOIN LatestRankings AS lr ON p.player_id = lr.player_id LEFT JOIN PlayerWins AS pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id LEFT JOIN PlayerStats AS ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id ORDER BY performance_score DESC

WITH FacilityAccess AS (SELECT a.facility_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS total_users, COUNT(a.access_id) AS total_accesses, COUNT(a.access_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS avg_accesses_per_user FROM access_logs AS a GROUP BY a.facility_id), FacilityTech AS (SELECT ft.facility_id, GROUP_CONCAT(t.technology_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS technologies_used FROM facility_technologies AS ft INNER JOIN technologies AS t ON ft.technology_id = t.technology_id GROUP BY ft.facility_id) SELECT f.name AS facility_name, fa.total_users, fa.total_accesses, fa.avg_accesses_per_user, ft.technologies_used FROM facilities AS f INNER JOIN FacilityAccess AS fa ON f.facility_id = fa.facility_id LEFT JOIN FacilityTech AS ft ON f.facility_id = ft.facility_id ORDER BY fa.total_accesses DESC

SELECT i.incident_id, i.case_number, i.year, i.type, i.fatal, o.injuries, o.recovery_time, GROUP_CONCAT(s.species_name SEPARATOR ',') AS species_names FROM incidents AS i JOIN incident_locations AS il ON i.incident_id = il.incident_id JOIN locations AS l ON il.location_id = l.location_id JOIN incident_outcomes AS o ON i.incident_id = o.incident_id JOIN incident_sharks AS ish ON i.incident_id = ish.incident_id JOIN shark_species AS s ON ish.species_id = s.species_id WHERE l.water_quality = 'clean' GROUP BY i.incident_id, i.case_number, i.year, i.type, i.fatal, o.injuries, o.recovery_time HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.species_id) > 1

WITH FilteredData AS (SELECT t.region_id, r.region_name, t.density FROM traffic_data AS t JOIN regions AS r ON t.region_id = r.region_id WHERE t.hour BETWEEN 7 AND 10 AND t.weather_conditions = 'sunny' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM incident_reports AS i WHERE i.region_id = t.region_id AND CAST(i.start_time AS SIGNED) <= t.hour AND CAST(i.end_time AS SIGNED) >= t.hour)), AverageDensity AS (SELECT region_id, region_name, AVG(density) AS avg_density FROM FilteredData GROUP BY region_id, region_name), RankedRegions AS (SELECT region_id, region_name, avg_density, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_density DESC) AS density_rank FROM AverageDensity) SELECT region_name FROM RankedRegions WHERE density_rank <= 3

SELECT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN DATE_FORMAT(CAST(time_stamp AS DATETIME), '%w') = '6' THEN 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS traffic_records FROM traffic_data GROUP BY day_of_week

WITH TopParks AS (SELECT v.park_id, p.park_name, SUM(v.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM visits AS v JOIN parks AS p ON v.park_id = p.park_id WHERE v.year = 2022 GROUP BY v.park_id, p.park_name ORDER BY total_visitors DESC LIMIT 5), ParkRevenue AS (SELECT r.park_id, SUM(r.annual_pass * r.total_entries) + SUM(r.per_person * r.total_entries) AS total_revenue, SUM(r.total_entries) AS total_entries FROM revenue AS r WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY r.park_id) SELECT tp.park_name, pr.total_revenue / tp.total_visitors AS average_revenue_per_visitor FROM TopParks AS tp JOIN ParkRevenue AS pr ON tp.park_id = pr.park_id ORDER BY average_revenue_per_visitor DESC

WITH MediaProductions AS (SELECT mp.media_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mp.media_id) AS session_count FROM media_production AS mp), MediaDistributions AS (SELECT md.media_id, SUM(md.quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY md.media_id) AS total_distributed FROM media_distribution AS md), MediaAccesses AS (SELECT ma.media_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ma.media_id) AS access_count, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(ma.session_duration, ' minutes', '') AS SIGNED)) OVER (PARTITION BY ma.media_id) AS total_session_duration FROM media_access AS ma) SELECT mr.title, mr.description, mr.status, mr.creation_date, mr.last_modified_date, mr.tags, mr.file_url, mr.thumbnail_url, COALESCE(mp.session_count, 0) AS session_count, c.company_name, p.performer_name, mt.type_name, mf.format_name, l.language_name, COALESCE(md_distributions.total_distributed, 0) AS total_distributed, COALESCE(md_accesses.access_count, 0) AS access_count, COALESCE(md_accesses.total_session_duration, 0) AS total_session_duration FROM media_records AS mr LEFT JOIN performers AS p ON mr.primary_performer_id = p.performer_id LEFT JOIN companies AS c ON mr.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN media_types AS mt ON mr.media_type_id = mt.type_id LEFT JOIN media_formats AS mf ON mr.format_id = mf.format_id LEFT JOIN languages AS l ON mr.language_id = l.language_id LEFT JOIN MediaProductions AS mp ON mr.media_id = mp.media_id LEFT JOIN MediaDistributions AS md_distributions ON mr.media_id = md_distributions.media_id LEFT JOIN MediaAccesses AS md_accesses ON mr.media_id = md_accesses.media_id ORDER BY mr.title

WITH SharedDatasets AS (SELECT d.dataset_id, d.name AS dataset_name, d.version, ds.user_id, u.name AS user_name, ds.permission, d.created_date, d.updated_date, d.status FROM datasets AS d JOIN dataset_sharing AS ds ON d.dataset_id = ds.dataset_id JOIN users AS u ON ds.user_id = u.user_id), DatasetAttributes AS (SELECT v.variable_id, v.dataset_id, v.name AS variable_name, v.data_type, v.unit, v.description, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(a.name, ': ', a.value) SEPARATOR ', ') AS attribute_details FROM variables AS v LEFT JOIN attributes AS a ON v.variable_id = a.variable_id GROUP BY v.variable_id, v.dataset_id, v.name, v.data_type, v.unit, v.description), CombinedView AS (SELECT sd.dataset_name, sd.version, sd.user_name, sd.permission, sd.created_date, sd.updated_date, sd.status, da.variable_name, da.data_type, da.unit, da.description, da.attribute_details FROM SharedDatasets AS sd LEFT JOIN DatasetAttributes AS da ON sd.dataset_id = da.dataset_id) SELECT CONCAT(dataset_name, ' - ', version, ' - ', user_name, ' - ', permission, ' - ', created_date, ' - ', updated_date, ' - ', status, ' - ', COALESCE(variable_name, 'No Variable'), ' - ', COALESCE(data_type, 'No Type'), ' - ', COALESCE(unit, 'No Unit'), ' - ', COALESCE(description, 'No Description'), ' - ', COALESCE(attribute_details, 'No Attributes')) AS combined_details FROM CombinedView

WITH UserAccessFrequency AS (SELECT user_id, video_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY video_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS user_rank FROM access_logs GROUP BY user_id, video_id), TopAccessedVideos AS (SELECT video_id, access_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY access_count DESC) AS video_rank FROM UserAccessFrequency WHERE user_rank = 1), VideoAnnotations AS (SELECT video_id, GROUP_CONCAT(annotation SEPARATOR ', ') AS video_annotations FROM frame_annotations AS fa INNER JOIN frames AS f ON fa.frame_id = f.frame_id GROUP BY video_id) SELECT v.video_name, u.user_name, tav.access_count, va.video_annotations FROM TopAccessedVideos AS tav INNER JOIN UserAccessFrequency AS vaf ON tav.video_id = vaf.video_id AND vaf.user_rank = 1 INNER JOIN videos AS v ON tav.video_id = v.video_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON vaf.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN VideoAnnotations AS va ON tav.video_id = va.video_id WHERE tav.video_rank <= 3 ORDER BY tav.video_rank

SELECT u.user_name, u.department, u.role, e.entity_name, e.iso_code, AVG(al.session_duration) AS average_session_duration, COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_accesses FROM users AS u INNER JOIN access_logs AS al ON u.user_id = al.user_id INNER JOIN entities AS e ON al.data_id = e.entity_id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(al.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '1970' GROUP BY u.user_name, u.department, u.role, e.entity_name, e.iso_code HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_accesses DESC

WITH DailyTraffic AS (SELECT td.site_id, DATE(td.collection_date) AS date, SUM(td.total_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles FROM traffic_data AS td GROUP BY td.site_id, DATE(td.collection_date)), SiteDetails AS (SELECT dt.site_id, dt.date, dt.total_vehicles, ms.site_name, ms.location, ms.latitude, ms.longitude FROM DailyTraffic AS dt INNER JOIN monitoring_sites AS ms ON dt.site_id = ms.site_id), DailyRanks AS (SELECT sd.site_id, sd.date, sd.total_vehicles, sd.site_name, sd.location, sd.latitude, sd.longitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.date ORDER BY sd.total_vehicles DESC) AS daily_rank, SUM(sd.total_vehicles) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.date) AS daily_total_vehicles, AVG(sd.total_vehicles) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.date) AS daily_avg_vehicles FROM SiteDetails AS sd), MonthlyTraffic AS (SELECT dr.site_id, dr.date, dr.total_vehicles, dr.site_name, dr.location, dr.latitude, dr.longitude, dr.daily_rank, dr.daily_total_vehicles, dr.daily_avg_vehicles, DATE_FORMAT(CAST(dr.date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(dr.total_vehicles) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(dr.date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m')) AS monthly_total_vehicles, AVG(dr.total_vehicles) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CAST(dr.date AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m')) AS monthly_avg_vehicles FROM DailyRanks AS dr) SELECT mt.month, mt.site_id, mt.site_name, mt.location, mt.latitude, mt.longitude, mt.total_vehicles, mt.daily_rank, mt.daily_total_vehicles, mt.daily_avg_vehicles, mt.monthly_total_vehicles, mt.monthly_avg_vehicles FROM MonthlyTraffic AS mt WHERE mt.daily_rank <= 5 ORDER BY mt.month, mt.daily_rank

SELECT dp.id AS data_point_id, dp.bool_col AS bool_value, ds.data_source_name AS source_name, dc.data_category_name AS category_name, dsc.data_subcategory_name AS subcategory_name, du.data_unit_name AS unit_name, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(dpc.comment SEPARATOR '; '), 'No comments') AS comments FROM data_points AS dp JOIN data_sources AS ds ON dp.data_source_id = ds.data_source_id JOIN data_categories AS dc ON dp.data_category_id = dc.data_category_id JOIN data_subcategories AS dsc ON dp.data_subcategory_id = dsc.data_subcategory_id JOIN data_units AS du ON dp.data_unit_id = du.data_unit_id LEFT JOIN data_point_comments AS dpc ON dp.id = dpc.data_point_id WHERE dp.bool_col = 1 GROUP BY dp.id, dp.bool_col, ds.data_source_name, dc.data_category_name, dsc.data_subcategory_name, du.data_unit_name

WITH ResearcherCounts AS (SELECT `condition`, test_situation, COUNT(DISTINCT researcher_id) AS total_researchers, COUNT(CASE WHEN correct = 1 THEN researcher_id END) AS total_correct_responses FROM experiments GROUP BY `condition`, test_situation) SELECT `condition`, test_situation, total_researchers, total_correct_responses, (total_correct_responses * 1.0 / total_researchers) AS average_researcher_success_rate FROM ResearcherCounts ORDER BY `condition`, test_situation

WITH TopSymbols AS (SELECT sp.symbol_id, SUM(tv.volume) AS total_volume FROM stock_prices AS sp JOIN trading_volumes AS tv ON sp.price_id = tv.price_id WHERE sp.time BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' GROUP BY sp.symbol_id ORDER BY total_volume DESC LIMIT 10), SymbolPrices AS (SELECT sp.symbol_id, AVG(CAST(sp.open AS FLOAT)) AS avg_open, AVG(CAST(sp.close AS FLOAT)) AS avg_close FROM TopSymbols AS ts JOIN stock_prices AS sp ON ts.symbol_id = sp.symbol_id WHERE sp.time BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' GROUP BY sp.symbol_id), UserCounts AS (SELECT sp.symbol_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS unique_users FROM TopSymbols AS ts JOIN stock_prices AS sp ON ts.symbol_id = sp.symbol_id JOIN access_logs AS al ON sp.price_id = al.price_id WHERE al.access_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' GROUP BY sp.symbol_id), FinalResults AS (SELECT sp.symbol_id, sp.avg_open, sp.avg_close, uc.unique_users FROM SymbolPrices AS sp JOIN UserCounts AS uc ON sp.symbol_id = uc.symbol_id) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(symbol_id, ': ', avg_open, ' - ', avg_close, ' (Users: ', unique_users, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS result FROM FinalResults

SELECT AVG((CAST(SUBSTRING(arrival_time, 1, 2) AS SIGNED) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(arrival_time, 4, 2) AS SIGNED)) - (CAST(SUBSTRING(departure_time, 1, 2) AS SIGNED) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(departure_time, 4, 2) AS SIGNED))) AS average_flight_duration FROM flights JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE airports.airport_name = 'LAX'

WITH RECURSIVE EventTypeHierarchy AS (SELECT type_id, type_name, parent_type_id, 1 AS level FROM event_types WHERE parent_type_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT et.type_id, et.type_name, et.parent_type_id, eth.level + 1 FROM event_types AS et JOIN EventTypeHierarchy AS eth ON et.parent_type_id = eth.type_id) SELECT e.event_id, e.name, e.start_time, e.description, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.title SEPARATOR ',') AS sources, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(i.name, ' (', ei.role, ')') SEPARATOR ',') AS involved_individuals, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.image_url SEPARATOR ',') AS images, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT v.video_url SEPARATOR ',') AS videos, LEAD(e.event_id) OVER (ORDER BY e.event_id) AS next_event_id FROM events AS e JOIN event_event_type AS eet ON e.event_id = eet.event_id JOIN EventTypeHierarchy AS eth ON eet.type_id = eth.type_id LEFT JOIN event_individual AS ei ON e.event_id = ei.event_id LEFT JOIN individuals AS i ON ei.individual_id = i.individual_id LEFT JOIN event_source AS es ON e.event_id = es.event_id LEFT JOIN sources AS s ON es.source_id = s.source_id LEFT JOIN images AS m ON e.event_id = m.event_id LEFT JOIN videos AS v ON e.event_id = v.event_id WHERE eth.level <= 2 GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name, e.start_time, e.description ORDER BY e.event_id

WITH RecentFeedbackCTE AS (SELECT uf.emulator_id, uf.comments, uf.feedback_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uf.emulator_id ORDER BY uf.feedback_date DESC) AS row_num FROM user_feedback AS uf WHERE LOCATE('improvement', uf.comments) > 0) SELECT e.emulator_name FROM emulators AS e INNER JOIN RecentFeedbackCTE AS rfc ON e.emulator_id = rfc.emulator_id WHERE rfc.row_num = 1

WITH WeatherTopData AS (SELECT w.station_id, w.year, w.avg_temp, w.max_temp, w.min_temp, w.rainfall, w.snowfall, w.thunderstorms, w.fog_days, w.tornadoes, w.hail_reports, w.quality_flags, w.data_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.station_id, w.year ORDER BY w.avg_temp DESC) AS rn FROM weather_data AS w), TopRecords AS (SELECT wd.station_id, wd.year, wd.avg_temp, wd.max_temp, wd.min_temp, wd.rainfall, wd.snowfall, wd.thunderstorms, wd.fog_days, wd.tornadoes, wd.hail_reports, wd.quality_flags, wd.data_id FROM WeatherTopData AS wd WHERE wd.rn = 1), StationInfo AS (SELECT ws.station_id, ws.station_name, ws.location FROM weather_stations AS ws), ProcessingStats AS (SELECT dpj.data_id, COUNT(*) AS total_jobs, SUM(CASE WHEN dpj.job_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_jobs, SUM(CASE WHEN dpj.job_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_jobs FROM data_processing_jobs AS dpj GROUP BY dpj.data_id), AccessStats AS (SELECT a.data_id, COUNT(*) AS total_accesses, AVG(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.access_duration AS DATETIME), '%s') AS SIGNED)) AS avg_access_duration FROM access_logs AS a GROUP BY a.data_id), FinalQuery AS (SELECT tr.year, si.station_name, si.location, tr.avg_temp, tr.max_temp, tr.min_temp, tr.rainfall, tr.snowfall, tr.thunderstorms, tr.fog_days, tr.tornadoes, tr.hail_reports, tr.quality_flags, COALESCE(ps.total_jobs, 0) AS total_jobs, COALESCE(ps.completed_jobs, 0) AS completed_jobs, COALESCE(ps.failed_jobs, 0) AS failed_jobs, COALESCE(ac.total_accesses, 0) AS total_accesses, COALESCE(ac.avg_access_duration, 0) AS avg_access_duration FROM TopRecords AS tr INNER JOIN StationInfo AS si ON tr.station_id = si.station_id LEFT JOIN ProcessingStats AS ps ON tr.data_id = ps.data_id LEFT JOIN AccessStats AS ac ON tr.data_id = ac.data_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS overall_record_count FROM FinalQuery

WITH ParameterAccess AS (SELECT param_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count, MAX(access_date) AS last_access_date FROM access_logs GROUP BY param_id), ParameterValues AS (SELECT param_id, AVG(value) AS average_value FROM parameter_values GROUP BY param_id), ParameterNotes AS (SELECT param_id, note FROM notes WHERE priority = 1), ParameterConditions AS (SELECT param_id, `condition` FROM conditions WHERE priority = 1), DiagramDetails AS (SELECT pv.param_id, GROUP_CONCAT(td.diag_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS diag_names, GROUP_CONCAT(td.category SEPARATOR ', ') AS categories, GROUP_CONCAT(td.version SEPARATOR ', ') AS versions FROM parameter_values AS pv INNER JOIN timing_diagrams AS td ON pv.diag_id = td.diag_id GROUP BY pv.param_id) SELECT tp.param_name, tp.description, COALESCE(pa.access_count, 0) AS access_count, COALESCE(pa.last_access_date, 'Never') AS last_access_date, COALESCE(pv.average_value, 0) AS average_value, COALESCE(dd.diag_names, 'None') AS diag_names, COALESCE(dd.categories, 'None') AS categories, COALESCE(dd.versions, 'None') AS versions, COALESCE(pn.note, 'None') AS note, COALESCE(pc.`condition`, 'None') AS `condition` FROM timing_parameters AS tp LEFT JOIN ParameterAccess AS pa ON tp.param_id = pa.param_id LEFT JOIN ParameterValues AS pv ON tp.param_id = pv.param_id LEFT JOIN DiagramDetails AS dd ON tp.param_id = dd.param_id LEFT JOIN ParameterNotes AS pn ON tp.param_id = pn.param_id LEFT JOIN ParameterConditions AS pc ON tp.param_id = pc.param_id ORDER BY tp.param_name

SELECT e.event_id, e.name AS event_name, et.type_name AS event_type, GROUP_CONCAT(i.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS involved_individuals, COUNT(es.source_id) AS source_count FROM events AS e INNER JOIN event_event_type AS eet ON e.event_id = eet.event_id INNER JOIN event_types AS et ON eet.type_id = et.type_id LEFT JOIN event_individual AS ei ON e.event_id = ei.event_id LEFT JOIN individuals AS i ON ei.individual_id = i.individual_id LEFT JOIN event_source AS es ON e.event_id = es.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name, et.type_name HAVING COUNT(es.source_id) > 1

WITH EmissionsTotal AS (SELECT facility_id, SUM(amount) AS total_emission FROM emissions WHERE emission_type IN ('CO2', 'NOx') GROUP BY facility_id), WasteTotal AS (SELECT facility_id, SUM(amount) AS total_waste FROM waste_generation JOIN waste_types AS wt ON wt.waste_type_id = waste_generation.waste_type_id WHERE wt.waste_type_name IN ('Solid Waste', 'Liquid Waste') GROUP BY facility_id), FacilityImpact AS (SELECT COALESCE(et.facility_id, wt.facility_id) AS facility_id, COALESCE(et.total_emission, 0) AS total_emission, COALESCE(wt.total_waste, 0) AS total_waste, COALESCE(et.total_emission, 0) + COALESCE(wt.total_waste, 0) AS total_environmental_impact FROM EmissionsTotal AS et LEFT OUTER JOIN WasteTotal AS wt ON et.facility_id = wt.facility_id UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(et.facility_id, wt.facility_id) AS facility_id, COALESCE(et.total_emission, 0) AS total_emission, COALESCE(wt.total_waste, 0) AS total_waste, COALESCE(et.total_emission, 0) + COALESCE(wt.total_waste, 0) AS total_environmental_impact FROM EmissionsTotal AS et RIGHT OUTER JOIN WasteTotal AS wt ON et.facility_id = wt.facility_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM EmissionsTotal AS et WHERE et.facility_id = wt.facility_id)) SELECT f.facility_name, fi.total_environmental_impact FROM FacilityImpact AS fi JOIN facilities AS f ON fi.facility_id = f.facility_id ORDER BY fi.total_environmental_impact DESC

WITH CountryGDPComparison AS (SELECT c.country_id, c.country_name, d.gdp_per_capita AS current_gdp_per_capita, hd.gdp_per_capita AS past_gdp_per_capita, d.gdp_per_capita - hd.gdp_per_capita AS gdp_growth FROM countries AS c JOIN demographics AS d ON c.country_id = d.country_id JOIN historical_data AS hd ON c.country_id = hd.country_id AND hd.year = 2020 WHERE d.gdp_per_capita > 50000), OfficialLanguages AS (SELECT country_id, language_name FROM languages WHERE is_official = 1), OrganizationalInvolvement AS (SELECT country_id, GROUP_CONCAT(organization_name SEPARATOR ',') AS organizations FROM country_organizations AS co JOIN organizations AS o ON co.organization_id = o.organization_id WHERE o.organization_type = 'Regional' GROUP BY country_id) SELECT cg.country_name, ol.language_name, oi.organizations, cg.gdp_growth FROM CountryGDPComparison AS cg JOIN OfficialLanguages AS ol ON cg.country_id = ol.country_id JOIN OrganizationalInvolvement AS oi ON cg.country_id = oi.country_id ORDER BY cg.gdp_growth DESC

WITH AnnotatedImagesCTE AS (SELECT ia.annotation_id, ia.image_id, ia.user_id, ia.annotation_date, ia.comments, ia.annotation_type, ia.confidence_level, i.class_id, i.path, i.format, i.resolution, i.dataset_id, i.capture_date, i.source, c.class_name, c.description, u.username, u.email, u.role, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ia.image_id ORDER BY ia.confidence_level DESC) AS annotation_rank FROM image_annotations AS ia INNER JOIN images AS i ON ia.image_id = i.image_id INNER JOIN classes AS c ON i.class_id = c.class_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON ia.user_id = u.user_id), FilteredAnnotations AS (SELECT ai.image_id, ai.class_id, ai.path, ai.format, ai.resolution, ai.dataset_id, ai.capture_date, ai.source, ai.class_name, ai.description, ai.username, ai.email, ai.role, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ai.comments, ' (', ai.annotation_date, ', ', ai.annotation_type, ', Confidence: ', ai.confidence_level, ')') SEPARATOR ',') AS annotation_details FROM AnnotatedImagesCTE AS ai WHERE ai.annotation_rank <= 3 GROUP BY ai.image_id, ai.class_id, ai.path, ai.format, ai.resolution, ai.dataset_id, ai.capture_date, ai.source, ai.class_name, ai.description, ai.username, ai.email, ai.role) SELECT fa.image_id, fa.class_id, fa.path, fa.format, fa.resolution, fa.dataset_id, fa.capture_date, fa.source, fa.class_name, fa.description, fa.username, fa.email, fa.role, fa.annotation_details, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.image_id) AS total_annotations_per_image FROM FilteredAnnotations AS fa

WITH ChurnedCustomers AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, ch.churn_date, ch.churn_reason FROM customers AS c JOIN churn AS ch ON c.customer_id = ch.customer_id WHERE ch.has_churned = 1), CustomerUsage AS (SELECT u.customer_id, s.service_name, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM `usage` AS u JOIN services AS s ON u.service_id = s.service_id GROUP BY u.customer_id, s.service_name), LastBill AS (SELECT customer_id, total_charge, bill_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY bill_date DESC) AS rn FROM bills), FinalBill AS (SELECT customer_id, total_charge, bill_date FROM LastBill WHERE rn = 1) SELECT CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS customer_name, c.email, c.churn_date, c.churn_reason, COALESCE(u.service_name, 'N/A') AS service_name, COALESCE(u.total_usage, 0) AS total_usage, COALESCE(fb.total_charge, 0) AS total_charge, COALESCE(fb.bill_date, 'N/A') AS bill_date FROM ChurnedCustomers AS c LEFT JOIN CustomerUsage AS u ON c.customer_id = u.customer_id LEFT JOIN FinalBill AS fb ON c.customer_id = fb.customer_id ORDER BY c.churn_date, c.first_name, c.last_name

WITH GameOutcomePoints AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(score) AS outcome_points FROM game_outcomes GROUP BY player_id), TournamentPoints AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(points) AS tournament_points FROM user_tournaments WHERE status IN ('registered', 'playing', 'eliminated', 'winner') GROUP BY user_id), UserTotalPoints AS (SELECT COALESCE(gop.player_id, tp.user_id) AS user_id, COALESCE(gop.outcome_points, 0) + COALESCE(tp.tournament_points, 0) AS total_points FROM GameOutcomePoints AS gop LEFT OUTER JOIN TournamentPoints AS tp ON gop.player_id = tp.user_id UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(gop.player_id, tp.user_id) AS user_id, COALESCE(gop.outcome_points, 0) + COALESCE(tp.tournament_points, 0) AS total_points FROM GameOutcomePoints AS gop RIGHT OUTER JOIN TournamentPoints AS tp ON gop.player_id = tp.user_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM GameOutcomePoints AS gop WHERE gop.player_id = tp.user_id)) SELECT u.username, utp.total_points FROM UserTotalPoints AS utp JOIN users AS u ON utp.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY utp.total_points DESC

WITH TimeOffDays AS (SELECT emp_id, SUM(num_days) AS total_time_off_days FROM time_off_requests WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(start_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY emp_id), TotalSalaries AS (SELECT emp_id, SUM(CAST(salary_amount AS FLOAT)) AS total_salary FROM salaries WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(salary_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY emp_id), PerformanceRatings AS (SELECT emp_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_performance_rating FROM performance_evaluations WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(eval_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY emp_id) SELECT e.emp_id, COALESCE(tod.total_time_off_days, 0) AS total_time_off_days, COALESCE(ts.total_salary, 0) AS total_salary, COALESCE(pr.avg_performance_rating, 0) AS avg_performance_rating FROM employees AS e LEFT JOIN TimeOffDays AS tod ON e.emp_id = tod.emp_id LEFT JOIN TotalSalaries AS ts ON e.emp_id = ts.emp_id LEFT JOIN PerformanceRatings AS pr ON e.emp_id = pr.emp_id

WITH latest_comments AS (SELECT c.experiment_id, MAX(c.timestamp) AS latest_timestamp FROM comments AS c GROUP BY c.experiment_id), latest_comment_details AS (SELECT c.experiment_id, c.comment FROM comments AS c JOIN latest_comments AS lc ON c.experiment_id = lc.experiment_id AND c.timestamp = lc.latest_timestamp) SELECT e.experiment_id, AVG(e.training_time) AS average_training_time, lcd.comment AS latest_comment FROM experiments AS e LEFT JOIN latest_comment_details AS lcd ON e.experiment_id = lcd.experiment_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(e.experiment_start_time AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2023' GROUP BY e.experiment_id, lcd.comment ORDER BY average_training_time DESC

WITH UserSessions AS (SELECT u.user_name, s.session_id, a.activity_name, s.duration, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(s.duration, ' min', '') AS SIGNED) DESC) AS session_rank FROM sessions AS s INNER JOIN activities AS a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_name = 'Alice Johnson' AND a.activity_name = 'basketball') SELECT user_name, session_id, activity_name, duration FROM UserSessions WHERE session_rank <= 3

WITH RankedAccessRequests AS (SELECT u.user_name, al.access_date, al.duration, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY al.duration DESC) AS request_rank FROM access_logs AS al INNER JOIN users AS u ON al.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN access_requests AS ar ON al.request_id = ar.access_request_id INNER JOIN `databases` AS db ON al.database_id = db.database_id INNER JOIN access_types AS at ON al.access_type_id = at.access_type_id WHERE db.database_id IN (1, 2) AND al.status = 'success' AND ar.status = 'approved' AND at.access_type_name IN ('SSH', 'Admin Console')) SELECT user_name, access_date FROM RankedAccessRequests WHERE request_rank = 1

SELECT u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.annotation_id) AS total_annotations, SUM(`if`.file_size) AS total_file_size, AVG(mp.accuracy) AS average_accuracy, AVG(mp.`precision`) AS average_precision, AVG(mp.recall) AS average_recall, AVG(mp.f1_score) AS average_f1_score FROM users AS u JOIN image_annotations AS ia ON u.user_id = ia.user_id JOIN images AS i ON ia.image_id = i.image_id JOIN model_performance AS mp ON i.dataset_id = mp.dataset_id JOIN image_files AS `if` ON i.image_id = `if`.image_id WHERE i.dataset_id = 1 GROUP BY u.username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.annotation_id) > 0

WITH SequenceDetails AS (SELECT s.sequence_id, s.sequence_accession, s.sequence_description, s.sequence_type, s.sequence_length, s.sample_date, c.country_name, ta.taxon_name AS taxon_name, sg.subgenus_name AS subgenus_name, i.isolate_name AS isolate_name FROM sequences AS s JOIN countries AS c ON s.country_id = c.country_id JOIN taxons AS ta ON s.taxon_id = ta.taxon_id JOIN subgenuses AS sg ON s.subgenus_id = sg.subgenus_id JOIN isolates AS i ON s.isolate_id = i.isolate_id), SequenceMetadata AS (SELECT sm.sequence_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sm.metadata_key, ': ', sm.metadata_value) SEPARATOR ',') AS metadata_info FROM sequence_metadata AS sm GROUP BY sm.sequence_id), SequenceAnnotations AS (SELECT sa.sequence_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sa.annotation_type, ': ', sa.annotation_value) SEPARATOR ',') AS annotation_info FROM sequence_annotations AS sa GROUP BY sa.sequence_id), SequenceVariants AS (SELECT sv.sequence_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sv.variant_type, ': ', sv.variant_nucleotide, ' at position ', sv.variant_position) SEPARATOR ',') AS variant_info FROM sequence_variants AS sv GROUP BY sv.sequence_id) SELECT sd.sequence_accession, sd.taxon_name, sd.subgenus_name, sd.isolate_name, sd.sequence_length, sd.sequence_type, sd.sample_date, sd.country_name, sd.sequence_description, COALESCE(sm.metadata_info, '') AS metadata, COALESCE(sa.annotation_info, '') AS annotations, COALESCE(sv.variant_info, '') AS variants FROM SequenceDetails AS sd LEFT JOIN SequenceMetadata AS sm ON sd.sequence_id = sm.sequence_id LEFT JOIN SequenceAnnotations AS sa ON sd.sequence_id = sa.sequence_id LEFT JOIN SequenceVariants AS sv ON sd.sequence_id = sv.sequence_id ORDER BY sd.sequence_accession

WITH SanJoseRoutes AS (SELECT route_id, route_name FROM routes WHERE city_id = (SELECT city_id FROM cities WHERE city_name = 'San Jose')), RouteStops AS (SELECT sr.route_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_stops FROM stop_routes AS sr JOIN SanJoseRoutes AS sjr ON sjr.route_id = sr.route_id GROUP BY sr.route_id), RouteFrequencies AS (SELECT sr.route_id, AVG(CASE WHEN service_frequency LIKE '% every %' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(service_frequency, LENGTH('every ') + 1, LOCATE(' minutes', service_frequency) - LENGTH('every ') - 1) AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS average_frequency FROM stop_routes AS sr JOIN SanJoseRoutes AS sjr ON sjr.route_id = sr.route_id GROUP BY sr.route_id) SELECT sjr.route_name, COALESCE(rs.number_of_stops, 0) AS number_of_stops, COALESCE(rf.average_frequency, 0) AS average_frequency FROM SanJoseRoutes AS sjr LEFT JOIN RouteStops AS rs ON sjr.route_id = rs.route_id LEFT JOIN RouteFrequencies AS rf ON sjr.route_id = rf.route_id ORDER BY sjr.route_name

WITH LatestPriceData AS (SELECT p.asset_id, p.date AS latest_date, p.open_price, p.high_price, p.low_price, p.close_price, p.volume, p.adjusted_close, p.dividend_yield, p.pe_ratio, p.data_source FROM price_data AS p INNER JOIN (SELECT asset_id, MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_data GROUP BY asset_id) AS latest ON p.asset_id = latest.asset_id AND p.date = latest.max_date), UserInteraction AS (SELECT a.asset_id, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count, AVG(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CAST(al.access_date AS DATETIME), '%J') AS FLOAT)) AS average_access_date, COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS unique_users FROM assets AS a LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al ON a.asset_id = al.asset_id GROUP BY a.asset_id), DataQualityIssues AS (SELECT dq.asset_id, COUNT(dq.log_id) AS issue_count, MAX(dq.issue_severity) AS max_severity FROM data_quality_logs AS dq GROUP BY dq.asset_id) SELECT a.name, a.ticker, a.asset_type, a.industry_sector, a.market_cap, lp.latest_date, lp.open_price, lp.high_price, lp.low_price, lp.close_price, lp.volume, lp.adjusted_close, lp.dividend_yield, lp.pe_ratio, lp.data_source, ui.access_count, ui.average_access_date, ui.unique_users, dq.issue_count, dq.max_severity FROM assets AS a LEFT JOIN LatestPriceData AS lp ON a.asset_id = lp.asset_id LEFT JOIN UserInteraction AS ui ON a.asset_id = ui.asset_id LEFT JOIN DataQualityIssues AS dq ON a.asset_id = dq.asset_id ORDER BY a.market_cap DESC, a.ticker ASC

`lag`.access_time AS latest_access_time, `lag`.action AS latest_access_action, `lag`.ip_address AS latest_access_ip, `lag`.user_agent AS latest_access_user_agent, `lag`.location AS WITH CandidateFinancing AS (SELECT cf.candidate_id, SUM(cf.amount_supported) AS total_supported, SUM(cf.amount_opposed) AS total_opposed FROM campaign_financing AS cf GROUP BY cf.candidate_id), VotingCandidates AS (SELECT vr.candidate_id, vr.legislation_id, vr.legislation_name FROM voting_records AS vr WHERE vr.legislation_id = 101) SELECT c.candidate_id, c.name, cf.total_supported, cf.total_opposed, GROUP_CONCAT(ig.group_name SEPARATOR ',') AS supporting_groups FROM candidates AS c INNER JOIN CandidateFinancing AS cf ON c.candidate_id = cf.candidate_id INNER JOIN VotingCandidates AS vc ON c.candidate_id = vc.candidate_id INNER JOIN candidate_interest_groups AS cig ON c.candidate_id = cig.candidate_id INNER JOIN interest_groups AS ig ON cig.group_id = ig.group_id WHERE cf.total_supported > 100000 AND cig.association_type = 'supporter' GROUP BY c.candidate_id, c.name, cf.total_supported, cf.total_opposed ORDER BY cf.total_supported DESC LIMIT 5

WITH SalesGrowth AS (SELECT s.outlet_id, c.category_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN s.item_outlet_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_period_1, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' THEN s.item_outlet_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_period_2, ((SUM(CASE WHEN s.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' THEN s.item_outlet_sales ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN s.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN s.item_outlet_sales ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN s.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN s.item_outlet_sales ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS sales_growth_percentage FROM sales AS s INNER JOIN items AS i ON s.item_id = i.item_id INNER JOIN item_categories AS c ON i.item_category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY s.outlet_id, c.category_name), FilteredSalesGrowth AS (SELECT sg.outlet_id, sg.category_name, sg.sales_growth_percentage FROM SalesGrowth AS sg WHERE sg.sales_growth_percentage > 20) SELECT fsg.outlet_id, fsg.category_name, fsg.sales_growth_percentage FROM FilteredSalesGrowth AS fsg ORDER BY fsg.sales_growth_percentage DESC

WITH GamePlayerStats AS (SELECT g.game_id, p.player_name, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.game_id ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_in_game FROM games AS g JOIN statistics AS s ON g.game_id = s.game_id JOIN players AS p ON s.player_id = p.player_id) SELECT game_id, GROUP_CONCAT(player_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS top_scorers FROM GamePlayerStats WHERE rank_in_game <= 3 GROUP BY game_id ORDER BY game_id

WITH AgentPerformance AS (SELECT s.agent_id, a.agent_name, COUNT(c.contract_id) AS total_contracts, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.total_price, '$', ''), ',', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_sales_value, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.commission, '$', ''), ',', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_commission, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.total_price, '$', ''), ',', '') AS SIGNED)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_transactions AS s JOIN contracts AS c ON s.contract_id = c.contract_id JOIN sales_agents AS a ON c.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE s.transaction_type = 'sale' AND c.status = 'signed' AND c.contract_type = 'sale' GROUP BY s.agent_id, a.agent_name), UnitSales AS (SELECT c.unit_id, u.unit_name, t.type_name, COUNT(c.contract_id) AS total_sales, SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.total_price, '$', ''), ',', '') AS SIGNED)) AS total_revenue FROM contracts AS c JOIN units AS u ON c.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN property_types AS t ON u.type_id = t.type_id WHERE c.status = 'signed' AND c.contract_type = 'sale' GROUP BY c.unit_id, u.unit_name, t.type_name) SELECT ap.agent_name, ap.total_contracts, ap.total_sales_value, ap.total_commission, ap.sales_rank, us.unit_name, us.type_name, us.total_sales, us.total_revenue FROM AgentPerformance AS ap LEFT JOIN UnitSales AS us ON ap.agent_id = us.unit_id ORDER BY ap.sales_rank

SELECT AVG(pl.years_of_experience) AS avg_years_of_experience FROM programming_languages AS pl INNER JOIN `databases` AS db ON pl.respondent_id = db.respondent_id WHERE pl.language = 'Haskell' AND db.`database` = 'Oracle 12c' AND db.proficiency_level = 'Advanced'

SELECT sp.poverty_level_id, COUNT(s.school_id) AS number_of_schools, SUM(d.total_donations) AS total_donations FROM schools AS s JOIN school_poverty AS sp ON s.school_id = sp.school_id JOIN donations AS d ON s.school_id = d.school_id WHERE s.enrollment < 1000 AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(d.donation_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY sp.poverty_level_id

WITH SalesByWeek AS (SELECT sd.week_id, sd.store_id, SUM(CAST(sd.quantity AS SIGNED)) AS total_quantity, SUM(CAST(sd.revenue AS FLOAT)) AS total_revenue, SUM(CAST(sd.cost AS FLOAT)) AS total_cost, AVG(CAST(sd.gross_margin AS FLOAT)) AS avg_gross_margin FROM sales_data AS sd INNER JOIN stores AS st ON sd.store_id = st.store_id WHERE st.location = 'Los Angeles' GROUP BY sd.week_id, sd.store_id) SELECT sbw.week_id, sbw.store_id, sbw.total_quantity, sbw.total_revenue, sbw.total_cost, sbw.avg_gross_margin, SUM(sbw.total_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY sbw.store_id ORDER BY sbw.week_id) AS cumulative_quantity, SUM(sbw.total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY sbw.store_id ORDER BY sbw.week_id) AS cumulative_revenue, SUM(sbw.total_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY sbw.store_id ORDER BY sbw.week_id) AS cumulative_cost FROM SalesByWeek AS sbw INNER JOIN weeks AS wk ON sbw.week_id = wk.week_id WHERE wk.week_number BETWEEN 1 AND 12 ORDER BY sbw.store_id, sbw.week_id

WITH ComponentMetrics AS (SELECT c.component_id, c.component_name, AVG(cm.sn74) AS avg_sn74, AVG(cm.abt) AS avg_abt FROM components AS c INNER JOIN performance_metrics AS cm ON c.component_id = cm.component_id GROUP BY c.component_id, c.component_name), ComponentPermissions AS (SELECT cp.component_id, u.username, cp.permission_level FROM user_component_permissions AS cp INNER JOIN users AS u ON cp.user_id = u.user_id), ComponentVersions AS (SELECT v.component_id, GROUP_CONCAT(v.version SEPARATOR ', ') AS versions FROM component_versions AS v GROUP BY v.component_id), ComponentOverallMetrics AS (SELECT cm.component_id, cm.component_name, (cm.avg_sn74 + cm.avg_abt) / 2 AS overall_performance_score FROM ComponentMetrics AS cm) SELECT om.component_id, om.component_name, om.overall_performance_score, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.username SEPARATOR ',') AS users_with_permissions, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.permission_level SEPARATOR ',') AS permission_levels, v.versions FROM ComponentOverallMetrics AS om LEFT JOIN ComponentPermissions AS p ON om.component_id = p.component_id LEFT JOIN ComponentVersions AS v ON om.component_id = v.component_id GROUP BY om.component_id, om.component_name, om.overall_performance_score, v.versions ORDER BY om.overall_performance_score DESC

WITH ManufacturerRecalls AS (SELECT m.manufacturer_id, m.manufacturer_name, ra.recall_id, ra.audit_date, ra.audit_type, ra.audit_result FROM manufacturers AS m JOIN recall_audits AS ra ON m.manufacturer_id = ra.recall_id WHERE m.manufacturer_name = 'Philips Medical Systems'), ActionAggregates AS (SELECT ra.recall_id, COUNT(ra.action_id) AS action_count, SUM(CAST(ra.action_cost AS SIGNED)) AS total_action_cost, MAX(ra.action_date) AS latest_action_date FROM ManufacturerRecalls AS mr JOIN recall_actions AS ra ON mr.recall_id = ra.recall_id GROUP BY ra.recall_id), ImpactAggregates AS (SELECT ri.recall_id, COUNT(ri.impact_id) AS impact_count, MAX(ri.impact_assessment_date) AS latest_impact_assessment_date FROM ManufacturerRecalls AS mr JOIN recall_impact AS ri ON mr.recall_id = ri.recall_id GROUP BY ri.recall_id), FinalRecallReport AS (SELECT mr.manufacturer_name, mr.recall_id, mr.audit_date, mr.audit_type, mr.audit_result, COALESCE(aa.action_count, 0) AS action_count, COALESCE(ii.impact_count, 0) AS impact_count, COALESCE(aa.total_action_cost, 0) AS total_action_cost, aa.latest_action_date, ii.latest_impact_assessment_date FROM ManufacturerRecalls AS mr LEFT JOIN ActionAggregates AS aa ON mr.recall_id = aa.recall_id LEFT JOIN ImpactAggregates AS ii ON mr.recall_id = ii.recall_id) SELECT manufacturer_name, recall_id, audit_date, audit_type, audit_result, action_count, impact_count, total_action_cost, latest_action_date, latest_impact_assessment_date FROM FinalRecallReport ORDER BY audit_date DESC

SELECT SUM(td.total_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles FROM traffic_data AS td JOIN monitoring_sites AS ms ON td.site_id = ms.site_id WHERE td.weather_condition = 'clear' AND ms.site_name = 'Elm St & 2nd Ave' AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(td.collection_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2018'

WITH AccessSummary AS (SELECT u.user_name, a.event_id, y.year_name, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count, MIN(a.access_date) AS first_access, MAX(a.access_date) AS last_access FROM users AS u JOIN user_access AS a ON u.user_id = a.user_id JOIN events AS e ON a.event_id = e.event_id JOIN years AS y ON e.year = y.year_id GROUP BY u.user_name, a.event_id, y.year_name), PrevYearAccess AS (SELECT a.event_id, u.user_id, COUNT(*) AS prev_year_access_count FROM user_access AS a JOIN years AS y ON DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = y.year_name JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(a.access_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = (SELECT year_name FROM years WHERE year_name < (SELECT MAX(year_name) FROM years)) GROUP BY a.event_id, u.user_id), AccessWithPrevYear AS (SELECT asum.user_name, asum.event_id, asum.year_name, asum.access_count, asum.first_access, asum.last_access, COALESCE(pya.prev_year_access_count, 0) AS prev_year_access_count FROM AccessSummary AS asum LEFT JOIN PrevYearAccess AS pya ON asum.event_id = pya.event_id AND asum.user_name = (SELECT user_name FROM users WHERE user_id = pya.user_id)), EventDetails AS (SELECT awpy.user_name, awpy.event_id, awpy.year_name, awpy.access_count, awpy.first_access, awpy.last_access, awpy.prev_year_access_count, e.date, e.holiday, e.type, e.is_recurring, ed.historical_context FROM AccessWithPrevYear AS awpy JOIN events AS e ON awpy.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN event_details AS ed ON awpy.event_id = ed.event_id) SELECT ed.user_name, ed.event_id, ed.year_name, ed.access_count, ed.first_access, ed.last_access, ed.prev_year_access_count, ed.date, ed.holiday, ed.type, ed.is_recurring, ed.historical_context FROM EventDetails AS ed ORDER BY ed.year_name DESC, ed.user_name, ed.event_id

WITH PlayerPerformance AS (SELECT tr.player_id, t.tournament_id, tr.`rank`, tr.comp_score, tr.rounds_won, CASE WHEN tr.`rank` <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS top3, CASE WHEN tr.`rank` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wins FROM tournament_results AS tr JOIN tournaments AS t ON tr.tournament_id = t.tournament_id), PlayerAggregate AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(`rank`) AS avg_rank, SUM(top3) AS top3_finishes, SUM(wins) AS wins, COUNT(tournament_id) AS tournaments_played, SUM(comp_score) AS total_comp_score, SUM(rounds_won) AS total_rounds_won, SUM(wins) * 1.0 / COUNT(tournament_id) AS win_rate FROM PlayerPerformance GROUP BY player_id), TeamAggregate AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.team_id, AVG(pp.`rank`) AS team_avg_rank, SUM(pp.comp_score) AS team_total_comp_score, SUM(pp.rounds_won) AS team_total_rounds_won FROM PlayerPerformance AS pp JOIN players AS p ON pp.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.team_id), FinalStats AS (SELECT pa.player_id, pa.avg_rank, pa.top3_finishes, pa.wins, pa.tournaments_played, pa.total_comp_score, pa.total_rounds_won, pa.win_rate, ta.team_avg_rank, ta.team_total_comp_score, ta.team_total_rounds_won FROM PlayerAggregate AS pa LEFT JOIN TeamAggregate AS ta ON pa.player_id = ta.player_id) SELECT fs.player_id, p.player_name, t.team_name, fs.avg_rank, fs.top3_finishes, fs.wins, fs.tournaments_played, fs.total_comp_score, fs.total_rounds_won, fs.win_rate, fs.team_avg_rank, fs.team_total_comp_score, fs.team_total_rounds_won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fs.win_rate DESC, fs.avg_rank ASC) AS overall_rank FROM FinalStats AS fs JOIN players AS p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id JOIN teams AS t ON p.team_id = t.team_id ORDER BY overall_rank

WITH FundingAllocationsQuery AS (SELECT fs.source_id, fa.year_id, fa.amount, COUNT(fa.allocation_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fs.source_id) AS total_allocations, AVG(fa.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY fs.source_id) AS average_allocation, tf.total_amount, RAND() AS random_identifier FROM funding_sources AS fs JOIN funding_allocations AS fa ON fs.source_id = fa.source_id JOIN total_funding AS tf ON fs.source_id = tf.source_id WHERE fs.active_status = 1 AND fa.year_id = 1) SELECT source_id, year_id, amount, total_allocations, average_allocation, total_amount, random_identifier FROM FundingAllocationsQuery WHERE total_amount > average_allocation

SELECT o.order_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.discount_amount, o.tax_amount, o.expected_delivery_date, sm.method_name AS shipping_method, sm.cost AS shipping_cost, sm.estimated_delivery_time, o.shipping_date, (o.total_amount - o.discount_amount + o.tax_amount) AS net_amount, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, GROUP_CONCAT(i.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS ordered_items, o.customer_notes, o.admin_notes, c.email AS customer_email, c.address AS customer_address, c.communication_preferences, c.preferred_payment_method, c.last_purchase_date, c.total_spent, os.status_name AS order_status, CASE WHEN os.status_name LIKE '%completed%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS order_completion_status FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN items AS i ON oi.item_id = i.item_id INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN shipping_methods AS sm ON o.shipping_method_id = sm.shipping_id INNER JOIN order_statuses AS os ON o.status = os.status_id WHERE o.total_amount - o.discount_amount + o.tax_amount > 100 GROUP BY o.order_id, c.name, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.discount_amount, o.tax_amount, o.expected_delivery_date, sm.method_name, sm.cost, sm.estimated_delivery_time, o.shipping_date, o.customer_notes, o.admin_notes, c.email, c.address, c.communication_preferences, c.preferred_payment_method, c.last_purchase_date, c.total_spent, os.status_name ORDER BY net_amount DESC

WITH UserPreferences AS (SELECT user_id, preferred_genre, preferred_tempo_range, preferred_loudness_range FROM user_preferences), TrackDetails AS (SELECT t.track_id, t.track_title, a.genre AS artist_genre, t.tempo, t.loudness FROM tracks AS t JOIN artists AS a ON t.artist_id = a.artist_id), MatchedTracks AS (SELECT up.user_id, td.track_id, td.track_title, td.artist_genre, td.tempo, td.loudness, tr.rating FROM UserPreferences AS up JOIN TrackDetails AS td ON up.preferred_genre = td.artist_genre LEFT JOIN track_ratings AS tr ON td.track_id = tr.track_id AND up.user_id = tr.user_id WHERE (td.tempo BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_tempo_range, 1, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_tempo_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_tempo_range, LOCATE('-', up.preferred_tempo_range) + 1) AS FLOAT) OR up.preferred_tempo_range IS NULL) AND (td.loudness BETWEEN CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_loudness_range, 1, LOCATE(' to ', up.preferred_loudness_range) - 1) AS FLOAT) AND CAST(SUBSTRING(up.preferred_loudness_range, LOCATE(' to ', up.preferred_loudness_range) + 4) AS FLOAT) OR up.preferred_loudness_range IS NULL)), UserTrackRatings AS (SELECT mt.user_id, mt.track_id, mt.track_title, AVG(mt.rating) AS average_rating_per_track FROM MatchedTracks AS mt GROUP BY mt.user_id, mt.track_id, mt.track_title) SELECT utr.user_id, utr.track_title, AVG(utr.average_rating_per_track) AS overall_average_rating FROM UserTrackRatings AS utr GROUP BY utr.user_id, utr.track_title ORDER BY utr.user_id, utr.track_title

WITH UsagePerPeriod AS (SELECT u.usage_id, u.word_id, u.date, u.usage_count, h.period_id, h.start_year, h.end_year, h.period_name FROM usage_stats AS u JOIN historical_periods AS h ON u.date BETWEEN CONCAT(h.start_year, '-01-01') AND CONCAT(h.end_year, '-12-31')), CumulativeUsage AS (SELECT p.period_id, p.period_name, p.word_id, SUM(p.usage_count) OVER (PARTITION BY p.period_id ORDER BY p.date) AS cumulative_usage_count FROM UsagePerPeriod AS p) SELECT cu.period_id, p.period_name, cu.cumulative_usage_count FROM CumulativeUsage AS cu JOIN historical_periods AS p ON cu.period_id = p.period_id ORDER BY p.start_year, cu.cumulative_usage_count

WITH PaidCustomers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM payments), CustomerServiceUsage AS (SELECT u.customer_id, s.service_name, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM `usage` AS u JOIN services AS s ON u.service_id = s.service_id WHERE u.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM PaidCustomers) GROUP BY u.customer_id, s.service_name), RecentPlanChanges AS (SELECT pc.customer_id, pc.change_date, pc.change_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.customer_id ORDER BY pc.change_date DESC) AS rn FROM plan_changes AS pc WHERE pc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM PaidCustomers)) SELECT CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS customer_name, csu.service_name, csu.total_usage, rpc.change_date, rpc.change_type FROM customers AS c JOIN CustomerServiceUsage AS csu ON c.customer_id = csu.customer_id LEFT JOIN RecentPlanChanges AS rpc ON c.customer_id = rpc.customer_id AND rpc.rn = 1 WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM PaidCustomers) ORDER BY c.customer_id, csu.service_name

SELECT v.variant_id, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count, GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS accessing_users FROM variants AS v JOIN access_logs AS a ON v.variant_id = a.variant_id JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY v.variant_id HAVING COUNT(a.access_id) > 1

SELECT e.name AS pathogen_name, `of`.factor_description AS contributing_factor, cs.symptom_description AS symptom, COUNT(c.case_id) AS case_count FROM outbreaks AS o INNER JOIN etiologies AS e ON o.etiology_id = e.etiology_id INNER JOIN outbreak_factors AS `of` ON o.outbreak_id = `of`.outbreak_id INNER JOIN cases AS c ON o.outbreak_id = c.outbreak_id INNER JOIN case_symptoms AS cs ON c.case_id = cs.case_id WHERE `of`.factor_description = 'Cross-contamination' GROUP BY e.name, `of`.factor_description, cs.symptom_description HAVING COUNT(c.case_id) > 1 ORDER BY case_count DESC

SELECT c.country_id, AVG(efi.property_rights) AS average_property_rights FROM countries AS c INNER JOIN economic_freedom_indices AS efi ON c.country_id = efi.country_id INNER JOIN economic_policies AS ep ON c.country_id = ep.country_id WHERE CAST(REPLACE(c.population, ',', '') AS SIGNED) > 10000000 AND ep.year = 2019 GROUP BY c.country_id HAVING COUNT(ep.policy_id) > 0

SELECT c.hexadecimal_value AS HexValue, COUNT(a.access_id) AS AccessCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name SEPARATOR ',') AS Users FROM characters AS c INNER JOIN access_logs AS a ON c.char_id = a.char_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE NOT c.ascii_value IS NULL GROUP BY c.hexadecimal_value HAVING COUNT(a.access_id) > 1 ORDER BY AccessCount DESC

WITH FilteredData AS (SELECT id, age, workclass_id, maritalstatus_id, education_id, race_id, sex_id, capitalgain, capitalloss, hoursperweek, income_id, date_collected, source, data_quality_score FROM demographic_data WHERE race_id = 1 AND nativecountry_id = 0), DetailedInfo AS (SELECT fd.id, fd.age, wc.workclass_name, ms.maritalstatus_name, ed.education_name, fd.capitalgain, fd.capitalloss, fd.hoursperweek, inc.income_name, fd.date_collected, fd.source, fd.data_quality_score, CAST(TRIM('[]' FROM inc.income_range) AS FLOAT) AS income_range FROM FilteredData AS fd INNER JOIN workclasses AS wc ON fd.workclass_id = wc.workclass_id INNER JOIN maritalstatuses AS ms ON fd.maritalstatus_id = ms.maritalstatus_id INNER JOIN educations AS ed ON fd.education_id = ed.education_id INNER JOIN incomes AS inc ON fd.income_id = inc.income_id), IncomeAnalysis AS (SELECT di.id, di.age, di.workclass_name, di.maritalstatus_name, di.education_name, AVG(di.income_range) OVER (PARTITION BY di.workclass_name, di.maritalstatus_name) AS avg_income_range, SUM(di.capitalgain - di.capitalloss) OVER (ORDER BY di.date_collected) AS cumulative_gainloss, di.hoursperweek FROM DetailedInfo AS di), FinalAnalysis AS (SELECT DISTINCT ia.workclass_name, ia.maritalstatus_name, ia.education_name, ia.avg_income_range, ia.cumulative_gainloss, ia.hoursperweek FROM IncomeAnalysis AS ia) SELECT fa.workclass_name, fa.maritalstatus_name, fa.education_name, fa.avg_income_range, fa.cumulative_gainloss, fa.hoursperweek FROM FinalAnalysis AS fa ORDER BY fa.avg_income_range DESC

SELECT r.facility_id, r.compartment_id, r.resource_type_id, r.unit, SUM(r.amount) AS total_consumption FROM resource_consumption AS r JOIN notifications AS n ON r.facility_id = n.facility_id AND r.compartment_id = n.compartment_id AND DATE_FORMAT(CAST(r.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CAST(n.timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y-%m-%d') WHERE r.timestamp BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-01-02' GROUP BY r.facility_id, r.compartment_id, r.resource_type_id, r.unit HAVING SUM(r.amount) > 100

WITH UsageCumulative AS (SELECT us.date, us.usage_count, SUM(us.usage_count) OVER (ORDER BY us.date) AS cumulative_usage FROM usage_stats AS us JOIN words AS w ON us.word_id = w.word_id WHERE w.word_form = 'report' AND w.status = 'active'), WordDetails AS (SELECT w.word_id, w.word_form, w.pos, w.usage_count AS total_usage, w.source, w.etymology, w.last_updated, w.status, c.category, c.category_type, t.synonym, t.source AS synonym_source FROM words AS w LEFT JOIN categories AS c ON w.word_id = c.word_id AND c.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN thesaurus_entries AS t ON w.word_id = t.word_id AND t.status = 'active' WHERE w.word_form = 'report' AND w.status = 'active') SELECT uc.date, uc.cumulative_usage, wd.word_form, wd.pos, wd.total_usage, wd.source, wd.etymology, wd.last_updated, wd.status, wd.category, wd.category_type, wd.synonym, wd.synonym_source, hp.period_name, hp.start_year, hp.end_year FROM UsageCumulative AS uc CROSS JOIN WordDetails AS wd JOIN historical_periods AS hp ON uc.date BETWEEN CONCAT(hp.start_year, '-01-01') AND CONCAT(hp.end_year, '-12-31') ORDER BY uc.date

SELECT u.user_name, f.feature_name FROM users AS u JOIN comparisons AS c ON u.user_id = c.user_id JOIN edition_features AS ef ON c.selected_editions LIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(ef.edition_id AS CHAR), '%') JOIN features AS f ON ef.feature_id = f.feature_id WHERE f.is_advanced = 1 AND u.is_active = 1

WITH ConfigBuildLogs AS (SELECT bl.config_id, bl.build_environment, COUNT(*) AS build_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN bl.build_status = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS build_successes, SUM(CASE WHEN bl.build_status = 'Failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS build_failures FROM build_logs AS bl GROUP BY bl.config_id, bl.build_environment), ConfigDependencies AS (SELECT c.config_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dependencies, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_shared = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shared_dependencies FROM configurations AS c LEFT JOIN dependencies AS d ON c.config_id = d.config_id GROUP BY c.config_id), ConfigurationsWithDetails AS (SELECT c.config_id, c.config_version, c.build_environment, cb.build_attempts, cb.build_successes, cb.build_failures, cd.total_dependencies, cd.shared_dependencies, c.created_by, c.last_modified_by, u1.username AS creator, u2.username AS last_modifier FROM configurations AS c LEFT JOIN ConfigBuildLogs AS cb ON c.config_id = cb.config_id LEFT JOIN ConfigDependencies AS cd ON c.config_id = cd.config_id LEFT JOIN users AS u1 ON c.created_by = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN users AS u2 ON c.last_modified_by = u2.user_id), UserRoles AS (SELECT up.user_id, up.config_id, u.role, MAX(up.created_date) AS permission_creation_date FROM user_permissions AS up INNER JOIN users AS u ON up.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY up.user_id, up.config_id, u.role) SELECT c.config_id, (SELECT CONCAT('Configuration ', c.config_version, ' in ', c.build_environment, ': ', CASE WHEN c.build_attempts = 0 THEN 'No builds yet.' ELSE CONCAT('Builds: ', c.build_attempts, ', Successes: ', c.build_successes, ', Failures: ', c.build_failures, '. ', 'Dependencies: ', c.total_dependencies, ', Shared: ', c.shared_dependencies, '. ', 'Created by: ', c.creator, ', Last modified by: ', c.last_modifier, '. ', 'Latest user roles: ', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ur.role, ' (since ', ur.permission_creation_date, ')') SEPARATOR ',')) END) FROM UserRoles AS ur WHERE ur.config_id = c.config_id GROUP BY ur.config_id) AS config_summary FROM ConfigurationsWithDetails AS c ORDER BY c.config_id

WITH DraftSchools AS (SELECT school_id FROM performance_reports WHERE report_status = 'draft'), SATScores AS (SELECT s.school_id, s.school_name, AVG(ss.avg_critical_reading) AS avg_critical_reading, AVG(ss.avg_math) AS avg_math, AVG(ss.avg_writing) AS avg_writing, SUM(ss.num_test_takers) AS total_test_takers FROM schools AS s JOIN sat_scores AS ss ON s.school_id = ss.school_id WHERE s.school_id IN (SELECT school_id FROM DraftSchools) GROUP BY s.school_id, s.school_name), TopInterventions AS (SELECT i.school_id, i.description, i.status FROM interventions AS i WHERE i.school_id IN (SELECT school_id FROM DraftSchools) ORDER BY i.school_id, i.date_initiated DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT s.school_name, sss.avg_critical_reading, sss.avg_math, sss.avg_writing, sss.total_test_takers, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ti.description, ' (', ti.status, ')') SEPARATOR ', ') AS interventions FROM schools AS s JOIN SATScores AS sss ON s.school_id = sss.school_id LEFT JOIN TopInterventions AS ti ON s.school_id = ti.school_id WHERE s.school_id IN (SELECT school_id FROM DraftSchools) GROUP BY s.school_name, sss.avg_critical_reading, sss.avg_math, sss.avg_writing, sss.total_test_takers ORDER BY s.school_name

generated_sql: WITH LegislationVotes AS (SELECT vr.legislation_id, vr.legislation_name, vr.legislation_description, SUM(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'Not Voting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_voting FROM voting_records AS vr WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(vr.vote_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' GROUP BY vr.legislation_id, vr.legislation_name, vr.legislation_description), LegislationSupport AS (SELECT vr.legislation_id, AVG(cf.amount_supported) AS avg_supported, AVG(cf.amount_opposed) AS avg_opposed FROM voting_records AS vr JOIN campaign_financing AS cf ON vr.candidate_id = cf.candidate_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(vr.vote_date AS DATETIME), '%Y') = '2022' AND cf.year = 2022 GROUP BY vr.legislation_id), LegislationAnalysis AS (SELECT lv.legislation_id, lv.legislation_name, lv.legislation_description, lv.yes_votes, lv.no_votes, lv.not_voting, ls.avg_supported, ls.avg_opposed, (lv.yes_votes - lv.no_votes) AS vote_difference FROM LegislationVotes AS lv JOIN LegislationSupport AS ls ON lv.legislation_id = ls.legislation_id) SELECT la.legislation_name, la.legislation_description, la.avg_supported, la.avg_opposed, la.yes_votes, la.no_votes, la.not_voting, la.vote_difference FROM LegislationAnalysis AS la ORDER BY la.vote_difference DESC LIMIT 1
